title: Discover Berlin Half-Day Walking Tour
description: See many of Berlin's most important landmarks and highlights, with informative commentary from your guide, on this half-day walking tour of Mitte. Learn insider information on the German city's different eras, stretching from modern times back through the Cold War, Nazi, Imperial, and Prussian time periods. Other stops on this jam-packed guided tour include Checkpoint Charlie, the Holocaust Memorial, the rebuilt Reichstag, Brandenburg Gate, and the Berlin Wall.

reviews.usertext:
We were in Berlin for 3 days and were keen to discover as much as we could about the city so we booked a walking tour with Original Berlin Walks, our teenage daughter wasn’t exactly jumping for joy at the prospect but once we met our guide Tom she soon discovered that this tour was not going to be boring! Tom was full of knowledge about the area but did not over load us with too much information, the walk was nicely broken up with stops and he was able to convey all his information in an interesting and entertaining way so we never felt bored or tired. We couldn’t believe how quickly the time passed as we walked and listened to all the fascinating history of Berlin. Tom was very good at encouraging his group to share their thoughts and feelings and kept everyone engaged very well.
We would thoroughly recommend this company if you are looking to see all the major points of interest in Berlin and learn about the history of the place and if you get Tom as your guide count yourself very lucky indeed!

My friends and I enjoyed the tour very much! We appreciated and understood Berlin's history better with Scott's help. He was able to hold everyone's attention with his humor, information, and articulate communication style. I think the tour was a great introduction for us as Berlin first-timers. My friends and I highly recommend the tour - we covered a lot of must-see stops: among others the Berlin Cathedral, Altes Museum, Mother with her Dead Son Sculpture, Humboldt University, Brandenburg Gate, Holocaust Memorial, and a lot more. We're all glad we took part in this tour!

I love walking tours and have taken many. This tour is not free and cost about 20 Euros. But in return you get a qualified guide and the itinerary of the walk is curated so over the 3 plus hours of the tour you see of the key places in Berlin. For a full list of what is covered, read the description. Our guide Annika was great, she conveyed the history of the places we visited but from a local Berliner point of view (she lives in the immediate area). The tour did start at 10:30, took a 30 minute break at Checkpoint Charlie, and ended around 2pm. We did this our first day in the city and it helped us shape our itinerary for the rest of our Berlin visit.

We were lucky enough to have Campbell as our tour guider today. He was extremely knowledgeable & kept a group of 15-20 people entertained throughout the 3-4hr journey. The journey started at Alexander-platz & ended at Checkpoint Charlie. Campbell covered all areas that I would recommend visiting, this is also an amazing way to see the city on foot & get your bearings. If you get Campbell has your tour guide, listen out for his comical impressions. :)))) thank you Campbell!

This tour led by our very knowledgeable and entertaining tour guide Walid, was an invaluable snapshot of Berlin past and present. Walid guided a large group with care and courtesy, pointing out landmarks and their associated history. We walked to places of significance including Museum Island, the remnants of the Berlin Wall, the Holocaust Memorial and finishing at the Brandenburg Gate. Walid's detailed explanation of the origins of the East and West divide, the rise of Nazism ,and the significance played by the early history was a walking museum that was both fascinating and entertaining. I recommend this tour for all those wanting to connect with the historical parts of Berlin. Thank you Walid, for your expertise.

Our tour guide, Scott was amazing! He was very knowledgeable, funny and helpful with his advice on what to do after the tour ended.
You get a 30 min break half way through at the Brandenburg Gate, there is a Starbucks and you need to pay 50cent for use of the bathroom.
We saw everything we wanted to in the 3-4 hours. The tour doesn’t take you to the East side gallery as it’s about a 20min walk away in a different area of the city, but you can easily fit it all in, in one day.
Would definitely recommend this company and Scott!

We met at the assigned spot, that seems like a place for all the tours to start. When we first met Maria, she seemed very soft spoken, and I thought how will I be able to hear her? But after getting us all together, her introduction showed her voice was loud enough for all of us to hear. Our group had 12-15 people, but she kept us together, and the stops were frequent enough for her to keep count. The tour was a mixture of old and new Berlin, with good stories and historic places. A rest stop at “Checkpoint Charlie” was well timed, and the restrooms were good. It’s a good tour to locate places to return to for a longer visit, but Maria gave you just enough time and info to whet your appetite for that spot. We ended at the Brandenburg Gate just over 3 hours after the start, and all questions were answered and directions to various restaurants and sights. All in all, a very good tour for a nice morning walk.

Thoroughly enjoyable tour of Berlin, with a wide ranging and interesting history of the city. Scott didn't just tell us about the facts though; he was very good to go into more detail, and add context beyond the events themselves, which was greatly appreciated and left much to ponder.

Fascinating tour! Would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin for the first time and wanting to see the main locations, and the context behind them. Honestly could have spent another two hours wandering and listening to Scott talk about the cities history!

I did a half day tour with friends on my first trip to Berlin. Xavier was our guide and we had the best experience. He was funny, light-hearted, thoughtful - all which kept a 4+ hour tour of some pretty heavy material quite entertaining. I would absolutely recommend and I would absolutely do another tour with Xavier again (He told me that he also does tours of Sachsenhausen, the concentration camp just north of Berlin). He's probably the best tour guide I've ever had. We had a group of about 13 - from all over the world, which was also a great part of the experience. Wear your walking shoes, and come well rested!

Glen from England was my guide for this group walking tour namely Discover Berlin Tour. I learned so many interesting things, in particular about Hitler’s Bunker, Checkpoint Charlie and the fall of the Berlin Wall.

I would highly recommend the Original Berlin Walks company to anyone thinking of booking a city of Berlin walk tour.

Xavier did a great job giving concise explanations of many complicated issues in Berlin's history. He shared stories and insights I would not have figured out on my own. He was very personable and happy to answer questions in a thoughtful manner. I would recommend this tour to anyone wanting to get a broad scope of Berlin's history!

This was an excellent and informative tour. Pip is a fantastic and personable guide and more importantly an extremely knowledgeable and professional historian. There is no question in my mind that this was worth the small cost over the free walking tours of the city, particularly if you have more than a passing interest in history and all it’s complexity and nuance.

Glen offered wonderful perspectives at a good pace with awesome props. If you have the chance, ask for Glen to take you around. In any case, take this tour at the beginning of your stay.

Walking past museums and sights, Glen told us briefly what was inside each one to give us an idea which ones were worth visiting and/or good value, and even which ones were newly opened. Before every crowded spot, Glen told us what to expect at a quiet corner and then unleashed us into the fray. Glen displayed printed photos of each landmark throughout history, which gave extra dimensions to the tour. He was perfectly prepared, had a strong and clear voice, and made time to answer questions and repeat any important points. Go Glen!

Our tour guide was really funny, enjoyable to talk to and vast amount of knowledge on the city of Berlin. He will make you think about something to which he will make you think about it in the end. Very easy to understand and get your attention, I highly recommend this tour and was good fresh air to hear someone still passionate about history.

Pip was a marvellous guide. With a quirky sense of humour, a talent to tell a narrative and an academic historical knowledge she wowed her eager audience of walkers. A great experience which I would enthusiastically endorse to anyone interested to learn and be entertained about Berlin.

Ryan is a brilliant guide with extensive knowledge that he contextualizes expertly. We took the tour upon our arrival in the city and for the following week we were gifted by the familiarity with the area he had provided us. Ryan's humor, insights, and long view of history are the ideal combination for walking tour host; my wife and I recommend this tour to everyone considering it.

This walking tour if perfect for people wanting to see most of Berlin. Our guide ( heidi) was amazing and very knowledgeable. Would 100% recommend doing this tour on the first couple days in Berlin so you can set up your itinerary for the later part of your trip.

Loved the walking tour with Rebecca. She seeded a deeper curiosity to understand more. We covered a lot of ground and her narrative together with the pictures really helped us get a quick awareness of the legendary city that Berlin is. Definitely recommend this tour

The tour was excellent, very informative and our guide (Walid) helped us to explore the multiple layers of history in Berlin. From start to finish the tour was cram packed with information, and Walid was very happy to chat and answer questions along the way (in fact he encouraged it). It was a great way to start off our visit as it gave us a general idea of the layout of the main city centre. The tour lasted 4 hours in total with a short break in the middle- bring some snacks and water! Would highly recommend.

This was a great walking tour. Our guide Xavier was very considerate of us, frequently checking in, and I learned a lot about the history of Berlin in a short amount of time. Xavier was very knowledgeable and funny, but also very thoughtful when covering the more tragic parts of Germany’s past. He also gave us helpful info about museums/sights that might not be worth it for our current trip because they are undergoing renovation. I would definitely recommend this tour to others.

We had the most fun walking around with Campbell and it was such a beautiful day to learn all about Germany. And learn we did, but it was learning in a fun way! Campbell made it fun and informative. We discussed everything from the very early days of the city to the fall of the Berlin Wall. Campbell had the right amount of humour and the bet way to describe things. Even though it was only 3 hours I could easily spend the whole day listening to Campbell discuss all things Germany.
Campbell also allowed everyone to mingle (after all you are spending 3 hours walking with these people so its good to get to know one and another) the pit stop was at the perfect time.
Highly recommend if you are in Berlin

An excellent and interesting tour. Our guide, Scott, was very knowledgeable and engaging. Would definitely recommend, especially towards the start of your trip as it gives you a great idea of what you would like to do for the remainder of your time in Berlin, as well as get your bearings around the city centre.

Our guide Gregor was brilliant and brought the history of the city throughout history to life. I would recommend doing this tour early in your visit as it made it much easier to choose attractions and choose which sites to buy entry to. Gregor also made the tour extremely interactive with the group and was very engaging. Well worth the price.

Sarah, our guide, clearly loved Berlin, and this really came through in the way she talked about the city, its history and particularly its evolution since WWII. We learned an incredible amount in the few hours that we were with her, including some sights that we had previously walked past, blithely unaware of their existence! This was the perfect activity to do on the first morning after our arrival. We felt like we had such a good appreciation of Berlin after our tour, and were able to make the most of our remaining days there using the information that Sarah gave us. Highly recommended!

Absolutely fantastic tour with Jacob. Told the story of this amazing place with the perfect balance of storytelling, sensitivity and sympathy to the ordinary inhabitants of the city down the ages. Starting just round the corner from Museum Island, and ending at Checkpoint Charlie, this tour packs a lot in to the 4 hours. A 'must do' in this remarkable city.

Really great walking tour with Campbell on a scorching hot day! We covered several centuries (!) of local history, but focused mostly on Berlin's role in WWII and the Cold War. An interesting route around the centre of the city at a good pace. Campbell was knowledgable, funny, and made sure we stopped in the shade where possible. (He even brought some sunscreen for us to borrow — thank you!) Highly recommend this tour, especially for first-time visitors eager to get acquainted with the city quickly.

Rebecca did a great job by explaining every checkpoint and encouraging the group to ask questions. I really liked that she shared what she liked or disliked the most on every topic she talked about. highly recommend this tour and Rebecca!!

Super easy booking / ticket / reminder process.
Met at Hackescher Markt by tour guides who split the larger group into two. We where a mix of Nationalities, couples, families and solo travellers, the pace and content of the tour pitched just right for the mixed group. Eran by far and away the perfect tour guide. Provided plenty of background and anecdotes without taking anything away from the story to be told. Took the tour on my first trip to Berlin and would recommend to any first timers to book onto an original Berlin walks tour. Already eyeing up a different theme tour for my next trip. Couldn’t fault it.

Thoroughly enjoyed our 4 hour walking tour with Tobi on Thursday,18 Aug. We’ve done city tours in Barcelona, Rome, Prague, Vienna and other European cities and Tobi was the best guide we’ve had so far. We really appreciated his knowledge, passion, humor and fun. We highly recommend this tour and if you can sign up with Tobi even better.

We did this 4 hour tour with Tobi as our guide . He was very entertaining, pitched it perfectly for our group of 20, explaining the facts very well and told funny stories to keep everyone’s interest. Coffee stop half way round . Highly recommended!

We had the pleasure of tour guide Rebecca's company on this tour and cannot recommend it, and her, enough. She taught us a huge amount of Berlin's history, mixing the somber with the hopeful and delivering it all with conciseness and wisdom. An excellent way to learn about the city and its people, and learn fascinating things about some sites you may just walk past on a normal day. We have come out with recommendations on where to visit next, and more of an appreciation of many aspects of Germany and Berlin. It was a suitable tour for young and older people with a break in the middle. Rebecca in particular was friendly, knowledgeable and enthusiastic about her job. Thank you very much; well worth the money and time.

أنا محبطة قليلاً من هذه الجولة، في هذه الجولة شعرت أكثر أنني في محاضرة تاريخ قائدة الجولة كانت تتجاوب مع الأسئلة بشكل لا بأس به، تجيب على بعض الأسئلة والبعض الآخر تقول أنها لا تعرف إجابته كنت أتطلع للمعرفة أكثر عن تاريخ برلين الاجتماعي والثقافي من وجهة نظر السكان الأصليين، شعرت أن قائد الجولة كانت تفتقد لروح البلد، أعتقد أنه لو قام بهذه الجولة شخص ألماني ربما عاش لمدة أطول في ألمانيا أو برلين لربما وصلنا الإحساس بشكل أقوى بالمدينة

I am a little disappointed with this tour, on this tour I felt more like I was in a history lecture. The tour guide was responding to questions quite well, answering some questions and others saying that she did not know the answer. I was looking forward to learning more about Berlin's social and cultural history from the point of view of local people, I felt that the tour guide was missing the spirit of the country, I think if a German had done this tour, maybe he had lived longer in Germany or Berlin, we might have got a stronger sense of the city

This tour was absolutely incredible and one of the top highlights of our trip to Berlin. Our tour guide Rebecca was fantastic, she gave just the right important information and kept everyone interested the whole tour. She pointed out things you wouldn’t have spotted when walking around and really changed our whole view of the city. It was a perfect balance. Would definetly reccomend this to everyone travelling to this city. Thankyou so much!

Tobi was such a great host - he was incredibly knowledgeable, engaging and authentic. His personal experiences were of such value to the tour and the tour provided such an educational and interactive explanation of the buildings, plazas and why they hold/held significance. So much more meaningful than simply walking around on our own.

This was a wonderful way to gain an introduction to Berlin and our host, Jacob, was an informative, knowledgeable and entertaining host. We have three boys aged 11, 14 and a 17 year old (studying History and armed already with some knowledge); Jacob’s delivery style ensured there was something of interest for all of them along with their aged parents! Excellent value, highly recommended. Ask for Jacob if you can!

Brilliant information and recap of Berlin history at the start. Lovely guide gave us warning about the rain and gave us time to grab an umbrella before the downpour of rain! And evenbin terrible conditions gave us a great experience. I would say having a small amount of knowledge going in is good and try to participate to create a better atmosphere and makes it less stilted. Go in knowing what you want to ask as the tour guide is a fount of knowledge and encouraged question. Also very moving and sombre parts were talked about very respectfully and the entire tour and recounting of history was done with enthusiasm. No preprepared monologues in a monotone voice, obviously takes great pride in teaching people.

This was a tour included with out Welcome Berlin All Inclusive card. We did this tour on 1st September with Xavier... He was a great guide very informative with good humour thrown in too... There is a lot to take in and he will tell you that it's impossible to cover all of Berlin and its history in a half day tour but he really does cover a good expanse of history and shows us small things we would never have seen or noticed without him. He will cover any questions chatting to each of the group as you walk round.

We did this on our last day in Berlin and really wish we had done it on our first day! It take about 4-4.5hrs and there is a stop for lunch/coffee/snacks at a small cafe near the Jewish memorial. The food was very reasonably priced too.

Next time I'm in Berlin I would definitely love to do another tour with them (and hopefully the same tour guide)!

Just back from Berlin so like all good tourists who want to get a good all round feel for the place we booked in for a English speaking tour of the City. Our tour guide was Sam Z, a young university graduate who came to Berlin to do his Masters in History. As you can imagine he really knew his stuff, he gave a brilliant introduction into the history of Berlin. From its very early days up until now, you can tell from the way he speaks about Berlin he really has a passion for the City. The tour is long but with his wit and knowledge he kept us entertained and the time flew by. I would highly recommend anyone to pay the very small charge for this great tour.
Tip- wrap up warm! The weather was bitterly cold and on Sams advice we all had to jump up and down like fools to stop our toes from freezing!
The most interesting 4 hour walking tour brought to life by our wonderful guide Nathan. He gave enough information to inform yet not so much you felt overwhelmed. Couldn’t recommend more highly.

Highly recommend the walking tour: interesting, fun and also educational. We were absolutely thrilled with our tour guide. Tobi was the best tour guide we have had in a long time. Sharing his own experience and memories made it even more compelling to listen. To sum it up: it’s the perfect way to discover and get to know Berlin!

Thanks Tom for a great experience!

My girlfriend and I did this tour on our first morning in Berlin. We both thought that it was fantastic! The information that was shared was great, with pictures to show, good humour from our guide (Tom), a few chances to sit down and get food or toilet.

Definitely recommend it, good price too!
If the weather isn't warm and sunny I recommend taking a warm jacket as it can be chilly when standing in the wind at one spot.

The walk was a great way to find out about the buildings , the history and culture and I recommend it .the group was larger than usual but our guide Glen was an expert at making everyone feel included and drew us all in. My son 26years also enjoyed so relevant for all generations.

Can you just imagine a living story happening around you?Every building, monument, memorandum comes to life and you feel like you are traveling through time.
From feelings of excitement, sadness, shock, laughter, this was a historical roller coaster for me. And believe me,I say it mildly. And you know what the biggest surprise is?To experience it all through the story of one man. It seems that the city can really come to life and history can be repeated, even through words.
All Im just gonna say,his name is Xavier.
Do not miss this for anything in world!

This one was probably one of the best tours I've ever done on a city break (and the longest/best value for money).

Our tour guide was Alex, who was absolutely brilliant and very knowledgable. He went in to a lot of detail at the sights and gave just the right amount of context for the time we had.

I would definitely recommend this tour.

Scottish Sam was excellent. We learnt more about Berlin history in one morning than we did for the whole time we were in school.

Would definitely recommend doing this tour on one of your first days in the city as there was lots of recommendations of places to come back and visit for longer.

Jonny was extremely knowledgeable, very friendly and we had a great group. It was definitely worth every penny and I would really recommend doing it on day 1 to help you get your bearings. Jonny went above and beyond what was expected. A really great tour.

Met outside Starbucks which was very easy to find and after short introduction to Pip our Guide we headed off on our tour.
At our first stop Pip gave us a concise run down of the history that preceded the Berlin walk in a very clear interesting way perfectly delivered! This gave the tone of the trip which was organised and thoroughly enjoyed going from sight to sight. Pip gave the group information and tips of things that might want to then be done or explored in further detail if time in Berlin allowed for this.
The tour ended at the Brandenburg Gate. My daughter and I would personally like to thank Pip for all the history and stories that were shared bringing Berlin alive! We did the trip on our first morning after reading reviews and this worked so well as we were then set to make the most of our time there. THANK-YOU 10/10!

Chris (the CANADIAN one ;) was a wellspring of knowledge, both historical and wildly esoteric. He really brought the history of Berlin alive with color, humor and poignancy. Highly recommend for anyone visiting this city!

Glen Was an absolutely amazing tour guide. He was extremely knowledgeable, very personable, and you can tell he really loved giving this tour and talking about his country. I learned so much, and got to see things that I’ve always wanted to and even more! I would highly recommend this to her to anybody!

Tobi our tour guide was outstanding and as a result provided us with one of the best walking tours we have experienced in Europe. He knew his history of Berlin and its many sites of yesterday and today. His knowledge of World War II and all that emanated from Berlin was delivered objectively, thoughtfully and sometimes with a little humor. It was a pleasure spending half the day in his company. We were not rushed at any point. Excellent value for the $$$. Highly recommend when visiting Berlin.

This is the best way to begin your exploration of Berlin. We went on a 4-hour walk around all the key sites on the first morning of our city break and by the end of it we had a great understanding of Berlin's history, key sites and events that shaped the city and Germany. Our guide was engaging, immensely knowledgeable and presented the information in a fun and understandable manner. Not only was the tour brilliant itself but the context it gave us significantly enhanced the subsequent sites and sights :P we visited in Berlin

I cannot recommend this tour highly enough. Our guide, Tobi, was interesting and knowledgeable and kept up a lively pace, so there was no time to be bored - yet plenty of time to look and ask questions. The tour covers the majority of the 'must-see' landmarks of the city and was a superb introduction to the history, architecture and people of Berlin.

If you’re short on time in Berlin I would recommend this tour to give you an overview. For 14€ it’s a good value for a 3.5 hour tour of the city, seeing some of the main sites. However, I thought the group was too big. Seb B was a great presenter and did his best to engage with the group but him having to turn multiple directions so often meant it was hard to hear everything. The tour is split between 2 parts, the “beautiful” part (Prussian era) and WWI/WWII/Cold War, but the second part was mixed together and harder to follow (although this is because of the route taken, to optimise the number of places visited within the time). Well done Seb B, however tours should be capped at a smaller number for a better experience!

Xavier was an excellent guide. One of our favorite experiences during our visit to Germany. He was witty, informative and kept our group interested the entire time. The wealth of information he shared with us will keep us thinking and pursuing our own reading for a long time.

Could not recommend this enough. So interesting, saw all the main historical sights all in one tour and learnt a lot.
Our tour guide Glen was amazing, he really knew his stuff, could answer everyone’s questions easily and told us so many little details you’d just never know if you went round Berlin by yourself.

Had been meaning to write a review for this tour for awhile - it was amazing! I was in Berlin for work and only had limited time to see the city and this was an amazing way to understand the history and the layout of the city. We got to see all of the sites, and our tour guide had amazing insights and stories to share about everything. I went with a German friend and even she enjoyed herself and learned something new!

The tour was easy to locate at the start and our tour guide created a really welcoming environment and was friendly and open to all questions. Highly recommend!

Glen was an amazing tour guide who obviously has a deep knowledge of the city's history as he has lived here since 1995.
He also showed pictures of the buildings and events as they would have been during/after the war which really helped put everything in context.
He was.also very friendly and gave us recommendations after the tour etc.
Would definitely recommend!

This tour was well worth the cost! My mom and I are visiting Berlin for the weekend after a couple of weeks around France and Germany and this was by far the best touring experience we encountered. We had originally planned on walking around ourselves using the "Rick Stevens" app but ultimately decided to try something new and we're very happy we did!

Georgia, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable about Berlin's history and showed us many interesting spots that we would not have thought to visit. I especially appreciated how she allowed time for us to take pictures at the more popular attractions, ensured we stayed warm by finding less windy stopping points, and was eager to answer questions while we walked. Considering that the tour goes from 10:30am to 2:30pm, I was concerned we would be hungry by the end but a 15 minute stop at a very reasonably priced café was scheduled in!

I would highly recommend this English guided tour to anyone who loves history and wants an overview of (nearly) every sight there is to see in East Berlin!

We have been on the tour with Tobi and can only mention the best about the overall experience. Very informative and as well impressive walk in Berlin with a lot of detailed information about history. Tobi did the tour so good that he was able to get our attention for about four hours - four hours that are really worth to spend if you would like to understand a little bit more and not just take pictures from the most important points in Berlin.

Meeting point was easy to find, tour guide was knowledgeable, friendly, accommodating and interesting. One main down side is it's quite a long tour and the break is scheduled for the tail end. I'd advise the break be somewhere in the middle. Toilet facilities are also surprisingly hard to come by along this route and while it might be difficult to keep track of all the public toilets in the city, perhaps arranging with 1 eatery half way through the tour or having 2 short stops will greatly help participants.

Jacob was an incredible tour guide, he made the experience very enjoyable and was extremely passionate throughout the experience. His love her Berlin shone through as he discussed the history of the city and the different historical landmarks we passed along the way. He was extremely friendly and made the experience very personable. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin. Thank you very much Jacob!

Highly recommended. It is long but there is a break in the middle. We learned so much in a 3 1/2 hour walk through Berlin history. Our guide Nathan did a fantastic job linking that long history of Prussian militarism to defeat of WWI to the deprivation and failed policies that led to the rise of Nazis, to the Cold War and Reunification. The plus was we got to visit places that corresponded to all these events. We did this on the first day of our week long visit and were able to refer back to what we learned over and over.

My boyfriend and I have been to Berlin before and have seen some of the historical landmarks. We had Xavier as our guide and I muss tell, it is rare to come across such a great guide who knows everything about the history of the city and the country. He informed us so nicely and it was a pleasure to listen to him. The tour was well planned, even though it is a 4 hour walking tour, one does not notice that one gets tired at all. Looking forward to joining in another tour!

This was a great way to get to know Berlin on a short visit. The tour takes you by all the major sites in half a day. My guide, Jacob, was extremely knowledgeable about the history of Berlin and made the entire experience so enjoyable. Got to know Berlin in a way I wouldn't have had I done the stops on my own. Felt like I had a personal history teacher with me to brush me up on my lessons and introduce me to totally new facts. Highly, highly recommend.

This was an excellent walking tour - tour guide Dave was superb - he covered off a huge number of historical sites of interest, gave us plenty of time to take a break and he kept us all entertained over the 3.5-4 hours. Cost of the tour is very reasonable and it is a fantastic way to get a flavour of what Berlin has to offer. We used the tour as a way to identify locations and museums we wanted to come back to the following day. Very well organised and easy to locate the starting point.

This little tour packs so much in such little time and with such great value.
Our guide Giorgio was full on informations but also had a funny way of sharing that info, that made the tour even more enjoyable.
I would suggest get to the meeting point 15...20 min before if you haven't been in the area before, there's a beautiful small market around that you can enjoy just before the tour.

We had heard about this tour group from a very old friend who had lived in Berlin for awhile, so signed up for the Discover Berlin tour before we got there. We took the tour on our first full day in Berlin, which was great because it gave us an idea of the layout of they city as well as the ability to go back and see places later that we wanted to explore more. Upon arrival at the Starbucks, we met our guide Jesse who was pronominal. He had a vast knowledge of the history of Berlin and Berlin in general and was able to answer most all the questions asked by the group. His passion for the history and for Berlin showed as it kept my wife and I engaged for the whole four hour walking tour. I just can't say enough about how good he was. Although we were beat by the time it was over, we were also glad to have helped get over our jet lag by doing such a fun and engaging tour. I'd highly recommend this to anyone visiting Berlin and if you're lucky, you'll get Jesse!

We spent a very enjoyable 4 1/2 hours in the company of our guide ‘Izzy’, who was both informative, insightful and passionate about the tour. Her diction being very clear and her knowledge boundless. Taking time to answer questions and also getting the group to question themselves in regard to the history of Berlin and Germany in the 20th century. Asking how we would react in light of the atrocities they took place. This meant the tour was so much more than simply a very well informed guide and her party of tourists.
Whilst 4 1/2 hours seems a long time for a tour, there were breaks to sit and have a coffee and this coupled with manner in which the subject matter was presented by Izzy, meant the time passed very quickly. So I would certainly recommend this tour to anyone who really wants to learn about the history of this City.

Amazing 4 hour walking tour through Berlin.
Our guide Walid was fantastic, very enthusiastic, hilarious and very knowledgeable. The tour includes a 15-20 minute coffee break midway through. Be sure to wear comfortable shoes and bring water.
The tour definitely goes quicker than it feels and despite its length is fairly well contained to the city centre. The tour takes you through many important landmarks and areas in Berlin and you'll learn all about the history of the city itself, not just specific to WWI and WWII but also centuries before and the years leading up to the present.
Absolutely worth the price

Fantastic tour. Got to see plenty of landmarks that covered many aspects of Berlin's history. Our guide Tobi was brilliant and he really brought the tour to life - his interest and enthusiasm really shone through. He was funny or sombre depending on what was most appropriate and his passion was clear to see. He really can really engage the group. The tour was approx 4 hours but honestly would have been delighted if it continued on longer. Tobi was happy to answer any questions too and share some of his own experiences of growing up and living in Germany.

Hosted by Scott this was an informative, thought provoking and interesting tour. Covers a number of sites over a 3 1/2 hour period withgood level of detail/context. Walk despite hot weather felt like a better option than a tyoicql pop on/pop off bus tour

The guide was really nice and covered everything in the perfect amount of time, neither too long nor too short. If you are looking for everything very much in details, going inside the museums and buildings then this tour is not for you. But if you just want to casually roam around and get to know in brief the details about the place, then this is the best tour suited.

The guide entertained all the questions properly and answered them to the perfect satisfaction. Furthermore, he was funny and helped with other queries about the city which weren’t the part of the tour ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The only reason for deducting a star is that the guide wasn’t too loud and if you are little bit behind, you miss onto the things

On Wednesday 8th of June, we had a 3.5hr English-language walking tour with Glen. This was one of the best walking tours I've ever been on and I cannot recommend it enough! He spoke so clearly wirh succinct and relevant information that you could visualise everything which made the experience almost immersive. It really helped us get to know the city and its history. A great thing to do on your first day. Thank you, Glen!

Ciaran our English guide was a great tour guide, very knowledgeable and creative with his approach. Definitely recommend doing a walking tour. Berlin is rich in history, the walking tour covered of many landmarks and provided background on the city and it’s buildings.

This walking tour was superb. Pip was the best tour guide we have had around numerous world cities. Very knowledgeable, easy to listen to, friendly and approachable - a joy to spend time with. We learned so much. The tour is longer than some we have done, but all the better for the range of sites, details and stories we listened to and the time absolutely flew by. Our sons and their partners wished Pip had been their history teacher. A great way to start our 3-day trip to Berlin and orientate us in the city and guide us as to what to see in more depth during our time there. Great value for money.

Probably the most encompassing tour you can take if you have a short stay in Berlin. It was honestly one of the best tours I have taken in general. You see all the major sites in Berlin and you learn so much about the history of the city from the founding of the city all the way until the collapse of the Berlin Wall, you see and cover it all. Our tour guide, Jonathan N, went above and beyond to ensure that we had an awesome time. If you have him as your tour guide, you’re in good hands!

I had a great time with Berlin Walking Tours. Communication was efficient and I was able to make arrangements for a private tour less than a week in advance.

The guide, Kai, was very punctual, and was a historian and a gentleman. We met at my hotel and set off for what ended up as a good four hour or so walking survey of Berlin, including many of the key sites (Brandenburg Gate, Hitler’s Bunker, ‘Checkpoint Charlie’, He didn’t dumb things down, and was able to provide a lot of insights so that we were able to have a more interesting discourse. He also had great suggestions for further exploration, such as the Historical Museum, which was well worth the time.

Kai also told me a bit more about his other work, which I found very inspiring.

The time went by very quickly. Kai’s a good dude for sure, and I’d recommend the tour for anyone.

This was one of the best walking tours I have ever taken. Our guide Jacob was fun, entertaining and very knowledgeable! We walked about 3.5 miles through the city and hit most of the major historical attractions. I would highly recommend this tour.

Our guide Rob was amazing! He taught us a lot about the history of the buildings and town. He also did good reading the group and relating events and stories to us. He definitely knows his history so when we asked questions they were always answered. Overall the walk was pretty easy and he kept a good pace for the group. I’m not normally a tour person but I definitely recommend this tour to get a whole perspective on Berlin. Even at the end he was willing to make sure people knew how to get home or gave us tips on where to go next.

I did this tour with Xavier in June on my Contiki tour and what can I say, he was brilliant and the content he shared was unmatched. He was extremely knowledgeable and was able to give quality information, answer all questions and explain stories in a simple manner - easy to understand. He was super friendly and gave pace to the tour so we didn't "doordle". We also got a chance to stop for coffee along the way as it was a long tour. He gave great recommendations and was very passionate about what he does - would highly recommend a tour with Xavier!

This tour is ideal for getting to know Berlin in about 4 hours and 10000 steps. Xavier was our guide and he was awesome. He led an English tour with a few people who spoke English as a second language (Mexican and Brazilian) he noticed when they looked confused and filled in with Spanish or Portuguese as needed, they glowed. Very knowledgeable about the history of Berlin and speaks in a way that captures your interest. Great sense of humor. Best 20 Euro I spent on my trip.

We took the Discover Berlin 1/2 day walking tour on September 1, 2022. Tobi (TOBS10) was our guide. Tobi was delightful! He was welcoming, cheerful, and knowledgeable. He was funny (when appropriate) and respectful (for example, when discussing the murder of millions of Jews, the disabled, gays and gypsies), the memorial to holocaust victims, etc.). He also shared a little about his life in East Berlin before the wall came down. He always invited questions and made time for everyone. He appears to really enjoy giving the tours and meeting new people.

We wish we could take Tobi's Queer Berlin tour on Saturday, September 3, but we had already made other plans for that day.

Thank you, Tobi!

Our tour guide for the day was Campbell, a graduate student at Humboldt University. He was incredibly knowledgeable about the history of the area, and was very entertaining to boot. We had a great time. Probably one of the best walking tours we went on while in Germany!

4 hours went very quickly as Scott was able to pace the speed and topics very well. He also went further than just naming the sites and events but gave an explanation about why events happened. Really good

Very exception informative tour of historical places and history behind all we toured. Scott from Scotland was engaging, funny, knowledgeable and very receptive to interaction of tour members. Most as you would expect was WWII related but some older historical context was added. Worth every penny.

Highly recommended tour visiting top sites around Berlin city centre. Rob from Manchester has been an amazing tour guide. Full of local knowledge with a great sense of humour. It was fantastic walking around the city with interersting stories about local attractions and key historical buildings. Thank you again for the amazing day!

Went on the walking tour today with our tour guide, Campbell. He did an amazing job of keeping everyone interested, laughing and curious about the hidden history of Berlin. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wishes to get a good understanding and knowledge about the city!

This is a very relaxing and informative walking tour of the city. It was led by Heidi. She has excellent knowledge of each sight/place we visit, makes it a point to make sure every one of us are assembled before she starts talking. The walking tour is really a great introduction to the city and gives us a very good idea of which one esp the museums to cover in detail on our own. Thank you Heidi for an excellent tour!

Amazing walk with our tour guide Xavier today. He was approachable and happy to answer any questions the group had. I’ve seen all the landmarks in Berlin that we had hoped to on a short holiday here. I have gained greater insight and knowledge in to the complex history of this amazing city and I couldn’t recommend the tour more highly!

I took this tour on my first day in Berlin and am so glad I did. The few hours are packed with interesting sights, and the tour covers many of the "must see" Berlin attractions. It really is time well spent. Tobi was our friendly and super-knowledgeable guide. He was full of facts and interesting stories about the various sights. He kept us going at a decent speed that did not at all feel rushed despite the amount of stuff we packed in. Glad we had time to stop off halfway for some ginger tea and donuts. Too many interesting sights on this tour to pick a favourite. In my opinion this is a "must do" tour.

Exceptional. Our guide was Campbell. He majored in history and has a passion for sharing. Very interesting, yet not so much information that you get bored. Me, being from the States, Campbell also shared what life was like in Berlin. (he moved from sunny Australia) This tour was about 4 hrs including a 25 minute break for food/drinks. I usually never take guided tours yet this time I'm glad I did. I really got a lot out of Campbell's information. Really opened up my understanding of Germany's past and how they addressed the Holocaust and other adversities.

James was an excellent guide and very knowledgeable. The tour left on time and 3.5hrs flew by. Great pace to the tour and not as much walking as I thought.. about 10,000 steps. The tour doesn't go to the east side gallery, so I would recommend adding that to your itinerary.

A most fascinating and informative tour! Our guide, Reuben, was outstanding. Berlin has so much history and interesting art commemorating that history. We were asked to experience some of the art first-hand before he told us what it (might) mean, which was a brilliant device. The tour took 4+ hours but never did I think to myself, "I'm beat. When will this end?" Quite the opposite. You won't be disappointed.

All the raving reviews are true. This is an absolute must activity in Berlin. A city with so much history can only be appreciated with an experienced guide. In our case, Ryan was the best guide we’ve ever had. Thoroughly knowledgeable and a pleasure to spend the afternoon with. Highly recommended!

Our guide, Ryan, was extremely knowledgeable about the city and even though it was cold and rainy made the entire tour enjoyable. I would highly recommend doing this tour early in your visit. It gave us a good idea of where we wanted to go back to, see more of and a better overall understanding of the city.

Just spent a fantastic few hours with Walid our tour host. I would say this is the best experience my wife and I have had on a city break. A very enjoyable and educational few hours with a good laugh into the bargain. I would thoroughly recommend this fantastic experience to anyone who wishes to spend some quality time with a very knowledgeable host.

We often will do a walking tour when we first arrive in a city - helps to understand the city and you often get great tips from the guide. Our Berlin walking tour was the best we have ever done. Our guide (Ryan) was excellent and despite the soggy, cold and wet conditions the four or so hours flew by. The kids (19 and 21 yo) also loved it. Thank you Ryan for a great tour!

Fantastic experience! We may have expected a basic tour of buildings and sites, but instead received an A+ education from Ryan! His in-depth knowledge, his ability to make history come alive, his great demeanor all contributed to an excellent tour experience. Further, as tour members asked questions, Ryan went even deeper to explain current or historical events. Just a great experience. Kudos to the tour company for having such excellent guides who are disarming, friendly, and really leave you with a great sense of pride for the city. Wow.

The four hours flew by, Georgia was easily one of the best tour guides I’ve ever had- really funny and informative. I usually zone out when a guide talks for a while, but I listened to every word. She also gave a rough itinerary of the day at the start which always helps. If you have one day in Berlin I would recommend doing this tour as you hit all the main tourist attractions, and if you have longer then I would recommend doing it Day 1 as there are plenty of tips for other things to do.

Had a fantastic day out on the walking tour around Berlin with our guide Kyle, it was great to learn about all the different facts about such a city like Berlin. The guide was also great at ensuring our security throughout the tour, just as Berlin like any city can be a hotspot for pickpockets in large groups. We also got some great tips and advice for our stay in regards to the best sights to visit whilst we were here (honest reviews about the TV tower for example). Amazing value for money and would book with this company again, we were going to do the LGBT tour of Berlin the next day but we slept in! Thanks agin

On my first morning in Berlin, I had the pleasure of taking this 3 1/2+ hour Tour principally of the Mitte Area, led by Polly. This is a popular tour, so the group was good-sized, but from the outset Polly did a superb job of engaging everyone and of providing very critical and constructive historical context for Berlin and Germany, Especially with reference to the unique history of the city post World War II. The pace of the tour was excellent and Polly answered questions and dealt with a wide range of interests very effectively, as well as nimbly handling a wildcard thrown at us, as we found ourselves having to navigate through a large friendly demonstration against current agricultural policies in Germany, complete with placards, floats and a significant presence of tractors.duction to the city of Berlin and to structures of great significance in understanding both history and contemporary . A tremendous introduction to the city of Berlin and two structures of great significance in understanding both history and contemporary Berlin.

A very dark period of history .. this is a sobering tour and important to appreciate what happened. There is so much history in this city and you really need a long weekend to appreciate it.Chloe our guide was very informative and very sensitive to the ages and opinions of the group.. really really recommend the tour company and our tour guide Chloe.

We went on this tour after having already seen a couple of the things that are mentioned in the tour itinerary but it was still very much worth it. It's a lot more interesting to see the sights while hearing about Berlin's rich history. Our guide was Georgia and she did an amazing job, she was very knowledgeable and had a fun way of telling stories. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Fascinating tour encompassing the vast and interesting history of Berlin. Brilliant experience and Eran could answer many questions. The walk is in excess of 3 hours but with a break in the middle and a flat city it is entirely stress free. Highly recommended for all ages. There’s a lot of history here, none of which should be forgotten.

This tour was fantastic. I did this tour on my first day in Berlin and it really helped me understand the city, where I’d like to visit more/other places to go, etc. Jörg, our guide, was incredible. He was knowledgeable and passionate about the city’s history, and was also a great guide! Would highly recommend this tour to anyone.

We met Jonathon K at the meeting point. He was very friendly and chatted to different people along the way. This was my first visit to Berlin and enjoyed the experience very much. I would recommend the walking tour and it’s good to walk around rather than jump on trains or buses as you see
much more.

Fantastic way to orientate yourself and learn about Berlin and it’s history. Jacob (JAKE) was the best guide we’ve had. He managed to make the history come alive and make you feel the history of the city. He included anecdotes and made it relevant to the current times by showing the connections from 750 years ago till today. Very friendly and inclusive to the group, taking time to talk to each of us. The tour was a gentle stroll so you got time to look, photograph and ask questions. It was a great start to our trip and showed us where else we wanted to go. The tour definitely showed us bits of Berlin we would have missed (like the window in the paving, opposite the Humboldt university showing the empty book cases). Hope you get on this tour and get Jake! Highly recommend.

We had Jake as our guide and he was awesome. He kept a good stable pace and we could tell he was passionate about Berlin and it’s history. I definitely recommend people do the tour at the beginning of their trip to get a richer understanding of the history. On the tour, Jake was open to questions and wasn’t monotone, he kept it engaging and fun. He even had a folder of pictures so we could compare the past to now. FYI there is an bathroom break in the middle thankfully to get a warm drink or bathroom run. Also bundle up, since we came in February, it was a bit chilly. Definitely go on the tour, insightful and interesting ! And hope you get Jake- he’s awesome !!

Excellent guided tour by Jess who was extremely knowledgeable and balanced in giving a historical perspective to events that relate to German history and particularly Berlin. It was extremely interesting and picked up all the major tourist highlights for Berlin.
One consideration was that it was possibly overlong at nearly 5 hours. Expected 3 and was told 4 at the start. Not helped by it being a cold day with a biting wind.
Would still recommend it and doing it early in your stay in Berlin as it helps orientation and understanding of this city with its rich history.

Alex was a great guide around Berlin and all of its history. He was witty and gave us a great context of the city and where both older and recent history took place.

The tour takes you from museum island through important landmarks of the 2. World War and The Cold War, and ends at Brandenburger Tor.

Go on the walking tour early on in your journey so you have time to revisit some of the recommended museums, memorials etc afterwards.

Pip really knew her history and made the walk fun as well as interesting. The experience gave us a first class introduction to Berlin which made our short stay in more interesting. We took her up on the tip that the Reichstag restaurant was good and had a great lunch the next day with panoramic views.

A really great tour with lots of information and Xavier the tourguide really takes his time to explain everything. 11/10 would recommand everybody who is going to Berlin and wants to know more about the city. Xavier brings it really all together with thougthfull information and good humor. Thank you for the tour greetings from The Netherlands :)

My hostel in Berlin was advertising this walking tour and I’m so glad I signed up! Xavier was a fantastic guide! He gave just the right amount of information to accompany the sites we visited and was open to questions and comments. He also used humor in a tasteful way that kept the tour light and easygoing. I went on this walking tour on my last day in Berlin so I’d recommend going near the beginning of your trip so you have enough time to check out any of the locations such as museums mentioned or come back to the sites you visited and wish to see for a longer amount of time. Totally recommend Discover Berlin and Xavier!

A group of four of us from the U.S., Sweden and South America took this tour on a Sunday afternoon. We loved every minute of it. Our guide, “Scottish Sam”, was an excellent storyteller. We saw many of the major sites in Berlin and he explained the history of Germany and augmented it with stories of the people who lived through it. He was having such a good time with our group (and we had such a good time with him) that our tour went over 4 hours. The tour was the perfect way for us to learn more about Berlin and Germany in a short amount of time. We all highly recommend this tour and Scottish Sam!!!!

We really loved our walking tour of Berlin. We saw so much of the city in just a few hours, and I would recommend this as a good way to get some ideas on what you would like to explore further (which we did in the next two days)

Lots of walking (obviously) so important to wear comfortable shoes. There was a short stop on the tour where you could grab a drink and bite to eat which was good too. Learnt a lot in a short amount of time - if I was back I would definitely do one of the other tours they offer too.

Johnny brought a great mix of information, passion and irony in this great historical walk of Berlin. His sense of humor kept both this father and his teenage son entertained through the tour. Couldn’t ask for a better day!

Rob from Manchester was our tour guide and even though our group was very large he did an excellent job of showing us the landmarks and explaining everything we needed to know about the history and culture of the city. He was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the city, which made the tour well worth it. Definitely recommend it

Matti our Guide brought Berlin's history to life. Everything was explained.
As a solo traveller, I felt included. Friendly people from all over the world.
Wonderful to see the Holocaust Memorial. Four hours did not seem too long as all the highlights were pointed out and explained. Matti allowed people to ask questions which he always produced answers for.
Definitely recommend this Tour.

Me and my boyfriend went on the walking tour with the most amazing tour guide Glen! He was very knowledgeable and a really friendly guy. On the day it was 32 degrees , glen made sure when we was telling us stories we were kept in the shade. He also offered 50 cent to anyone who needed it for the toilet on our break. Couldn’t recommend this tour more!

We did this tour on our first day in Berlin and I would highly recommend it. The tour orientates you in the city and you get to see some of the major sights. Our tour guide Chris (Canadian Chris) was excellent, his passion for history really shines through.

My husband and I visited Berlin a few days ago for the first time. The very first thing we did was go on a walking tour so we could get familiarized with the city and its history before we went off on our own exploration. Booking this tour was definitely the highlight of our trip! Our guide, Nathan, was absolutely wonderful - he is extremely knowledgable about the history of Berlin, and feeds you the information in such a pleasant way that it does not feel like a boring class lecture. For any of you considering this tour, look no further! THIS is the tour to go on to see most of Berlin an learn about its history!

The tour guide Xavier was excellent - very well-informed, personable, enthusiastic and interesting. He coped extremely well with the different personalities on the tour, kept the group together and answered questions with aplomb. All in all an outstanding tour guide.

Heidi is an amazing guide! I learned a lot about the city’s history from her. We covered so many monuments and sights. I think walking is the best way to tour the city despite Berlin not being particularly pedestrian friendly.

This was the best walking tour we have been on. Our guide ISANNE was infectious with her enthusiasm and incredible depth of knowledge which was delivered in a very accessible and professional way. We stopped at many key sites and learnt facts that were both entertaining and very thought provoking.

The history of Berlin going back to its early growth and all the way up to modern times was covered whilst seeing the evidence in front of us! ISSANE didn't just speak...she introduced ideas that made you think and feel, it is a superbly put together tour that you should not hesitate to go on.

Xavier was our guide, and he gave an excellent tour! After condensing centuries of German history into a digestible summary, he showed us the major highlights of the city, relating them back to the history, and peppering in fun facts and anecdotes. He was approachable and friendly; we felt comfortable asking many questions and he had thoughtful answers. The depth of his knowledge of Germany history was impressive and we all learned a great deal. Moreover, he struck the right balance when switching back and forth between the glamorous and not-so-glamorous parts of Berlin history; no easy feat. With no reservation, I can say it wqs the best historical tour that I have taken in any city.

With just one day to spend in Berlin where do you start? Well you’d be hard pushed to find anything better than this walking tour (followed by a few beers).
We were a little unsure about it at first as neither my partner or I are walkers or history buffs and the thought of a 4 hour trudge around the city on a cold February day was a bit daunting, however from start to finish the tour guide Wouter had us captivated with his knowledge and passion for what is a truly remarkable city. 4 hours went so quickly, we learned so much and saw places we would never have found otherwise and the walking pace was just right.
This is a truly excellent tour!

This was a spur of the moment decision. My husband and I wanted to see the sights of the city and to hear some of the history of Germany. Polly was our guide and she did an amazing job of telling the history of Berlin all the way back to the Prussians and Berlin was a part of both world wars. Highly recommend as a good way to see the layout of the city and important buildings and monuments but also to understand some of Germany's complicated past.

Jess have an amazing tour. He was incredibly knowledgeable, shared some opinions, and was able to answer every question from the group. He had an American accent which made his English very easy to understand. I did this the morning of the first day of my visit and it helped me discover the city and plan the remainder of my stay. Would highly recommend!

I booked the 1030 tour in English and it proved to be a good time to go. We had a short break at lunch and the tour itself took four hours. It didn’t seem that long, as our guide (a history graduate) was excellent and kept our interest while informing us about Berlin’s ancient and recent past. Easy walking on flat terrain (Berlin is thought to derive from an ancient word meaning ‘swamp’) and the tour not only covers all the key sights but is a great way to orientate yourself to the city.

So me and my friend decided to do this walking tour mostly because of all the great reviews despite the fact that I don’t usually like guided tours as I get bored pretty easily and let me just say..WOW. I mean that was pretty awesome! Our tour guide Sam Z was everything you want your tour guide to be - interactive, friendly, funny and engaging. He made something so mundane very interesting, so much so that even after almost 4 hours of walking around in the cold and rain, we were disappointed to see the tour end.

Couldn’t recommend this tour more. Our guide, (Scottish) Sam was absolutely phenomenal. He was incredibly knowledgeable and ended up running over by 30 mins (no one minded!) and stayed extra time after to answer questions individually afterwards.
It was a really great way to see the main sights, especially on a short stay.
This was the best city walking tour I’ve done and I heard another person say the same!

We recently returned to live in Berlin after nearly 20 years away, and when my sister came to visit over the holidays we thought a walking tour would be a good way to get to know the city once again. Well, I ended up discovering a lot that I didn't know already - thanks to Georgia, our superb guide. I really appreciated her vivid storytelling and loved the way the tour was pitched in a way that would engage first-time visitors and still interest people who know the city quite well. At four hours it was long enough - but not too long! Thanks

Very interesting and informative tour of some of the main sites in Berlin. Tobi was excellent guide with first hand stories of East Germany and the wall coming down. I’d recommend doing early in your stay, as the tour will show you places you may want to come back and spend some more time at.

Our guide was very knowledgeable and kept the group interested on a cold 3 hour morning tour. We got to see all of the major sights, some local cultural information and a lot about Berlin and the impact of history on the city itself.
Would recommend to anyone.

Fran was amazing on a 3 hour walking tour, I have been on a few walking tours around Europe and Fran delivered the most in-depth and interesting tour around Berlin. She was very knowledgeable about the history and explained everything with great passion and humour. I would highly recommend for to anyone for a tour of Berlin!

Excellent tour, enjoyable and informative. Our tour guide Jonny was knowledgable and entertaining, and it was the right balance of fun information, Berlin history and city recommendations. Great value, highly recommend.

Wonderful opportunity and a great way to see Berlin, cannot recommend this group/experience enough. Our guide's name was Xavier, who was perfect for the job. (Kind, excellent communicator, and very knowledgeable about the city and sights). Tour kept very interesting and engaging throughout. You get a great view of so much of the city explained to you every step of the way, and detail and history pointed out that you never would've noticed otherwise. Its a multi-hour tour that seems like its over very quickly. Guides available for all major languages, and a break for lunch partway through. I signed up last minute along with my older sister and it stands out as a favorite memory/part of our trip. 10/10, cant go wrong here. "Original Berlin Walks" tour

My mom and I took this tour last fall. Our tour guide (Dave? I think it was?) Was a history student, and sure knew his stuff.

I wasn't sure about a walking tour per se, but it also came highly recommended by another passenger at the airport who has done Berlin Walks tours, many times.

Only thing I'm sad about is that we didn't have time to try out one of their many other tours.

I'd highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants to see a bit of Berlin, learn some history and for a really great price

I definetly recommened this tour to everyone who visits Berlin. This city has such historical value and this tour sums it up pretty effectively. Our tour guide Canadian Chris has excelent knowledge and he is really good at his job. 3.5 hours walk in the cold didn’t even bothered us at all, because the tour is well designed and our guide was professional. Thanks Moon Lord for this lovely tour!

Brilliant tour with Chris (from Canada) and an excellent start to our first trip to Berlin. I've been on many similar tours in different European cities and I'm going to say it: this was the best one I've been on!
Chris's knowledge of the city within the context of Germany's history, and the present, was impressive. He had the perfect balance of information and entertainment.
The tour lasted about 4 hours - that sounds like a long time, but the time flew by, so the pace was just right.
Chris was knowledgeable, articulate, and gave each item on the tour a historical perspective. The tour gave us food for thought long after it was finished.
Thanks Chris (and sorry again that we had no cash to tip you - still feel guilty about that!) Fiona & Nick (22 march)

If you're new to Berlin (or not), this is a great tour as an introduction to a fascinating city.

Our tour guide Georgia was fab, She was so knowledgeable, but also full of passion, you could tell she really loves this city.

As well as the actual tour, she also gave us top tips and insight into other things we could do during our visit. Cannot recommend this tour, or Georgia, enough!

Georgia was a knowledgeable delight; she took us to many of the important historical sites in Berlin, with many anecdotes and stories about them and the people involved. It was a bit warm, so recommend bringing water along. Halfway through we did get a break and fueled back up. Georgia somehow managed to call back to various stories in the earlier parts of the tour later on, which tied everything up for us. Definitely recommend greatly, and if you can tour with Georgia, do it!

Jesse was a brilliant host and guide. His vast knowledge of Berlin and it’s history is second to none. The tour not only helped us understand the effects of the World Wars and Cold War on Berlin and it’s citizens, but also gave us the history that shaped the city into what it is today.

I would recommend any new or frequent visitors of Berlin to participate in the tour.

An excellent tour with a very knowledgeable guide. 100% one of the best ways to see Berlin and all the sights. Our guide was a history expert from Uni, so provided the best historical insights you need to understand the historical and cultural events that have transformed Berlin into the city we identify it was in the 21st century. Remember to check the weather and maybe bring an umbrella! This tour goes on “rain, hail or shine”.

This is our first day in Berlin, and the tour was amazing for us to learn about the rich history behind the city, as well as orientate ourselves. Georgia was a wonderful guide: friendly and helpful, and obviously knew a lot about the history whilst delivering it in an engaging manner. 10/10, had a lovely and educational time, despite the rain!

We took the Discover Berlin Walking Tour yesterday with Matti as our guide. It was a fantastic way to orient ourselves to the main sights in Berlin and as an introduction to the incredible history of the city. Matti was a great guide, delivering short, succinct talks on the history and architecture of Berlin as we walked around the city centre. He was engaging and interesting as a guide and I particularly enjoyed the way he mixed personal stories with the historical overview. His thoughtful style really encouraged me to actively reflect on what I saw.
We also took up some of his recommendations for museums and districts to visit in the evening, which lived up to expectations. I would wholeheartedly recommend this tour and thank Matti for his excellent introduction to Berlin.

Our tour guide Nathan was fantastic. Really knew his German history, gave really in depth explanations at each point, even so much as his own familial connection with Germany. The tour covered all the main points you'd like to see, and didnt feel rushed or like you were walking miles. It's a really beautiful city, and although it's been largely rebuilt since the end of ww2, you can still see remnants such as bullet holes in buildings, which are pointed out during the tour. Overall a brilliant walk through Berlin's history and beautiful architecture!

We had a wonderful time touring around Berlin with Georgia! She did a great jump of telling the history of the city while also sharing things she enjoys about the current state of Berlin and Germany. It is a very informative 4 hours and well worth the investment of half a day. If you can do this at the beginning of your stay it will help you decide places to explore further.

We had a fantastic tour guide ,Scott who was actually Scottish, he was highly entertaining and knowledgeable and had chats with everyone while walking around .even though it was 4 hours of a tour not a bit boring or long winded so time flew by .would highly recommend this tour

Our guide Heidi was very good and quite informative about the Berlin sights we took in such as the Brandenburg Gate, the Holocaust Memorial and Checkpoint Charlie. Weather was warm, remember to bring juice or water with you. There's obviously a bit of walking to do too!

Our guide Chris (the Canadian one) was incredibly knowledgable about all things Berlin. He taught us so much about the history and culture, keeping it fun and light whilst also focusing on the harrowing past of the city. It is a must do tour for this city!

I couldn’t believe the amount of knowledge Sebastian had about the city. He was full of passion and although gave a significant amount of information some which I’ll never be able to remember, everything was so detailed and found ourselves encapsulated by his love and passion of the city.
A great tour, fully recommend and our guide Sebastian was amazing!

Me and my gal pals decided to spend the weekend in Berlin, we decided to book this for our first day there. It was incredible. Our tour guide Matti was one of the best guides that I've ever had. He was able to tell personal stories as well as knew everything about the city. He was funny and kept us interested the entire time. I would recommend this tour to anyone that is visiting.

An excellent introduction to the city and overview of the development of 20th century Berlin. Our guide Scott was a lovely soul and is exceptionally knowledgeable about Berlin and Germany’s history and spoke with great passion and care about the subject. The pace was perfect and Scott paid attention to including everyone and allowing just the right balance between talking, walking and time to ourselves to look longer at certain aspects of the tour. Lots of additional pieces of information you would never know without a guide make it extra special. A great start to our weekend and highly recommended.

We were part of a tour of 29 people, all English. Lynsey was our guide and she was very knowledgeable and personable. She wove in some positive historical info, among the obvious dark past of Berlin and Germany under Nazis. She explained the significance of many spots, including Hitler’s bunker, the square where he gave his speeches and the location of the wall. But she added photos from her book to illustrate how things were through the years. She knows her history! And she engages everyone! She was impressively professional when a fellow tried to join the tour for free, encouraging him to go to a location to pick up the designated free walking tour... she was so polite, he couldn’t refuse! She was a great ambassador for the tour company and for Berlin! Worth the money and your time!

Izzy our tour guide has an impressive in depth knowledge of the city. She spoke passionately about her adopted city of Berlin and gave us periods of self reflection throughout allowing us to visualise how the old Germany might have looked like. She was funny witty and very intelligent just an absolute great way to submerge yourself in the city. Highly recommend this !

Despite appalling weather, Kyle our tour guide was pleasant, with good knowledge and the ability to put her own spin on some of the events, buildings and individuals. Really good explanation on building such as German & French Cathedral and the burning of Jewish books gave a great in site into the history of the City. This is a great tour and well worth the money and time.

I loved the story telling and this is one thing that you can not really do without a good guidance. The guide pointed us key points that modelled the city and also showed us images how the places were before, which I found super interesting because I've already seen those pictures during high school and now I was exactly there. Jonathan is cheerful and warm and made us feel comfortable during the tour even when it was 3C outside. I highly recommend it!

Wouter, our guide. Was very knowledgeable and engaging. The tour was very comfortable in terms of pace and packed us full of information whilst visiting the most historic parts of this wonderful city. 10/10 would recommend and if you get wouter you’re in for a treat.

Took this tour with Gregor in February 2022. He was terrific- extremely knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin's history, culture, and art. Even though we had terrible weather, Gregor made the tour interesting and fun. Would definitely recommend!

Just done this walking tour with our guide called Scott.The tour lasted approximately 4.5hrs and was very informative and interesting. Scott was very knowledgeable and a great tour guide. We really enjoyed it and I would highly recommend doing this if your visiting Berlin

This was a perfect walking tour with a rich history of the city and Campbell as our guide (who looks very much like Bradley Cooper haha) . The tour was very well crafted designed to let us know everything about the city and by large the country from right after the Roman times. Campbell was very informative, very funny and quite high on EQ. One of very few tours that you do not want to end inspite of the very cold weather. Go for the tour without thinking about it twice.

Just go for it without thinking twice about it.

Interesting and the perfect way to get to know the city. Wear comfy shoes. It is about 4 hours long with a break at a small cafe midway through. Small children may get bored but all of the adults on our tour seemed to have a great time.

Matti was an excellent guide and gave us a good insight into the city’s history & culture. We learnt so much from the knowledge he imparted & we thoroughly enjoyed our tour with him. Just be prepared & wear your comfiest footwear as there is a lot of walking involved with only the occasional chance to sit & let your feet recover!

What a fabulous introduction to Berlin and it's journey from being a divided city within East Germany to a bustling and cosmopolitan capital.
Our guide Tobi was brilliant: funny, knowledgeable and full of anecdotes on what it was like to grow up in East Berlin before the wall came down. The pace was relaxed but extensive in the ground we covered and the sites we saw.
We did this tour on our first full day in Berlin and due to the diverse sites we visited and heard about, it set us up for the next 5 days of exploring on our own.
We cannot rate this tour (and Tobi) more highly!
Thanks for a great day!

My fiancee and I attended the 10:30 tour. Our guide was Beth, she was fantastic. Beth was friendly, polite and engaging.I really enjoyed the fact we discussed as a group or thoughts on certain pieces of art work or sculptures during the tour. It really brought it to life us.
We would highly recommend this tour, great way to get your bearings of the city as well so do it as soon as possible during your visit. The meeting point is really easy to get to using public transport (trams/underground).

This walking tour was guided by Jess, a history student whose passion for history and Berlin shines through. He is engaging and articulate and able to condense and translate a volume of knowledge in a short period of time offering an in-depth perspective into such a complicated era. Best of luck with all your studies and next adventures Jess and thank you for a well spent few hours - we could have listened to you all day !

We had a really good 4-hour tour of Berlin. Our guide, Wouter, was very knowledgeable and helpful. The tour was interesting, informative and kept at a good pace. It is a great starting point for those visiting Berlin as you can then decide where you want to spend more time, which Museums to visit etc. Very good value for money as well.

Did the half day walking tour today and it was fantastic. The tour guide, Tom, was encyclopaedic in his knowledge and was really engaging. The tour covered a lengthy period of history from 1800s to the 1980s and the significant incidents that occurred. We learned so much. The tour lasted over 4 hours and was so interesting. We could’ve spent hours speaking to the guide, Tom, as he was fantastic! Absolutely recommend!
