Our tour guide, Georgia, was an extremely friendly, and passionate person about her work. She really enjoyed sharing her knowledge of all the parts of the tour. We learnt a lot from her about various parts of the city and the history of it. Well worth the money we paid, extremely good day/tour.

Was told the tour would take 3-4hours and this is as advertised. Didn’t get started till nearly 11 (start time meant to be 10:30) and was finished just after 1pm with a half hour lunch break.

Guide walked extremely quickly - at times it was difficult to keep up if you wanted to take a photo.

Had a good knowledge of the history of Berlin

In one afternoon, my friends and I were able to visit and learn about berlins historical monuments. It was very informative and our guide linsey was very open in answering all our questions and giving her own (local) take into every thing. I’d highly recommend this to anyone if you’d like a quick intro to the city!

I took this same tour a few years ago when I was last in Berlin and it was fantastic. However, I was so disappointed on this 2nd time- this tour was bad, so underwhelming that our group actually left half way through to use our guidebook to do our own walking tour.

I was really excited take this tour again with my family (5 adults) since the first time I took it it provided such a great overview of major attraction/events/history of Berlin. I thought it was be a good way to kick off their first visit to Berlin to provide historical context, cover major attractions and get a lay of the land so we could use subsequent days to explore areas that struck our interest on the tour.

The problem was our guide, Davide. As it happens, he is Italian but has lived in Berlin for ~15 years. Initially struck us as a little funny that a non-native would lead such an iconic tour but no judgment- just looking for a good tour. However, the issues were not his nationality but the tour’s pace and focus. And it started right there in the intro: we spent far too long going over Davide’s background before finally, finally heading off… on an tour that was painfully slow and minutely focused on the royal succession. An hour into the tour we’d made it like a half mile and pretty much exclusively listened to a lecture on a handful of specific monarchs. The tour felt disorganized and directionless. It was minutely focused on obscure facts while largely skipping general context or large historical plot lines. Felt like we were just kind of walking around talking about Germany monarchy, passing interesting monuments and buildings with just a casual mention to them. In fact, we stood feet from The Empty Library during another long dissertation on German royalty…and the square and library were mentioned only as an afterthought. That was pretty much representative of the whole tour so at that point we decided to go.

Really too bad, especially compared to the amazing first experience I had on this tour. I feel bad criticizing Davide but he should not be leading these tours. Seems like a quality control issue with the guides.

I highly recommend this tour. It was about 4 hours long and we were brought to a majority of Berlin’s landmarks. Our tour guide, Tobi, was thoughtful and charismatic. Due to the extreme heat, he’d frequently lead us to a shaded area to tell us about a particular landmark’s history, while incorporating a few jokes in between. There was one scheduled “coffee break” during the tour which was a perfect time to grab a quick bite to eat. Do yourself a favor and booking this walking tour.

It was a very good walking tour of about 3 hours 30 mins.Giorgio our guide was very good in explaining the history of Germany concisely . He was very friendly and interactive . Would definitely recommend to my friends visiting Berlin.

We really enjoyed this tour got to see a lot more of the city’s historic sites than we would have done on our own. Jared our guide was amazing he made the historic sites relevant. The time flew by. We would recommend this tour to everyone. Would love to take another themed tour with Jared next time we are in Berlin.

5 stars for our guide, Glen, who was engaging, knowledgeable, funny and a joy to be around. I appreciated the visual aids he provided to lend context to his presentation.

3 stars for the management at the meeting up spot. Very disorganized and no instructions. Also Starbucks probably not the best place to meet. Too crowded. The ticket person was pleasant enough but we (guests) stood around for about 15 minutes not knowing what was happening. Also my group was more than 15 people which was max, as advertised.

The English tour was amazing, in half a day we covered so many spots. I would say the tour is so much worth the time and the money. Walid is very knowledgeable in Berlin and German history, he will answer any question you throw at him and will tell you fun facts about Berlin where you cannot find somewhere else. He is a friendly and nice guy and if you don’t know what to do in Berlin he can definitely recommend something for you. Thanks Walid!

We did this walk with our two children aged 12 and 14 and were a bit worried about the 4 hour duration and how they would react to a four hour stroll around Berlin!

Fortunately for us we had an amazing, super informed, interactive and very personable guide called Gregor who made the four hours fly by with his running commentary on the fascinating history of Berlin.

I would thoroughly recommend this tour with older children and this tour company. Would love to have done the WW2 & The Third Reich tour the following day but that would have probably tipped the kids over the edge!😋

Very nice overview of the main sites in Berlin in 4 hours. Would have been better to use headsets, as we couldn’t always be next to the guide to hear what he was saying. Also a lot of noise from traffic, other people, etc. And with a headset you can also share info along the way so it’s not standing in one place for so long. But very informative and good guide.

Despite a 6.30am flight we decided to do this walk o our first day and get our bearings. Booked onto the 2pm walk and met Polly. She was really friendly and so knowledgable. She explained things clearly and you felt you could ask questions. We got to see so many things and so much than if we’d tried to do it ourselves. We really enjoyed the experience and clocked up 20,000 steps in the process. Thanks Polly for introducing us to Berlin and recommendations for our trip

Our guide Steve was excellent. Very knowledgeable and charismatic. He kept us laughing and most importantly informed all the way around about what we were seeing and also about what you couldn't necessarily see at first. There was a half way stop off at a nice little cafe with free toilets. Absolute must is to bring extra layers than you think you'll need as standing and walking on the concrete for so long will make you colder than you realise! Bring a hat at the very least. Very highly recommend this tour company, it was the highlight of our trip.

Jacob, our guide was extremely knowledgeable and provided a fascinating running commentary as we walked through the city. The walk lasted, I think, over 3 and a half hours with a short break for tea / coffee and a cake (not included in the price).
I would certainly recommend this walk. We learnt a great deal of the history of Berlin and picked up some tips of places to explore in more depth at a later date.

No one turned up at the time and place advertised. We waited half hour and then called the head office and they told us that the tour we had booked through trip advisor was no longer running (Friday 11am from freidrichstraß bahnhof )
Had to pay to get transport to alternative location for a different tour later that day. That second tour with Sebastian was very good.

Outstanding walking tour with guide, Campbell. It’s not easy to keep a relatively large group engaged for 4 hours, but Campbell’s historical knowledge and ability to clearly communicate, made the time quickly go by. I learned so much about the area and the tour made me want to do more research. Great value!

I was astonished—this tour went by in a breeze. I was expecting it to be a slog, but it felt like the amount of time needed to cover so much history and our guide Pip was riveting for the duration. Even so I know it was just scratching the surface. A great way to learn about World War II, the Berlin wall, and Berlin today. I will note that aside from the 20 minute break, there was almost no sitting. Nonetheless, I would highly recommend.

Our guide Ay (pronounced like it sounds, similar to letter “A”) is originally from Ireland who studied German history, is an excellent insightful tour guide. From the tour, we were able to appreciate many of the historic buildings on the East Berlin side, the Berliners, and the changes to Berlin since the re-unification. Ay is thoughtful of her group’s need to take time for pictures at the Volkswagon vintage cars, bathroom breaks, ascertain all members are caught up. We greatly recommend this tour. Greatly enjoyed it!

I don't have enough words to describe what an incredible time our group had on our Berlin Walks tour with Georgia. We had never been to Berlin before and it took some persuading to even get half our group on the tour - historical tours can sometimes be a bore. Georgia made the history of Berlin not only interesting, but digestible and impactful. Her passion for the history was immediately apparent and it doesn't hurt she's funny too! This isn't just a scripted tour either, Georgia was willing to take on any question from the LGBTQ community, current events, history of food - you name it and she knew about it. The only bad thing was this was our first tour of our trip and everything else couldn't compare!

Absolutely fantastic! We have never done a walking tour before but we loved it. We had unknowingly walked a similar route the day before and couldn’t believe all the things we had missed. It’s so worth knowing about the things around you, even if your not massively into history. Our tour guide Xavier was so knowledgeable and enthusiastic, he made it all almost come alive.
We would strongly recommend this tour 😊

There are enough superlatives to describe Ryan and the well paced, so engaging, knowledgable and passionate delivery in story and history of Berlin.

This is a must for anybody coming first time to Berlin; to orient and place the significance of Germany, east and west conflict in modern times.

The walking tour was carefully selected with points of interests; so well balanced to be informative and not overwhelm.

Very good value and thoroughly recommend as a half day in the city.

First time we take these kinds of tours and it was initially driven by the fact that everything was closed on a 1st of january. It turned out fascinating and really enjoyable. Xavier is a great guide with not only knowledge but a storytelling that keeps you interested and captivated for the full 4h30 of the visit. Given the history of Berlin it would be a mistake to miss this.

Seb B was funny, engaging and knowledgable. He did not come off as arrogant as other guides we've had. He made sure everyone from the tour was near and could hear him. Also that it was interactive and not just a monologue. Really was a great introduction of Berlin through the Prussian Empire, Nazi regime, Cold war and unified Germany after. He also knew 4 languages.

This tour was money well spent. An excellent half day spent walking around the streets of Berlin being given an insight into it's history both good and bad from a knowledgeable tour guide. Xavier, the bald French man. One of Frances' greatest exports was our tour guide for this informative tour. Be prepared for a long walk, but with good pair of shoes it will be a day you'll remember. Thank you Xavier for a superb tour.

This was such a fantastic way to see and learn about Berlin.
Xavier was a knowledgeable and charismatic guide who managed to fit centuries of history into a half day tour without making the tour seem rushed or cramped with too much info.
I am so glad we got a space on this tour and couldn’t recommend it highly enough.

We were met by a very friendly lady on a cold and damp morning outside a the coffee shop. She encouraged us to keep warm and use the bathroom whilst we were waiting, which was although obvious, very good advice. Rob was our guide and he was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about all the subjects he spoke about, which makes such a difference on these tours. We were privileged to have a very small group. Rob dealt with a difficult member of our small group very patiently. Overall it was excellent value for money, we learnt so much.

Four hours with Ysanne is time very well spent and goes by in a flash. She has a wealth of knowledge about Berlin’s history and shares it through vivid stories that inspire the imagination. We appreciated Ysanne’s excellent voice projection, which is important for people with hearing aids. She encourages each person to consider how different sights make you feel and think about how you might have acted during Hitler’s regime. Ysanne’s perfectly balanced approach of walks & talks, storytelling & historical facts and personal reflection made the tour one of the most memorable we have had in Europe. We also appreciated the short restaurant /bio break at the 2/3 mark and found ourselves returning to the same cafe a few days later.

This was my first time in Berlin so we wanted to do a tour that would give us a good introduction to the city. We LOVED the tour. It hit all of the highlights of the city and our tour guide, Charlotte, was FANTASTIC. She knew so much about the city and presented it all with a fun, personable touch! Highly recommend!

Our guide Pip was excellent. She packed so much information into our four hour tour with wit, passion, and a clear understanding of German history and culture.

On our well paced tour we took in all the main sites that we had wanted to see, and left with a much better appreciation.

Highly recommended.

Polly was exceptional. The tour was informative and covered all of the city sights that we wanted to see. After the tour we simply went back to the museums that appealed to us. Without a doubt this is a ‘not to be missed‘ tour!! Best value in Europe.

Our guide, Tom, was very knowledgeable about Berlin’s history. He kept us moving as we visited all of the highlights. He was able to weave together the different time periods to make sense of Berlin. We truly enjoyed this tour.

Great way to start off our week in Berlin. Covers pretty much all of the big ticket items as well as less well known sites. Our guide, Wouter, was excellent. He was informative (clearly knows his subject matter well), engaging and went above and beyond to ensure the tour was enjoyable for the whole group. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Berlin.

We joined the walking tour of Berlin today with Woulter as our guide. A truly informative and thoroughly interesting tour from beginning to end - the time flew by! Woulter's knowledge of Berlin's history was excellent - not only was his tour factual but also allowed us to interpret and question for ourselves elements of the city's history. Woulter was highly approachable and always patient with our questions - this tour is an absolute priority if visiting Berlin. We cannot recommend it enough!

I learned so much history. The time flew and it was the best way to see the city.
There is so much history in Berlin that without an expert whom knows the city and the history behind each place we stopped at you would be lost for sure.

Steve was a fantastic tour guide: he is very knowledgeable about Berlin, Germany and its history. His love and respect for history makes the tour with him a very enriching experience. He also shared interesting fun facts which make you leave the tour feeling like you know something special about Berlin. He is also a good actor and will be sure to get a few laughs from you. Definitely recommend.

As a solo traveller I really enjoyed the walking tour as the guide, Ysanne, was so lovely and accomodating. I learnt so much about the history of Berlin and so many quirky facts. It was a really cold day, so Ysanne added in an extra stop in a warm cafe which was so nice! I enjoyed the tour that much that I booked another one with the company. Would recommend 10/10!!

Took this tour and learned a lot from our guide, Jonathan! He was very knowledgeable and showed us all around Berlin while sharing with us the history of the city. We learned a lot! We never would have been able to hit all of those monuments in such a timely manner on our own. Highly recommend

Just back from 4 days in Berlin and have to say the walking Tour was the highlight. We had a fantastic guide who was so knowledgeable and a really nice guy too (sorry his name escapes me but he's originally from Holland). He took us through the history of Germany with focus on Berlin of course, plus he had a wide range of knowledge about art and writers too. At each stop on our Tour he shared the history and significance of where we were ........ if you only have time for one thing on your visit to Berlin do this tour it'll cover so much and guide you where to return to if you've more time so you get the best out of your overall Berlin trip ....... the telegraphy of terrors is another one not to miss.

Having been to Berlin before, the walking tour I did before left me feeling that Berlin was ashamed, sorry and empathetic about its horrific past. This tone was set by the tour guide who set the tone. This was with another company. The tour on Sunday was by contrast utterly horrendous. There is a onus of huge magnitude for the guide to set out the context as to how Hitler rose to power, the events, methods of fear and manipulation that led to compliance whether through abject fear, ignorance or vile human traits. There is a necessity for empathy and examples to support this. My partner is Jewish and I cannot forgive your guide for the blasé, ignorance and laziness at best that led to watching my partner in a level of upset, anger and sheer disbelief at the consequences of this. I was appalled as a non-Jew. And I would suggest that your company needs to review its content and take a very long hard look at its unique set of responsibilities on behalf of Berlin and it’s obligations to customers backgrounds. Insider Tours guides had a polar different approach on both previous occasions. Your guide caused great distress and upset. This is not a tour that should be glossed over by jobbing hungover actors. The score of zero is only achieved by the lack of options below.

The booking process was easy and the meeting point was well described and easy to find.
I enjoyed the tour very much! I saw more on Berlin in 4 hours than I could navigate myself in that time. I learned so much about Berlin and its history , which has now got me wanting to learn more and come back.
Charlotte was my tour guide. She had great passion for her work and Berlins history. She was very knowledgeable and explained each location in great detail with her fun personality.
I will be back and booking other tours. Thank you Charlotte 🙌

The only negative was the extreme amount of detailed information provided by the tour guide. There is a reasonable amount of detail and detail to the extreme. This tour guide provided so much detail that I found myself losing interest in what he said due to information overload.

The tour was popular on the day we attended and ended up being split into three groups. We were lucky to be out into the group led by Wouter. He was fantastic. Extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic. We were so impressed with how he answered questions on topics that weren’t necessarily part of the tour in German, Dutch and English.

The tour last around three hours and takes in Museum Island, the Brandenburg gate, Reichstag and the site of Hitler’s bunker amongst other locations.

We learnt so much and can’t recommend the tour more. It brought Berlin’s history to life and added depth to our trip.

This tour was great! We got a great intro into just a little bit of the amazing history of this city. Our guide Glen enhanced all the stops with a folder of photographs he had to show what the spot looked like historically. His knowledge and experience shows.

My teen son and I went on this tour. It was the right balance between walking and listening. The mid-walk break was nice, too. It was a very helpful orientation to Berlin, covering many time periods and layers of history. Pip, our guide, was knowledgeable and offered insightful interpretations of the sites. She made the history relevant. Excellent tour!

We started our one week stay in Berlin with the Discover Berlin tour led by Giorgio, and it was perfect! The tour was very interesting, touching on lots we already knew, but much that we didn't. Giorgio was incredibly knowledgeable, thoughtful, spriited, and provocative. As Jewish tourists in Berlin, we had a lot to think about, and Giorgio was thorough, but sensitive, in his presentation. We highly recommend the tour and especially Giorgio.

This tour exceeded our high expectations and i can highly recommend it. Caprivating from the start. We learned so much and information was shared in such an engaging way. Our tour guide Ciaran ended the tour at the Brandenberg Gate with a poem which encompassed the whole history journey we had just experienced. His own composition. Absolutely brilliant!!!!

This tour covers quite a bit of ground, metaphorically and literally. Excellent value for the cost and the perfect intro to the Mitte district and Berlin as a whole. Our tour guide was Jacob---he was patient, engaging, and informative.

This tour was one of the best I have ever done. Campbell Bews was the guide, and he was outstanding. The 4 hours went by like it was one, as the high interest level was maintained throughout. His knowledge of the history of Berlin was thorough, and the many anecdotes made it magical. He is one of the few tour guides I have met who, when he asks ‘any questions?’, actually means it, and gives interesting and well informed answers without getting side tracked into things that may not hold the attention of the whole group.
Thoroughly fascinating. Thank you Campbell!

We did the tour with Xiaver. He had a wealth of knowledge on the history of Berlin and explained everything clearly and in an engaging way. The city tour is very interesting and there is so much history to see and learn about. We really enjoyed our experience!

Had a great walking tour! We were guided around various places in Berlin, including Bradenburg gate and finishing at Checkpoint Charlie. There a lot of people on this tour, 24, with quite a few solo travellers which made it nice for me (as a solo traveller). Would recommend!

We really enjoyed this tour. The group was relatively small about 12 so it was very manageable. Many highlights including Museum Island, Brandenburg Gate, Bebelplatz and Checkpoint Charlie to name just a few. Sebastian was a very good guide. We really enjoyed the day with him.

An excellent walking tour that takes in the main buildings and other sights in central historical Berlin. Note you don’t enter any of the buildings and museums etc - it just shows you where they all are. For us, a perfect start to our visit to Berlin as you can see where everything is, hear the history and stories, get good tips for other things to do, and so on. We had about 20 people in our group and it was absolutely fine - we could hear everything and get access to the guide to ask questions etc. Our guide Ryan was very knowledgeable. We would highly recommend this walking tour, especially as a “first thing to do in Berlin”.

Me and my brother participatef in the tour „Discover Berlin“ and we really enjoyed it! Gregor (our guide) is an excellent storyteller and the half of day just went so fast that we did not recognize how 4 hours flew. The tour was organized properly, we met right on time, the logic of the tour was well-planned because we started with the basic information about Germany and Berlin itself, and we ended tour between „East“ and „West“ side of Berlin. Gregor was very communicative, he replied to all our questions and walking tour was not boring at all, tour was interactive, we had a really nice friendly and funny atmosphere.
If you are willing to know more about Berlin, German history and want to get time tips (i.e. where to go else and what do see), i would definitely suggest you Gregor as your tourguide!

Best wishes,
Your Pinguins 🙆‍♀️

Our guide, Xavier, was excellent. He managed to combine the rich Berlin history in a nice story often accompanied by relevant photos he shared with us.

Moreover, Xavier was patient and he nicely responded all our questions. These 4 hour tour was a pleasant experience we will definitely do again next time we return to Berlin.

I’ve done 5 walking tours with Original Berlin Walks now - they are the best. Xavier was another great guide. Very personable, funny and careful to take care of all members in the group. Most importantly though, Xavier’s extensive knowledge of Berlin, it’s history, politics and people meant that his tour was really interesting and in places, very moving. When asked questions he was able to discuss with real insight. Our group of fellow walkers who crossed the generations and nationalities, gelled well as a result of Xavier’s relaxed lead. It was a great opportunity to meet travellers from other nations and chat with them. My husband and i thoroughly enjoyed it. Thanks Xavier!

I would highly recommend this tour. Our guide was very friendly and extremely knowledgeable about the history of Berlin and Germany. We got to see many of Berlin’s historical landmarks and we were given historical context for every landmark. We learned so much while on this tour and truly deepened my appreciation for such an amazing city. I recommend this tour to everyone and anyone who is visiting Berlin!

We really enjoyed the walking tour. Probably one of the main highlights of our family trip to Berlin. Everyone from the adults to our 10 year son really enjoyed the tour and our guide Heidi was great. Thanks so much

Chris from Canada was our tour guide and he was so energetic, informative and interesting to listen to. I very much enjoyed our tour of the city and would do it again. I highly recommend doing this if you've got time. He was a very good story teller with many facts and he encouraged us not to just listen but to question why any of the history may have happened. He was absolutely a joy to have and I'd hire him to discuss Berlin again!

This 3.5 hour walking tour was superb from the first few minutes. Our guide was Glen, who was incredibly knowledgeable (no doubt helped by his personal experiences of living in Berlin), engaging and shared historical photographs of the places we visited to bring the history to life. If we hadn't done this tour we would have blindly walked past some wonderfully interesting places! We would highly recommend this English speaking tour of Berlin. Thank you Glen for a really excellent, memorable time.

The tour was fantastic, I would recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin. Our guide Scott was great, he did a really nice job of talking about the history, incorporating art, and showing how relevant these stories are for today. Scott was an amazing story teller. We covered a lot of ground and I feel like I got a lot of bang for my buck!

We enjoyed every part of the walking tour. Our guide, Maxime was very knowledgeable, great personality and tried to involve the group as best he could. We thought it would be a long day but it went by very quickly and we learned alot about the history of Berlin. Excellent value!

Tobi was a great tour guide and he made this experience very enjoyable. Tobi was very personable and I thought he provided a really interesting overview of the highlights on the tour even with some pointers about what to watch out from in Berlin. Yes, there is lots of information and no, I probably won't remember it all but I still had a great time learning about the different sites. We ran a little overtime but we were free to leave at any stage after letting him know.

My partner and I took the discover Berlin tour during our recent visit to the city. Our tour guide Nathan was extremely knowledgeable and really engaged with each of the tour participants. I would definitely recommend anyone visiting Berlin to take this tour and when booking definitely request a tour with Nathan.

Fantastic! Our guide Gorgio, was a historian with a PHD degree and knew everything about each site we visited.
The tour was a complete and comprehensive four hours of walking and history overview. He was energetic, courteous and entertaining. Great experience.

Our tour guide for the day was Gregor. If you appreciate history or art, highly recommend. Gregor provided such nuanced and thought-provoking commentary and stories highlighting Berlin's complex history. Not only did I learn a lot, but I honestly walked away with such a deeper understanding of Berlin's complex history and had some preconceived notions challenged (in a good way!).

I cannot recommend this half-day walking tour highly enough. Scot was absolutely brilliant, it was obvious that he'd put a lot of work into creating a brilliant tour. By the end of the afternoon, I really understood Berlin and its history and the whole experience made my trip come alive.

Sarah was an excellent tour guide very knowledgeable and interesting. She kept us entertained for over 3 1/2 hours. This is a fabulous introduction to Berlin showing key places of interest and explaining the complex history

We've had a really nice experience doing this trip. Our guide Johnny did a really good job and gave us alot of information about the city's history. We started looking at the city through different eyes which was very valuable to us. Would definitely recommend this!

By far the best walking tour that I ever experienced. Our tour guide, Chris or in his own words, the Canadian Chris 😀 is very informative and entertaining with his wicked sense of humour. He gives us not only the history of Berlin but also shows us what lessons that we can learn from the past. I would recommend this tour to everyone that want to have an introduction to the history of Berlin.

Gregor was an amazing guide who clearly loved the Berlin history. He explained all poi’s in a clear way which not only explained the history but also the importance of these monuments and how they relate to the present. He even managed to do this in a open non biased way. All in all I would 100% recommend Gregor as yours guide as he Is a friendly social guide who is extremely knowledgeable about Berlin and Germany 🇩🇪.
Well done Gregor 👍

Amazing tour, very insightful - our tour guide Jonny was super friendly had an incredible depth of knowledge. We did this on the first day of our trip and saw everything we wanted to in Berlin, it also gave us an idea of what we wanted to re-visit. At the end of the trip Jonny was also so kind as to give some personal recommendations on bars and restaurants for the rest of our trip. Great value for money and would 100% recommend. Summer and Tom.

This was one of the best tours I have ever done. Lynsey our tour guide was FANTASTIC - equal parts knowledgeable, warm and kind and we had a lovely day with a small tour group on this occasion. It was a safe experience and anyone hesitant about booking a guided tour in the current pandemic climate should go ahead and do it! I learnt so much and it definitely made my trip to Berlin that much more memorable.
The tour gave a great overview of the main historical sites of (mostly) East Berlin in one day. The tour guide was engaging and knew what he was talking about. Definitely more than worth the price.

This tour really shows you all of the highlights of Berlin. Our guide explained the historical significance of all of the important buildings as well as the monuments and other attractions. He did it in a fun way and was always available for questions. Although there’s lots of walking and the tour last four hours, it was never boring and quite comprehensive.

Maxime was quite an engaging tour guide. He kept the group moving and not only gave us the informative historical perspective but also provoked us to think about what we had seen. Tour covered Imperial era, Nazi book burning and the holocaust plus a great many Cold War sites.

The amount of historical detail was impressive. I really felt I had a good overview of Berlin’s history by the end. Tips: go to the washroom before it starts and wear comfy shoes. Jonathan K was very well-informed and sprinkled amusing tidbits into the history.

This experience was never boring and always full of interesting pieces of knowledge on Berlin history. Our guide (Tobi) enthusiastically provided to the group a good perspective on everything we were visiting. Very well done!

It was a fantastic experience, Rob S is a funny and welcoming guide. He showed us so many great places to go and gave us very insightful information about each place as well as the history. I had no idea what I wanted to do in Berlin and now I have so many place I want to go to!

We did the walking tour in Berlin with Tobi today and I can’t see anything else beating that experience on this trip. He was so kind, knowledgeable and interesting and brought such a passion to everything he was telling us. We really enjoyed hearing everything from a locals perspective and his love for Berlin and for meeting and teaching people was beaming from Tobi. Thanks for an unforgettable experience. Amy & Jo, Ireland

This was an excellent tour. Jonathon N. provided lots of history and context to the sights we were seeing, making it an interesting and informative tour. He covered many of the important landmarks in Central Berlin. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and would recommend it.

Jared our guide was really knowledgable - lots of interesting info. I didn't realise it was going to be so long, we met at 10.30 and it finished at 16hrs!! Great value for 14 Euros. Our group wasn't so big either, so you didn't feel like a herd of sheep.

This was a very interesting 4.5 hour tour with Tobi. He was light hearted but was able to bring the history to life for us. Learnt so much on this tour. He was also born in east Berlin and remembers the wall coming down and when asked shared a little about what this was like. Would recommend.

This is a great thing to do if you're on a short city break as we were. So much is packed in to the tour. Jonathan N, our guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. He made sure that he spoke to each of us while walking. We went to the major sites. The tour contains lots of walking as you would expect but it was at an easy pace so don't be put off.

Our family of 6 people took this tour today. Xavier was the BEST!!! Knowledgeable and entertaining, Xavier took us through so much interesting history affiliated with each of the sites coupled with cool relevant stories that we couldn't believe it! I enthusiastically recommend this tour in general and Xavier as a guide. We felt so lucky. Thank you!

This was an excellent overview of Berlin.
Our guide Walid did a great job of explaining all the famous land marks and gave a good historical account of different periods in Germanys history, without overwhelming you.
This is quite a long tour so wear some comfortable footwear. Highly recommend this experience.

Heidi was an outstanding tour guide! I would highly recommend her and the tour. She was very knowledgeable and informative. She was able to answer all questions asked. Her communications skills and the way she linked things together was very effective. She always found a good quiet location out of the crowds to talk to us. I’m so glad we did this and would do it again.

This was an excellent tour, really informative and presented in an entertaining but sensitive way. Scott was a brilliant guide and he gave everyone a great insight into the history of Berlin as well as ideas about what to see and do during the rest of our stay. Would highly recommend this tour.

We booked through Expedia. The tour was great. Fran our tour guide was Very knowledgeable and it felt like the hours flew by. This was our favorite part of our trip to Berlin and we highly recommend a tour with Fran!

I have been running around Europe for a month now and this is by far the best walking tour I have been on so far. Jake was so knowledgeable and engaging, and made an effort to get to know the group and even have a few chats in between destinations. Berlin is a city rich in both history and culture, and this tour really does it justice. 100% recommend.

Walid was our guide today and gave us an enlightening history of Berlin from many centuries ago to the present day. While this was a lot of information to take in, it was delivered in a humerous way and he has amazing knowledge of all its intricacies. Walid has his own interesting story to tell and we found him very engaging with a terrific sense of humour. This was a wonderful day in Berlin 😀. Jennifer and Gerry Norton, Ireland.

Loved everything about this tour. The tour guide Jacob was amazing, he explained everything so clearly and such passion it made everyone really connect with the history and fall in love with Berlin. Would recommend, must do.

We decided to spend our first morning in Berlin doing the half day Discover Berlin tour (having thoroughly enjoyed one in Boston last year). Jonathan was our guide and he was brilliant - his manner was warm and approachable and he gave us so much information and interesting facts that we wouldn't have known if we had walked about on our own: he was really engaging. He also took time to answer all questions and to give us a list of suggestions for things to do in the current difficult circumstances with some of the indoor attractions being closed. Highly recommended. Thank you Jonathan!

Our guide, Rob, was a history scholar and it made the tour amazing! He was able to explain the "how" and "why" of Berlin's changes over the year, in reference to the geopolitical climate, in a really easy to understand way.
The sights were good, pace was great and it was lots of fun too. Highly recommend.

Our guide Ryan was excellent. He was extremely knowledgeable and knew the most intricate details about everything. He also was friendly and warm. The tour was great. We really wouldn’t know half the information if we tried to walk around ourselves. A definite must do in Berlin!

Great tour of Berlin, nicely organised in a chronological fashion. Tour guide (who was studying History at a Berlin University) had lots of interesting stories. Might have been slightly long for some people at 4 hrs but he held our attention.

There is a lot to see in Berlin and this was the perfect way to get to those must see places in one tour. You get some history thrown in by really informed and fun guides while seeing a big chunk of the highlights. Jonathan K was phenomenal! He really knows his stuff! Bring comfortable shoes and some water because it’s quite a bit of walking.

Really enjoyed this tour - Jonathan was great at imparting lots of knowledge with a few bad jokes to keep everyone engaged. So much history was covered as well as little anecdotes. A thorough introduction to the city and well paced.

Reuben was a fantastic guide. I couldn’t recommend this tour more highly. It was the perfect length of time, covering a huge amount of ground in detail that would be impossible to cover yourself. Amazing value and friendly hosts! I will highly recommend this to friends coming to the city.

Charlotte did a great job of explaining the relevant details of Berlin's history. It did not solely focus on World War II which was nice but did have relevant details that encoupassed it. Overall we had a great time and learned a lot.

This tour was wonderful!! Our guide, Pip, was so knowledgeable. This tour is time well-spent if you want to get to know the city. It was just long enough to offer some nice exercise and a mind full of history and stories, but not so long that anyone gets hangry or tired. Pip had a great sense of humor and was very personable.

I also want to add my appreciation to the tour operator for allowing me to move my reservation ahead by one day when my flight was unexpectedly delayed. Thank you for your flexibility!!

100% would recommend.

We did the walking tour on the 13th Oct starting at 10.30am. Our guide was Xavier. He told us very interesting stories at every site and answered all our queries. His humour made the stories even more interesting. It was easy to understand Xavier as he was clear in his language and storyline. If possible I will recommend Xavier to friends as their tour guide.

Georgia, was our host, she was amazing! Very knowledgeable, personable and an excellent guide all around. She hails from Scotland however, her knowledge on Germany was extensive. From the Island of Museums to Check Point Charlie and everything in between, she was able to convey the importance and the relevance of the history of Berlin. The wait was well with it for Robert and I.

Fantastic walk Tobi our guide was witty, interesting, passionate and a mine of information. His life story was fascinating as was hearing about the history of Berlin. He knew so much and had some useful visual aides. The walk lasted hours and covered all of the sights we knew we needed to see. Despite the rain we all stuck with him to the Brandenburg gate!

With Ryan we had a super half day to get some understanding of the Berlin history. Plus it’s buildings. Plus it’s restaurants. Plus the museums. So next to his in-depth knowledge of history he was also very helpful to guide us to the ‘should go after the tour’ 😇
Berlin history is impressive and a very good tour like this one is helping to understand todays world! And thus you should do take this tour to start your visit if Berlin

What a great tour. Jacob our tour guide for the English tour was amazing. Gave us great bits of history and done it with a smile the whole time. The passion he has for the city of Berlin spoke volumes and made the tour even better. He even showed us West Berlin! Top bloke, could of even had a beer with him.

Tour by Georgia was really great! She was extremely knowledgeable and engaging and gave us a great overview of the history of Berlin and Germany. This was a great way to see the main attractions of Berlin. I would highly recommend to everyone.

Jonathan was a fantastic guide. He brought his own family's personal story into his guiding which added an valuable and thought-provoking dimension to the things we were seeing and learning about. The tour itself is an very good overview, perfect as an introduction to the city, to its history and its personality and culture now. Jonathan was great about answering questions, giving us personal tips for other things to do and see. Highly highly recommend the tour, Jonathan as the guide, and the company as professional and well-organized.

Our tour guide was Xavier and he was truly fantastic. He loves the city and he knows so much about it. We very much enjoyed his sense of humor, the depth of his knowledge and his desire to give us the most information in over 4 hours. Highly recommend this tour to understand the long history of Berlin.

We have been on walking tours in other cities but our guide Pip was by far the best. An historian with a fantastic knowledge who brought the background of Berlin to life while all the time also being sensitive to balance ‘right and wrong’ to ensure an un-blinkered and insightful perspective. Highly recommended.

We wanted to get n overview of Berlin on our first day of visiting. Tobi was our guide and could not have been more perfect. As an East German native, he offered a unique perspective to the Cold War time period that we lived through. In addition, his wit, wisdom and knowledge were refreshing, personal and engaging. He kept us safe, dry during rain, and paced the tour well. Our entire experince with this company from booking to meeting to concluding at the Brandenburger Gate was a true delight.

We spent a fascinating 5 hours with Xavier on his walking tour of Berlin. We felt very lucky to have him as our guide. We only had 2 days to spend in Berlin and he covered everything we wanted to see. He is articulate and thoughtful and I highly recommend him.

Having booked this walking tour due to it’s excellent reviews it did not disappoint! Our guide Sam W was informative and passionate about Berlin’s history. The tour covers a lot of key historical sites in Berlin, perfect to get a good overview if only visiting for a couple of days. Excellent value for money, would definitely recommend!

GREAT guide! We met at 10:30 and Jonathan had us laughing by 10:35. We wrapped up about 3:00. Exhausted, informed, entertained. Jonathan is very engaged, knowledgeable, patient with the group. And fun. (He threw in some good little jokes through out the day).

I don’t think there were any questions any of us asked that he couldn’t answer. He is passionate about history, and very informative of al the places we walked to. At no point did he make us feel rushed. And the 25 minute coffee/bathroom break mid tour was welcomed.

Berlin is such a huge city. With SO much history. I absolutely recommend booking a tour with Original Berlin. And request Johnathan!

Over all, the tour is probably just a bit over 3 miles - 4 hours on your feet. So dress comfortably!

Truly the best way to learn about the history of Berlin. Giorgio was a fantastic guide that answered all of our questions and was very enthusiastic and cheerful. He led us to a great coffee shop to have a snack towards the end of the trip. The 4 hours went by very quickly and we visited everything we wanted to see in Berlin. Our family of 4 had a great experience and would recommend to anyone!

Steve is very knowledgeable with a sense of humor. His guide is funny and abundant. If you are interested in the Cold War history, I would definitely recommend this walk to you. Unfortunately, I’m not a native speaker and Steve speaks kinda fast. So I guess I only get 60-70%…

Jacob was fabulous, very knowledgeable and entertaining! The tour is 4 hours and you cover all of the key landmarks and history of East Berlin. We had a restroom break about half way through and a quick food stop about 3 hours in. I would recommend to do this on your first day in Berlin to get a lay of the land.

This 4 hour introductory tour of Berlin was amazing! Our guide, Xavier, was extremely knowledgeable but also funny and engaging…nice pace….you don’t need to be fit to manage the walking as you stop often to listen to wHat he has to say….and have a 20 minute snack break after 2+ hours. We have learnt so much on that short space of time…and really loved it!

The half day historical walking tour with Tobi from Original Berlin Walks was really excellent. Tobi was so knowledgeable and informative with a chatty, friendly personality. He didn't rush the tour and was happy to answer any questions from the group. I came away from the tour with a much better understanding of German / Berlin history. Thanks Tobi for a lovely Berlin experience.

Xavier educated us about Germany’s history AND kept us entertained throughout the whole tour. He gave us lots of interesting historical information and answered all of our questions. Xavier was a wealth of knowledge about Berlin - the good, the bad, and the ugly. Thanks Xavier and Original Berlin Walks!!

An excellent orientation to downtown Berlin! Approximately 4 hours of interesting history to go with the many brief stops along the route. Making this your first activity when visiting gives one a brief overview of the area, and helps planning for your day's ahead. Johnny, from England, was a great guide. We would recommend him highly.

We were very happy with our choice of this tour on our first morning in Berlin. Our guide Jörg had a lovely friendly manner, a wealth of knowledge and a fund of fascinating anecdotes. The tour took around four hours on a very warm day, and covered all of the advertised sights. We were able to have a short (and very welcome!) lunch break at Checkpoint Charlie.

We had Ryan as our guide and his passion and obvious love of the city was clear from the moment the tour started.
The tour itself was fantastic and took in many of the key tourist attractions and the commentary from Ryan complimented it brilliantly.
Although 3 and a half hours sounds a long time, it flew by really quickly as we enjoyed it so much

We just loved this guided tour as it points out the most visted locations in Berlin. Xavier our guide, a French guy who speaks beautifully english and lives in Berlin for years. What would you want for more? Really knowledgeable, energetic, and impartial when he talks about facts of history. Our guided tour took more than 4 hours, but we didn’t even realized how time flew by as there was always something new and interesting to learn and hear about. Overall, I strongly recommend this tour for visitors in Berlin.

We had to compress four days in Berlin into one so we chose the Discover Berlin walking tour that took us to all the major places in Berlin-Mitte. Our tour guide Sarah was excellent, extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Would go on more tours if we had more time.

Just finished the 4 hour walking tour with Maxime, really marvellous. Our small group of 10 were really great. Lots of answers to lots of question! Really recommend if interested in getting an indepth history of Berlin 👏👏

This was an amazing tour that really gave you an understanding of Berlin’s complicated and tragic history. Our guide, Walid, was not only knowledgeable but very personable and funny. He broke things down in a way that was easy to understand. Highly recommend!

Our guide Jonathan N. was excellent throughout delighting us all with his knowledge and humour. The starting point was easy to find close to Hackesher Markt station and the walk was easy paced with stops at points of interest along the route. We saw many of the well known sites along with several lesser publicised places. Jonathan had time for everyone and answered any questions thrown at him. Wonderful value and a must for any first time visitor although anyone would enjoy the experience.

We took a quick 3 day trip to Berlin and booked this tour. It was absolutely fantastic! It was 3 1/2 hours long and we learned and saw more than we would have on our own. Steve, was absolutely brilliant and very knowledgeable on all topics regarding Berlin.
If you can get Steve as your guide, you won’t be disappointed.

Seb was our guide, and he was excellent. He was able to explain a vast amount of history, with clarity and sensitivity. Although I had read a lot about Berlin, I still learnt lots of new facts. Totally recommend this tour, especially as a way of orienteering yourself.

Dave was an amazing tour guide! I learned so much about the city and history. He was friendly, helpful, and kept no only my attention but also enraptured the children on tour with his great storytelling skills. He also gave amazing tips for us to use after the tour.

If you're looking for an excellent introduction to a lot of Berlin, this tour is great. Rebecca was friendly and informative and very open to any questions the group had. She didn't over dramatize nor did she under emphasize the importance and significance of the sites and the associated history. We moved quite quickly and covered a lot of ground, but I never felt rushed.
It is not a trip which gives you the super-deep experience of all of the sites, but it will set you up very well for an overview of sites you might want to revisit, and also gives a good idea of the nature and geography of Berlin overall- so it is a really good tour to start your trip with.

As we were on a tour of Europe, we had done a lot of walking tours by the time we got to Berlin. This was by far the best. Our guide was Daniel, he was fantastic. He read his group and told us about the places we were visiting but let us ask questions as well. He wasn’t monotonous like a lot of guides are and was very knowledgeable. Highly recommend this tour, we learnt a lot.

I recently completed the tour with tour guide Scott. He was cordial and knowledgeable, giving the group a well-rounded history of the city. I liked too that he introduced historical facts in German history that I was unaware of.

Sam Z was an excellent tour guide. He was upbeat and very knowledgeable about the sights that we saw. We went to where Hitler committed suicide, Brandenburg gate, checkpoint Charlie (where we learned that there is no Charlie. Charlie stands for the "C" gate) and many others. I love that the guide takes you to all of the top spots of Berlin without you having to find them yourself and give you in-depth information about the area. I am highly recommending this tour!

Highly recommended tour! It’s a great introduction to the city, plenty of interesting information but at the same time, not overloaded or overwhelming. Thank you so much to Chris (the CANADIAN one, since he asked to clarify lol) for being such a fantastic guide and keeping everyone interested and entertained for 3-4 hours. Great, great tour! :)

Great ride, nice way to know the city. The tour guide was one of the high points in our trip to Europe, always with an historical fact or comment. At the begining i have some misgivings on the tour. But as soon as it started everything changes

It's difficult to cover everything over a city like Berlin. In the tour we managed to see the most important things in a few hours, without getting tired, and without sparing important details. An that's what makes a tour successful. Thanks Beth

Had an amazing half day tour of Berlin with Scott from Berlin walks .. I had done some research before I had come to the city but Scott really gave me an understanding of the history of this great city .. I would so highly recommend this tour ..

We took the tour in English in July 2022 and were hosted by Heidi. Heidi was fantastic. She is knowlegable, clear and enthusiastic. Even though I initially thought 3.5 hours would be too long, time flew by amid the history and clear explanations of Berlin. Highly recommended.

Our tour guide, Jake, was fantastic. Probably the best of the guides I have encountered across a number of different European captial walking tours in the last few weeks. He was able to convey a lot of information about the sites we visited in an informative, engaging and passionate way. Its clear that he loves this city and enjoys showing it off to visitors. The tour went for just over 4 hours, and we covered a lot. If you are new to Berlin and want to learn about its history, personality and discover many of the main locations and landmarks, this is your tour and Jake is your guide.

We had such a friendly and knowledgeable tour guide in Steve, who was passionate and kept the whole experience alive. I learnt and saw so much and left with so much more understanding about the place we were staying. Yes there is a lot of walking but at a reasonable pace and the sights are so fascinating you don't really notice. Such a good price too!

Excellent guide (Tobi). Very knowledgeable and patient. Very good English too. The walk was long but Berlin has so many things to see. The day was very sunny, but Tobi make sure we always had a shady spot to listen to him.

A fantastic walking tour with Scott. I would highly recommend. He was so knowledgeable and funny and gave us loads of information. He allowed plenty of time to ask questions and stayed after in case anyone needed advice or help.

Took this tour with Heidi our first day in Berlin and it really served to help acquaint us to the city. It was a large tour (maybe about 30 people) but Heidi managed the group very well. She is really an excellent guide and a treasure trove of information about the city. Highly recommended.

My husband and I loved the tour. Chris has the rare ability to impart history in a clear and simple way, sharing just enough information so we remember it. He gave us a great context for Berlin’s history and as a history graduate has deep knowledge with which he could answer all our questions. A charming fellow with a good sense of humor too. He clearly enjoys his job and is great at it!

I can see why this is the top tour IN Berlin! I was engaged in this tour from beginning to end. A fantastic way to see all the major historical sites in Berlin as well as giving them meaning by learning about the story behind them. Izy our tour guide was amazing she was not only passionate and knowledgeable about Berlin but really made you think about what you were seeing and ask yourself questions about life in general! I will remember this tour for all the right reasons.

We had a great tour, Discover Berlin , with Jonny. He was knowledgable with a good sense of humor. We had seen some of the monuments Jonny showed us, but it was interesting to hear more of the history behind them. We are also taking another tour about World War 2 and the Third Reich and look forward to hearing more about Berlin from that perspective.

Jonathon K was superb in the scorching heat of Berlin .

It was a hot day and yet he kept going, loved his energy . He took us through the time of historical Berlin till 2000's in a nutshell which helped me take my picks for the next day.

Thanks Jon

Warmly recommended to everyone coming without too much background info about Berlin.
Tobi is a guide me and my 12 year son really appreciated, after experiencing his original, filled with empathy, informative and with a touch of humour guidance.
Thanks Tobias!
Would even think of repeating, this time with the while family.

If you don’t do anything else in Berlin you have to do this. We had Sam Z as our tour guide and he was simply fantastic. He was a wealth of knowledge and very likeable (easy on the eye too). He showed us landmarks with lots of commentary and I was simply captivated. Go, you won’t regret it 👍🏻

This tour was the very first thing that my 17 year old son and I did after arriving in Berlin. Best decision I've made for a long time. Our tour guide, Campbell, significantly enhanced the experience with his deep knowledge and great sense of humour. Amogst other things, the tour breathed life into my son's sudies. He's just finished studying the rise of the Nazi ideology and is currently studying the Cold War.

Scottish Scott was our tour guide who provided an insightful and thought provoking experience in a relaxed and friendly manner. Super knowledgable tour guide who brought our mini Berlin tour to life. Highly recommended...

Just done this tour and was a bit apprehensive as we don’t normally do walking tours but after this one will certainly consider them again . Our guide Jake was brilliant, very informative and made the tour extremely interesting and you see and hear about things you’d miss if you were on the bus etc. Definitely 100% recommend

Really enjoyed our walking tour of Berlin with Glen. Very informative and interesting stories bringing the city’s history to life. The time flew by. Would highly recommend Original Berlin Walking Tours and will book another one on my next trip to Berlin.

Our tour was absolutely fantastic. Max was an excellent guide, with an astounding understanding of Berlin’s culture and extensive knowledge of its history. He found a way to make the tour accessible to everyone in terms of information given but also raised the bar a little, encouraging everyone to be involved, ask questions, and offer their thoughts, making the tour very engaging overall; discussions were intersectional in scope and left room for a lot of reflection.The tour itself covered plenty of ground, without being exhausting or rushed in any way. It was a fantastic way to be introduced to a truly spectacular city. I can’t recommend the tour more highly!

Highly recommended. Amazing guide called Gregor. Passionate, thought provoking and very humble. The half day flew by and left us much better informed about Berlin as a city. Excellent experience all round.

I did this tour with Jonathan K on July 8. He was wonderful! It was a prefect way to see and learn about Berlin in a few years. I couldn't be any happier with the tour! If you want a quick way to learn about the city, get a taste of the major sites, and go for a pleasant walk in Berlin ... do yourself a favor and sign up!

We had a brilliant and extremely informative walk, Nathan was an excellent guide who was able to give us a great insight into the history of Berlin. We can thoroughly recommend this tour. Well worth enduring the cold!!

In general I would highly recommend this tour. Here are some of my insights:

- Very passionate, informative, friendly and funny guide (Xavier)
- No map was provided as it was written in the description
- Not all of the stations will be exactly meet and I suppose it changes depending how fast the group is (We ended up in Checkpoint Charlie). Yet it covers most of the stations with a nice history of Berlin explanation.

Our guide, Wouter, was fantastic. Very knowledgeable and friendly. He has a real passion for the history of the city and sharing it with his charges. We covered a lot of territory and he kept everyone engaged throughout. It was a cold day, but it didn't get in the way of our enjoyment of the tour. Glad we took this on our first day because it gave us a great orientation to the city and informed our plans for the next couple of days. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed this 4 hour walking tour of Berlin. Our guide was very knowledgeable and despite the cold we walked fast enough to stay warm. We also stopped for lunch along the way. Would highly recommend doing this walking tour.

A great way to see all the major attractions within a few hours. Our Guide Ysanne was very knowledgable and engaging which definitely enhanced our experience. This tour gave us the opportunity to plan the rest of our trip around which sites we wanted to revisit. Well worth the money!!

The tour took cca 4 hours. Our guide Sam Z made it so intersting that we didnt even notice the time, eventhough it was freezing cold.
We recomed the tour for everyone who wants to lear basicaly everything about Berlin in one day!

The walking tour was very informative and information-packed. I like how they split everyone who signed up into two smaller groups. Our group size was about 9 or 10. Our guide was Jonathan K., and he was very knowledgeable and approachable. I definitely appreciated all of the information and sites without having to look up and locate all these places on my own! Jonathan provided great insights and context as well. Thank you!

Booked this tour for our 3rd day in berlin wish we had done it on our first day. It was fantastic and I would highly recommend it. Sarah our tour guide was brilliant and her knowledge and enthusiasm really made this tour.learned so many interesting points that if we were walking around ourselves we would of missed. This is a must do when visiting berlin.

I took my two children aged 9 & 14, slightly nervous as to their attention span! I needn't have worried. Polly our guide was just brilliant.... her story telling is superb. The tour covers the main historical events of Berlin and is a fantastic way to start your sightseeing. Thoroughly recommend

We did a tour yesterday with “Jess” who was fantastic. He was incredibly knowledgeable and patient. My 16 yo daughter said it was the best thing she did in Berlin. I’d highly recommend anyone doing this trip as the first thing when they arrive. It gives you the WWII background and do much more (there is so much more to Berlin than the 12 years of Nazis and the Wall).

Our time in Berlin was too short, will definitely come back and hopefully “Jess” is still sharing his knowledge.

Xavier is a nice and knowledgeable person. We visited almost every important historical spot in Berlin. Xavier introduced us to the interesting stories behinds these spots and share his opinions. The journey took half a day but we didn't get bored or tired. Of course, it's impossible to know everything after only half a day, but after this trip, you will know what you want to know.

High recommend! Every person who loves history and walking should join this wonderful trip.

Our half day tour with Alex was great! He did an excellent job, making us feel welcome and free to ask questions. He is a great historian, very knowledgeable and shared many insights significant to Berlin. We certainly felt we received what we paid for. Thank you for the great tour Alex!

Here visiting with my 16 year old son. Literally the best money I have ever spent as a history fan. Rob S was a passionate and knowledgeable tour gauge who made it an amazing half day for us. Can’t recommend him/this enough.

The tour guide — Chris from Canada — did a great job. There was a lot of information and sights packed into the half day tour. It was a good primer about the history of Berlin, as well as for traveling in Germany in general. (Carry cash! A very good piece of advice!)

I knew quite a bit about the Cold War and WWII already, but this fast tour still had a lot of information I didn’t know.

I highly recommend! Next time I’m in Berlin, I will be looking up this tour guide’s specialty tours.

This was some of the best money we spent in Berlin. Xavier was an excellent guide, he shared so much and kept the tour moving without going too far into one topic. I leaned a lot that I didn’t know before. I would highly recommend.

Sam B was a wonderful guide informative, witty and relevant. Clear spoken engaging and respectful of the emotive subject. We did not feel rushed and there were many opportunities for questions which he was happy to answer.

What a lovely tour of Berlin! We got to see pretty much all the important historical places which define this city. Jake was such a brilliant, knowledgeable, captivating and friendly guide. Thank you Jake! I actually didn't show up for a pre-booked hop on-and-off bus the next day as I doubt there would have been much to add after this tour!

Excellent tour and Jonny was incredibly knowledgable and extremely good at sharing his knowledge, the history of Berlin and of the landmarks we saw. The trip and the walk flew by - and suddenly (and sadly) we were finished. There was no problem because of corona and we, and the tour, were not compromised at any time.

Our guide was fantastic, intelligent and very knowledgeable. She really put a lot of her passion into the tour. Near the end of the tour my daughter felt sick, it was very cold. Unfortunately, we left early. My apologies to the guide I really would have like to have thanked you personally.

Fantastic tour! Georgia was our guide and she was brilliant. We have been to Berlin before but wanted more info around the geographical history of the city. This was perfect. Georgia was full of knowledge and facts that we wouldn’t have got elsewhere and showed us parts of Berlin we otherwise wouldn’t have seen. She also tells a great story and was full of advice for the rest of the trip. Cannot recommend this tour enough!

Brilliant start to the history off Berlin ,Sam B your a brilliant tour guy ,awesome knowledge on all the history off Berlin makes you definitely want to come back an explore more off Berlin ,awful lot to squeeze into 3days.
Brilliant tour off the points I wanted to see.
Thank you Sam B

Nathan our guide was supremely knowledgeable. Able to bring to life the complex history of Berlin with passion and humour. We were shown things which on a 4 day visit we may very well have missed. A superb way to start a short break in this wonderful city

Just what we needed. Jake's tour of Berlin was amazing. He showed us around and explained in detail with photos the history of Berlin. Also gave us hints on how we could explore the city through the remainder of our trip.

I did both the Half Day Walking Tour and the Third Reich Walking Tour; both were excellent. Guides Xavier (he's French, don't hold it against him) and Gregor (He's a Berliner, don't hold it against him) knew their stuff. Both historians, they had more than answers to questions; their love of the city was evident.
Be prepared to walk. You get a good sense of the scope of the vast history of Berlin. And it is vast.
Take the time to do a solid walking tour. If I could have done more with this group, I would have but as the world is still in the throes of reopening, we had limited opportunities. If you have the chance to see more layers of this city with this crew, do it.

Our tour guide Jess was excellent! He was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the history of Germany. The tour was interesting and very informative. As we have never been to Berlin before, this tour was a perfect introduction to all the highlights and must see, sights in the city.

If you want a brief history and a starting point in this great city - this is a good way to achieve this. So many of the main sites are walked past. This has made the rest of my stay easier to organise as to which ones I want to go back to. Our guide Jonathan was a great source of information and extremely knowledgeable. He brought the history of the city alive and gave a great overview.

This was a perfect way to see all the best bits of Berlin in a condensed 3-4 hour tour. Our tour guide Rob was brilliant and made it thoroughly enjoyable. Would absolutely recommend for those visiting Berlin.

Our guide was terrific. I learned so much about the history of Berlin, World War II, etc. This tour covered many highlights. Jonathan our guide was terrific. I arrived in the AM from the USA and took this tour in the afternoon for approx 3 hours I think. I was a terrific way to start my 5 days. This tour company has great guides - took four of their tours.

I was in Berlin for the Marathon and only had a day to explore pre run. Levent was a FABULOUS guide who took us around the city with so much enthusiasm. I fell in love with Berlin during that tour and was so glad I chose Original Berlin Walks and Levent!

Xavier was our guide. He could not have been more informative and entertaining. He was overflowing with information, humor, and enthusiasm. He walked very fast to pack a lot in and our tour extended well past the cut off time. Most important sites covered. I think he is one of the best guides we have ever had, if not the best. Plus he looks just like Daniel Craig.

Best way to see all the great monuments and attractions in Berlin whilst learning the detailed history along with it. Heidi was so welcoming and friendly and could answer any questions asked. Wouldn't recommend any other tour

Scottish Sam was a great tour guide! The tour was filled with a lot of great history. I especially liked the interesting and funny anecdotes that were given at times. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Berlin!

We were touring Berlin in August 2022 with three teenagers. Our guide was Chris from Canada. He was pleasant, funny, and knowledgeable. Overall this was sensational experience. Strongly strongly recommend for anyone

Hi to his Mom. Great job

We took this walking tour on our first morning in the city. Our guide Jacob was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about his adopted city. Tip: take one of those free tourist maps you get at hotel receptions and keep an eye on where you are on the walk. It really helps to familiarise yourself with the area for after the walk.

We had Maxime as our tour guide, gave us the down low of the full tour beforehand and we got to see the sites as suggested in the tour.. great interaction between tour guide and group. Gave us options and voted on things to do.
Very knowledgeable about Berlin history, perfect English. Very understandable

Really great tour, guide was friendly and informative and added a little humour where appropriate, too.

Good overview of the city's history, a nice change from the usual Nazi and Cold War focused tours. Highly recommended.

Gives you the break down of the important things that happened here and the story telling is amazing. We were in Berlin for 4 days and throughly enjoyed the walk and the sight seeing accompanied by the facts which would have taken a lot of books to reach. Highly recommended. We did it twice once with Jake and the second time with Ryan. Both of them were amazing and had really interesting facts about the city
Participated on 1/2 day walking tour on a wet Saturday in January. It was excellent - the guide was engaging, well informed and likeable. Got a much better insight into Berlin’s history and politics.

Xavier was our guide .Kept us interested for the whole tour with his immense knowledge of the history of Berlin and the Wars right up to present day .
It made sense of the amazing city of Berlin today and the many historical areas .

The tour with Ay was interesting and very informative. The tour was around 4 hours with breaks but Ay kept us engaged throughout . This was my daughter‘s first proper walking tour ( she is 10 and the pandemic kept us from traveling in the last 2.5 years) and she loved every bit of it too. Would highly recommend this tour and Ay for a wholesome experience of Berlin.

Rebecca was an excellent tour guide. She has a wealth of knowledge, and covered a lot of both ground and time. The pace was great and the time went by quickly. This was my first time in Berlin and I highly recommend this as a starting activity.

We were a little lucky with the sunny winter weather, but this tour really was one of the best parts of our trip. Berlin has such a rich history in plain sight, and you'd never know it existed or it's story without a great guide, which Campbell certainly was. Great character , knowledge, and recommended various things after the tour ended. Great experience, thanks

This was an awesome tour. One of the best tours I have taken in a group setting. Xavier was informative, knowledgeable and fun. He answered all our questions, kept us all entertained with his great personality and enthusiasm for Berlin. A great way to explore so many sights and so much history. Wish I could give Xavier 6 stars.

We had a fascinating time with our excellent guide Steve. He was so full of energy and information and we learnt so much. It was a cold day so the stop half way through for a hot drink was welcome. Wear lots of layers! Steve got the perfect balance between knowledge, humour and the sensitivity which some of the sites demand. Would highly recommend this tour and this guide.

This was great. Maxime was a very knowledgable guide with an engaging approach and affable manner. Put lots of landmarks into context with interesting stories of each. Wife and I in our forties with 15 year old daughter and all enjoyed it. Highly recommended.

Excellent 3-4 hour walking tour through the main tourist/historical points of Berlin, with great informations and details.

Tobi is an excellent guide, with great communication. In addition to the great historical knowledge, at the end of the tour, he shared his personal experience, which makes everything even more interesting.

A great tour to do if you have 1-2 days in Berlin! It was super informative and we got to see a lot of sights in the 4+ hours. TOBI was an excellent guide (and super funny too!). He kept the tour informative and entertaining - a 10/10 experience!

Absolutely incredible, my favourite part of my holiday in Berlin. The guide was very friendly, knowledgeable, entertaining and a great orator. The tour serves as a great baseline for your visit and will leave you with a good idea of areas that you would like to revisit afterwards. Can't recommend it highly enough!

We had our walking tour with Glen this morning and it was amazing. He was so knowledgable about the history of the city. Everything was explained so well and was Glen was mindful to give a balanced view of East Berlin from Berliners he knows personally. The history we gained from this tour was fantastic and definitely 100% value for money. Would highly recommend the tour and would highly recommend Glen! Thank you!
Killer tour. Highly recommend. Learned a lot in a short amount of time. Jacob was our guide, and his passion for Berlin was contagious. Am sure all guides are good, but hook up with Jacob if you can.

Fantastic experience with our wonderful tour guide Walid. His has an unique perspective since he has been living in Berlin since 16 years ago. It’s also a pleasure to have an exchange with him about the circumstances of the local science education system.

Excellent tour a must do when in Berlin, it covers all East Berlin and all the historical sites of importance. It gave us a great sense of the city and its history along with our bearings. Jorg is an excellent guide and this 4 Hr walking tour is a Must Do

This was exactly the kind of tour we wanted-centred on the last 100 years of modern world history and its horrors. Our guide was Kevin who controlled us suitably
germanically. The historical info was based on true sources and totally correct. He was very passionate but a little n on engaging. In a way that was good but I realise that it is because the tour is prepaid so he doesn't expect a tip (though he cheekily suggested one, which we paid). A great tour but little engagement, and a few too many uses of 'so what could go wrong'. This is refreshing. J

I cannot recommend enough, especially if a first timer in Berlin. A fantastic well researched tour, Georgia was an excellent host, so knowledgeable, funny and honest. Recommend to anyone wanting to learn more about the history of Berlin.

Kyle our tour guide was just amazing. Her knowledge, her ability to answer questions and keep the kids entertained was very special.
It was super cold yet she kept us going for the entire 4 hours!
My kids, ages 10 and 12 were not bored.
A great tour to get a good understanding of Berlin (and German) history!
Well done Kyle!

Don't go to Berlin without taking this tour. Amazing. You can then go back & rediscover in more detail should you have time.
Words can't describe how amazing Georgia was. Her knowledge of Berlin & her presentation should be bottled. Everyone was treated as an individual.
Do ask for her!!!

Steve was a fantastic tour guide. We loved his information, his jokes, and his clear enthusiasm for his job. He also helped us figure out what to do after the tour. This was one of my favorite walking tours ever, and the four students I brought along loved it as much as I did.

Campbell was fantastic, witty and extremely knowledgeable. Him being a graduate in history and an expert on World War helped a lot. He kept up the spirits of the Group through the 4+ hours trip. The tour covers a lot. The Original Berlin Walks and Campbell are highly recommended.

Tobi is an absolute gem!

It was my first time in Berlin with my wife as part of our honeymoon. Tobi did an amazing job making our experience of Berlin a very meaningful one. I asked history related questions that he answered with much insight. Great story teller as well.

To be honest, this was my best walking tour throughout our 24 day European honeymoon trip.

We toured Berlin September 23 with Original Berlin Walks and had Sarah as our guide. She was fabulous - her English was perfect with a great Aussie accent. Sarah brought Berlin to life for us.
