We had toured by ourselves the day before, but it is so much better with a knowledgeable guide. 4 hours well spent, stopping briefly at approximately 25 sites.

Thoroughly recommend this tour!

Lesley and John (Canadians)

Our guide Xavier made this tour come alive. He gave 110% to the whole day. I would gladly do another tour with him, and what’s more he made it interesting for my 12yr old, now that I was not expecting! If you want to know a city in less than a day, this is the man and this is the tour!

This was a long (just over 4 hours) tour, but I loved every minute of it. Mainly I think as our guide, Tobi, was so engaging. I think helped by the fact that he had grown up in East Berlin and lived through the wall coming down. It was a fascinating tour and I learnt so much about the history of Berlin. Thanks Tobi for such a great time.

Xavier was epic. Was a cold December day but he made it amazing. Loved his passion and enjoyment for showing us round the history of Berlin, not to mention his exceptional knowledge. Would highly recommend this tour and Xavier

Our guide (Rob S.) truly made history come alive! We loved every minute. This was our favorite activity on our two week trip to Germany so far. Tip: Wear confortable shoes. Rob didn't skimp on the time. We got our money's worth and more. A perfect day of sightseeing and learning in Berlin!
Great job by the tour guide. I believe his name was Glen? Sorry, I am bad with names. Did a great job explaining the history of Berlin. A lot of ground was covered and interesting sites were visited.

My friends and I really enjoyed the tour. We had Rebecca as our guide. She was knowledgeable and had a great enthusiasm for the history of the city. We were 1st times in Berlin and this was a great introduction to the various spots in Berlin. About 4 hours walking but didn't feel tired. Had lunch and toiket break. Was suggest cafes where one could try local cusines like currywurst. Highly recommend.
Tobi, thanks a lot for being our tourist guide. We had a memorable berlin city tour because of Tobi. If you are coming to berlin, want to go for a city tour, don’t miss Tobi’s guiding tour…

I’ve been on many similar tours throughout Europe, but Giorgio’s was the best. Extremely knowledgeable, patient, easy to understand, and obviously dedicated to his job. He really knows his history and makes it entertaining. He could be a model for other guides. We got a full four hours of information. We really got our money’s worth!

I only started taking guided tours a few years ago. But walkabouts like this with such a great guide are the reason I love them now. Jonny spoke with passion and a lot of knowledge. I can’t recommend this tour, and particularly Jonny, enough.

We thoroughly enjoyed this half day walking tour. It was our first time in Berlin and learned so much. Rebecca was absolutely brilliant! She was professional but friendly and interacted well with the group. Her knowledge was first class. I would highly recommend.

A great tour, absolutely recommended! Our tour guide, Gregor, was great and very knowledgeable. Answered every question with a smile. We got to see a lot of sights, yet it did not feel stressfull. Would absolutely do again! Thank you!

Great walking tour of Berlin. Our guide Tom was amazing, very knowledgable and obviously very passionate about Berlin.

The tour gave a great overview of the history of Berlin, and took us around a whole bunch of the major sights, along with great recommendations of other things to see and do in Berlin from Tom.

Would definitely recommend this tour, well worth the money.
Canadian Chris (aka Moon King) was a great tour guide. Good mix of history and commentary. Answered questions fully while keeping a good pace. We learned and enjoyed.

An excellent tour around Berlin encompassing the history of Nazi rule and much more besides. Our tour guide, Xavier, was brilliant and I enjoyed the history lesson, as well as his excellent narrative throughout. Highly recommended to all visitors to this wonderful Capital city

A great walking tour.

Our guide was Glen. Passionate, animated, interesting and knowledgable.

A brilliant introduction to the main sites in Berlin, and great to hear the background to what / why !

Thoroughly recommend for your first day in Berlin ... if you are lucky enough to get Glen ... you have hit the jackpot !!

Joined the Discover Berlin walking tour with Fran, had so much fun it was as if the cold did not bother me after walking for 4 hours. Fran is deeply passionate and knowledgable in her field with explanations that are clear and concise. Leaving Berlin a lot more knowledgable. Thanks Fran.

I really enjoyed learning about the history of Berlin and how the East Berlin people felt. Glen was an entertaining guide. I particularly liked seeing Checkpoint Charlie as it is now as I have previously been through it before the Berlin Wall came down.

I and my wife really enjoyed it very much. Our guide Dave who is from Melbourne Australia was very good. Made the four hour tour very interesting and had a great humour that pleased all on it. He had very interesting stories about places we stopped off at. I must say it was excellent and very enjoyable.

Heidi was a fabulous, kind, patient guide who shared so much history and detail, we loved it!
My only regret is that we didn’t do this the first day of our holiday as it’s opened our eyes to so many amazing places to visit further.
We would highly recommend and are considering another tour for later in our week. Thank you very much, Heidi!

As first time visitors to Berlin, my boyfriend (German) and I (Australian) absolutely loved this tour. Tour guide Canadian Chris was excellent. The whole day was a perfect mix of informative, thought provoking and also very fun, which is especially hard to go between when describing some of the intense parts of Berlin’s history. Tasteful delivery of facts with a great mix of contemporary info and tourist tips made a great tour! Would definitely book another tour with this company!

Our tour guide Gregg (Gregor) gave us a real insight into this remarkable city. It really gave us what felt like a better understanding of the history that the people here have experienced, embraced and evolved from. Left us wanting to learn more and opened our eyes to so many things.

Thank you Scottish Sam for the very informative, historically accurate account of Berlin. Your tour was great fun, would have enjoyed the entire day with you on tour. Highly recommended for anyone wanting a 1000 year history lesson crammed into a couple of hours.

Cheers

Blaise and Hayley
South Africa

Great 3 1/2 hour tour with Sam.W. Saw loads we would have missed or spent hours trying to find.
Very knowledgeable and helpful guide in Sam.W.

Would heartily recommend as money very well spent.

I signed up for the walking tour or Berlin. The tour exceeded my expectations the guide, Sam Z, was brilliant. A history scholar who is clearly passionate about his subject, and was able to explain the history of Berlin in just the right amount of detail to make it interesting.

I have been on a lot of city tours and without a doubt this was one of the best thanks to Sam. Berlin as a city has a lot to offer. I would definitely highly recommend this tour.

Amazing tour - very knowledgable guide and managed to keep up all entertained and engaged despite awful weather. Great activity for day 1 of our visit to Berlin as we could then decide what more we wanted to see. Good pace, not rushed but didn’t realise 3.5hrs had passed!

Had a really fabulous tour today with Xavier. He was great fun and so immensely knowledgeable and interesting about Berlin; he used humour and his personality to make it a great experience. We would recommend him and the tour to anyone coming to Berlin.

Without a doubt the best walking tour I've ever been on. Martin was a brilliant guide - extremely knowledgeable, entertaining and passionate. Provided valuable insight into Berlin's complex history. Would highly recommend this tour, thank you Martin!

Josie and I had a great time exploring Berlin with our guide Georgia who seem to know everything about Berlin. An excellent lunch along the way as well. A definite good day for our first day in Berlin.

The tour guide Xavier was incredible . Really took us in a journey, it being a walking tour and all. We really enjoyed every part of the tour. Knowledgeable and fascinating. Getting an introduction into all the history that shaped the modern Berlin and what makes it such an incredible place to visit made it an unforgettable tour. Lovely hot day and unusually quiet(er) streets capped an already great walking tour.

Such an informative tour. Glen, our tour guide was brilliant. A great way to learn about the history of Berlin at a bargain price. Would have loved a copy of Glen’s folder of old photos that added context to many of the places we visited. If they could produce a booklet to accompany the tour I’m sure all participants would buy one. I definitely would have.
Fantastic guided tour. Tobi was full of information, funny’s and great. Lasted about 4 hours with half hour break but we’ll worth it - learnt so much and we all enjoyed. Great value for money

Matty was my guide and I have to say he was amazing. He was full of knowledge, enthusiasm and added his personal touch to the tour. I'm so glad you were the tour guide Matty. You made me feel like I left knowing Berlin. Thank you for taking the time chatting to me and all your other guests during our walking tour. You made a difference.
Louise from Ireland

The tour was really great. Tobi our guide was very knowledgable. He made it fun to listen to. You get to see a lot of the tourist attractions on this tour. We stopped at Checkpoint Charlie for a coffee break, before restarting the tour. Then it was on to one of the remains of the berlin wall, again Tobi had lots of information about this area. The tour finished at the Brandenburg gate. Tobi was ready to answer any questions at each place we stopped. The memorial to the holocaust victims was poignant. Would highly recommend this tour if you are planning a trip to Berlin.

Absolutely wonderful tour! We had a great time and learned a lot. Out guide Tom was very knowledgeable and just fun to listen to. I loved how the tour is structured: you're traveling through history from the early days of the Berlin village to the modern day. I highly recommend this tour!

Very informative tour! We had the knowledgeable Johnathan as a guide. Awesome guy😄.
Would definitely recommend if you want to walk around a bit in Berlin.
Remember to wear good shoes and hat/shades and bring something to drink.
Highly recommended!!! 😊😊

Our guide, Jess, was so knowldgeable and enthusiastic. He gave an insight to the history of Berlin and the sights on the tour. He was always happy to provide more information as requested by the group. An afternoon very well spent and an excellent way to learn and understand so much more about the city.
We'd never been on one of these tours before, but will definitely repeat the experience...tho' Jess will be a hard act to follow!!

My tour guide was Jonathan. He is quite experienced with the city and history. Didnt drag the tour, covered all the places and explained well about everything. Will definitely do again once im back to Berlin. Thank u. It was well worth it for the price i paid.

Fantastic tour! We were in Berlin just for one day and we’re so glad we did this tour. Our tour guide, Reuben, was amazing! So knowledgeable about the history of Berlin. He took us to all the must see spots. Highly recommend.

Jacob was an amazing tour guide.he kept it entertaining at all times.
I loved how knowledgeable, friendly and engaging he was.
I took the tour because I had nothing to do that day,but I didn't know it would be one of the best things I'd do in Berlin.
It's truly recommended.

my friend and i went today for the “discover berlin” tour with Chris the Canadian as our guide. the tour was amazing and even though it was raining a bit he was making sure we won’t miss anything. he was energetic, knowledgeable and extremely fun! if this is your first time in berlin, you must take this tour and preferably with Chris.

It was wonderful experience. Our guise was Jorg and he was well educated person. His tour was very funny and we have seen a lot of beautiful, interesting and amazing places. I would recommend him to everyone. Its a must do tour in Berlin.

In Berlin for only the weekend and wanted to go on a tour that wasn’t too long but was able to take us around all the sights. This tour did not disappoint. Our tour guide Sam B was excellent and informative-didn’t realise I didn’t know anything about Berlin but do now. Fascinating. Would highly recommend!

This tour was fantastic, very informative and a great way to get to know Berlin and its history. I had Scottish Sam as the guide and he was really great and knowledgeable. I already know this will be one of the most memorable parts of my six week Europe trip.

Very good value for the cost. Four hour tour covered historic area of central Berlin. Very informative tour guide. We did the tour when we first arrived in Berlin and it showed us places we wanted to go back to on our own.

Our guide Scott was brilliant. Very passionate and knowledgeable. Thoroughly enjoyed this trip. 4 hours sounds like a long time but it flew by. Learnt so much and enabled us to find our way round the city for the rest of our stay in Berlin. Throughly recommend.

Rebekka (sorry, not sure about the orthography :) ) guided us through Berlin. It was super cool, even though she wasn't able to stop the rain... My only regret is that the visit is mostly about the contemporary history of Berlin (WW2, Cold War...), I wished I learned more about the more ancient history as well.

Simply put, it's a 1930s to 1950s history class condensed into 4 hours. It was very well done. Dave was amazing and super knowledgeable and helpful from the history of Germany and Berlin to other sights and sounds around. Also has that noticeable friendly and energetic Australian accent. Great tour.

Very informative and experiential: lots of knowledge and insight about the origins and development of Berlin. Scott was amazing as he quickly put centuries of history into context, and explained things in a very straightforward way. The way he allowed us to experience and interpret the holocaust memorial was amazing. It was nice to take a 20 minute break at the half way stage too, much needed.

Our guide Anika was excellent. Great commentary and a fantastic synopsis of Berlin history prior to start. Ticked off some of the major attractions in Berlin. Would have liked a bit more time to explore each one, but overall a great tour

What a great way to spend our first day in Berlin. It was awesome and informative tour of Berlin! It was great for both my parents and I who had totally different interests. I was able to learn a lot about Berlin’s history and they got to take tons of pics. Our tour guide was Nathan and he was beyond amazing. It was like taking a nice stroll through Berlin with an old friend. If possible, definitely request him!

We had a fabulous tour with Jonathan. My knowledge of the history of Germany and Berlin was small but after the guided walking tour I was blown away. Jonathan is an excellent guide and he was also full of great recommendations. The highlight of our visit to Berlin.
Our Walking Tour of Berlin was fantastic. Our Tour Guide Rob was extremely personable & interesting. His love of history really showed and he made the tour one to remember. Would highly recommend it.

We all thoroughly enjoyed the half day walk in central Berlin. Our guide Nathan was excellent and had extensive knowledge of the history of Berlin . With his passion for history and Germany we couldn't have asked for a better tour.

We did the walk on our first day in Berlin. Not only was it full of information about Germany’s history but it also helped us discover what attractions we wanted to visit throughout the rest of our trip. Sarah was our guide and she was very welcoming and knowledgeable!

We took the early tour (in English) today and we loved it!
Sam B was a wonderful guide and gave us an amazing tour, we had a great time. He was so knowledgeable about the city! It was super informative and we learned a lot of interesting facts and visited a lot of famous places.
We definitely recommend this tour!

Absolutely wonderful tour of Berlin and an essential start to any holiday here. Our tour guide, Maxime, was amazing. Really informative and engaging. The walk last for 4 hours but it’s a really relaxing experience. Hugely recommend.

Our tour led by our guide Xavier was excellent. Thoroughly reccommend this tour to explore the history and significant parts of Berlin. Xavier was very knowledgeable and with good personality could answer any questions we threw at him. Brilliant tour.

The tour was amazing and very informative. The guide (Sam Z) was super helpful and nice. He gave some useful tips not only about travelling around Berlin, but also about Potsdam. It is a good tour for someone who is interested in history and some of the most important highlights in Berlin.

Excellent tour, our guide Giorgio was very knowledgeable and engaging. It's not an ordinary walking tour, it's a walking history class. My family appreciates the way you managed the participants, it was interactive and insightful. Kudos!

Our guide, Stephen, really made our tour of Berlin amazing! He was passionate, theatrical, and hilarious. Most of all, he was informative. I dont think our trip would have been as fun or interesting if we hadn't taken this tour! Very much recommended!

Kevin was amazing! Yes indeed! I felt like I got 4 years of history in 4 hours. So knowledgeable, friendly and nice. He offered us places to go for lunch after too! The places we visited were so touching and moving, and it was wonderful to get the history behind every place.

Great walking tour by Franziska. Thoroughly enjoyable morning tour that moved along at a steady pace with enough rest breaks. Information was well delivered and made all the more pleasurable by the wealth of facts and history from the talented and informed Franziska. Well done. I highly recommend this tour.

We did this walking tour with Anja yesterday. Having done lots of such tours, I gave to say this was absolutely fantastic. Knowledgeable, fun, nice - everything you want a tour to be. Thanks for teaching us so much in such a short time.

This was really a great tour!!
Our guide Tobi was extremely knowledgeable with a very pleasant personality!
We saw all of Berlin in just a couple of hours, in a great itinerary with many stops.
Tobi shared many stories with us!
Totally recommend this tour!!!
Sam W was a great tour guide, really knew the background of Berlins History and was extremely friendly

The route was good but our guide (Gerard?) from Indiana just wanted to talk non stop. Mainly about himself and rarely about the monument. After nearly two hours and having travelled only as far as the Deutsch History Museum we abandoned the tour in search of warmth and more interesting information. From the reviews, other guides may be better and certainly two that left after us passed us out and disappeared out of view.

I would recommend a map, google or a good guide book. Cheaper, less patronising and more informative.

My friend and I took Ysanne’s discover berlin tour this past week and loved it! She is incredibly knowledgeable, sweet and entertaining. We loved her and would highly recommend her tour!!! Thanks Ysanne!!!

We only had 2 full days in Berlin so decided to book a walking tour to get our bearings.
Our guide, Wouter, was so knowledgeable and passionate the four hours flew by, in fact the walk overran by 30+ minutes but no one noticed or cared, I think we'd all have been happy to spend the rest of the day with him.
We've always sniggered at the group's following a lady holding an umbrella up but realised these walks tell you far more about the city you're visiting than you can absorb no matter how many guidebooks you read.

We had Ryan, who was an awesome guide for a 4-hour intro to Berlin’s history. We stopped at many of the major sites anyone in Berlin has to see: Museum Island, Bebelplatz (where Nazis burned books), checkpoint Charlie, the former site of the Gestapo HQ and only remaining portion of the Berlin Wall, and more...

Ryan was a great guide!

Our tour with Gregor was outstanding. He provided a comprehensive yet concise overview of Berlin’s complicated history and its vibrant rebirth .He was engaging and extremely knowledgeable and incorporate social, political and artistic perspectives in his presentation. It was a walking history class with a favorite young professor. We highly recommend this tour.

We had a fantastic 4 hour tour this morning. Rob, our Mancunian tour guide (don’t hold that against him) was truly excellent. He certainly knew his stuff in great detail but shared at a level that we could follow - in four hours you do get to cover a lot of information. Rob delivered this in a very engaging way with a bit of humour and light banter thrown in. We have been on a few walking tours and this was definitely the best one we’ve done.
Thanks Rob!!

My sister and I (79 and 75 years old) took this walking tour with Georgia as our guide. She was excellent. We covered a lot of territory on a very hot day, and the pace was very good. It was a fairly large group -- more than 20 -- ranging in age from 20-somethings to us old-timers, and Georgia made sure we all heard her commentary. She has a deep knowledge of Berlin's history and gave a very clear explanation of the significance of the sites we visited. I've been to Berlin on previous occasions, but I learned a great deal from Georgia. I highly recommend the tour and the guide.

My wife and I took this interesting sounding tour on 10/20/2017.We walked with our guide who said he was from Greece and had done his Phd. in something relevant to tours of cities.
We love history and enjoy informative guided tours.
Any tour is visual and it is enhanced by pertinent, interesting and to the point information imparted by a knowledgeable guide. A good guide is very important in enhancing the tour experience.
But alas, our guide talked for around 20 mins. at each spot that he stopped at and trying to listen to him I was glassy eyed, attempting to absorb that an elector or an emperor had worn a blue robe or his mistress had worn red and on and on and on.
Should I pay attention to this constantly running tape recording or look at the marvelous buildings in front of me and all around?

The joy of anticipating and appreciating the architecture was completely lost.
A family of four left after about 45 mins and I told the guide that it was difficult to enjoy the tour.
He said he knew he spoke too much but he was doing his job!
This was probably our sixtieth tour with Viator and the most boring.
After 2 hours we left by taxi saw the Berlin Wall and the memorial with excellent first had information from a third generation Berliner our taxi driver who gladly answered questions and allowed us to get down and take photos.
BUT OUR MONEY SPENT ON THIS TOUR WAS WASTED.THE GUIDE CONTINUED TO TALK AND DIDNT REGRET ONE BIT THAT WE LEFT.
In fact at the start of the tour he had stated that those who want to leave may do so any time.

Georgia is absolutely amazing with her spectrum of knowledge and sincere passion about history, and thanks to her, the tour has been super informative and interesting! The pace was quite comfortable, and all the discussions and Q&As with Georgia were absolutely fascinating as well! Highly recommend it!

Jonny the guide made the tour :)
Brill tour. Jonny was very informative and made the tour interesting
This was an excellent tour and the price could not be beat. Sarah was fantastic. She knew so much about the history of the city and had lots of interesting facts and stories to share.
Excellent, Sam was brilliant as our tour guide, learned so much about the history of Berlin. Would recommend.
Really enjoyed my trip around Berlin. The guide Campbell was full of useful information. Would recommend to anyone visiting the city for the first time.
Amazing tour! Beth, our Guide was incredibly knowledgeable. The tour is worth so much more than what you pay for!

Our host Matti was fantastic. We visited a set of key destinations in the town, where he provided historical context and detail that gave us a concise view of the city. We got a perspective on the history of Germany generally and Berlin in particular, and of course extensive coverage of the various world wars and their impact in this fantastic city. The tour went by surprisingly quickly.

This is an outstanding tour not to be missed. Excellent very knowledgeable and friendly guide Joseph. It made our few days in Berlin and gave us great insight into the history of the City. Highly recommend.

We had Tobi as our tour guide and he was the highlight of the tour. He had a vast knowledge of local history and was a thoroughly engaging tour guide.
The tour itself was very informative and takes you through a good part of East Berlin so you see alot of the historical landmarks.
This walking tour of the city, coupled with Tobi's dazzling personality was certainly the absolute high point of the day for us.
This is a must.
5 stars.

The tour was super interesting with Campbell. Very informative and we were all encouraged to ask questions. The dark history of Berlin truly sends chills down your spine. The tour pretty much covers all it had to from the German empire to the fall of SS and then the famous Wall and the unification of East and West Germany. The holocaust memorial site was truly amazing but what's more amazing was the way Campbell explained everything, gave more meaning to the site than i could have imagined. Campbell was funny and informative and he knows his history. When i get back here with my parents next year, i will do the tour with Campbell again. Highly recommended.
The tour includes a lot of historical and landmarks in Berlin. It is perfectly organized and our guide Tobi is very knowledgeable. It is a must!

We had a great tour with Toni. He was very knowledgeable and entertaining. This was the BEST money we spent on our trip to Europe! So much interesting history in Berlin. I would highly recommend this tour.

I have been to Berlin a couple of times and obviously had my eyes closed!! I just want to say a massive thanks to SamZ!!

Without a shadow of a doubt the best way to spend 4 hours! Informative, reflective, engaging and funny! All the group had the best time. Sam has a real passion for history and Berlin revealing the true identity of a once divided capital!

I’d even do this tour again! Thanks to Sam (Z)

The guide ,Scott, started by being a bit nasty and spoke as though the tour was below him. Didn’t want to engage in any talk but rattled out history which is already in textbooks.
Have been to few original walks in different cities. However berlin one has been by far the worst one.
Even the Christmas market walk was not that great.Felt the guides were bored of doing these walks.
The only one guide that was fun and nice was Damian

A BIG thank you to Tobi, our guide for the day who is professional and knowledgeable. The tour was thoroughly enjoyable, informative and engaging. It covered a lot of area and interesting/ important landmarks. I recommend it as a must do for first timers to Berlin!

Our tour guide was Xavier/ great personality - gave lots of pertinent information along the route and had a portfolio of photos which he showed us to illustrate differences - we saw all amazing sights - walking pace was comfortable- even for us seniors - good value and worthwhile to get a “sense” of Berlin and it’s history
The tour was excellent very informative & well planned. We couldn't have wished for a better tour guide Xavier was a great friendly approachable guy. We would definitely recommend this tour.

Kevin was an amazing guide. I don't want to reveal too much about the tour, but suffice it to say, you'll get your fill of WW2, Cold War, and pre-modern history. You'll traverse a large portion of the city and see some amazing sights. The tour guide will give deep context to these sights and, perhaps, will challenge your emotions and preconceptions regarding the history of Berlin and Germany in general. I can't recommend it enough.

Very nice walk tour around berlin with an Irish tour guide (this was unexpected)..
He really knew his subject & made us discover Berlin from another angle. Great one & would recommend. Not much to walk as i initially feared - all Berlin landmarks are closed by..

My husband and I did this tour today and are really happy we chose to have a tour of the city with a guide rather than wondering around on our own which we usually do. Georgia was our guide and she was excellent! Very knowledgeable but also very interacting with the group, so it didn’t just feel like pouring out facts but was really interesting. I would definitely recommend taking a tour as you learn details about places, people or buildings which you would have no idea about if you just walked past them on your own. Thanks Georgia!

Sebastian made the tour. We were collected from a Starbucks in the centre of Berlin by Sebastian. Sebastian knew his history. A self confesssd “geek” of ancient history and also more modern history, he was able to bring the tour to life with endless enthusiasm and knowledge of the city.
The tour takes you round the main highlights of Berlin over a 4 hr period. Sebastian sets a steady pace, pausing every so often to explain the buildings and the history.
Sebastian really cares about the history and brings massive historical events to life, with his dramatic and thought provoking narrative.
The tour took in Museum Island, Frederic the Great, the collapse of the Berlin Wall, Checkpoint Charlie, Hitlers bunker, the Jewish memorial and the Brandenburg Gate. Over the 4 hours you get a real feel of the city and Sebastian really helps this. We stopped half way through for a coffee break and the 4 hours flew by.
A must for new visitors to Berlin looking to get their bearings and receive a full overview of the history in this superb city. If you are lucky enough to have Sebastian as your tour guide, the experience will be that much better but I’m sure the other guides are just as good,

I always try to get on a walking tour the first time I visit a city and I chose this tour. Our guide was an Israeli Jew who was very knowledgeable and funny. There are some things one would likely miss if you did not take a tour; such as, where Hitler's bunker was located. The tour was a very good introduction to Berlin and we spent a good deal of time waling down Under de Linden. He noted the differences between East & West German buildings. None of us took many pictures as there is a lot of ground to cover and you do not want to miss what the guide is saying. Realize you will have to go back to the sites to really take photos, which I did. Excellent guide - strongly recommend tour.

We did a half day tour and enjoyed it on a nice Berlin day. The price isn’t too bad for how long and the info you get. Our guide Kevin, or Martin (can’t remember exactly) has lived in Berlin for a number of years and is invested in the city emotionally. He has a wealth of knowledge which is great for a tour like this but were a little disappointed in his interaction with the group and how he would give personal opinion on a lot of subjects. ‘Enjoy it whole you can’. Questions would only be answered in context and only if the questions were up to his standard. His quick shut down and reaction to questions at the start of the tour ended the likelihood of us asking any questions at all. This really was a shame! We enjoyed the tour however (which was only saved by his knowledge) and made joke of his constant shut down of others. To end the tour he mentioned tips etc. which we found a bit amusing. We know this is how you make money but we also did pay for the tour. If we felt it was that good we would tip you.

Gregor, our guide, was simply excellent. These types of tours are very much made or broken by the quality of the guide. We have experienced the entire spectrum of these tours throughout our travels. Our tour with Gregor was fantastic. He clearly takes great pride in his work and it is clear he has a personal mission to make sure the group has a thorough understanding of Berlin and German history and culture. The tour went above and beyond expectations and it really made my stay in Berlin. I feel I now have a rich understanding of German culture, it’s history, the personal feeling and sentiments towards its history and even it’s effects on the people today. I’m sure I wouldn’t have gained this kind of perspective on my own. I cannot recommend a tour with Gregor enough.

Berlin is a big city and this is an excellent way to start your visit. Tour guide Ken took us to the major tourist sites and provided a solid overview of the history and added some humor along the way. The tour took less than four hours and includes a thirty-minute break midway through the tour. Ken is a brisk walker so be prepared to keep up--we loved his pace.

For city breaks our first activity is always a walking tour to get a good initial overview of the city, this tour was perfect. Sam W was our guide and he clearly knew his stuff when it came to the history of Berlin. There is so much history in Berlin, this tour is the ideal place to start
Took the tour with the guide Sarah who was friendly and extremely knowledgeable. The tour was well paced and gave me a great understanding of the history of Berlin.

We are in Berlin for a few days and wanted an introduction to the city. This tour was excellent. Polly was our tour guide and she was very knowledgeable. She kept my teenage daughters interest for the 3.5 hours which is no mean feet and she's come back to the hotel reading more about the issues raised. We were a bit worried 3.5 hours might be a long time walking but it went by really quickly with plenty of opportunity to stop and listen. We would all highly recommend this tour... A great way to get to know this city. Thanks Polly!

Kyle was a great guide. Very friendly. Very knowledgeable about the city. This tour was the perfect introduction to the history of this fantastic place.I would recommend all visitors start with this tour.

Great tour with Dave very interesting and very informative and thought provoking, also he has a great sense of humour. Saw loads of points of interest which gave us a great start to trip so we could go back to the ones we wanted to view in-depth again. Walk was 3 and half hours but loads of stops and also a short break half way. Had photos to make points and engaged with group. Aside from giving a great tour i was impressed with his care to group it was extremely hot in Berlin he had brought sun cream for anyone who had forgot, made sure we all had opportunity to get water if we didn’t have any and when we did stop he made sure he gave talks where we had shade, also had tips for free museums. Highly recommended.

Sebastian was very outgoing, funny, and informed! He is not just an expert in history but you can tell it’s his passion! It was fun to hear the background of some of the places in Berlin. I did enjoy every minute in the tour and highly recommend it to every one.

Sam W. was our guide for this approx. 4 hour walking tour. He was outstanding -- knowledgeable and friendly. We saw a lot of sites - mostly in the old East Berlin - during this tour. Only drawback was the size of the group - almost 40 people - but Sam did a good job keeping us corralled and spoke loudly enough so we could hear.

Sam W. was awesome! This tour is great because it covers a lot of “not-to-miss” sites in Berlin. Do it at the beginning of your trip and this will give you an idea of what to see and where to go back again for a more in-depth visit. We enjoyed it so much we booked the Sachenhausen camp for the next day!

Our guide Jonathan was excellent - very knowledgeable, providing great information, but allowing us time to reflect and enjoy the places we visited. His use of pictures showing how the areas we visited used to look helped to put everything in perspective.

Jonathan, our guide, was excellent. We booked an English speaking tour although many on the tour weren't English speakers. He kept everyone involved, checking in with them, asking if we had any questions. He was friendly and really engaging.

In these tours main thing which makes a difference is your guide , I was lucky to have Tobi as the guide who has an amazing passionate style of communication , brilliant knowledge and thing which make him a perfect guide is his personal story of being German grown in east Berlin during tough times !!!! Fantastic personal examples like getting rationed bananas , smuggled tights etc eyc.

THANKS TOBI !!!

My tour guide was Xavier - a very insightful and enthusiastic guide. I had a blast on the tour and learned alot about the city of Berlin. We covered all the main attractions and he provided us with detailed introductions and explanations about each attraction. I highly recommend this tour and guide!

It was our first time to Berlin and we wanted to get as much history of the city as possible. We throughly enjoyed ourselves and it was a wonderful experience. Our guide Sam W was very informative and personable, which overall highten our experience. He brought us to all the historic sites and really gave us a detailed perspective. This tour is very well put together and worth the money.

Sam W is very knowledgeable, from UK so no problem in command of English. He did a good job in explaining the history, interesting point of the place. He also give good advise on which will be some interesting place to visit in Berlin which is not cover in walking tour. I recommend to take this tour to give you the background in term of history and a overall view of what is Berlin. Some certain interesting place that I go back again the next day to further explore such as Berlin Dom and the memorial to the murdered of Jews of Europe.( must visit their underground muzium).

Booked last minute onto the Berlin half-day walking tour.

We were running a little late so we rang the number on our confirmation email and the company made sure someone was waiting for us so we could find the tour party.

Our guide for the afternoon was Ken, who was a very friendly Irish man who took pride in telling us about the city. He made sure that no one got left behind and told us the best places to grab a snack.

The tour itself was comprehensive in covering a lot of distance and showing us some of the important historical buildings. We stopped in appropriate places and Ken’s talks were informative. We walked around the museum island, to Checkpoint Charlie, to the Topography of Terrors museum and to the Reichstag.

The tour lasted from 14:00 ‘til around 17:30 where we finished at the Brandenburg Gate. Great way to see Berlin! Worth the £12.00!

Absolutely amazing tour given by Ysanne (Izzy). She was really informative and kept plenty of enthusiasm throughout the entirety of the tour (3.5 - 4 hrs). It was the first time me and my girlfriend have done a walking tour (we usually do bus tours), we are so happy we did as it's been an unforgettable experience of our time spent in Berlin. Would definitely recommend! Go Izzy!!!
Absolutely worth it. Provides interesting historical and cultural knowledge about Berlin. Rick our guide was excellent, knew his stuff and had an informed opinion. Great way to get to know the city.

We had just one full day on our trip to Berlin. I booked a half day walking tour in the hope it would make the best of our time. Our guide Wouter was excellent. He was so knowledgeable about the history and beauty of the city, the four hours flew by. Every five minutes I had my mind blown (as I had very little previous knowledge) I especially enjoyed how Wouter revealed some of the attractions with an element of surprise. I have been inspired to read more about this beautiful and complicated city

My family and I undertook the walking tour with Nathan on Monday of this last week. Whilst we were blessed with good weather (which helps in February!), the content, construct and quality of the tour was excellent. Nathans delivery was content rich but not over complicated and was delivered with deep knowledge, passion, balanced opinion in some areas and condensed several hundred years of history (focussed on the period since 1871) into a 4 hour walking lecture. Unlike an unguided open top bus tour with a dull multi lingual recorded commentary - this was like a high quality, professional socio-economic history, culture and politics lecture all rolled into one. It provided a great basis for the remainder of our visit to Berlin and captured all the right key sights and events around the city. Dont be put off by the 4 hours - its not a 4 hour "walk" - in fact the leg work is relatively modest - its the content of the dialogue, the visits of the key locations across the city and the way they are woven together that made this such a high quality experience. Probably not one for small kids - but those of a secondary school age, and adults with a genuine interest in learning about the city and its history will benefit and be able to follow the intelligently layered information. Its not too "high brow" and intellectually challenging - you dont need to be a history and culture "geek" - its not a test and its not at all difficult to follow (I managed it !!) Can not recommend highly enough - truly excellent. Many Thanks.

This tour is brilliant and at a very low cost of £25 a couple worth every penny.

Our tour guide Darren was great. With his PHD in history he made the whole experience captivating with his knowledge and enthusiasm with a little Irish charm and humour thrown in.

It was much needed on the day we went as it was raining non stop and freezing but Darren never wained!

The tour itself was long however so be prepared to walk.... a lot. Having said that you will definitely get to parts of the city you wouldn't see normally and all major land marks were covered. The coffee stop half way through was definitely needed.

If you want to see Berlin for its culture and history at a great price do it.

Thanks Darren.

We were a little worried about spending four hours walking around Berlin in the freezing cold however the afternoon absolutely flew by. Our guide Kathryn was fantastic, she kept the tour engaged and interested and knew so much about German history!! We learned more in those few hours than in my A Level history lessons all those years ago!
The tour itself was brilliant and covered all the major sights to be seen here in Berlin (Brandenburg gate, Reichstag, memorial to the murdered Jews, the wall, check point Charlie etc.) but also includes some fascinating places you might not see if you weren’t with a tour (Hitlers bunker, Bebelplatz, Palast der Republik).
It was a bonus that the tour finished at Gendarmenmarkt which has a fantastic Christmas market this time of year!
I could not recommend this tour any more highly. It was so informative and interesting and exceptional value for money!

Nathan was our tour guide and he was incredibly knowledgable about German history and did an impressive job of condensing 800 years history for us laymen. It helped us understand the war factually and was incredibly interesting. Highly recommend! The tour covered Checkpoint Charlie, Reischtag, Brandenburg Gate, Hitler’s bunker car park, Jewish memorial, museum island, Berlin Wall. It was four hours in all, including time for a cafe break.

This was an excellent introduction to the history and places of Berlin. Our guide, Matti, was fantastic. He was able to share personal stories and help us put the places and timelines in context. He also was easy to follow and understand.
Toby was great and kept us going through the Low temperatures. The tour was excellent, we learnt a lot about Berlin and his personal touches were brilliant.

Took the morning tour last Sunday starting at 10.30 AM and despite the cold, was one of the most informative and interesting things we did. Our guide (Nathan), was approachable, extremely knowledgeable, friendly and interesting even putting some personal stories into his presentation. He answered questions from the group with ease and made the whole tour well worth the money that we paid. We saw all of the main sites on the tour and were able to revisit at leisure. I learned a heck of lot from this tour and enjoyed the friendly company of the group - I would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin.

Great walking tour with Barnaby, he gave us a lot of information during our 4-hour walking tour, definitely recommended. He is really knowledgeable and willing to answer all the questions we had. He also recommended very good pubs :)

Tobi is an East German who has inside knowledge of living in Berlin behind the iron curtain when the wall came down. He is passionate about his subject and knows Berlin from its origins to today. 4 hours flew by as we saw all the major sites and learned so much. Far better than the Sandermans tour yesterday to sacsenhausen.

I would ask for Tobi and use this company again.

Gregor was our tour guide and I found he was informative, funny and a berliner (local) which made our tour very enjoyable. Our tour started at 2 in the afternoon and went for about 4 hours and was jam packed. It got off to a bit of a slow start but as we moved through the city, got to more of the attractions I was looking forward to. The tour itself was quite affordable and I would recommend it to a first timer visiting Berlin wanting to get an overview of the history and city itself.

Gregor was our tour guide and started off very well, explaining the history of Berlin and how it came into existence as a city. When we started into the history areas of Berlin, Gregor, who was an art major, started discussing the "meaning" of the relics and how we should apply them. When we got to the square where they burned the books, Gregor preached for almost 30 minutes about the significance of the "empty library" and how we should interpret it and apply it to our lives. At this point, I had had enough preaching and my wife and I left the tour and saw the rest on our own. I was very disappointed because we signed up for a tour of the history of Berlin and got a new age sermon on art and metaphysics.

This was really an excellent walking tour of berlin , going through all of the main points of interest for tourists. Our guide Rob did a fantastic job in explaining the rich history of Berlin. This tour gives you a good idea of what part of city you want to come back and explore in more detail.

I usually get apprehensive when I go on these walking tours, because at times the experience is hit or miss. Today's tour hit the bullseye, and it was all due to our tour guide, Rob S. He was extremely knowledgeable in the city's history and presented it in a manner that was fun, thoughtful, and interesting. There was never a moment (aside from my being distracted by my picture-taking), that I wasn't interested in everything that Rob had to say. Couple that with the shroud of mystery about the city itself, and it makes for a smashing tour experience. I was sad that I wasn't going to be around for Rob's next tour, but it will certainly be one I seek out when I return to this fantastic city!

Beth ? (Graduate student from Wales), our guide was very informative and did an outstanding job in presenting Berlin in a very positive and balanced light. contrasting old Germany states to the rise and post Nazi was very well done. As she stated we could have talked for hours but this was a great overview and introduction to Berlin. The 93 degree heat was a bit of a challenge but good 15 min break halfway thru gave us time to regroup. Highly recommended. Good overview of Museum island was appreciated as I did the "wonder Lust" tour at Nat Galley and saved the other museums for another trip.

We took the four hour Berlin walking tour with Rachel and she was fantastic. She was very knowledgeable and kept the tour moving. She kept us in the shade on this very hot day. She made sure that all of the visitors on her tour were ok and checked if there were any questions. She was easy to understand and easy to hear. She clearly loves what she does.

Our your guide Brett took us around all the sites in Berlin and explained the history of them all in great detail. We saw parts of Berlin we didn't expect to see and learned alot l about the place. Would really recommend for people visiting as it gave a great overview of the city.

It was my first day in Berlin (first time I visited) and I decided to do the morning walking tour. Tobi was a fantastic guide who provided us with heaps of information about the history of Berlin while providing us with valuable information on each of the sites and what we can do for the rest of our stay. I would highly recommend the Discover Berlin walking tour and Tobi especially who is a fantastic guide.

Berlin is a city with such a rich history, and I'm so glad that this tour reflected that. Our guide Jess did an amazing job explaining the history behind all of the places we visited. We thought we knew quite a bit about the city before beginning the tour, but learned so much more. There is so much to take away from Berlin, important lessons for the future and respect for those who suffered in the past. Definitely check out this tour for a primer of places to see in the city!

Laura was our tour guide. We were travelling as a family, 2 (older!) adults plus one 19 and one 16. Both teenagers can moan on tours but we all loved this one. Laura was a great story teller, engaging and fun. The time flew by. We had seen some of the sites already but Laura added to our understanding, explaining their importance in social, political and historical terms. Thankyou 😁

A must for first timers on a short break to Berlin. Great introduction to the history and key sights of with an excellent guide. We were put in a group of 33, a little larger than we would have wished, but in the event it didn't affect our enjoyment of the tour. Ken, a former student of Modern European History at Humboldt University was funny, engaging and extremely knowledgeable with the added benefit of an extremely loud voice ! The tour is a great way to get your bearings and decide where you would like to go for a longer visit. Thank you Ken - we voted you our favourite activity !

Our guide Nathan gave a fascinating account of the history of Berlin from the origin of the city right through to the fall of the Berlin Wall. The four hour trip flew by and my husband and I were enthralled by Nathan’s knowledge and the easy manner in which he delivered the information. Would highly recommend this tour.

Our guide Jonathan was extremely knowledgeable of all locations we visited. He showed the historical progression of the city from a swamp to the capital of Germany. Would recommend to anyone who enjoys immersing themselves in the history and culture of Berlin. Great tips for follow up information on places to visit.

Amazing tour and our guide Xavier was very knowledgeable and interesting. You learn so much more about the history of the city on a guided walk than by going on your own. Would thoroughly recommend this tour.
Xavier went the extra mile in informing us of the former swamp’s story. He went over his time to fill in the gaps.
Xavier was our guide and he gave an educational but very interesting tour though Berlin. Definitely I would recommend it
Ciaran was the consummate guide, scholar, humorist and surprise poet! He brought the various histories of Berlin alive with enthusiasm and adroit historical insight.
This tour is halfway between a too chatty guide and a quiet guide. You get enough information but rarely get too much. It lasted for about 4.2 hours, so do keep that in mind.

The walk was amazing and it made my trip much better with knowledge about the city! I learned so much about the city and its history. It was also included in the Berlin city pass so you must join it if you can!
Our guide was Xavier. He was very knowledgeable and provided a fantastic tour. We had a great time and would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Berlin.
I love Canadian Chris's perspective on Berlin history and blunt sarcasm on serious topics. Loved the tour! Highly recommended. Actually a "must" experience if you visit Berlin.

Sarah was a great guide and the tour was very interesting.

I wish I had time to do the Cold War and Third Reich tours.

Great tour guide (cambell)
He explained history and events making it interesting and unforgettable experience.
Engaging. Enthusiastic. Knowledgeable. Fun.

Walid was insightful, knowledgeable, charismatic, and did I mention incredibly handsome. Best Bangladeshi Brit turned Berliner an American tourist could ask for! Covered so much of Berlin in one afternoon, a must do for anyone in town for a short amount of time.

We had a great day all thanks to this walking tour. Walid was excellent. He has amazing knowledge of the city and he is a really nice guy. Will definitely be recommending to friends who also wish to visit.
Excellent tour from a local guide, who was engaging and informative and had some very touching personal stories to tell about life in Berlin.
Great tour to get an idea of all the sites in Berlin. All within walking distance and Xavier the tour guide was very knowledgeable and funny!
Our guide, Xavier, was fantastic! I can’t recommend this enough! The tour was amazing and included the whole history of Berlin!

If you want to have a walking tour of Berlin and learn as much as possible in a three-hour span, this is the right tour! Martin was an amazing guide with a great way to explain history, with a great sense of humor, and perfect English. Don’t hesitate in picking this tour!
Tobi was our guide. His way of story telling and his attitude made this walking tour a very enjoyable and interesting experience. Would definitely recommend it!
Xavier was fantastic! His enthusiasm for the varied history of Berlin is infectious. It was a morning well spent.
It was a lovely tour and our guide is very knowledgeable in all things Berlin. I wish it was a bit longer though even though I understand the children were a bit tired. Would definitely recommend!

I am a new resident to Berlin and took the tour to get to know the city and some history. Jess, our guide was extremely knowledgeable and had many great stories. I will do this tour again when I have visitors to Berlin!

Brilliant tour - Kyle (our tour guide) brought the tour and history to life - witty and informative at the same time. Really helped out the geography of Berlin in place and also the East/West history.

Very passinate Young guide, WHO kept the group intrested in Berlin and it’s history.
Although it rained all the walk
Great tour! Kyle was a fantastic guide. She knows her history and delivered all information with humour and charm. Thank you
Alex was a cool & resourceful tour guide. Thanks again. Hope he continues to tour others within Berlin.
A nice tour to put the whole German/Berlin history in a nutshell. Alex (our tour guide) was very friendly and had a firm grip over the history.
Jonny was awesome! The tour was well paced, and our guide was very knowledgeable, easy to talk to, and genuinely funny. Very glad the tours have opened back up and that I booked this one.
I recommend this tour, very knowledge guide, a lot of history details provided. a great introduction to the city.
This tour is great for those who like to walk.Will was really awesome.He had some amazing facts and details about the places in Berlin.
We did a half day tour with Rob Willis, and also a Sachsenhausen concentraion camp tour with Amy. Both excellent - thoroughly recommended.

Our tour guide Scott gave us a great insight into the city's history and included lots of interesting facts about it's architecture. He even gave us a list of places that were outside to visit as lots of attractions were closed because of the coronavirus, and we visited every place he suggested!
Excellent tour the guide Scott was very knowledgeable and informative. He even tried to provide ideas and tips because so much was closed due to the corona virus.
Very interested tour led by an enthusiastic and knowledgeable Berliner. Very much enjoyed by both of us thank you.

This was a fabulous walk through the city with a very pleasant and informative guide.
Rob who we had on a dreadful day for weather was clued up and knew his history of not just the city but the past the it held too.
He made the day interesting and his manner was pitched at the right level albeit we were a small group.
The start point at Neu Promenade is easy to locate as the bill board is on Starbucks fore court. You are merged with a smile and good welcome before setting of on a three and a half hour walk, it may not feel like it but you will cover a good few miles and may be in need to be a good level of fitness to embrace the journey.
The tour does take you through most of the iconic sightseeing parts of the city which is great to do on the first day to identify where you may want to return to on your own later.
There are so many places visited on the tour that it is also difficult to pick any favourite. That said checkpoint Charlie does stand out.
There are a few places Rob pointed out that we returned to that we only passed like the old Gestapo Hq that now has a museum on it that has free entry. Rob has also a wealth of knowledge on tickets for other attractions and tours if you need them.
All in all this was a well worth while tour at little cost 14€ each. Recommend this tour, you won’t be disappointed.
Brilliant 4 hours in the company of the knowledgeable, friendly, irrepressible Ysanne! Highly recommended.

Jake was an excellent guide with very extensive knowledge of history and culture. Me and my girlfriend really enjoyed our tour and would definitely recommend this to anyone wanting to see the history of the country.

Hitler's Bunker
Nazi Air Ministry
Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe (Holocaust Memorial)
Bebelplatz, scene of the Nazi Bookburning
Neue Wache (War Memorial)
TV Tower
Friedrichstrasse (1920s cabaret mile!)
Humboldt University
St. Hedwigs Cathedral
State Opera House
Gendarmenmarkt
The Tiergarten

The ability to distill 800 years of Berlin history into 10 minutes is quite a skill. Ysanne was enthusiastic, well informed and very importantly, passionate about Berlin and its complicated history. Ysanne’s relationship with the group was easy and informal, she encouraged and welcomed questions, and fielded them with confidence. This was an excellent way to be introduced to the many significant locations in Berlin, and we used it to select those that we wished to visit again in more depth later. Thanks for the tour, anyone who is as passionate about the Doctor Marten bootware as we are has got to be worth supporting!
