A must do in Berlin! Thank you Lynsey!

Seb B was great and made a cold, wet day in Berlin memorable. He was extremely knowledgable about Berlin specifically and German history more broadly. More than willing to field any left field questions and made the tour enjoyable throughout. Would highly recommend!

Our tour was both informative and entertaining. It rained for about an hour and was really cold, but the whole group were still really engaged due to the tour guides expert knowledge, humour and unique tales from around the city. Highly recommended

This walk covers the history of Berlin and places this in the buildings and sites of the city. Our guide, Campbell Bewes, was knowledgeable and entertaining keeping us informed of both the big things and the little ones which make the walk just that little bit different. Always able to offer things to do later when you are interested in more, and details of life in Berlin. The walk was long enough to see a lot, but not too long that you feel you are missing out on things as you pass them, and it finished right on time.

A very informative and easy going four hours was spent with our engaging and enthusiastic guide, Campbell B last Sunday afternoon. Extremely enjoyable despite the changing weather. The walking pace is comfortable and takes in the sights you'd expect to see on a tour of Berlin along with a few hidden surprises. Highly recommended.

This was probably the most entertaining informative , Fun and educational tour I've ever been on. If this is your first time in Berlin as it was ours, then this is an absolute MUST. Sam was an increadable orator and extremely brilliant at giving a potted history of Berlin. It was really entertaining- yet he really knew his history having studied at the university here reading history. Such a fantastic insight into past and present Berlin. The tour not only took in historical monuments and sights but also an insight into art, culture, and politics. We all had quite an emotional experience and were so glad we came . Thank you Sam Z !

Walking with Sam Z very knowledgeable Sam had good sense of humor as well as knowing when the time was right to be reflective. Great tour to be familiarise with surroundings and understand some of Berlins history. Would reccomend in fact it's a must!

We had the good fortune of spending four hours in the company of the wonderful Sam Z this afternoon. So glad that we chose today to do this tour despite the unfriendly weather as we were treated to an entertaining and informative meander through the streets and history of Berlin. This really was value for money and something I would recommend to anyone hoping to discover more about this great city.

Really informative. Polly the guide was great. Gained so much knowledge about Berlin. She made it really interesting and answered everybody’s questions instantly. Length of tour perfect . If undertaking in December make sure you wrap up!

This is my first experience of a walking tour. Am sorry that I didn’t try it out earlier. It’s an excellent way of visiting the major sites, guided, with excellent explanation of the history and sites and in such a short time. Our guide, Kyle was top notch. We usually take a hop on hop off but there is no comparison to a walking tour.

Our guide, Kai, brought his knowledge, humour, and his obvious affection for the varied and complex history of Berlin to this tour .It was informative and engaging and perfectly paced. We didn't even notice the freezing temperatures.Highly recommended.Thank you.

Our guide Kai was excellent, full of knowledge and interesting. He knows his stuff! At the same time he was mindful of how cold it was and how long we were standing still whilst he talked, so he was careful to not have us standing around forever. With his knowledge and interesting stories he could easily have you standing there for some time. All round excellent tour and guide with an injection of humour, at appropriate times 👌👌👌

We went on this tour the day after we arrived on our first visit to Berlin. It took in all the 'must see' attractions in the city, plus a few more! Our tour guide, Polly, was really knowledgeable about the history of Berlin which added to the whole experience. Can't recommend this tour highly enough.

First and foremost, a massive thank you to our fabulous guide, Kevin. What a guy! Not only knowledgeable and personable, but able to explain some very complicated and painful parts of 20thC history. In particular, his moving soliloquy at the Holocaust Memorial towards the end of our walk really touched us.

If you enjoy walking, this is for you. On this freezing cold, but bright day, we covered miles, and every inch was worth it.

I can't recommend this walk enough if you want an overview of this complex city.
We had Guide Kai yesterday, he was a fabulous guide, highly recommend this walk, he spoke with such enthusiasm and clear to hear. Loved every minute besides being frozen to death😣!
It was wonderful, Kyle is a fountain of information, it was funny and dinámic, 150 per cent recommendable!!!!

Very informative, interesting and fun. A great way to get a good sense of the fascinating history, culture and people of Berlin. Rob our guide was very knowledgeable and personable, creating just the right balance of good facts and good humour! Would highly recommend.

Took introductory tour of Berlin with Jarod yesterday morning. That guy is amazing. His knowledge level is DEEP! He has a Ph.D so knows far more than the average tour guide. He gave us a lot of basic, typical information, but then went deeper to discuss things like EDM and graffiti culture in Berlin and the role it played at the fall of the wall. He told us about the history of the cathedral of Berlin and the attitudes various leaders played in promoting and discouraging its completion. He shared his amazement as he showed us the spot where professors and students joined in with the Nazis to burn 30,000 “unacceptable” books at Berlin University. He was passionate in his description of the meanings and motivations as we visited the Holocaust memorial. Our tour was scheduled for four hours, but he spent over five hours with the group. I highly recommend this experience and especially Jarod as a guide here. By the way our group size was about 15 people.

A big thanks to Jake our guide who was exceptionally passionate & informative tour guide. His knowledge & style even kept teenage children interested. The walk was a nice balance between seeing lots of places of interest , history of the city ¬ being rushed. Will definitely recommend this tour

We did the walking tour with Beth. She was brilliant, her knowledge of the history of the city was first class, and she spoke with such enthusiasm that she really brought things alive. She was also very funny at appropriate times with lots of interesting anecdotes. She never tired of answering questions and gave us plenty of time to really take in the many different sights. The four hours or so absolutely flew by and we left the tour feeling we had a really good understanding and appreciation of Berlin and its vast history. This tour was terrific value and the highlight of our four days in the city.

We love walking tours. They are a great way to initially explore a city and this was no exception. Jared was our guide and he took us by great locations and provided us with fantastic information. He was great with my kids as well. The day of our tour was raining, so I was appreciative that he kept us sheltered whenever possible, however it didn't impact the tour. I would suggest this tour if you have the time. It made for a great first day of exploration in Berlin.

We really enjoyed this tour. The information was on point throughout, Jared couldn’t have been a better guide. He was helpful on any questions we asked throughout the day. The value of the tour was great considering the depth of areas we seen and information provided. Highlights for us include the history Jewish community in Berlin, Jareds description of Musuem island, Hitlers bunker and the overall atmosphere on the tour. Great day all round

We really enjoyed this tour. The information was on point throughout, Jared couldn’t have been a better guide. He was helpful on any questions we asked throughout the day. The value of the tour was great considering the depth of areas we seen and information provided. Highlights for us include the history Jewish community in Berlin, Jareds description of Musuem island, Hitlers bunker and the overall atmosphere on the tour. Great day all round

Our tour guide was Izzy , an excellent tour guide who evidently loved Berlin's complex history. Despite cold, wet, miserable weather conditions everyone stayed with the tour keen to hear more from Izzy whose knowledge and analysis of Berlin's lengthy history was second to none. She took us to all the key sites in Berlin and was able to provide well informed commentary and discussion beyond what most visitors would expect of the 'average' tour guide. Thanks for a wet, cold but fascinating tour Izzy, we will not forget your efforts!
I forget the name of the guide, but she was excellent and very knowledgeable. Great vale for money and had a good pace.
Lindsey was knowledgeable and culturally sensitive. She never imposed her opinions on others but prompted the participants to think for themselves. She made history come alive!

We really enjoyed our half day walking tour with Fran. She made the trip so interesting with her excellent historical knowledge and unique style of bringing history to life and her English was amazing.
The trip included all major sites from Museum Island through the centre of Berlin via The Brandenberg Gate, to the Holocaust installation and finally to the beautiful GendarmenMarkt Christmas market. The route was perfect and her talks and comments on life in the East were profound and thought provoking. It was well pitched for a mixed age group and had a good pace - not overdone which can be a problem - and enough detail to quench the thirst of most serious historians.
All in all excellent introduction to Berlin.

I visited Berlin last weekend with my two daughters, we had amazing weather, very cold wet and windy but had an even more amazing tour with Izzy who was so knowledgeable and made the morning so interesting. I don’t normally find it easy to remember information but know that Izzys passion for her subject mean so much of what I leant is embedded. We all need to know Berlin’s history it affects everyone of us in different ways. We must not forget and need to ensure others don’t either!

We are from the USA. This is the 4th walking tour that we have taken during our full country tour of Germany. Our Tour guide (Kyle) who is also from the USA took 16 of us on the walking tour (14 were from the UK). Kyle was very factual and well prepared but over opinionated and at times was critical of American culture. We do not want to pay for a tour to hear personal opinions, especially when it demeans our home country. It was offensive to us that she had a low opinion of the United States. None of our other walking tours were offensive in any way. Original Berlin Walks need to coach their guides better.

Did the free 1/2 Day Walking Tour of Berlin. We booked on the day at the Information Centre next to the Brandenburg Gate, and joined the tour outside the Starbucks there. There was about 30 people there, and as there were 2 guides we split into two groups of 16 which was fine. Did the tour on the first day of our mini break to help us get our bearings which worked well.

Saw all the main sites in the area. Took about 3.5 hours. Guide was very engaging, made the time go fast.

Would certainly recommend. Obviously this is not free, tips are expected, but the guide will let you know what is appropriate.

The walking tour was amazing, our tour guide Jake was very informative and was good at explaining things in greater detail whilst making it interesting and engaging. The tour does not feel like 3 hours at all and there are breaks in between. I would recommend going as you learn so much about the history of Berlin.

Beth was the absolute best tour guide we could ask for-- funny, knowledgeable, and willing to answer tons of questions. She took our group through about 800 years of history and culture in an engaging and accessible manner, while not glossing over the difficult parts of Berlin's history. Highly recommend this tour for any and all!

We took the tour with Sam B. who was very knowledgable throughout and keep things interesting without overloading us with information. Would highly recommend to get your bearings in the coity and see the main sights.

Our guide Campbell is a great storyteller and the tour was extremely interesting. We visited most of the places on our list in this tour and it really helped us to get our bearings. Would thoroughly recommend.

Ryan our tour guide was amazing! Full of knowledge and was so good at explaining things in detail while making it interesting and engaging. Would definitely recommend for anyone visiting Berlin and if you can get Ryan as a guide that’s just an added bonus!
We had a great time and attended the tour led by Sam B. Sam was very knowledgable and engaging- a great way to learn about the city and its history. I would definitely recommend to others.

Jonathan our guide was so knowledgable, kept everybody within the group engaged, provided an impartial perspective on Berlin’s history and made everyone feel welcome. I would highly recommend whether you’re into history or not.

A great way to introduce visitors to Berlin. Our guide Fran was very knowledgeable and conveyed snippets of local art, history, politics, arcitecture, current affairs on a very gentle 3.5 hour walk. My 11 year old son thoroughly enjoyed his first day in Berlin, and is already keen to return to this fascinating and beautiful city again.
Lovely walk around Berlin with fran. She is extremely knowledge and you can tell she loves the the history of Berlin. Would 100% recommend a walk with fran

This is the best money (and so affordable) that you can spend in Berlin! Great tour of the highlights and history of the city. Our tour guide was Beth she was extremely knowledgeable and also very funny, a great sense of humor which always makes any experience more fun!

Thank you to our tour guide Polly who guided us around Berlin. All the information given was delivered in a manner that kept you engaged throughout (me and my husband remembered everything she told us about the history of the city) Polly was very knowledgable and helped us with any questions we had. We would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting!

Our guide Beth was fantastic - funny and informative - and I wish she had taught me history at school because I can remember everything she told us (almost). It was the best way to see Berlin and I cannot recommend it highly enough.
Knowledgeable and informative guide, while group lasted tour despite inclement weather. Excellent introduction to the history of Berlin

Sam B was a great tour guide for our walking tour. So informative and interesting. Saw lots of the major historical sites and kept spirits up despite the rain. Also ready with lots of recommendations which was very helpful. Great morning had by all.
Aussie Dave made the morning tour interesting and fun for a mix of ages, barely noticed my tired feet, highly recommended and a great way to spend our first morning in Berlin.
Sam B was exemplary - he has an amazing wealth of knowledge which made this a truly incredible walking tour. Highly recommend!
Well done to our guide Izzy. We went for our tour on a cold, wet day in December, but she managed to keep us all interested with her extensive knowledge of Berlin.

We really enjoyed this tour. Despite it being a freezing cold day, Beth kept us engaged throughout the 4 hours. She was informative, enthusiastic and humorous. Learnt so much and it was a really good grounding for going on to explore the city and museums.
Sam B was a fantastic guide, very informative and interesting - learned and gained a lot from the tour. Great experience, well worth the price - would highly recommend it.

Our tour guide Amy did an amazing job of showing us around the city of berlin and all the amazing history that came along with it. She showed us a new side to Berlin that many of us on our trip had no idea about such as standing above hitlers bunker, and also dug deeper into a lot of information about places that are well known. Amy really made our groups experience of Berlin and it's history one we could not forget, would recommend 110%

We spent several hours in the company of Martin who was a very engaging and knowledgeable guide. The four hours sped by, even for our three children (14, 12 and 10) - no easy feat! The walk covers a lot and the sort break in the middle allows you to refuel on a good coffee and cake. Do it!

With our excellent guide Dave the tour was very informative with enough detail to give a really good understanding of the past and current city of Berlin. He was also able to give advice and information on other areas worth visiting, such as Christmas Markets for us. I would throroughly recommend this for first time visitors to Berlin.

We took the Discover Berlin tour led by Sam Z and I can honestly say it was the best thing we did in Berlin. Sam is passionate and engaging about the cities history and major characters. He provided insight and historical context on all our stops throughout the walk. Berlin has an interesting and chequered past and can conjure up some powerful emotions during your travels. Sam bought perspective, insider detail, chalk drawings, techno dance moves and a healthy dose of humour, whilst never shying away from the dark passages. I can’t recommend this walking tour enough, the only thing I regret is not having more time in Berlin to take a few more walks with the original walking tours gang. Top marks!!!

Laura was an excellent guide, full of history and local knowledge that made the walk so interesting. She took us to places we would never have found or known about as well as all the key places of interest.
Its a 5 hour walk, (so wear good comfy shoes!) but most definitely worth the time

Together with a group of friends, mainly first time visitors to Berlin, we had a brilliant walking tour with our guide Jonathan. He was personable, knowledgeable and he hit just the right note with historical facts, general observations and thoughts. Jonathan also invited us to share our thoughts and feelings at what we were seeing. All in all an excellent walking tour with a brilliant guide.

Great tour. Strongly recommend if you are on a time budget. Gives a great overview of this complex city. Our tour guide Dave ( the Aussie) was very informative and knowledgeable about the nooks and crannies of Berlin.
Sam Z was amazing and kept us informed and entertained his passion love of the city shown - thank you 100% recommend excellent value - Pic shows Sam in action

Was in Berlin for 2 short days and spent 4.5ish hours on this walking tour.
A condensed version of (some of) the main attractions in the city with our knowledgeable guide Jake who was simply excellent. Plenty of history, stories and recommendations about the city. The groups can get a little large (we had 30) but still it was great. I would definitely recommend this walking tour to anyone!

It is a great tour for those having a short stay in Berlin or for those wanting to know Berlin grossly before choosing specific sites of interest for deeper exploration.
The tour is well designed,- both contextually and in terms of route.
Sam W, our tour guide is fantastic person,- smart, intelligent with great sense if humor (he is of British descent anyway)).
If you’d like to know Berlin from exterior in half day plus its very interesting history, take this tour and definitely with Sam W.
Thank you Sam, I really enjoyed!! Great job!!
Very good, nice pace and very knowledgeable guide. Excellent way to understand Berlin in a short period of time and not expensive at all.

We did this tour today with Laura as our guide. The tour is very well planned and the information is fascinating. Laura undertook the very challenging task of introducing us to the beauty and fascination of the city, while allowing us time to reflect and consider some of its most troubling moments. She did an excellent job and I would 100% recommend this to all visitors.

Our guide Laura was fantastic. She was well informed, amusing and thought provoking. She looked after the group well, making sure we were well briefed and safe. The tour was all we hoped for and more.
Dave and Sue Lancashire, England.

An easy to book trip. Jonathan our guide was excellent he was well informed and knowledgeable. We loved ambling round the areas we probably may not have visited by ourselves, with the group. Also Jonathan was able to give current up to date information re the Christmas market and things to do.
This trip may be a little arduous for mums with little children and older mobility compromised people
Love it though ... and great value for money
Thanks Jonathan
Sam W took us on an excellent walking tour around Berlin. He was interesting and knowledgeable and made the tour extremely enjoyable. I'd thoroughly recommend a tour with Sam W.

We really enjoyed our Discover Berlin tour with Gregor. It covered pretty much the entire history of civilization in Berlin in about 4 hours, so nothing in-depth, but an excellent overview for an introduction. Gregor was very knowledgeable and answered every question thoroughly and with respect. He grew up in Berlin, so his personal stories and those from his family who lived there when it was East Berlin added an extra interesting perspective. His art history background showed, and we spent extra time on some of the stops with abstract art. Overall I would highly recommend this tour. I definitely came out of it with a better understanding of historical and modern Berlin.

Our half day walking tour of Berlin, guided by Sam Z, was a great choice! The tour was extremely informative with illustrative images and detailed descriptions. Sam was able to keep everyone’s attention by making the trip engaging and interesting. Would highly recommend this to everyone as a primer to Berlin.

I rarely write reviews but felt I had to for because our tour was excellent value for the cost. Our guide, Ryan, was very knowledgeable about the history of Germany. He was respectful of the victims of war and of the wall. Ryan was happy to answer questions any time and also gave people recommendations or further information at the end of the tour. After taking the tour we changed our itinerary to visit the German Resistance Museum and a few other places that had not originally been on our list but had been mentioned or visited during the tour. A word of warning, we (briefly) got separated from the group and would recommend keeping a close eye on your group in crowded areas where many groups meet.

Our tour guide was Rob ( from Manchester 😉 ). A really nice guy full of enthusiasm and a bursting with knowledge about Berlin.
The tours starts with the first settlers in Berlin all the way up to Micheal Jackson dangling a baby out a hotel windows.
The tours was a little over 3 hours but included a quick brew break half way around.
My wife and I stayed Friday, Saturday and Sunday in Berlin and did the tour on the Saturday afternoon looking back I'd have done the tour on the Friday so the rest of the weekend could be revisiting all the museums and sites Rob pointed out.

I can't recommend this tour enough, we plan to visit Berlin again next year and will do this tour again... highlight of our time in beautiful Berlin.

A group of 3 of us took the Berlin half day walking tour with our tour guide Sam Z and loved it. Sam was enthusiastic and made the tour very enjoyable. This is a really good way to fit in so much in a short amount of time and learn a lot. We all came away saying how we would definitely do more walking tours and how good the experience was.

Thank you, Sam Z, for guiding us around Berlin. We would definitely return for other walking tours with this company.
Highly recommend taking this tour! Informative and you get to see all the sites. Our tour guide was so knowledgeable. It will not disappoint.
The tour was fantastic! Jake was an amazing guide, he's extremely knowledgeable and is very passionate about the history of Berlin, which just adds to an already wonderful tour. Cheers!
1 guide and appr. 35 people in a group makes it difficult to follow the story of the guide. In particular when he talks not loud enough. After 10 minutes, we quit the tour.
Really great tour, our guide was really informative and helpful , highly recommend to see all the sights.

Berlin is very spread out and these key historical sights are not always the easiest to find, so taking this 4-5 hour walking tour (with a good break) was the perfect introduction to Berlin for us! I have the impression that their guides in general are all very good and well informed and ours was certainly all that as well as being very personable and with the knack of making history so interesting. There was so much to see and to learn, and we really enjoyed getting the perspective of a Berlin resident. We had such fun on this walking tour and it really set us up for the rest of our visit in the city! Save yourself the headache of trying to do this on your own - the tours are very reasonably priced and the tour guides deserve a good tip at the end for their great work!

I believe this is my first review ever, I normally never write them. But this tour is absolutely worth it, truly no other way to see the city. A huge part was because of Jonathan he was our tour guide. Beyond incredible, so knowledgeable, aware, informative, just completely full of information. Whatever they are paying him, they should double it.

You see absolutely everything, have time to listen, understand, ask questions and take your photos. We never felt hushed ( like we have on other tours ).

The company itself was extremely accommodating to us. We missed our original date for the tour, because our flight was delayed. But they had no problems accommodating us at a later date with no fees.

Thanks so much, we had an incredible time.

Xo
From
Canada
Can recommend this tour. Tobi was our guide and had lots of interesting stuff to tell. Coming from East Germany himself it all became very real to hear him talk about his youth.

We did this tour last Friday with our guide being James. He was friendly, enthusiastic and gave enough information during the tour to make it very interesting without going into too much detail so that you were overloaded with facts. Liked the short comfort break at Checkpoint Charlie before carrying on with the tour as well. All in all excellent value for money and I would have no hesitation in recommending this tour to anyone and especially if James is your guide.
My guide Xavier was fantastic- very knowledgeable, I learned a lot about the city and felt like I saw a good deal on this tour. Would book again.

Xavier gave us an excellent tour which even ran over time due to his willingness to answer questions and his detailed knowledge of modern Germna history. While it is now just a car park, being on the site of Hitler's bunker is quite an experience. Excellent and very worthwhile walk!

We went on a half day walking tour to discover Berlin with our French, but perfect English speaking tour guide Xavier. Xavier brought Berlin to life for us with his knowledge and anecdotes as well as superb humour. His enthusiasm was infectious. I would highly recommend this tour to everyone!

A great 4 hours spent learning about Berlin. Our tour guide Sam W couldn’t have been more knowledgable and helpful! A brilliant introduction to an amazing city providing us with a wealth of information which we wouldn’t have otherwise known. Sehr gut!
Excellent walking tour. Tobi, our guide, shared his amazing knowledge and experience from the perspective of one raised in East Germany. Nice pace, great humour, considerate of everyone in the group.

This is a fantastic tour to go on to get a feel for Berlin. Our guide Ysanne was amazing..so knowledgeable and interesting. She really engaged with the group to go deeper about the things we saw. She was flexible and friendly. The tour was just the right length, a decent price and not too big a group (they split the group several times at the start so it was more manageable). It was easy to book online via Trip adviser but some people did just show up and book on arrival too.

We had great weather but I think you could do this come rain or shine. Really recommend!

Really enjoyed the walking tour. Xavier the tour guide was very informative and enthusiastic, and highlighted lots of parts of Berlin that we would have completely missed otherwise. Would definitely recommend!

We wanted a way to see as many of the key sites in Berlin in a reasonable amount of time so we booked the half day walking tour. It was definitely money well spent. We stayed in a hotel near the Hauptbahnhoff, which also has an S-Bahn and U-Bahn station. The meeting place for the tour, Heckescher Markt, was only 2 stops on the S-Bahn. The day we were scheduled to take the tour, it was raining. So they let us postpone until the next day. The next day was pleasant and off we went. We saw everything: Museum Island, the Holocaust Memorial, the remnants of the Berlin Wall, where Hitler's bunker as located, the Brandenburg Gate... They are all within easy walking distance of each other. Our guide, Ken, was Irish and made the tour highly enjoyable. He was self-deprecating, funny and extremely knowledgeable. He gave us a 30-minute break halfway through the tour, and we finished up at the Brandenburg Gate around 2:15. By all means, book this tour!

Absolutely fantastic walking tour of Berlin with Xavier. He was an excellent guide, informative, witty, full of interesting stories and insights into this historic and at the same time modern city. He made the four hour walk very relaxing and made sure we all enjoyed every minute. J’ai passé une merveilleuse journée à Berlin et sous le soleil en plus! Merci mille fois à vous Xavier. C’était une journée parfaite - vous êtes si gentil. À la prochaine fois.

Fascinating walking tour with Rob Willis. Tickets very nominally priced for 3 hours of covering all the major sights, together with interesting facts and insights. Why does Berlin have raised pink pipes? What does Berlin mean? Who is the Philisopher King? All this and more delivered with a touch of humour by Rob, who luckily set off on a German exchange years ago and never looked back. Well worth a morning, and a very quick way to get to know Berlin, including tips on best beer and currywurst!

Our tour guidePolly introduced us to the main areas of importance in Berin, but most importntly she took the time to make sure we had context. I felt that her tour was pitched at exactly the right level for someone like myself that had a vague idea of German history, but several misconceptions about the Berlin wall and wher it stood. Polly used a simple drawing in the sand to explain how Germany was divided and where Berlin and the wall were situated amongst all this. Fantastic! The tour was a reasonable pace, with several opprtunities to sit down if you needed to. Polly herself was extremely clear and to my mind, incredibly insightful and respectful. I would throughly recomment this tour and Polly in particular.

Despite heavy rain, this was an excellent tour with Kevin. We enjoyed his intelligence wit and irony which linked the historical past to present realities in Berlin and Germany. We learnt a lot. Thank you Kevin

This was an extremely interesting and fun way to start off our trip to Berlin which captured the main sites we were interested in. Liz was a brilliant guide with lots of knowledge and her brilliant sense of humour made it great fun as well as intuitive. As a Scotsman I’ve also got to add that these trips are also extremely good value for money!

It was an amazing walk through the city that brought out the city's complicated relationship in a very interesting way. Our guide Wouter revealed his love for the city and his deep understanding of the issues it grapples with by adding context.and perspective to Berlin's grand buildings, public art and other places. We had a wonderful time today and would recommend this walk hugely to anyone wanting a quick introduction to Berlin

This is a great way to gain a history lesson that is very intense and very informative. Liz, our tour guide was extremely knowlegable and very respective to interact with all of the participants. Definetely recommend this four hour walking tour.

Although the weather was not cooperative, the tour of the city was a great way to see the historic parts of the city. We saw Museum Island, the Berlin Wall, Check Point Charlie, Brandenburg Gate, as well as many other important historical sites. Our guide was informative and knowledgeable of the city sites. We enjoyed this tour and this way of seeing the city sites.

A great way to get to know Berlin, informative, educational and a fun way to get to know this fantastic city. Our guide Xavier was knowledgeable, friendly and passionate about his job and he made the tour fun and so interesting. I recommend it fully, Hell if you haven’t Yet been to Berlin what are you waiting for?!

It was our first time in Berlin, and the walking tour was fabulous to get to know the city. Our guide was Ken, and he was both informative and engaging, a born raconteur with a great sense of humour. The tour lasted about 4 hours but time goes very quickly, and it is packed with some of the highlights of Berlin.
Well worth it!

Several friends recommended a walking tour when visiting Berlin. It is totally the best thing to do on your first day. This trip - and our guide Walter - was excellent. He gave us so much information and explained everything is a very easy way. He also recommended other places to visit.

Tobi was our excellent guide who was very informative and made the tour very interesting with personal anecdotes. My teenage son was even fully engaged for the whole time. We only had one full day in Berlin so wanted to see as much as possible. Now we know which places to revisit next time. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin.

It was a panoramic view of the city in a walking tour at a reasonable pace, and a break in the middle for refreshments, the guide Sam Z. was knowledgeable, very pleasant and a good narrator as a student of history living in Berlin gave us a nice and good perspective on the city and several of it's landmarks.
Tobi was a fantastic guide, who was very knowledgeable and presented the facts in a fun and approachable manor. Would highly recommend!

Can’t say enough positive things about this tour, and our guide Sarah. Sarah has such a genuine interest in the history of the city that shows in her delivery of concise facts.

You will have a good experience and walk away knowing you made the right choice. This is well worth your time and a great value.

We had Sarah as our tour guide and she was great. Such a passion for Berlin and its history. We were reminded of (or introduced to) some of the main events that have happened in Berlin over the centuries. Everything we visited was made interesting by Sarah with her facts or stories. She was open to questions throughout the tour. It was nice having a break at Checkpoint Charlie. Sarah provided suggestions of other things to visit in Berlin.

Scot, the Scotsman, guided us expertly from one landmark to another, providing invaluable insight to Germany's complex history. Scot conveyed his passion for the subject matter in his engaging and informed narrative. The experience was fabulous and I'd recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin for the first time.

Lovely tour. Our guide, Sarah, was very friendly, funny, informative and answered all our questions. She also recommended a ton of places on the way.
Perfect to get a general idea of the city and its history. Recommended!

Our guide, Sam B, was very knowledgeable of the area. He was able to highlight many important historical aspects of the buildings and areas we visited without letting things get too dark and overwhelming. Some parts seemed a little rushed/fast, but we had a big group and a lot to cover, so I consider that par for the course of the tour. At the end of the tour Sam gave recommendations for the rest of our stay in Berlin, which we appreciated. Overall I would book again!
I highly recommend this tour. Laura, our guide, was very passionate about Berlin's history. She readily answered all questions.
Thank you Scott. It was really fun and Scott was really knowledgable. I would really recommend Scott!!!

Very informative and knowledgeable to include stop at local cafe adding to the experience. Sadly slightly spoiled by the request of tips at the end.
Thanks Australian Dave.

Original Berlin Walks follows a great structure and itinerary for the walks. You hit all of the key highlights in Berlin. The tours does depend solely on the engagement and character of your guide. I did 4 tours on my trip and this tour guide was my least favorite. I do not believe there is a way to know who your guide is ahead of time.

Our guide was Issanne, and she was OUTSTANDING. Very easy to hear and an exceptional story teller. We could not have imagined a better way to gain such a fantastic insight into Berlin's social and political history.

Sam W was our guide for this tour. He has a wealth of knowledge and a true passion for culture and architecture.

We had Sam Z as our tour guide showing us around Berlin, he was the best tour guide that we could have got! Very informative and knowledgable about Berlin. Would definitely recommend using Original Berlin Walks when come to Berlin!! He made the group laugh and the tour never felt rushed.

Very enjoyable tour. Jonathan was great. He provided an educational tour that was educational and thought provoking. We took the 9 a.m. tour on our first full day in Berlin and it was excellent. Our guide Lyndsse (sp?), a Scottish expat, did the entire 3.5 hour walking tour without notes. We took this tour with an amazing guide. Jake is so knowledgeable and nice that made our day taking us to all the different places and explaining with detail all its history. I would recommend everyone to book this tour with jake!!

We did the half day walking tour with an excellent guide called Sam W. He made our tour very interesting with his knowledge of German history. Starting out I thought 4 hrs was going to be very long but it went too quickly. I was sorry when the tour finished! Highly recommended!

We did this tour with Heidi. She was a wealth of knowledge and we left the tour with a much better understanding of the history of the area. We visited all the main tourist attractions and would highly recommend this tour to anybody visiting Berlin
Sam guided us through the bulk of our to-do list. He was excellent at responding to questions and provided excellent insight to history and current eventa.

We did this tour the day after we arrived in Berlin. Never been here before so thought this would be perfect to find our way around the most interesting places. Georgia was our Guide. Would highly recommend this tour. We had Sam B (much emphasis on the B) and he was fantastic! Gave great insight into the history and culture of the City and was extremely friendly and knowledgeable.

This tour is an incredible way to start a trip to Berlin. We were guided round the main historical sites by Martin who was passionate about the city and its history. First off I just have to mention our tour guide Robert McCracken had an in depth knowledge of the city and history of not just Berlin but Germany in general. I always found that the key to a great tour is not just the information that you lear but the way the tour guide presents it in a story. Oh and by the way Robert has the greatest sense of humor and is a freaking riot of laughs. That being said on to describe the tour. Robert was taking us through the Mitte district and surrounding areas. It felt like you were talking a walk back into the past through history as he guided you through the tour. I didn't want to mention any of the sights so as not to spoil the cool twists and turns you walk through. Just as important Robert was also willing to ask any questions that were not the subjects covered on the tour. Ask him about the Curry Wurst. Our tour group started at 1030 on a Saturday August 10. Thanks Original Berlin Walks ti was awesome knowing I only scraped the surface of the city and will be looking forward to traveling back!

Absolutely amazing, informative tour. Had an excellent tour guide named Xavier who couldn’t have been any more helpful. Got to see some of the most popular sights of the city that you might not have found without a guided tour. 100% recommend excellent for all ages too.

As we read reviews to book our tour, we were excited to visit Berlin and have a walking tour to experience it. It was a very hot day (36+C), which certainly isn't the fault of the tour company, but the pace and placement where you stand is definitely within control of the tour guide. Tour guides have been some of our very best experiences on our trips, sadly for us, the tour guide on this tour was one of the worst experiences. He mentioned in the beginning of the tour that he was new, but that he had a doctorate in history and tutored at the University. In our opinion, as we had just spent a month on tours in many countries, he had no sense of what a tour guide should be and was belligerent, pompous and condescending to guests and the general public that we came in contact with. He almost got into a fight with a man who happened to walk up and stand on the edge listening. He told the man to leave. He told the man that he was stealing from his livelihood, it was uncomfortable for our group as the man said, "Sir, you are on public property and I have every right to listen". Our tour guide huffed and took us to the middle of the grass without any shade and scowled. A few men in the group laughed and said, I thought there would be a scuffle. One commented that the price of the ticket would then be worth it, as so far he could have had a better tour with a guide book. Our guide would not have heard this, as he would tell a fact and then almost jog to the next spot. He was quite tall and not once did he look back or take any care with our group, even when an older woman tripped and twisted her ankle. On our break, four people left the tour. He seemed to not know facts and mentioned that a standoff at Checkpoint Charlie lasted for 16 days (really only 16 hours). At hour 3, after he took us out of our way to go and see what he called "his sponsor" businesses, we left the tour, too. My husband ran after him to tell him we were stopping and he simply said "fine" without stopping or asking if everything was okay. We could have simply left and he would have never noticed. I understand that tours are subjective, and the reviews are mostly great, but this company may wish to take a closer look at who they are hiring and how they are training, as their quality depends on who is leading the tour.

Laura is very knowledgeable, lots of information n perfect pace. visit all sites w significant history, Laura gave tips x return visits to museums n other recommendations. the info provided was presented in a good manner, easy to understand n plenty of facts. I recommend this tour n Laura was excellent.

What a wonderful way to see Berlin. My tour guide was Martin and he has a larger than life personality and truly loves the city. I learned so much and never got bored. There was also a break halfway in for the bathroom and snacks which was much appreciated. Absolutely recommend!

Sam W. was an excellent tour guide! My family and I had a great time getting to know the city of Berlin on this tour. We went by most of the sites that we hoped to visit. Sam W. was very informative and had a great personality. Thanks for a great time!
Tobi was our guide for the walk. He was fantastic. Very knowledgeable, funny and willing to assist you on anything. I highly recommend Tobi and this tour to get an understanding of the city

Our guide Sam W was a rockstar and had an unlimited supply of interesting facts about Berlin, from the big trends to the fascinating minutiae that made the history feel real. Half a day felt just right, and like very good value

Martin was an enthusiastic, passionate and professional tour guide. I found his tour informative and interesting. I only had a half day in Berlin and wanted to get a feel for the historical heart of the city and was delighted I could cover a lot of ground in four hours ( though the break in the middle for a coffee was appreciated) as well as increasing my historical and cultural understanding.
Thank you. A well presented tour and good value for money! Highly recommended!

We took the Discover Berlin Tour with Scott on July 22, 2019 and the tour was absolutely fantastic. We took this walking tour in Berlin and Sarah was our guide. She was an excellent guide. She gave us a lot of details and history of the various places that we walked by. She gave great tips on specific places we should visit if we were short on time. Would definitely recommend

The tour took over 4 hours but was at a nice pace and the group stayed together without any problems. The tour took us through the Berliner dome, Museum island, Unter den Linden, the Brandenburg Gate, the Holocaust memorial and the Berlin Wall, finishing close to Checkpoint Charlie. Gregor, our guide, was excellent and gave us great insights into the buildings, areas, and history of the city. He was very well informed and welcomed questions and comments. He is very passionate and balanced and was quite happy to discuss the dark history of Berlin and the Nazi regime. He had a good sense of humour and challenged us to think rather than just look and listen. He was very friendly and was very willing to share his own family history in relation to the Berlin Wall and East German society. I would highly recommend the tour.

This was an excellent use of four hours on a very short trip to Berlin. Xavier was very knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin, which make the tour exciting and engaging. Amaaaazing, Xavier was great. It was the best part of our stay in Berlin. Having Xavier (who is French) do an English tour was perfect because he was unbiased against or for Germans and Americans. Must do while in Berlin.

dave is also mixing that learning tour with lots of fun & chats...you will not get bored for sure:)

We took part in this walking tour yesterday which was led by an amazing tour guide - Sam Z. It was a very hot day (around 34 degrees) but at all times Sam made sure he chatted to us in the shade where possible. The tour took us to so many places and covered topics and tips to visit the main highlights in Berlin. Sam was incredibly knowledgeable and approachable and very passionate about Berlin (he’s from Scotland and had studied for a Masters degree in Berlin) where he now lives full time. Highlights of the tour included our visit to the car park under which Hitler had his bunker built, the Bebelplatz the site of one of the infamous Nazi book burning ceremonies, the Jewish Holocaust Memorial, the Berlin Wall and Checkpoint Charlie. We particularly enjoyed Sam Z’s visual description ( he drew a map of Germany on the ground) of the recent history of the country and in particular East and West Berlin. All in all this was an excellent tour led by an amazing young man who clearly enjoys his job and loves imparting his wealth of knowledge in a very accessible and empathetic way. We would highly recommend it. Make sure you wear comfortable shoes and try to join Sam Z’s group if you can!

I fully realize I am going against the flood of 4- and 5-star reviews.

We booked this tour before we left, with a discount on the Welcome Card, on the advice of my tried and trusted travel guru Rick Steves. Perhaps it was the guide we had, but we left the tour after less than an hour. It was supposed to be 4 hours; our guide said he would go 4.5-5 hours, and it wasn’t long into the tour before we realized why.
