So I pulled out my Rick Steves guidebook, and we followed his Berlin City Walk, still learned some history and culture, and saw amazing Berlin sights.

Judging from these other reviews, our experience is an aberration. Still, it is worth noting.

Great 4 hour walking tour with Xavier a Frenchman obviously a born again Berliner.Knew his history and didn’t hold back in letting you know his views. Our previous visits to B were before the Wall came down so we were expecting a lot from this walk about and Xavier didn’t disappoint. Recommended.

This was a great tour- made great in large part by our guide, Nathan. He provided context, answered questions and was attentive to everyone on the tour working to insure everyone could hear and see everything related to each stop on the tour. We would highly recommend this tour; try to get it with Nathan!

This is my second time doing this tour, and I would do it again! Our guide this time was Sam Z. The guides do a great job presenting all the highlights of Berlin in an interesting and sometimes humorous fashion. This is a million times better than a bus tour, because you hear the history firsthand and can ask questions. Both of my guides had degrees in history and were very well informed. Walking allows you the opportunity to explore the city and orient yourself to the sites, which you can return to later to explore in more depth. I highly recommend this tour. It meets in Hackescher Market which is convenient for breakfast and a quick potty visit before the tour. The guide also stops for about 20 minutes at a spot about half way thru the tour where you can get a snack, use the bathroom, rest your feet etc.

I also did their concentration camp tour two years ago and it was also excellent.

Tipping: tip well-they earn it!
What a fantastic walking tour of Berlin. Wouter was a fabulous guide, so informative, knowledgeable and easy to listen to. Would thoroughly recommend.

This tour took in the main sights with an informative and entertaining narrative from our excellent tour guide, Sam B. The historical background to the events from the Prussian dominance, through Nazi Germany to the DDR/West Germany divide and the wall was explained clearly, and you learn things you would never bother to read in a dry tourist guide book. A brilliant start to a Berlin visit & you can always return to your favourites for more detail and a longer visit if you wish.

Sam Z today gave us what can only be described as a brilliant walking tour.
He was personable, entertaining and above all knowledgeable.

My one abiding memory of the tour though will be how he gathered us all together after visiting the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe. Sam gave us time to reflect, offer our thoughts and think about what the memorial meant to each of us.

In short, a completely memorable 4 hours of enlightenment, joy and facts about this amazing city.

Thank you Sam

We were lucky enough to have Martin as our tour guide. Extremely knowledgeable guide who answered any and all questions and pointed out so many other sites along the tour. Did a terrific job of explaining the history in details so all had an understanding of the significants. He even recommended places to go after the tour to get food and drinks. His recommendations were amazing and we would not have ventured there without Martins suggestions. Do this tour early on in your visit to Berlin, you will not regret it and it gives you a great understanding of the sites for when you venture out on your own.

Our tour guide was Martin. He was excellent. The tour was exactly what we were looking for to get a historical tour of the city in the short time we had in Berlin.
Would highly recommend it and with Martin.

My parents and I have recently returned from our first trip to Berlin and we can not recommend this tour enough. We had never done a walking tour before as we normally do the bus tours when on a city break but were recommended by a friend. We had an excellent, funny, informative guide Jonathan who took us round the city sights and filled us in on the history involving them. The tour was approx 4 .5 hours in total with a 30 minute break and yet time goes by quickly and enjoyably. I am so glad we did this tour and will definitely be doing walking tours in other cities. Highly recommended and I hope you get as good as a guide as we did with Jonathan. Thanks Jonathan for a great day.
Did the tour with Sam Z - we could not fault his knowledge , his friendliness and how he brought Berlin history to life for us.

Our French guide was brilliant particularly as he was delivering the tour in English! A great tour with many interesting stories and anecdotes that turned our perspective of Europe and Berlin (during the war) on its head. Don't visit the city without doing this tour.

Shout out to Ken, our guide. He was funny and informative. The tour takes you through most places of historical interest and the guide was very well informed about the history of Berlin, and of the war and all that came after. So much history to learn about! Starts at the market in Mitte and ends at the Brandenburg Gate.

Worth the time!

Our guide was great, but he did have a tendency to go on a little too long at each stop. He was informative, but 15 to 20 minutes in one place is more of a lecture than an introduction to the various sights.
The time could have been cut in half, or alternatively we could have taken in more sights on our walk.
The geopolitics were a little over the top, but all that said it is a worthwhile introduction to the main sights of Berlin.

Charlotte, our tour guide, exceeded our expectations big time. She gave us very detailed explanations and is also very funny. The total duration was around 4 hours, including a 20 min break at Brandemburg Gate. This is a must do tour when you visit Berlin!
Sam B was GREAT!! His very detailed in depth narrative can't be beat. This is a relatively fast tour. If you are a shutterbug you may miss some shots but the narrative makes up for it.

We have never been go Berlin before and this was the perfect way to indulge ourselves in the history and culture of the city. Kevin was our tour guide and made the walking tour an extremely enjoyable experience. Great knowledge, friendly service and a very accommodating route makes this a must do for all visitors.

This is a comprehensive tour to get to know Berlin and its history. It's long and a lot of walking! I had my 70 yo parents with me and towards the end, they were exhausted. They very much enjoyed it but depending on the tour guide, it could be as long as 4 hours! We had Beth and she was amazing! Extremely knowledgeable about the German and Berlin history. She told great, unbiased stories and lead a great tour. I would highly recommend this if you have a short period of time in Berlin. You see everything in a short amount of time.

Booked the 2pm English spoken walking tour and our host Matt (a Californian native) was great. He was super knowledgeable and had some fun and interesting stories about the history between east and west Germany as well as in depth information of the history of Berlin and how it came to be today.

Would highly recommend this tour! I am keen to book another with this company to do the graffiti art of Berlin.

Our tour guide was Jared and he was excellent and provided a terrific amount of information and advice throughout the entire walking tour. He was also more than happy to give further advice on other sites to visit and also places to eat and drink. In addition he had a great sense of humour and although American by birth was passionate about Berlin.

Our tour guide Jake was enthusiastic and engaging with excellent knowledge of Berlin.
The tour lasted 4 hours, and was jam packed with sights and history from the very beginnings of Berlin through to modern day. We would not be able to see and learn as much on our own in the 2 days we had in Berlin.
Lots of walking involved and a quick pit stop for a quick drink and snack.
Jake encourages questions and was able to answer everything we asked along the way.
Excellent tour, we would recommed this to anyone new to Berlin.

If you book this tour try to find out if your guide will be Wouter.

This is the best tour we did in Europe, and that is because we had Wouter as our guide.
He is a fountain of knowledge. He very eloquently explained the history of Berlin (including WW2 and the Cold War). With Berlin's tumultuous history, it takes a very special understanding to explain how Berlin is moving forward. Wouter showed us this city with sensitivity AND passion. A remarkable tour!
Thank you!

We went on this tour on Sunday and we were not disappointed. Our guide, Gregor, gave a great overview of the history of Berlin before taking us around the city. He had great subject knowledge and it was obvious that he was passionate about Berlin.

Highly recommend this tour to anyone. You don’t need to have background knowledge on anything as it is all briefly explained at the beginning. Wear comfortable shoes though, there is a lot of walking involved! (As expected in a walking tour!)

We have collectively done 3 tours with Original Berlin Walks and been very impressed with their approach:
- Discover Berlin 1/2 day (Gregor)
- Sachsenhausen Concentration Camp Memorial 6 hr (Heidi)
- Potsdam 6 hour (Sebastian)
The tours were well thought through and the guides demonstrated both good content knowledge as well as a willingness to explore some of the more complex social and cultural issues that underpin the fabric of contemporary Germany.
Highly recomended

It was our first visit to Berlin and decided to book a walking city tour for our first morning. Meeting place was easy to find and welcome guides were friendly. Ryan was our guide with a group of approx 22 people. He was extremely knowledgeable about the city and took time to ask and answer questions from group. I learnt a lot about Berlin and it’s history. The walk lasted about 4 hours at a leisurely pace with a coffee break. Excellent value for money and a must do. Thank you Ryan.

This was a very well-designed and highly-informative tour of key sights. Nicely paced and spaced, unrushed but not slow. Ken was an impressive guide: knowledgeable, lively but also serious when appropriate. His commentary on the haunting and abstract Holocaust memorial was one highlight. As an educator myself, I highly recommend both him and the tour.

Great opportunity to check on the main point of interest of the city centre of Berlin. Good and sinthetic presentation with the nice and funny guide Xavier. Absolutely pleasant start for a quick visit of the city!

Heidi was our guide. She was amazing! She has an obvious passion for German history, making her presentation not only informative, but captivating for her audience through her extensive knowledge. This made our afternoon with her not only interesting and thought provoking.

What a fantastic tour. I was doubtful about booking an organised tour as we usually just wander around independently. SO glad we did. Ryan, our guide, was knowledgeable and clearly loves the city. I learnt so much that I wouldn’t have if we’d not been on a tour. It’s a whistle stop tour of the highlights but Ryan managed to cram in so much information that we felt we really got to know the city. Great value for money too!

Xavier was a really good at showing us around Berlin. He really captured the history and described facts in a way which was enticing. There were so many things that I learnt about Berlin and it was a great way to see the city. The tour covered a lot of important landmarks and I didn’t mind the fact that the tour ended up being 5 hours long instead of 4! It was a lovely late afternoon/evening and it was great that we stopped off for snacks halfway to fill our stomachs and give our feet a rest. I would definitely recommend the walking tour to others who are interested in knowing more about Berlin’s history.

Xavier was a really good at showing us around Berlin. He really captured the history and described facts in a way which was enticing. There were so many things that I learnt about Berlin and it was a great way to see the city. The tour covered a lot of important landmarks and I didn’t mind the fact that the tour ended up being 5 hours long instead of 4! It was a lovely late afternoon/evening and it was great that we stopped off for snacks halfway to fill our stomachs and give our feet a rest. I would definitely recommend the walking tour to others who are interested in knowing more about Berlin’s history.

We visited Berlin on a sunny April weekend and went on the tour on Sat morning. Our tour guide Rick, was incredibly knowledgeable and articulated the history of Berlin with real passion. He took us past all the main sights and gave us lots of interesting facts to keep us engaged. I'm so glad we booked the tour rather than just milling about between the sights. This was so much more informative and real fun, plus a very nice walk, not too long really, not too short.
I'd recommend this tour to any first time visitors.

This your was probably the highlight of our visit to Berlin.

Jess, our designated tour guide, was excellent: his knowledge about Berlin and Germany’s history is astonishing.

If you are into history, this is definitely your tour. You will learn so much.

At first 4 hours may seem a bit much, but it’s totally doable.

Worth every penny.

We did a walking history tour our first morning in Berlin and it was such a great way to get orientated around the city and to know which museums were worth going to. Our tour guide Rick was great. He has such a passion and wealth of knowledge for Berlin history and was happy to answer all our questions. Really worth doing these tours to get the most out of Berlin. There is so much you would miss doing it alone.

This was the first thing we did in Berlin and it set us up for the trip. Darren, a passionate historian, reminded us of all that history we learned in school and how it has translated forward to where Berlin and Europe is now. The time flies by as you explore the city.

This tour is amazing value for money and should be the first thing you do if you’re in Berlin for the first time . The tour guide Rob ( who is British )is absolutely passionate about his subject matter and is totally engaged with the history and culture of Berlin . It is his passion & interest that permeates this tour and engages everyone . He explains the history of Berlin from its earliest beginnings right upto the present day as you walk round the old district of Berlin . Although it’s a 4 hour tour time goes by quickly as he points out the various landmarks and talks you through the key protagonists and events in the last 800 years . Plenty of chance to talk photos & ask questions - so much I didn’t know but I do now .
I can’t recommend this tour enough . Rob is amazing . Thank you for introducing me to this wonderful city .

I only gave this tour 2 stars because the team at the original tours office was responsive and helpful... otherwise I would’ve found a way to give this tour a negative. I arrived at the Starbucks meeting spot exactly at 2pm which was the scheduled time. By then, the tour guide, can’t remember his name(some guy from Pittsburgh) had already gone off and started.

Confused, I called the office and they sent someone to find me and catch me up to the group. When we finally caught up, I realized that this tour guide must’ve started 10 mins maybe more before the scheduled start time.

I travel a lot, and I like tours like this especially when time is short in any given place. I did one in London(undiscovered London) that was FREE. The guide waited 10-15 mins to give everyone a chance to find the meeting place... HE DIDNT LEAVE 10 mins BEFORE the scheduled time!

Moreover the London guide was excellent. He took his time talking about each place we went to(this was outdoors in the dead of winter). This Berlin guide was annoying as hell. It was like he was reading from a text book. I was so bored listening to this guy that I wandered off to take pictures while he spoke... SEVERAL TIMES.

I could chalk this up to it being rainy and cold which it was... however I don’t think that was it. I think this guy just sucked. We took a 20 min break half way through to grab coffee, use a bathroom etc and I knew beforehand that I wouldn’t come back. A girl I met on the tour and I went to grab a coffee and continued site seeing without this dude’s nasally voice buzzing in our ears. If there was a positive - it’s that I met someone equally as over that tour as I was.

I was very fortunate to have booked this tour in advance of my (short) visit to Berlin. Rob Willis is an excellent guide who isn't just going through the motions and reciting some prepared script about the city. It's obvious that he knows a lot about Berlin, and he is eager to share that knowledge with his groups. It's a fair bit of walking (flat), but well worth it as Rob gives a well-organized introduction to this city. I am not usually a fan of organized tours, but I wholeheartedly recommend this one. Don't waste your time - book a tour with Rob Willis and give yourself the best introduction there is to Berlin!

If you are traveling to Berlin for the first time, this is a must! The tour is four hours long and filled with historical information. You get to see many incredible landmarks across Berlin. Sam W was knowledgeable, friendly, and funny! Go and leave the tour having a grown appreciation for this beautiful city.

If it's your first time in Berlin and want to learn about it's history whilst seeing all the sights, then I can't recommend this walking tour enough!

I had Beth as our English tour guide who was incredibly knowledgable when it came to everything Berlin and it's history, and I can't think of a better person to have shown us around! The four hours fly by, and I enjoyed every second of it.

This was definatley a highlight of my first time in Berlin, and it was worth every penny.

This would be a great tour to do on your first day as you get so much information about what is around, and knowing the history makes your trip educational as well.

Thank you Beth again for a wonderful tour!

We had done a walking tour in Hamburg, so we decided to try another in Berlin. Neither myself nor my wife had ever been there, and this tour seemed like a way to see a lot of stuff in a short amount of time.

It was really great. Our guide Scott was very knowledgeable and was able to answer any questions.

If you do the tour, it is pretty long, but not tiring. Make sure to wear comfortable shoes. You stop about halfway for a break. And in our case to warm up, since it was really cold.

This was a great informative walking tour with our Guide Kevin whose historical knowledge , reference to the atrocities of the Hitler regime and his Sarcasm (which I personally thoroughly enjoyed) and his expressive hand gestures ( i'm not sure if he realises how much he communicates with his hands) was a great way to see Berlin and find out about it's history on a cold February day. We were dead on the 4 hours which sounds a long time but with Kevin's enthusiasm goes very quickly. There is a lot to take in as Kevin know's a lot but I would recommend this tour whole heartily if you are visiting Berlin for a short time

I went on a Discover Berlin tour and despite the cold had a really good time. Our guide Kevin knew so much about Berlin and was really enthusiastic to show us the sights and I learnt lots of new things about Berlin's history from the beginnings to modern day Berlin via both World Wars and the separation. Highly enjoyable.

This is a great tour, informative and well delivered . A great way to get your bearings and make a list of the sights that you want to revisit. Don't be put off by four hours of walking. Its' all done at a slow pace with a break for snacks half way through.The tour gives plenty of interesting insights into the history of Berlin and also the stories/facts behind the attractions visited. Well done to our guide Sam W, a thoroughly enjoyable tour.

Fabulous tour. Incredibly interesting insight into the famous landmarks of Berlin. Nathan our guide was very knowledgeable and held everyone's interest in this 4 hour tour. I'd highly recommend it. Wrap up however, it's freezing! 😊

A brilliant 😁 experience, Walter our tour guide was very knowledgeable about the points of the tour. A very worthwhile experience as this allows you to get your bearings and work out how to navigate around the points of interest within the city rather than the bus tours. A big thanks to Walter and good luck in the future from the CAT phone guy.

Georgia led our tour. She is engaging, super-knowledgeable, funny and the best tour leader I have had anywhere in the world. She loves Berlin and her goal is that she imparts that to all of her clients. I was so impressed with her presentation. Plus, the tour was brilliantly laid out so that the history unfolded as we walked across the city. I will do an Original Berlin Walk on my next visit or any city where this company operates.
Brilliant and fascinating tour of Berlin, beautifully presented by Kathryn. A wonderful introduction to all the major sites. World class.

Booked this as an option to do something when I was in Berlin for a few days and so glad I did! This your is amazing and our guide, Rob was so lovely and has a wealth of knowledge about the city. We visited, among other places, the Berlin Wall, Hitler's bunker, the hotel where Michael Jackson hung his baby out of the window...apparently Einstein, Justin Bieber and President Obama also stayed there. It was an amazing afternoon and we learned so much. Rob was a real pleasure as a guide and we couldn't have asked for a better guide. A real must if you can do it.

We went on a walking tour on Tuesday morning around the city. Tobi was a fantastic tour guide: informative, knowledge and funny. We learned an incredible amount about German history on the way and I could not recommend it more.

Toby our tour guide was interesting and informative . A brilliant introduction to the history of Berlin both in the recent and distant past. I would recommend this tour to everyone on a short trip to Berlin .We saw many of the important sites and their significance explained in a facinating manner. If Toby had been my history teacher I think I would have enjoyed the subject more! He really brought it to life

We did the “Discover Berlin Tour” with Jess and it was excellent. We have done quite a few walking tours in various cities and this is one of the best. We did it the day after we arrived, I like doing this as walking tours like this give you a good overview of a city and can help steer you to which attractions you want to focus on.

I was a little dubious before hand as I am usually not a fan of “foreign” tour guides, preferring ones done by locals. My concerns were completely unfounded here, Jess was very knowledgable and as a history student at one of the Berlin Universities, clearly has a huge passion for German history.

The tour itself took just over 4hrs and it flew past. It covers most of the centre of Berlin so you see loads of sights. Jess gave a load if info on each place and was always keen to answer any questions the group had.

My wife and I booked a tour and Ysanne was our guide. She was brilliant - exceptionally knowledgeable, passionate, articulate and unfailingly friendly and energetic. Having a good guide is essential to an enjoyable tour and Ysanne was much, much better than merely 'good'. She brought the amazing and often-tragic history of this amazing city to life and we both learned so much in the course of our four hours. And I know our feelings were shared by all in our large (27 strong) group.
We had Issy as our guide she was brilliant, informative and passionate about the history. Really loved this tour and learnt so much.

What a fabulous tour, our guide Nathan was that educated in all aspects of the history of Berlin it was astonishing. I have always wanted to buy a book that simplified the first and second world war as it’s so complex, well ........... I no longer need to as Nathan made an exceptional job of explaining it all to the backdrop of the main Berlin landmarks. Brilliant day for all of us including my 16 year old son who is currently doing his A level history! Great Job Nathan!

Went on this tour yesterday our guide Wouter was fabulous and extremely knowledgable. The tour left on time at 10.30am and we had leisurely stroll around the main historical points of Berlin stopping on the way for Wouter to share his vast knowledge. Wouter did not rush the tour and was more than willing to answer any questions. Would certainly recommend!

This was exactly the type of tour that I love. In addition to giving the historical details about the sites we visited, Julian included lots of stories which made each place come alive. I feel like I have a much betterunderstabding of Berlin‘s complicated history. Julien is a very experienced guide.

I took the tour last week and I'm so happy I did. It was so worthwhile and our guide John (from Cork) shared his abundant knowledge of all the sights we visited along with his Irish charm and wit. The tour and guide were thoroughly engaging from beginning to end. One of the best and most inexpensive tours I've been on. Highly recommend it!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I can only echo the other reviews. We were blessed with great weather but it was still a brilliant way to see the city whilst learning more about the history and culture at the same time. Our guide Ken was excellent and led the tour in both an informative and entertaining way.
A word of warning though there’s a lot to take in so be prepared for a walk at a reasonable pace.

We met our guide Izzy for this half day walking tour. It was very informative about Berlin and it's history to the present day. Izzy was very knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin and it's history. She was very receptive to questions and indeed helped us find a restaurant for dinner that evening. I have already recommended this to a friend coming to Berlin in December. We couldn't have learned so much on our own for sure.

Jess, our guide, was so engaging and intelligent. He knew the history of this city and shared his wealth of knowledge with us. He answered all questions and pointed out fascinating parts of the city. We saw all the highlights of the city, from Brandenburg gate, holocaust memorial, reichstag, opera house, museum isle. Too many to mention. We really got a good feel of the city and its history. Would totally recommend this tour and this guide!

Rob Willis was an excellent guide and a great ambassador for Berlin. We learnt so much in a short time in a an engaging 4 hour walk. He also gave us good advice on restaurants, using public transport and other visits to do.

Tour hits most of the historical highlights in the Mitte district. Georgia provided excellent, focussed and succinct details of the history but could provide incredible, accurate details if anyone requested more info. Also very willing to provide suggestions for other sites, restaurants and venues to visit according to each persons interest. Spoke clearly and loud enough to be heard by all in the group. Highly recommend her as a guide.

We took the Insider Tour with Jamie, a Brit who has lived in Berlin 15+ years, and he was outstanding. I'd recommend taking this tor your first day to get an overview of what you want to visit later--you only see the outside of the sights.

The four hour tour includes a 20 minute break mid-way and involves 3 miles of walking --no hills. Group size was 17, which was very manageable.
Fabulous walk with our guide Dave yesterday. Very friendly and knowledgeable ... kept the group engaged for the full tour. Lots of advice on other things to do while in Berlin. Highly recommended!

Gregor with Original Berlin Walks was the best guide I have ever encountered on a city tour. He was extremely knowledgeable not only of the history of the sites and locations on the tour, he engaged the group and generated conversation about alternate meanings and opinions on various memorials and exhibits. Very well worth your time. I highly recommend this tour.

We had only a few days to explore Berlin and decided to take a walking tour to see the sights. We could not have done better than this walk with Ryan. Not only was he knowledgeable, but he added some personal perspectives on the city and its history. We were very impressed with his depth of knowledge, allowing us to draw our own parallels to current events. His Scottish brogue was pretty cool too.

We took the 9am tour and were glad to have missed the heat of the day.

Finally, Ryan gave our adult nephew advice on where to get a tattoo in Berlin and a great German restaurant.
Overal this was an enjoyable well paced and excellent Engish, the guides are fun to be with and impart a lot of knowledge. Highly recommended.

On the 26. of August my girlfriend and I decided to go on the 14 o' clock walking tour in Berlin. Personally, I am not much into culture or history, but our guide Xavier really made this tour spectacular! He managed to give us so much information as we walked around, he was very good at informing the entire group as well as answering questions between checkpoints. Take this from a person who normally thinks history and walking as a drag, this tour is worth every single penny... (cent)!
To you Xavier: Thank you again for such a great tour, it was awesome, keep up the amazing work you do! :)

If you want excellent overviews and orientation to this complex city, I cannot more highly recommend Original Berlin Walks. We did 3 walking tours with Original Berlin Walks, each of which was truly great. We covered so much history and sights with negligible overlap. I felt these tours provided us with a good handle on overall history, and we could move onto the museums that we wanted to see in our 5-day visit. They also gave us a better understanding of the train system and the layout of this huge city, making touring much more manageable.

The tours that we did include: Discover Berlin, Hitler’s Germany, and East Berlin. Having been on countless private and group tours, I was very impressed by the very high quality of OBW’s guides and the content of the tours. Here are my assessments of the guides.

East Berlin: Ryan brought us to the really historic sites regarding the Wall (not the much-hyped touristy ones, like Checkpoint Charlie), and he delved into the history and 4 iterations of the Wall's evolution. We learned so much on this tour about the history and the cultural impacts of what was both a divided city and a divided country. I don't think that we would have seen all of these sights, much less understood their full significance, without this tour. Ryan was extremely knowledgeable, articulate and made the Cold war come alive. He is also a charming and thoughtful man, making this a very enjoyable tour.

Discover Berlin: This was a great orientation tour provided by Georgia, who adeptly synthesized a lot of history and sights in about 4.5 hours. We saw so much of Berlin on this 94-plus degree afternoon. She was engaging, attentive and so helpful on additional sights to see on our own and names of good restaurants. Plus, she made it fun!

Hitler’s Germany: This tour provided more insights as to what it was like to live in Berlin in the 1930s and 1940s and the rise of Hitler. Jess did a great job in explaining what the Jewish people endured over the years. He also took us for our break to the Topography of Terror Museum, which is amazing as to the documentation and photographs of this tragic era. He was also obviously well-studied in this history, based upon the content of the tour and his answers to questions.

So we went on a competitor’s tour, and it did not measure up to these tours. It felt like OBW’s fee was just a fraction of the value and enjoyment that we experienced.

We took this four hour tour of the centre of Berlin with Xavier and had a great time. Xavier was incredibly knowledgeable, very funny and very personable. The trip started with a 15 minute detailed history of how Berlin formed and how Germany formed around it. we saw all the major histoical sites which are listed in the perspective from the company and our guide went into great detail about how everything came into being, the impacts of the Second World War and brought everything to life and provided context. All in all it was very educational but be waned, it's fast paced to get it all in and you it's something like an 8KM walk. My only critical feedback is that the company should put a limit on the number of participants. We started off with 30 people which in my opinion is too many. Xavier did an exceptional job regardless but I would have appreciated a more intimate group. A great experience none the less. I highly recommend the tour and 5 stars to our guide.

This was an awesome tour with Rachel as the guide. Her knowledge of German history and command of German made the tour extremely interesting. It's always a great tour when your tour guide has advanced educational background; no surprise that Rachel could recite dates and years for each and every tour attraction with so much ease. This tour starts and ends at 2 different locations and is 3 hours long. The guides generally help with directions at the end, Rachel was very helpful orienting nearly each of us in the group back to our hotels, etc.

Where to begin but with our superb guide Jerad!.. At every stop on our tour he gave a TED talk on the history of the location heavily embellished with phiosophy, theology, political science and good humour. Jered spoke with passion, knowledge, compassion and enthusiasm right to the last second, despite it being one of the hottest days of the year. This tour was, without question the highlight of our 4 days in Berlin. We found ourselves cross-referencing the rest of our holiday with the insight we gained on this incredible walking tour. Make it top of any ‘to do’ list.

We took this walking tour with some trepidation as we had booked it a while ahead, not knowing there would be a heatwave , with temperatures in the high 30’s. Despite the heat we loved the tour- our tour guide was Xavier, and he was an excellent guide, animated ,knowledgeable and passionate about the history of Berlin. I would recommend this tour early in your holiday as it gave us a good overview of location of the main areas of interest in relation to each other, as well as giving an informed insight into the fascinating history of the city.

I only had a day-and-a-half in Berlin, so rather than waste time trying to find my bearings, I chose to do the 2pm walking tour. I'm really glad I did as I got to see many of Berlin's sights, but also learnt a lot about the potted history of this fascinating city.

Unfortunately I was feeling really ill, and combined with the 38c temperatures on the day, it was a real struggle for me, but Rachel's commentary, knowledge and delivery encouraged me to stick with it, and I'm glad I did.

You meet opposite Berlin Friedrichstraße station outside a cafe/restaurant - it's easy to find because they put a sign outside but make sure you arrive around 10 minutes early. The tour group was probably about 25 people, so it was big but manageable.

The walk covers Brandenburg Gate, the Berlin Wall, Museum Island, Berlin Cathedral, Checkpoint Charlie, far more besides and also the many memorials around the city including the fascinating Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe.

The guide clearly made adjustments due to the unseasonably hot weather by making sure we stood in the shade as much as possible, and despite being 4 hours the walk isn't physically exerting and there is a 20 minute break just over half way through at a cafe. If it is hot, though, bring lots of water as there aren't many water fountains in Berlin and not really a chance to buy water en-route.

Some of the attractions you can see close-up and have time to enjoy, particularly the aforementioned Memorial to the Murdered Jews and Neue Wache, while some you can only enjoy a cursory glance at in the distance such as the Reichstag and the Berlin TV Tower.

I found it hard to get photos sometimes because obviously time was of the essence but the tour is a great way of introducing you to the many sights of Berlin, so make sure this is the first thing you do so you can revisit later in your holiday.

Special credit to Rachel (hope this is spelt right). She has been a Berliner for five years and what she doesn't know isn't worth knowing. She was confident, clear in her delivery and had this ability of answering questions in just a single sentence yet including so much information in those few words.

Having only 1 day in Berlin, I wanted a way to get a good overview of the city and learn a bit about the place. I went on the 9am walking tour and our guide was Kai.

His knowledge of the city was incredible and the 4 hour tour gave a great insight into a city with a very interesting past. His tour outlined the history of Berlin from it's founding through to the present day and the tour really brought the city to life.

The tour was excellent value for money and I would highly recommend this to anyone planning to visit Berlin.

Had an amazing half day with Tobi - our tour guide for the walking tour. It was a really smart way to get to see this beautiful city in a compact format. I would recommend you start your Berlin trip with one of these tours and then circle back to the places that you find most interesting. It's a super efficient way to get an overview and create a mental map, so you know where you are going (and why you are going there) without having you nose in your phone the whole time.

As for our guide - Tobi - what a guy! Funny, smart, engaging, entertaining and knowledgable. He did a great job of keeping our diverse group together, managing to convey his deep knowledge of the history and culture of the city with his own experiences throughout the whole tour. I would definitely seek out Tobi as a guide for this, or any number of the other walking tours he guides through Berlin. He really made the experience exceptional.

Jonathan was a great guide on this well paced walking tour that showed us the highlights of Berlin. We were given a great background for all the sites we visited and he answered all our questions. Also the east of Berlin is far more interesting than the west - base yourself there if possible

This 4 hour tour of the main highlights in central Berlin started on the banks of the Spree, with a short and captivating introduction of the city´s role and history from its foundation in 1237 to the present day. The tour then took us past the many and important landmarks in central Berlin, chronologically through history, from a Holy Roman Empire outpost through Prussian unification, rise of Imperial Germany, Napoleonic wars, WW1 and WW2, the cold war and then unification again. Rarely have we had history presented in such scintillating, logical and visual manner. Even the lunch break at a restaurant frequented by locals was a highlight!
Our guide Nathan is very knowledgeable, organized, clear and concise. He has studied Central European History and his family connection to Germany is a bonus that adds a personal touch. We simply couldn’t have hoped for a better guide.
This tour is a gem for the first time visitor to Berlin - or as a refresher if you are returning after some time, not to mention tips for planning the remainder of your visit.

Really enjoyable and informative walking tour, led by Jess. He is a history student and his knowledge and enthusiasm really made the tour. Great tour around Berlin with Ken. Family were initially pretty sceptical, but came away having thoroughly enjoyed the afternoon. Ken can tell a good story with information, humour and speed!

If you think you know the city, you’ll be pleasantly surprised how the tour magnifies your experience. Lots of time for questions and personal recommendations. Exceptional - a walk to remember.

Had a really informative and interesting walking tour with our very enthusiastic guide Jake. He was happy to extend the time he spent with us and was at ease with everyone in the group across all ages. I would thoroughly recommend this tour.

First time in Berlin and expected a high level overview of the main attractions allowing us to revisit anything of particular interest afterwards.

The first 90 minutes had a very heavy connection with homosexuality for some reason. The tour guide chat at each stop seemed to be an opportunity to speak at length on subjects dear to the guide and in such detail that we soon got tired of his voice. Less is more. The first bit of interest for me was the bullet holes at the Colonnades but otherwise €14 to listen to a guy on his various soap boxes was poor value indeed and a waste of our limited time on our visit. We both bailed before the half way mark.
If using this company I would suggest asking which of their selection of tours you have been allocated to and make a decision about which tour you join.

She helped me find the Stumbling Stones I so desired to see. It was a true treasure to have her as a guide! We would like to thank her so much! Thank you!

Jonathan was passionate about his city and had excellent knowledge of the history of Berlin and of the major sights. He was warm and inclusive and involved us in discussion at stops along the way. He answered questions and was genuinely interested in us. It was a wonderful introduction to the city and enabled us to explore independently for the rest of our stay. Thank you Jonathan!

Absolutely outstanding because of Wouter (Walter)... positively the most knowledgeable, charming and even-handed “teacher.” His truthful and unbiased presentation of facts, both good and gruesome, made this the quintessential overview of Berlin.
Gregor, our guide, was fantastic. So knowledgeable, it was a great way to see the city and learn about the history.
gregor was very well informed & funny, he kept the group moving on for over four hours! met some lovely people. thanks very much

Had a great tour with Wouter today, who did a fantastic job as a guide. He was able to incorporate so much of Berlin's past and discuss how it has influenced the present. He also had a good sense of humor and was very well spoken. Overall, great experience. Highly recommended.

This walking tour is a must if you are visiting Berlin for the first time. Our Guide Ysanne (who is from Coventry) was fantastic and her historical knowledge was brilliant. This tour captures the main sites of Berlin so that you get to know where things are for further visits.
The walking tour was great and very interesting. Beth was an excellent guide and her knowledge was first class.

If you make it to Berlin, don’t hesitate to take this tour, the guide Sarah (from Australia)
was excellent, she was very well read, knew her material and did a wonderful job educating us.
Even with the cloudy, cold and sometimes wet weather,we enjoyed the tour, learned a whole lot of historical facts about the German capital. Thanks Sarah.
Our guide was Polly who made our walk very interesting. She had an amazing knowledge which she shared in an easy to follow way. Great value for money. Would recommend to everyone.

Fantastic tour. Well worth doing. Our guide was Ken. He was very informative and witty. We really enjoyed his commentary, sarcasm and knowledge! One of the best tour guides we have come accross in our travels.

My parents and I did this tour the day after I ran the Berlin Marathon. Sarah was a wonderful guide and had so much knowledge about the city of Berlin. It was the best way to learn more about Berlin. I had no idea so much history was in the city.
Brilliant tour with Liz. Good pace and her knowledge was informative and interesting. Would definitely recommend Liz as a guide if you get the choice.

Our tour guide James couldn't have been anymore knowledgeable and had good craic with the whole group. He provided us with really interesting facts and answered any questions we had. If you are going to Berlin for a short break I would 100% recommend this tour - as it isn't long and you get to see everything Berlin has to offer. Thank you James for a brilliant day!!
Rob Shaw was our guide for the afternoon and despite the bad weather he kept our interest and made the history of Berlin come alive. Recommended tour that was just the right length

Our tour guide Jess was a wealth of knowledge. He had very many interesting facts and very knowledgeable about the history of Berlin. He truly is passionate about his city and his job. It’s a great way to be introduced to Berlin. Absolute must do when visiting!

Simple but very informative tour of some of Berlin's landmarks. If you don't have much time, this tour could help you summarize the most relevant places and interesting events in the history of Berlin. Highly recommended!
Ysanne was our tour guide. She was amazing, passionate and highly knowledgeable of all aspects of our tour. It was a most enjoyable day in Berlin.

We nearly always do a walking tour early in a visit to any major city and this was one of the best. Our guide was Ysanne who, over the course of four hours, not only introduced to the history of Berlin but also spoke with passion about the factors that. led to the rise of the third reich and lessons for today. There was also humour and humanity. Ysanne really knows her stuff and could go well beyond the standard tour content in answering questions and talking about her own experiences.
I would recommend this to anyone.

Our guide, Sarah, was Australian and had lived in Berlin for 9 years. Such an interesting lady and really knew her stuff.
We walked for about 2.5 hours, yet it felt about 30 minutes because she made it so good.
Would definitely recommend this tour

Jess was a most knowledgeable and thorough guide. He patiently answered numerous questions and made the tour really worthwhile. We thoroughly enjoyed the experience. I would recommend this walking tour to anyone visiting Berlin.

This is a great way to see and understand the history of the city . Our guide Fran was very knowledgeable and her great personality made the tour fun as well as very interesting and the four hours fly by. Definitely recomended.

We met up with our guide at 10.30 on a dull and a bit rainy day. He was Dutch and his English was excellent. The tour lasted over 4 and a half hours with a short break and was so informative. He gave us so much information and it helped with our holiday over the next 2 days. He was very patient with questions and his enthusiasm for Berlin shone through. I wish we had booked another tour with him but sadly we didn't have enough time over a weekend. Great way to start our visit.

This tour was great! The 4 hours was so well spent within a walking perimeter of Berlin formerly known as East Berlin. The details of Berlin’s history that our tour guide Martin provided were informative, fun, and very interesting. This gave us a great overview of where to go the next time we are in Berlin. Martin provides in depth information with an obvious love for Berlin.
Just did this tour. Amy was our guide. The tour was very informative and Amy was great. Highly recommend this tour

The Famous Walk was excellent. Walked us through the history of Germany. The tour guide, Phil, was very knowledgeable and made the tour very interesting. He was very professional and answered all our questions. I recommend this tour very much.

If you are interested in The history of Berlin, this is your tour and Sam W is your guide. Sam W has wealth of knowledge and communicates it very well. Four hours seems like a long time, but with all the fascinating information and historic sites, it just flew in. It’s great value and I highly recommend.
Australian tour guide was excellent and the past anecdotes were also interesting. Highly recommended. Berlin sure is one influential city!!

I've visited Berlin before but had only a very superficial feel for it. Kai, our guide, was so knowledgeable and thorough that I feel I have a much better grasp of the city and its history. He maintained a good pace without hurrying and combined information with humor. I highly recommend this tour.

Our guide was Jess who was ridiculously knowledgeable. The tour overran slightly because he was giving us so much information, which he delivered clearly and with an obvious passion for the subject matter. There were lots of questions from the other members of the tour and he answered all of them. We enjoyed the tour immensely and would definitely recommended it. Thank you Jess, you gave us a brilliant tour of Berlin and its history.

This tour was a delightful walk through the streets of Berlin centre. During the tour we visited all the major landmarks we had wished to see. Our tour guide Laura was amazing, her knowledge was second to none of the historical events surrounding the buildings and architecture and gave a damning insight to how the city reacted to the horrific events following the holocaust and both world wars. It was a definite eye opener to what had happened and how the city has been rebuilt from the ashes. I would highly recommend taking this tour if you would like to know more of the culture and heritage of this wonderful city.

We had an excellent time on this tour. Ken was our guide and he was extremely knowledgeable with a sense of humor that made the tour even more enjoyable. He was happy to answer any questions we had. I highly recommend this tour and Ken was awesome!!

Today, this was a fantastic way to find our way around the key places in Berlin. Jake's knowledge, enthusiasm and humour was infectious. His tales brought Berlins history to life. Many thanks for a memorable time.

Sarah was our tour guide. A must do for when you arrive in Berlin. The tour takes you to the landmark sites and more. Our tour guide Sarah was really knowledgeable and has a passion for the city which was really evident. An Aussie who has adopted Berlin as her home. Thanks Sarah for a great first day to Berlin.

We have just been on the discover berlin tour with Jake and found it fascinating and informative. Jake's knowledge of his subject and his friendliness and helpfulness made the tour an unforgettable experience

Our guide Sarah was phenomenal and this 3.5 hour walking tour could not have been a better introduction to the main sights of Berlin city centre. Having done this for many years she smoothly provided a huge amount of information, made it interesting and answered all our questions. She also helped us decide which venues to visit by way of follow up which was useful as we only had a couple of days there. Six of us booked this introductory tour and we were all impressed. Highly recommend Sarah and this tour.
This walking tour is so fun and informative. It is pretty long, but you see a ton of sites. Our guide, Laura, was fabulous. Highly recommend!

Laura was an excellent guide! She was entertaining and shared many different interesting stories about the places. The 4h tour passed very quickly. I enjoyed it very much and would definitely recommend it.

Our tour guide was Sam Z and he was great, very knowledgeable and friendly, he made the tour so interesting. We did the tour the day after we arrived in Berlin so it gave us some knowledge of where things were in the city and in the following days we revisited some of the things which Sam told us about so we could spend more time in certain places. It’s a fantastic way to learn about the history of Berlin we’d highly recommend the tour
We went on tour on a cold and rainy day with guide Izzy. Despite the weather Izzy was informative, entertaining and passionate about her history. Can thoroughly recommend this tour.

Interesting tour and a fantastic guide, Martin
We had a nice and fun tour and visited the most interesting places in Berlin

Laura was our guide and she really made the tour come to iife - she took us to the main sites of Berlin and gave detailed information about each place we visited - we walked about 10km but did not feel like that as so much to take in - definitely worth doing the walk as you will learn so much more

I'm so glad I booked this tour - I thoroughly enjoyed learning about Berlin's incredible history. Our guide, Martin, was great: clearly very knowledgeable and tremendously engaging throughout. The four hours really flew by! This was a wonderful use of my (unfortunately) limited time in Berlin. Thank you
The guidance through out the Walking Tour was full of anecdote and historic data presented by an extraordinary guide, Carlos.

An excellent tour with our guide Beth, giving a balanced and interesting overview of Berlin's complicated history.
Would highly recommend.

Our 4 hour tour on 6th October covered hundreds of years of history and a large number of sites, but the 4 hours flew by. It was perfect to give an overview and help get your bearings when you only have a short amount of time in Berlin, which was the case for me and my friend.

Our tour guide Sam Z, was excellent. He kept our varied tour group engaged with the tour with his narrative, using sensitivity and humour as required, and with anocdotes about previous tours sprinkled in.

I would definately recommend this tour for anyone visiting Berlin, especially for the first time.

Scott created such a great experience for discovering Berlin! He’s educated about the history and really respectful about it. By far the best tour guide I’ve ever encountered and would highly recommend him :)

This is an extremely good tour that covered early history, through the war and the reunification of Berlin. Our guide Issy was amazing....eloquent, knowledgeable and humorous with it! You are in a largish group but it really doesn’t matter as she draws you into some great historical facts and stories. Sadly the sun didn’t shine but do wear comfy shoes! Thank you Issy from The Brighton Midwives.

We had Ken as our tour guide who was excellent , he was knowledgeable , adding humour appropriately . He went above and beyond his remit as during the tour we were unable to get to certain points due to a demonstration taking place and roads being closed off . He readapted the tour and took us to all sorts of places we would never have found . All in all a great teacher and only wished I had a teacher like Ken when I was at school !!!

As a family of four with two young teens, I was tentative in booking a 4 hour walking tour. After it was said and done, I’m so thankful we did! Scott, our tour guide, was not only thoughtful in explaining the sometimes dark history of Berlin, but he was also very knowledgeable and entertaining. He was also very aware of his audience and he did an amazing job of keeping our attention for the entire 4 hours. This will certainly be a history lesson and tour we won’t soon forget. Thank you Scott!

While in Berlin in July we did both an open top bus tour and this walking tour. The walking tour was just so much better! Our tour guide was Sam W, and he was really knowledgeable and informative and friendly. We saw so many places and buildings that otherwise we just would not have come across, and learnt a lot from Sam who clearly knows his stuff. I would most definitely recommend this walking tour.
Best walking tour! Our guide Ken was excellent! Very knowledgeable and very informative. He went above and beyond to show us so much of Berlin! Highly recommend!!

My wife and I decided to take a short break in Berlin not really knowing what to expect, on the day after arrival, we decided to do a walking tour rather than bus, and was not disappointed. Tours were in English, and took us around all the key sites we already earmarked to visit, the group size was very good, and the tour guide (Jonathan) was very informative and knowledgable on German history and politics, added to which very friendly which put everyone at ease. The tour ends at the very impressive Brandenburg Gate. Tour was around 3 1/2hrs ...and you will walk a reasonable distance, so be ready, but well worth it.

Four hours of information and fun with time for contemplation. Sam Z led us through the streets and sights of Berlin, kept us entertained and informed on over 1000 years of History, even allowing time for refreshments. An afternoon well spent and value to boot. Oh and don’t forget to wear your sensible shoes!!!!
This was a very informative interesting tour led by a very knowledgeable guide. Extremely well done!

Interesting trip round many important landmarks with a history lesson full of detail and providing some reasons to explain how Germany was transformed. Did not shy away from the painful areas. A good way to see plenty but you may wish to revisit some with more time.
A fairly fast pace at times taking 4 hours to go from Hackescher market to Brandenberg gate but timd to ask questions at every stop.
Excellent tour with Ken - highly recommended. Plan for at least 3.5 hours...it’s worth it tho, get a great overview of a very complicated city.

Martin was an amazing guide, full of history and knowledge of his hometown of Berlin. We have been here before and did one of the double-decker tour buses but enjoyed the three and a half hour boots on the ground tour of Berlin even more! This really was an incredible value. Martin did a great job of pacing the walk so that everyone from a small child to folks in their 70s could keep up; there is also a 25-minute snack and bathroom break about half way through.
Sam Z did an excellent and very informative job telling, educated and moving us to think for ourselves on the history of Berlin. He truly knows his history and made it very enjoyable for me.

We had limited time to sightsee while in Berlin and are so glad we started with this tour! Kyle was engaging and informative and made the 4-hour tour completely enjoyable and worth it despite the cold and rain. Highly recommend for anyone visiting the city!

Today we did a great walking tour around what was primarily the old East Berlin. Our guide Sam W was our tour leader. He was incredibly knowledgeable & generous giving us a fantastic overview of the history of the people, places and events which helped to shape this amazing city. He touched on the history leading up to and including the 2nd World War as well as the post War partition of the city including the establishment of the German Democratic Republic and the infamous Berlin Wall right through to the eventual reunification of Berlin. Despite the rain Sam kept us all on track and provided a great orientation to this fascinating city. Very good value tour. Highly recommend. Thanks again Sam W.

Excellent tour (ours was four and a half hours!) stopping at major sights with a short break about half way through for a coffee and loo stop. Our guide Laura made sure that by the end of the tour we knew far more about the history of the city than before. Her near-perfect English made for a highly informative tour full of interesting points and she obviously has a great deal of knowledge about the history of Berlin and its main monuments and buildings. Highly recommendable.

Fantastic tour which takes in a lot of sights at a very good pace, never feeling rushed but also not having to hang around waiting to move on. Our guide Lynsey was incredibly knowledgeable and very engaging and made the tour a real treat. Would definitely recommend this tour.

Despite the rain Rob kept us all so entertained with his wealth of knowledge and laid back funny personalities. What this guys doesn’t know about all things Berlin especially the history isn’t worth knowing. We will go on other other tours for sure
Excellent detailed information on the historical events and monuments by our knowledgeable tour guide Laura.

A fantastic tour around parts of Berlin that were under communist control after the second world war. Our guide Tobi was very knowledgeable and made the tour very interesting. Fantastic value for your money.
Great tour, Johnathan was an amazing tour guide very knowledgeable. You will leave the tour knowing a lot more about Berlin And its history than you would expect.
This is a MUST-DO experience in Berlin. Laura, our guide, was incredibly knowledgeable, articulate, passionate and generous. Cannot recommend this enough.
Sam W was an amazing guide! Aside from knowing the facts, the way he presented all the information and Germany as a whole was great.

We had our tour with Sam W this week, he was a really good group leader, very knowledgeable about the history of Berlin and all the different sights and historic buildings - we enjoyed the whole tour from beginning to end, plus the humorous touches! .Although we do have some knowledge of German, it was helpful that the tours are conducted in English, as there is a lot of information and historic background. It really helped us find our way around the city later and decide what to visit on the subsequent days of our visit to Berlin. Thank you for a great tour, Sam W!
This tour was lead by Beth who was an excellent tour guide . Knowledgeable and friendly we got to understand the history of Berlin and the main areas of interest on our 4 hour tour. Highly recommend.

This tour was exactly what we hoped it would be. A great overview of the city. Jake showed he is passionate about Berlin and his enthusiasm was catching. Group size was 24,a bit larger than we had hoped but he managed it well. Thank you Jake.

We took this tour as an introduction to Berlin on our first day there. Our guide did an excellent job of taking us to the major sites and locations, while providing expert commentary about the complex history of this city. Highly recommend!

Good tour for first day in Berlin. Guide was knowledgeable but didn’t drown us with information. Visited most of the key sights and got an idea of things to do afterwards. Pace was really good- walked quite a lot but didn’t feel like too much. Recommended!
We would thoroughly recommend this tour. Our guide, Polly, was knowledgeable and engaging. We had our kids with us, the youngest one 9, and all were kept interested until the end.

Our tour with Lyndsey today was excellent. She struck exactly the right balance of being interesting and informative but not overwhelming. She was warm and friendly and answered all the groups questions and gave lots of tips for sightseeing and things to do for the rest of everyone stays. Would not hesitate to recommend.
Excellent tour, informative and enjoyable. Recommended. Will definitely go on another tour when I can

We only had 1 day to see Berlin and took the half-day Discover Berlin tour. We had Jake who was informative and interesting. His stories helped bring the history of Berlin alive. We saw all the best sights of Berlin, it was perfect for our short visit.

We had a first class walking tour yesterday with (female) guide Kyle. Kyle had not just the depth of knowledge you would expect from a professional guide, she combined that with exceptional attention to detail in making sure we all were able to hear her, and avoid unwelcome attention from scammers or pickpockets. That advice proved useful well beyond the walk itself.

Her approach was consistently to tell the human stories involved in Berlin's history from the perspective of the people involved, helping us understand why their actions were rational for them in their context.

Her mixed US/UK heritage, she explained, made her wary of criticising the actions of the populations of other countries. It was particularly interesting to hear her speak of meeting with elderly ex-GDR residents, and how they compared that life not with the West, but with the hard times they had experienced earlier in the 20th C.

Can't recommend highly enough.

Six friends and I met up with the tour organisers outside Starbucks on Neue Promenade which was just outside the Hackescher Markt station.
We were split into groups and introduced to our guide Lynsey from Scotland.
We set off at a steady walk and stopped in a local square for some introductions. We had visitors from the US, Canada, New Zealand, Hong Kong and the UK in our group.
The tour took us to all the key sights including the Brandenburg Gate, the Reichstag, museum island etc. We also saw the location of the Fuherbunker (now a car park) and remnants of the Berlin wall adjacent to the Topgraphie of Terror museum which is located on what was the site of the SS HQ.
Overall the tour was incredibly informative, Lynsey was a great guide and happy to answer any questions throughout the walk. We also stopped off at a lovely little cafe half way through for coffee and a delicious pastry.
I would highly recommend the tour as your first activity in Berlin. It was a great way of orienting you as to where everything is and how to find your way round. Particularly useful if you have never been before, and or if it has been a long time since a previous visit. I was in Berlin for a day trip in 1993, and can honestly say it has changed rather a lot since then.
Thank you Lynsey for a fabulous tour!!!!
Scott & Leyla Charlton.

fantastic walking tour, Sebastian our guide was a walking history lesson. enjoyed all the layers that make up Berlins history.
highly recommend.

This was a great tour and wonderful to see the sites upon arrival to get an idea of where we may want to go back to. Martin was a great guide and very knowledgeable and entertaining! Easy to find the Starbucks meeting place and very walk able. Would definitely recommend this tour.

Best walking tour ever experienced. Georgia was highly knowledgeable and entertaining. Loved the walk which went much faster than the 4 hours that it took. Georgia’s knowledge and interaction made the tour worth every cent. An absolute must do to really understand and appreciate the dark history of Berlin and the efforts made to educate the world of those darkest times. The tour Achieves the goal that history never never repeat itself and the world needs to understand the profound pain and horror that this period caused in order to unite the globe in tolerance and humanity. Perfect for both history buffs and the sightseers.

Easy to get to the meeting point via public transportation. When I first heard our guide’s Scottish accent I was a bit worried about not having a local but nothing could be further from the truth. He had excellent knowledge of the history of the city and did a great job of presenting it in an interesting way, not just regurgitating facts and dates. He was the best city guide we have had on our European trip thus far. We would highly recommend this walking tour.

Lynsey our tour guide was great! She efficiently and effectively showed us the major landmarks we wanted to see. Lynsey even gave us a 20-30 minute break to get food and use the WC. There was a lot of information she presented and she had pictures to go along with hr talk. We enjoyed it!!

We had a great afternoon with an entertaining informative guide called Dave from Australia. He was attentive and spoke with humour, simplicity, an obvious affection for Berlin and respect for its history. His street art was something to remember but it illustrated the partition issues memorably and with skill. Well done!!
Knowledgeable tour guides!!! Precise but well explained details of the History we are not taught in schools.

Our guide Laura was fantastic and really interesting, going above and beyond to make the most of the tour. We learnt so much from her and both agreed that it’s a great way to see all the major sites in Berlin in half a day.
Our Guide Laura was fantastic! A great walk and tour of Berlin and what it offers. I enjoyed all the aspects of the city we visited.

We had Georgia as our tour guide and where do I start, there are too many adjectives to describe how fantastic she and the tour was. Informative, enthusiastic, passionate and friendly are just a sample of those I would begin to use. Would highly recommend this trip for any visit to Berlin! I'd advise taking it at the start of your visit as she provides a variety of recommendations throughout, which will help you when you go on to do other things😊 5 stars, 10/10.
Thank you, Georgia.
Kind Regards,
Sam & Lucy (Lake District Couple)

Our guide, Ken, started out by summoning up Berlin's history up until the beginning of the 19th century. We then went around to different places in central Berlin and our guide explained the background and what had happened there. There was a 30 min pause in the middle of the tour when you sit down and have a beer or go to the bathroom. All in all a very nice experience!

Our guide Kai was so knowledgeable and brought the history of the city to life. The tour was covered so much but was so engaging - it was incredible value for money. It’s a great way to be introduced to the city and see things you may want to explore in more detail later.

This was excellent way to start our trip. Our guide was Seb B. He was very Knowledgeable and thoughtful. He gave lots of information and dates. He spent time time to talk to all the people in the group.

Very pleasant, friendly, informative and knowledgeable guide. Jonathan ticked all the boxes as a guide and helped us with information(chocolate shop and restaurants) that we were planning in our special break. 5 stars. Thanks again, Ali and Amanda.

Really knowledgeable with a dash of wit young English lady we had give the tour, and it was so interesting and so much fun I didn’t want it to end! Great value and in a city with such incredible history, well worth taking the time out to do the tour. Even found out our hotel was the Michael Jackson baby dangling hotel!! Not something the hotel publicizes but thank you for enlightening us Berlin walking tours!

I really recommend making this tour as one of your first activities in Berlin, you'll learn a lot about the city and its landmarks. Our guide was Georgia Riungu and she is outstandingly good, she kept us the whole tour engaged and interested, and her knowledge and passion about Berlin is contaguious. A personal observation for her... please, I know days may be hot, but don't use loose short sleeves if you didn't shave your arm pits... I found it... disturbing :S
We had Kyle take us on our walking tour. She was friendly and knowledgeable. We took the tour our first day so we would know what to go back to during our trip.
We had a great tour with Rob. He had amazing knowledge of the city's history and made the tour interactive and fun
Sam W was an exceptional guide through the Mitte district of Berlin. We highly recommend this tour and hope you are lucky enough to have Sam W as your guide!

This tour leads through the Museum island and through to Brandenburg Tor and ends in Charlies point. The guide (Gregor, he is very good and all liked him) was very pleasant and explained all the details of Berlin, and Germany history and I (and most of us I guess) like the part he said many things about Germany's recent ordeals and their thorough regrets and how situations lead the country in those history. After the tour, every one must have felt sympathy to German people and to all our human beings. It was also very fun and sometimes with some jokes. I'm not very good at listening to English, but I enjoyed it very much. I recommend this tour to everyone who visits Berlin.
It was fantastique, Gloria is pationate of history. She takes Berlin to her heart. I recommand highly.
It was a great tour. Our guide Polly was very good. Got to know the history of Berlin and saw lots of landmarks of the city. Will recommend to everyone visiting Berlin.

Sarah is one of the best guides we've ever had on a walking tour. She kept everyone engaged for over 4 hours with her knowledge and precise delivery while making it fun at the same time. Would recommend this tour to any first timers to Berlin.

My husband and I took this walking tour on the first day of our trip are so glad we did. Our tour guide, Sam Z, was fantastic. He began by summarizing the history of the city in 10 minutes, then explained how each site along the way fit into the timeline and theme. I highly recommend this tour for understanding Berlin historically, geographically, and culturally.

Having participated in numerous walking tours, we'd rate our tour with Sam W as one of the best we've booked. Here are some pros...
1) The tour was well organised and started promptly. 2) A large group was split into three smaller groups. The group size was ideal and it was easy to keep everyone together and engaged. 3) The tour covered all the main sites you'd want to see, and we saw them in a fairly chronological order. 4) Sam's knowledge was phenomenonal! He was also warm and personable, and always asked if anyone had questions.
Cons... none, book if you're in Berlin!
Jake fun and dynamic from start to finish. Never boring, a concise and condensed history of the City. Exceedingly good value.

Our group of 4 had the most informative and entertaining 1/2 day tour. The tour guide Georgia was simply fabulous. She was knowledgeable, friendly, helpful and made sure everyone kept up and enjoyed themselves.
Would reccomend her very highly.

Sam W was our guide, he was very knowledgeable and interesting to listen to :)
About three hours long but it felt shorter, lots of stops so you don't exert yourself

We thoroughly enjoyed the four hour walking tour yesterday. Georgia Riungu was our guide. She was extremely knowledgeable, respectful of all sites and group members, very friendly, funny and a great story teller! I highly recommend her your. We’re only here for 2.5 days and this was such a great wAy to learn about the city and its history. In fact we enjoyed the tour so much we meet Georgia again today for the tour of the concentration camp. Again, exceeded expectations. She held such a challenging experience so respectfully. Many many thanks!

The english guide Sam B was so entusiastic and deep into the german history that it from time to time was difficult for us norwegians to follow everything he said, but we loved the walk even though we felt that we lost important information here and there.

I visited Berlin for 1.5 on my birthday with my best friend. We booked this tour and our wonderful guide Kevin taught us more in 4 hours than we could have read in 4 days. Very informative, very stimulating, the tour is most highly recommended! Thank you!
Tour leader Martin was knowledgable and put information across excellently. Would whole heartedly recommend.

Liz was a great guide -- we learned so much! Lots of good information and "inside" stories. Beautiful sights and good recommendations, including where to eat dinner. (We loved the Syrian restaurant that Liz recommended.)

Sam W or Dr Sam 😁 was a fantastic tour guide. We learned so much in this walking tour that we never knew before. Amazing sights with all the incredible information given to us as we walked. Plenty of time was given to take in the sights and to ask any questions. We weren't rushed at all and I would highly recommend this tour.
Very interesting and excellently commented tour. We saw and heard a lot that we would not have otherwise known about.

Thoroughly recommend this tour. However, long your visit to Berlin is for, it is worth doing this tour as early as possible as it provides you with a good overview of Berlin and gives you ideas of where you'd like to spend more time. Our guide was the excellent Lynsey. She brought the history of Berlin alive. Learnt a lot in a fun way. Many thanks Lynsey

Guide Martin was excellent and we finished with a good idea of how the key sites fit together across the history of the city. Do this tour on your first day and reap the benefits for the rest of your visit.

Booked it the morning of on my one day in Berlin, seeing it had good reviews I just decided it must be good. The reviews were right, very informative and enjoyable! Had a great time seeing all the places I was going to see without a tour plus so much more, and it was nicely paced not to slow or too fast! And our guide was great!

This is a really good way to see and learn abouy a bunch of cool sights in Berlin in a short amount of time. I would definitely recommend it if you only have a few days in the city. Our guide Jess was especially knowledgeable, and he provided a bunch of interesting social and historical context for the different sites.
Informative and fun! I would recommend doing this tour first to get a broad view of Berlin. It is quite a long walk. Make sure u have a comfortable shoe.
An excellent tour, with Alex as our guide. He was very well informed and also made the subject entertaining. Thoroughly recommended!

A great 5 hours spent with our guide Jess. I did an open top bus tour the previous day and the walking tour complimented this brilliantly, going into far more detail. Engaging delivery and extensive knowledge from Jess. Highly recommended.

My mother and I just did the 1/2 day (4 hr) walking tour and had a blast. Martin's knowledge and family history of Berlin is amazing. Having never been to Berlin and just visiting for the day from Hamburg we left knowing so much about Berlin and its history. I would 100% recommend Martin to anyone, and his English is better than mine.

Hey Martin, Thanks for walking us through the middle of Brandenburg Gate. Haha

We took the Discovery Berlin Half-Day Walking Tour with our guide Georgia. She was the absolute best. Probably one of the best walking tours that we have taken, and we have taken a few at various European cities. The tour covered all the major sites in Berlin, including the Brandenburg Gate, the Holocaust Memorial, the site of Hitler's bunker, the Berliner Dom, Museum Island and others. Georgia was informative, interesting, funny and kept a reasonable pace. Highly recommend this tour!

We took a 6 hour walking tour on our first day in Berlin. Our guide Kevin was very thorough in introducing each site and giving us an objective overview of the history and significance of the many stops along the tour. He made sure that we had enough stops for rest and food to pace the tour. Kevin is an excellent guide and we fortunate to have an attentive small group interested I learning about this great city. The price for the tour was extremely reasonable and I highly recommend the longer 6 hour tour which gives you a thorough overview of Berlin and allows you to return another day to those places that appear most interesting.

What a wonderful way to discover Berlin. First time visit and our tour guide (Chloe) what a wealth of information, gave us a great insight to this amazing City. We were shown so many sites with ample time to soak up the view and info.
Also great information of places where to have local food and drinks. 👌👌👌👌
A must when you visit this city👍👍
Thank you Chloe 🙏🙏

I booked a place on this tour for myself as my first activity of my first ever trip to Berlin. I couldn't have asked for a better welcome to this amazing city!
Heidi was the perfect guide: she paced her descriptions of our sights and surroundings just right, and gave just the right amount of information to ponder as we explored around; not oversimplified, nor overwhelming.
Moments of laughter, wonder and solemnity made for a truly enriching introduction to the city of Berlin. I'll be recommending this tour, and Heidi, to anyone I know who's visiting for the first time.
