On a cold, wet morning in Berlin, we were expertly guided through the wonders of Berlin. Jonathon was a fantastic guide, very knowledgeable, willing to answer any questions, and to make the group think about what we were seeing. Miserable weather, but a wonderful tour and brilliant guide.
Great tour with an experienced and friendly guide. I would recommend this to anybody visiting Berlin!

Jonathon was an exceptional tour guide, I had the most amazing time and it was a great way to see Berlin for the first time. We really went all around the key sites and Jonathan was very knowledgeable about everything and super friendly and helpful!! I can’t recommend enough.
Sebastian have us a fascinating tour of a Germany and Berlin that did not exist in my childhood spent in BAOR

Excellent guide. Very knowledgeable about the history of Germany and Berlin. Responded in depth to questions. Our guide was Rob Shaw and we would highly recommend him. He also had a great sense of humor.

Berlin is very walkable and this was an excellent introduction for a visitor with limited time. The guide hit the high points and an overview of the Nazi and communist eras of the city. Well worth the money.

Scott was such an incredible guide and made the tour so much more than I ever could have expected! Such a fountain of wisdom and insight that made for an amazingly powerful look into such a profound time in history.
Polly was a great tour guide! Covered a variety of topics/historical moments and got to see a lot of the city in a short period of time. Well worth it.

Did this walking tour with Rob Shaw on my first day in Berlin, and it provided a brilliant introduction to the city. Berlin is a city with a unique history, and he covered everything from the medieval right up to the cold war, with plenty of opportunities to ask questions. And as a historian, he was able to provide his own insights into it all, which made it even more interesting. Probably the best 10 euros I spent on my holiday - very highly recommended.

This was one of the best walking tours I have done. It fits a lot of information into 3.5 hours and is a perfect way to get oriented to Berlin and history. Sarah was an amazing guide - we visited a large variety of sites and locations and she maintained a wonderful narrative that helped connect all of the sites and stories together, keeping us engaged and making it easy to follow and remember. Her love for Berlin was obvious. I highly recommend taking her tours!

Ken was our Irish guide! He had spent a year studying at the university and was a history student. This definitely showed in his knowledge of Berlin. He had a great sense of humour and sensitively dealt with the more difficult subject matter, especially given we had some young members in our group. We took his recommendations for lunch and museums and he took the time at the end to give us directions to our next stop. Well worth it!
I did this tour yesterday and Georgia was my tour guide, she did an incredible job! It exceeded my expectations. Georgia was very knowledgeable and had a very good sense of humour! Highly recommend!

Excellent walking tour - Ken was a fantastic host full of great facts but with great charm and enthusiasm that kept our group interested and engaged despite the blistering heat of the day. Tour was nicely paced over 4 hours with a drinks break mid- way. Highly recommended as a primer and orientation of the core central sights.

Did this walking tour hosted by Beth and must sat it was absolutely great and would thoroughly recommend,Beth was a great guide with excellent knowledge of Berlin took as to all the important places explained the history and answered any questions the group had definitely a 5 star experience.

Great way to learn about Berlin and it’s history, our guide Darren super informative great knowledge, enjoyed his own personal perspective on all of the topics
Highly recommend this guide

We attended the discover Berlin half day walking tour on Thursday 22 August at 10.30am. The meeting point was perfect for breakfast snack & bathroom visit at the start. It was very organised with the tour guides arranging our respective groups. Our guide was Lindsey and she was excellent. She was very knowledgeable explaining in detail all of the many sights we visited. It's a huge city so for us it was the perfect way to see & learn as much as possible about Berlin. Lindsey conducted the tour at just the right pace for us allowing enough time to discuss the sights & take pictures. Our group were good too as there were approximately 26 of us,looking out for each other as we walked. We took a lunch break in a cafe recommended by Lindsey which was lovely. She continued her support to our group at the end of the tour in providing help with directions back to our bases. We would definitely recommend this tour to our friends & family. Thank you for a great day.

I recently visited Berlin and was fortunate enough to have Cesar as the guide on a walking tour. Not only is he extremely knowledgeable, he is also clearly passionate about his subject. He made every topic interesting, particularly his recounting of some of the awe inspiring stories at the Resistance museum. He is an excellent guide and I would highly recommend him.
Our guide, Georgia Riungu,was great, very lively and knowledgeable . Tour is about 4 hrs and it covers all the main sites, Definitely recommend this tour.

I visited Berlin a number of years ago with my husband and we did this walk which we felt was excellent. Returning last week with my son I wanted him to have the same experience. It was just as good second time around. Our guide, Lynsey, was excellent. Lots of interesting information about the different sites, a good pace and great care for we visitors, especially when one lady seemed to have got lost. Lynsey took great care to find her before we proceeded! There was a useful break in the middle for a snack in a small cafe. Highly recommended.
Georgia Riungu was our professional, knowledgable, fun and utterly engaging guide. We learnt so much from her and couldn't have have had a better experience.

Our tour was led by Lynsey. She did an incredible job! I was so blown away by her ability to keep us engaged while throwing a ton of information at us. I learned a lot about Berlin during the walk and we hit most of the major points of interest. I would very highly recommend this tour for anyone who is interested in the history of Berlin.

Learned a lot about the history of Germany and Berlin. Hit most of the highlights along the way in a short amount of time. Our guide, Bonnie, was excellent!

Highly recommend.

Highly recommend the tour. Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and approachable. The day was hot but Plenty of shade. If you do this tour there isn’t much left to see in Berlin. Highly recommend

We had a fabulous time with Lyndsy. So much so that we went on another tour the very next day! (East Berlin tour) Her knowledge is amazing on German history. The Berlin Walk is a must! I recommend you do this tour on the first day - (permitted you’re not tired) It’s a fabulous way to get to know a part of the city and it’s history. Many stops and allot to take in. *I wish LYNDSY had given us more stickers* personal joke between her and us ;) Do it - you won’t regret it and I sure hope you get LYNDSY as your tour guide!

Chris and Dave. X

A most enjoyable tour of the main tourist sights in Berlin. Ideal for us with only a limited time in the City. Ken, our guide, projected his voice well with the ideal combination of information and humour. Highly recommended.

So, I did the half day walking tour and it was brilliant. Very informative guide too.
The tour gives you a great background to the history of Berlin whilst ticking off some of the sight seeing locations. Would recommend to anyone. (Coming from somond that rarely books on a walking tour!)

What a fabulous experience this was. We found the meeting place easily, and were there early enough to swap to the 9am tour even though we’d booked the 10:30. This was done without any hassle and much appreciated.

Jake was our tour guide and he was excellent in every way - informative, friendly, and looked after us on a 30oC day. His knowledge and love of Berlin really made this an unforgettable experience. Thank you so much Jake! PS NZ really did lose the Cricket World Cup by no runs ;-)

This is a fantastic tour. Martin was everything you could hope for in a tour guide: engaging, enthusiastic, extremely knowledgeable, and he delivered that knowledge with the perfect balance of education, humour and respect for the city. There was no question from the group that he did not have the answer to.
The structure of the tour itself is a great introduction to Berlin, especially for a first visit. It is well organised and every team member I interacted with was friendly and helpful. I highly recommend Original Berlin Walks (so much so that I booked their Sachsenhausen tour for the following day as soon as this tour finished).
Excellent tour, very knowledgeable guide. Pace was good, not being rushed with plenty of time for photos. Highly recommend

It was fantastic tour with fantastic tour guide. Our tour guide (Darren) had PhD. in German History and he was so passionate about it!
I learned so many things that I didn't know before (and I was not generally very interested in the history!).
Walking tour gives you the oppotunity to see all the "must see" places in Berlin. You can go back again if you want to see more.
100% must do tour!

Fantastic tour covering many interesting sites with a very knowledgeable, friendly and entertaining guide. We did the midday tour which fit in well with our other plans and found the smaller group made for a much better experience. It was very hot but our guide made sure to keep us in shade where possible and we stopped off for refreshments at a nice little cafe.

Scott did an excellent job of introducing us to the highlights of Berlin.
There was a lot of complicated history to cover but Scot did it in an interesting Nd sometimes humorous way. The walk was at a leisurely pace and as it was so hot Scot tried to keep to the shade where possible. It was good to have a half hour break in the middle to grab a drink. We saw lots of things which we would never have found if we had walked on our own. Well worth the time and effort. With his tips for things to see we will be able to make the most of our short break in Berlin

Scott did a good job summarizing swathes of historical, socio-political information into digestible nutshells. Whether you already knew about the background of Nazism or the Cold War or not, you would come away feeling your understanding was deepened. He knew the answers to everyone's questions too!

It was wonderful! The guide’s (Freddie) accent was challenging but it made us listen! He was wonderful and passionate about the history and it’s impact - I would request him again! Berlin is not pretty but it in extremely historical and interesting!

I can't recommend these walking tours highly enough! The time absolutely flies by, and there are so many things packed into the time without it seeming like you are being overwhelmed. There is so much fascinating history to be seen and learned about, from the Unification of 1871 to the Cold War and beyond. A special shout out to our amazing tour guide, Sam (B!), who was very entertaining and knowledgeable! Such good value for money- an absolute must!

We had an amazing morning walking through the city and learning about the history and culture of Berlin. Jonathan was a wonderful guide full of knowledge and anecdotes that really brought the city alive. Our family of five loved it and we would absolutely recommend it to anyone.

We began our tour on our first day in Berlin and it exceeded all expectations! Sam Z took us to all the iconic landmarks throughout the city, telling us facts and stories along the way. What we enjoyed most is that from Sam’s knowledge of the city we were able to learn about parts of history that would’ve gone unnoticed otherwise. He was extremely informative and able to answer any questions we had (the chalk drawing was also very helpful for understanding the reasons behind the rise of the Berlin Wall). This tour is a must for a first time trip to Berlin! Well done Sam, we have already recommended the tour to friends and family.

Had a great day with our family of 5 - some who like history and some who are not quite as interested :). Overall, it was a great experience with Sam Z - he made it interesting and enjoyable for all of us. Sam’s chalk drawing of Germany and the Berlin Wall really helped us understand. We all recommend this day tour with Sam Z - good for ages 54 and below.

By taking this tour you will get familiarized with the city. This way you can roam around yourself in the later days of your trip. So take this tour on the very first day. Laura was an excellent Guide with in depth knowledge of the city. It will be nice though if the guide can take the group to "Berlin Wall Museum" and tell them to go through it later on their own. That museum has excellent picture of Hitler's Nazi era.

I booked the half day Discover Berlin walking tour on the morning of my arrival and finding the meeting point was very easy. We were split up into group of 20 or less which made the tour easier to deliver and mobilise and more personal. Our tour guide Kai Janssen knowledge
on the history and culture of Berlin and more broadly with its connections to broader Prussian, Dutch, Jewish and modern German society painted an amazingly rich picture among the fine architecture and the occasional significant parking lot. Can’t recommend this trip enough to anyone looking for an introduction to the city and its past.

Georgia was wonderful, very thorough and complete with her knowledge, and spoke English better than I. We covered a lot of territory in a short time all the while not feeling rushed in any way. We saw many of the important sights in the old East Berlin and got many tips about things to see and do on our own as well as good places to eat (and a bit of where not to eat and what not to see--very important when time is critical). Thank you Georgia (8/14/2019).

From start to finish, the tour with Sam W was simply brilliant. The speed of the walking tour was just right for both families, the slower walkers and also the avid! At each historic spot, Sam W spoke about the architecture, the history of the surround area, the impact of the wars and bombing, the impact on people of Berlin. He was very knowledgable and the information was accessible for those who know nothing about the German history. By the end of the tour, I felt that I had truly learnt the history of Berlin and each milestone which has led to the city I love today. The tour itself last around 4 hours, including a 20 minute break, so it’s definitey value for money. Thank you again to Sam W for a wonderful day.
Our guide, Ryan, was totally terrific. Great pace tailored to his guests, and incredibly knowledgable. Highly recommend this walking tour.
SAM W was a personable and knowlegable guide. The tour is very a fascinating incite into the history of the city.
Thanks to Laura for taking us on this wonderful tour of Berlin, her knowledge of the sites was great and we learnt so much more than we could on our own. A great way to discover this city.

Rob W was a fantastic guide, pretty much a walking encyclopaedia about Berlin with some added humour. Never done a walking tour before and I think I will be doing more of them from now on. Learnt so much and it’s such a fascinating place to visit, I now wish I’d had more time there to explore. The tour itself was not excessive walking and had a brief stop for a drink/snack break also Rob tried to keep to his time limits which gives you the whole afternoon to do as you wish. Thanks Rob, you made this trip to Berlin fantastic for me..... Note: if you wish to visit museums, they are usually closed on Mondays.
Very knowledgeable and personable guide who was able to cover a great deal of ground in 4 hours. Excellent overview and introduction to Berlin, especially its history.
We greatly enjoyed our walking tour of Berlin mostly because of the detail about the history of Berlin and its culture given by Martin our guide - on Thursday 8th August. A great tour - many thanks.

This was a well organized tour to many amazing places in Berlin. The tour guide, Scott, was knowledgeable, professional, and willing to answer any questions. We would definitely recommend this to anyone!
What a great tour. Learned some much on this tour. Izzy is very knowledge and informative. She was very engaging with the group. Overall great experience and highly recommend!

We found the meeting point with ease, and started a very interesting tour ! Our guide was so informative and told the history of Berlin in a frank but fun way. Four hours disappeared quickly and we felt like we could navigate our way around parts of Berlin by ourselves, as we did the next day! Good tips and pointers given, thoughtful break stops added. So Enjoyable ..... do it!!!!

Our guide, Rob Willis, of Original Berlin Walks exceeded our expectations and gave us a very thorough overview of Berlin. British born, he had a wonderful understanding of the city and German culture. While the focus was on the Nazis and East German occupation, he emphasized that it was only a small part of Berlin’s history. One of the better guides and tours we have ever had.
Our tour guide, Ken, was excellent. He told us a lot about the history of Germany, the different sights and what was at each museum, etc.

Awesome tour. We were able to see all the most important site in 3.5 hour. Jonathan was our guide. Even thought we got there 20 minutes like they we were able to catch up and Jonathan tour person was helpful briefing us about everything we missed. Definitely a most do!!

Scott was a personable guide who knew his history! He used a philosophical approach to explain the rise of the Third Reich and the events that arose to support the regime. We had lots of stops and I appreciated his allowing us to experience the Holocaust memorial before speaking about it. We had lots of time to take photos, particularly at the Brandenburg Gate. I would recommend this tour if you have only a few days in Berlin and ask to be in Scott's group!

Our tour guide Sam was so informative, helpful, friendly he really knows about Berlin & it’s history if you are lucky you may be on one of his tours. It was very easy to find the starting point for the tour & easy to identify the specific tour that we were on. The tour started on time, was easy to hear & follow, plenty of photo opportunities, & chances for toilet breaks & a lunch break. Great value for money & highly recommend.

Our tour guide was Maddie (spelling?). He gave a great tour. He was enthusiastic, informative and a great host to welcome visitors to Berlin. This tour included great highlights and even in the grip of the heat wave in Europe this summer, the walk was not too strenuous. It was a great walking tour! I couldn't have asked for more!

The tour was great - Georgia was a fantastic tour guide with a talent for summarizing history succinctly without oversimplifying it. I chose this tour to see the Reichstag, Brandenberger Tor and the Berlin Wall. Slight disappointment that we did not go into the Reichstag (Georgia had some great tips for going back), and the section of the Berlin Wall is short (the Memorial in PrenzlauerBerg is much better), but there were a lot of wonderful extras for me - Berliner Dom, Neue Wache, Bebelplatz. Overall, a really great introduction to Berlin for a first time visit! I highly recommend it.
We had Ken as our guide and his knowledge of the city was exceptionally. Throughout the whole tour he kept it entertaining and you always were interested to what he was saying.

We had Georgia as our tour guide and it was clear she was knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin and its complex history. She had a excellent way of summarizing history to make it manageable while acknowledging where it might be an oversimplification and also made an effort to give a balanced view of what life might have been like between the 2 divided Berlins. I am usually not the most interested in walking tours with a lot of history but I found this tour to be a good introduction to Berlin and found the stories to be intriguing and meaningful.
Informative and thought provoking in a friendly way. A great introduction to Berlin and its many faceted history.

This walking tour with Sam Z was awesome! He provides a lot of historical information about the places we went to, and gets the group talking and thinking about what we saw (like at the Memorial for the Murdered Jews). Highly recommend him and this company for a tour!

Very knowledgable and efficient our guide Sam W. He was always willing to know if the group had doubts or queries. This tour tooked us through the memory and history of the city. I strongly recommend it for a Berlin experience.

You get the logistical knowledge of a newby to Berlin coupled with the fantastic local knowledge, in particular east Berlin from Sam W, he wowed us with his knowledge of the area and he added his experience and educated twist on events. Have participated in something similar to a lesser degree of acceptability, Sam W definitely impressed

We did “Best of Berlin” a 6 hours tour around the main sites of Berlin. Dave, our tourguide was excellent! At a very comfortable pace he took us through the history of Berlin, allowing us to appreciate the evolution of the city. He was very kind to make suggestions for the rest of the trip and was interested in helping us continue the journey after the tour had ended.

We had Sam Z as our guide, and couldn’t ask for a better guide! Incredibly knowledgeable on the subject, also very funny, but knew when the time was right to laugh and when the time was right to be more serious/solemn. Fantastic tour with a fantastic guide. Well done!

Highly recommend this tour and company (on time, we’ll organized and fairly priced). Our guide, Kyle (a knowledgeable young American woman living in Berlin) provided great historical and present day information about Berlin. Allowed plenty of time to explore at each point of interest and answered everyone’s questions. Nice pace. She was thoughtful about keeping group in the shade as it was extremely hot and humid during our visit. Also provided suggestions for additional tours and activities for our stay.
Sara was an amazing guide, she made the walking tour super fun filling it with a lot of trivia & good knowledge about Berlin history. Thanks a bunch Sara!

Recommend you do this tour ASAP after arriving for an overview of the city. Laura is a great guide, very knowledgable and informative. We visited many of the famous landmarks of the city. Wear comfortable walking shoes.

Georgia led our "Original Berlin walking tour". Her knowledge and delivery are a treat, especially given the sensitivities of many of the topics covered. The sites she shared and background information were a very important part of our Berlin experience. She was very willing to answer questions and share information with ny of the (sensibly-sized) group's interests and concerns. Any of her tours would be good I'm sure!

This was a rich and fact filled immersion into the history and culture of East Berlin, and formed the foundation of our visit to Berlin. Georgia (our Guide) did a commendable job with her knowledge of the facts and history!
Nathan, was Outstanding !!!, I'm more interested in the German experience. The details about the Berlin wall put in Betlin in 1965...plus
Had a great time on the tour- Sam W, our tour guide, was fab with exceptional knowledge of the city and it’s history. Definitely a must do on your first day in Berlin!!
Amazing knowledge from our guide Jonathan. He was entertaining and informative. The Tour helped us understand Berlin a lot better.

Went on this walking tour with a group of my friends. We weren’t expecting too much but Daniel was really informative and a great tour guide.

Cool guy and decent tour worth a go x
Very informative, funny and full of interesting facts and conspiracies :) also looks like Jason Mraz
So informative and interesting! Didn’t get overloaded with too much information, it was delivered buckets Daniel in fun and entertaining way!! Can’t recommend more
Daniel led a very informative walking tour of Berlin which covered many of the major sights and landmarks.
We went on a tour with Daniel and it was excellent. He also draws very well and he has a good looking hat.

This was one of the best tours I’ve ever been on. Prolly was a brilliant guide. She’s extremely knowledgable about Berlin and its history, and I couldn’t believe how much I learned in such a short time. I highly recommend this tour!
We Had a great time together with the guide Laura, who had good knowledge and lots of stories about Berlins history. 4 hour walk and we enjoyed every minute :-)

During our stay in Berlin, my girlfriend and I decided that we wanted to take a tour to learn more about the history of the city. Our tour guide, James, was great and was very informative about all of the places that we stopped at. This tour allowed us to not only learn more about Berlin's past but it also helped us get to grips with finding our way around. Would definitely recommend this tour if you want to learn more about Berlin but also if you just want to see the many famous sites that the city has to offer.

Well organised and our guide Martin was amazingly knowledgeable, fun, professional and interesting. He ensured our whole group of twenty had a good time. This walk is a must for anyone, especially at the start of your stay in Berlin. You do walk a lot, but half way there is a loo/food stop. It was a hot day (Tuesday 6 Aug) and wherever possible we stood in the shade. Despite being a "Berliner", Martin (who spoke perfect English) had a great sense of humour. Thanks for an unforgettable experience!
Great walking tour, Sam Z was so personable and passionate about Berlin's history. Very very enjoyable afternoon!
Great!! Highly recommend this tour. Heidi our tour guide was exceptional! We saw a lot during this tour. Amazing!!

We had only a few days in Berlin and the hotel concierge recommended the walking tours. We were lucky to get Kyle as our tour leader. It was supposed to be less than a four hour tour, but really took a little over four hours. Great intro to the city, tons of interesting information, good thoughts about how to spend the remaining time we had. Well worth the time and money. We had been to Berlin when the wall was still up. So much has changed. Really worth the visit.
Jake was outstanding. The cost of the tour very reasonable $31 for two. The tour lasted almost four hours. I honestly could have gone longer.

This was a good background of the history of Berlin. An American doctoral candidate in German history guided our tour. He impressed upon us how Berlin and Prussia came to prominence, much like the US did, by promoting policies of tolerance and diversity. Berlin invited Jews, Muslims, Catholics, and Lutherans to live peacefully with each other there. It didn't take long with the reparations after WWI and hyperinflation for this society founded on tolerance to welcome a Hitler and scapegoat Jews and other religious and ethnic groups. I'm an American and was thinking all though the tour how much of the history there could apply to Trump in the US.

As a family with 2 teens (13 & 15) we thoroughly enjoyed the tour. We did this on our first day in Berlin and it has given us a great basic idea of what we want to do and see on the rest of our break. Nathan has an excellent knowledge of Berlin and is passionate about it's history, this came across and enthused us all too. He answered questions from everyone including children and made the answers relevant to the person who asked it.
We would definitely recommend this tour, especially at the start of your break! Thank you Nathan!
Kyle was both informative and engaging with the right balance of getting on with it and consideration of creature comfort. Highly recommended.

Missed our booked time so took later tour, and were fortunate to have Martin as our guide. Being Geman and the way he spoke, you felt that his knowledge was part of his heritage and not just a repetition of facts. He added interesting details to historical events, and the pace of the tour was excellent, with short walks between each point of interest. He also encouraged you to ask questions. When we took a break after two hours, it felt as though we had been going much longer (in a good way!), and we came away feeling that we understood much more about Berlin, and could not have spent our time better.
We had a great tour with Ysanne, she clearly knew her history and all of the family were really engaged for the whole tour.
Jake was amazing, couldn’t have asked for a better tour guide! He was very informative and entertaining, was the highlight of our trip. Couldn’t recommend it more.
What a great way to get an overview of Berlin. Wouter was knowledgable, personable and engaging. Highly recommended.

Having recently sustained a back injury was unsure of a walking tour for four hours, bot I’m so glad I did. The time flew by due in part to Martin’s enthusiasm for his wonderful city. My husband, son and I learnt so much, with lots of little tidbits and personal accounts from Martin. His knowledge of the city and it’s history was both informative and fascinating as well as in depth. Learnt more about the war from Martin than most history books/lessons at school. We are English by birth but now live in Australia, so have some insight into how the war and its after effects impacted the German people, but came away with a far better understanding. Thank you Martin for making the tour so enjoyable and adding your personal flair to it. Would highly recommend .

Our family did the 1/2 day walking tour in Berlin on our first day in Berlin. It was a great way to get a feel for where things were in the city. Out tour guide Jake did a great job of taking us to major sights and giving us the history behind the sights. We would highly recommend Jake and the tour!

We were slightly intimidated by the idea of a *4h* walking tour, but it was far less hard core than it sounds, and it was interesting so the time just flew by. Sam B. was our guide and he clearly knew what he was talking about, plus he was funny. :) Highly recommend!

Had an excellent walking adventure with Ken today. Incredibly knowledgeable with an Irish charm and wit, unafraid to address difficult issues with Berlin (Germany’s history) whilst not making light of it he certainly took the mickey out of Herr Hitler to break the mood.

We visited museum island, the holocaust museum, checkpoint Charlie (where he helpfully explained what to avoid in terms of scams in the vicinity), the Brandenburg Gate among other points where Ken would fill us in on huge swathes of history.

It lasted about 3.5 hours and I was ready to sit down after that. He was very patient with my son’s continual questions.

Excellent walk. Saw all major sites that any first time visitors to Berlin would wish to see. Kyle our enthusiastic, warm and highly informative guide was superb. She had so much to tell us at each stop and was always willing to answer general questions about the city and getting around. Highly recommended walking tour. Not sure if we got lucky with our guide but she was superb!

This was our first visit to the German capital and provided an excellent overview into Berlin's history, as well as giving us a taste of places to revisit later in our trip. Our guide was interesting and informative. Would definitely recommend.

Thank you Gregor for a superbly informative, engaging and insightful tour around this fascinating city. Your clear delivery helped put the ever changing faces of Berlin into an understandable context. Our discussions on Bebelplatz and the rain enforced ‘seminar’ in the cafe will stay with us for a long time.

We will not hesitate to recommend you to future visitors. Dankeschön!

My mum and I were keen to know some more information on the history of the city after being in Berlin for a couple days, we much appreciated all of Fran’s historical information and loved that she added her own opinions and views on the city too, which made the tour less bland and more interesting. She was very considerate, finding shady spots, offering us use of her suncream and help with finding the toilets whilst on the tour. She answered all of our questions and even recommended things for us do whilst on the rest of our trip ( We loved the street food Thursdays in the old market!). Thanks Fran😊

I was slightly disappointed when I realised our guides weren't native Germans. I needn't have worried.

Kyle was absolutely fantastic. I couldn't believe her depth of knowledge, and the quality and quantity of content. Even when answering questions, she had the depth of knowledge you only get from someone who is passionate about the topic.

Not just a "rattling off of dates and events," Kyle included stories of individuals from the eras being discussed, as well as anecdotes to give us context to the political and social climates that influenced the events discussed.

I must also note the bi-partisan, unbiased and respectful way topics were covered.

Thanks for a lovely and informative afternoon Kyle :-)

Scott provided a historical overview and context about Germany and distilled it to bookmark pivotal events in Berlin’s history. An excellent job of handling the group and addressing questions. Great Job!

I really enjoyed this walking tour. We got so many key spots I wanted to see anyways and I learned so much about the history of Berlin. Our guide, Scott, kept the tour well paced and was a great story teller. Definitely recommend!

This tour was great! Kai was very knowledgeable and clearly loves his job and the city. I had such a great time and the break was nice-had some delicious ice cream! A good quick overview of a city with a complicated past-answered a lot of questions and gave me a list of a bunch more! Would highly recommend! We had less than 24 hours in Berlin and this was totally worth spending the time on

My husband and I were on a cruise that stopped in Warnemunde last Thursday. We didn't want to pay the high excursion prices charged by our cruise, so I planned my own about a month before our visit. I booked the Discover Berlin Private Half-day Walking Tour because the regularly scheduled times didn't work out with the train schedule. I exchanged literally about 25 emails with Lars, who I believe is the owner, and can't say enough good things about how wonderful he was in helping me figure out logistics. Fast forward to the day of the tour. My husband and I had booked the train to Berlin with a connection in Rostock. We got off at the wrong stop in Rostock and missed our connection to Berlin. Stupid Americans. Where's the eye-rolling smiley when you need it? I called Lars and he not only got our guide Sam to accommodate us two hours late (thank you Sam!), but also had him meet us at the station in Berlin and show us the way back at the end of the tour, since we obviously needed our hands held. To make a short story long, once we finally made it to Berlin, Sam put on an excellent tour. He is smart and knows his history. We got a great overview and look forward to our next visit to that fascinating city.

Kyle (female) took us round Berlin to all the major sites. Look no further. She was very well informed and we looked at East and West from both sides and political views. Extremely well worth the money.
Terrific walking tour. Very knowledgeable guide. Recommend. We saw and learned so much. It was a great tour.

This is a must if travelling to Berlin. All those years of history lessons, I learnt more in the initial 15 minute briefing by tour guide Sam B. Our teenagers totally engaged with Sam and fascinated of the history. Even the kids agreed Sam B should be a history teacher great talent. Thank u for the tour it was superb.
Excellent guide with superb knowledge of Berlin, it’s history and culture. Very good understanding of needs of adults and teenagers/ young adults.

Highly enjoyed the tour that was given to us by a very nice, knowledgeable and articulate guide.
It wasn't tiring and the guide did his best to give the tour added value

It may depend on what tour guide you get but our chap was no fun, we spent over an hour standing at 2 places looking in the same direction listening to him talking - it reminded me of being in a history lesson st school ! He wasn’t exactly interesting as he didn’t engage with his audience ...one man who had his 3 young children with him struggled to keep them entertained from the onset and spent every other second taking selfies with them to keep them amused. If you like history this is for you but don’t take the children under 15. There needs to be less talking and waiting time and more viewing and experiencing this interesting city. If the guide was a bit more lively we wouldn’t have skipped away before the first half !

This tour is fantastic. The history of the city is explained in four hours that go by really quickly. Our guide Ysanne was knowledgable and passionate and took us thru 800 yrs of history with clarity, insight and sensitivity. Without the tour we would have missed out on many locations and historic buildings and gems of information; it made us feel at home in the city allowed us then to understand the other historical sites/museums. It was also fun! It’s €14 - best value for money ever.

One of our favorite tours! Kathryn was an amazing and knowledgeable guide. The rich history and culture of Berlin - so much more than we ever knew - came to life through this tour. Berlin is an amazing city. Visit Berlin and do this tour on your first day. If you only have a short time in Berlin, it will give you a great overview. If you have a few days, it is a perfect launching pad.

The tour is fast paced with lots of walking... comfy shoes!!!

We had Sebastian as our guide and he was very knowledgeable and animated. He gave us Berlin's history in a nutshell while we walked to the different buildings and sites. It is a 4-hour tour with a 20-minute break near cafes for refreshments, snacks and the bathroom. Unfortunately it was 30C and humid the day we did the tour. Wear comfy shoes, a hat and sunscreen!

Cannot recommend this tour highly enough! Scott did an amazing job of guiding us around the city and bringing the rich history of Berlin to life. Scott’s extensive knowledge led to an extremely thought provoking tour with an excellent mix of history, politics and art. Thank you!
A 4 hours trip with good story and introduction from Lauda. She is very thoughtful guide, bringing us her thoughts and views. it’s a fantastic journey.
Scott is an excellent and extremely knowledgeable tour guide. Provides an interesting and very thorough overview of a complicated history - was really best tour I’ve done in any city.

Great tour. Not rushed but lots of contents. Guide with great stories at all the sights. More than enough time for questions, including an extra story at the end. Great bonus: the guide showed us to a great rooftop bar in Neukölln, a flea market and an open-air Karaoke.
We would really recommend this tour with Scottish Scott. He was extremely knowledgeable, reflective and personable. He was able to condense and unpick a huge part of German history into 4 hours.

We thoroughly enjoyed the walking tour! Scotty was very knowledgeable, articulate, engaging, careful to keep group together, and stood in shade because it was very hot outside. We learned so much on this tour! We HIGHLY recommend this tour on your first day visiting Berlin! Thank you, Scotty!

Our guide Jake was an extremely enthusiastic and knowledgeable guide. He filled every minute with interesting information about history, architecture, culture, and his own personal experiences of living in Berlin. He seems to genuinely love the city and his enthusiasm made it a very engaging experience. I would highly recommend this tour!

Easy to find start point. Jake was our guide and proved to be a an excellent host for the tour. The tour was packed with facts and covered the main attractions that could be squeezed in to the four hours. I'd highly recommend this tour. Jake, if you read this - Kreische, world cup whisky & good stuff in WSC

My friends and I didn’t know what to expect but our tour guide Scott made the 4h of walking in the bright sun super interesting and fun. He always made sure everyone was okay and somehow always managed to find a shady spot for the group when talking about the history of Berlin. He also always made sure to explain both sides of Berlin’s story and let us make up our own minds about any political views. His knowledge in art really helped as he always incorporated bits and pieces of it that made the history become very real and made any possibly boring fact interesting and easy to follow. We would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin!

Our guide Sam B was outstanding, knowledgable, engaged and provided a depth of insight that was magnificent. The time passed very quickly but the pacing of the tour allows you to appreciate the city and its history very easily. It was the highlight of the trip except.

We where in Berlin for only 2 days. And this was a super tour.
Thank you Scott for your enthusiastic presentasjon on the historic places and the history connected to it. Great lad!

Our tour was with Sam B and it was absolutely fantastic. He told us everything we wanted to know and delivered the history in a considered and thoughtful way. He had answers to every question and have recommendations at the end when we asked. Also, we arrived slightly late via scooter and were swiftly directed to the tour group which was kind. I would highly recommend this tour. If you want to gain a broad and insightful understanding of German history in relation to significant monuments, sites and buildings this is the perfect tour for you.

Our guide Sam B provided us with a brilliant 3.5 hour walking tour of Berlin, full of interesting facts and stories. He delivered a brief overview at the beginning, therefore allowing us to have a framework upon which we could anchor facts, dates and stories. I really recommend this tour for an introduction into the rich history of Germany and Berlin.

This was a great way to see some of the important aspects of Berlin, and learn a lot along the way. Jake was a great guide, you could tell he had a passion for the city and he wanted others to appreciate the city as he does. He was very informative, while still keeping things entertaining. The tour lasted over 4 hours, and I didn't want it to end, because I kept wanting to learn more from Jake.

I can’t speak highly enough about this tour. Our tour guide Scott brought us to many of the major historical sites and provided comprehensive overviews of their significance with a wonderful balance of sensitivity and depth. Scott’s sense of humor also contributed an appropriate and appreciated levity to otherwise very complex and often upsetting histories. Highly recommend this tour, and especially Scott!

We took a walk for 4h30 min covering so many of the major points of interest in Berlin. Our guide was Jess, a pleasant company and a walking encyclopedia.
Highly recommended!

We had an amazing tour! Our tour guide knew everything about Berlin! We walked all around Berlin, seeing the amazing landmarks and history of them. If you want to find out more about Berlin than in books or on the internet, then choose this fantastic tour!

We were so impressed with this Tour of Berlin: Kai, our guide, gave incredibly detailed information and insights into Berlin’s extraordinary history. He gave us facts and legends! His expert knowledge and humourous delivery at times made this tour really valuable. He is a credit to this Tour company.
Really glad we booked this tour, jonny was a great guide with great knowledge,highly recommended experience to see all berlin has to offer but at a relaxed pace and in a jovial manor

The guide Kleine was amazing and the landmarks we visited had their history described in great detail by the wonderful tour guide however it was quite sunny so be mindful of the current wether and bring sunscreen if necessary as a lot of the time we were outside of shaded areas
My son and me enjoyed the tour very much. Sam W. has deep knowledge of the history of the city and was very capable in conveying it in a very interesting and exciting way.

We took the Discover Berlin walking tour (4 hours) with Rob, from Manchester. We found it to be a great way to get a good overview of the city, learn some of the history of Berlin, and hear some interesting and informative stories surrounding these sights. Because this tour covers so many sights in just 4 hours, you cannot get a full understanding of all of them. But this overview will give you a starting point in developing a plan to see those that most interest you. We took this walking tour on our first morning in Berlin, and found it to be a perfect introduction to this city.

I went on this with my reluctant teenage daughter who was always going to be hard to impress. Tobi our guide more than did the job. He is extremely knowledgeable, empathetic, funny, and really brought the fascinating history of Berlin to life. We were a mixed and fairly large group but Tobi went out of his way to keep everyone engaged and make sure everyone understood. The pace was perfect. He was able to answer all our questions and brought a unique perspective, particularly as he’d grown up in East Germany. We both would highly recommend the walk and Tobi as a guide (in fact the teen who didn’t want to go in the first place decided on the 5 star rating.......)

This was a perfect way to start our long weekend in Berlin Jess was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the city and it’s history, we were completely engaged throughout the tour as was everyone else. Jess was an excellent guide and if you were thinking of doing a walking tour during your trip then would definitelyrecommend this one.
Excellent tour with Tobi. Great insight into the history of Berlin and Germany. Loved how Tobi gave us a personal East German view too. Recommended.
Daniel was a great tour guide and delivered a very humorous walking tour of Berlin and covered all of the sites I wanted to see! Highly recommend and definitely worth the time and money :)

Campbell was our guide, absolutely brilliant. He has a natural talent to impart knowledge in an informative and humorous manner. A great tour to take if you have a limited time in this city or it can be a good starting point to plan what activities to do & sites to see in detail.

I was in Berlin for business with limited time to explore the city. I booked this tour hoping it would be a way to see the highlights. It was really terrific. Chris (from Canada) was my guide and there were about 15-20 people in the group. The tour moved along at a good pace, included a lot of beautiful sights and a good bit of history. Chris is extremely knowledgeable and obviously values the importance of giving an accurate history. The tour was excellent!

Today we took part in a tour of Berlin, led by Pip. She was an excellent source of high quality information (and funny). We enjoyed the pace, the locations we visited, and the questions we were able to ask her along the way. It is an affordable way to see the sights, and we highly recommend it!

Absolutely loved our tour with Daniel. He was really knowledgeable and able to answer all of our questions. Tour was informative and the perfect amount of time! Daniel was very friendly and gave us lots of recommendations for our time in Berlin!

Scott was an excellent guide who possessed the skill of taking a 4 hour walking tour and making it an amazing history lesson. He managed to give a clear factual account of the history of Berlin which emphasised the significant historical points, and proceeded to overlay this with many moving stories of heroism. The historical mix of fascism, communism, political turmoil, liberal thinking and Jewish genocide were clearly laid out, and we as a group had the opportunity to learn and understand. Before you do anything else in Berlin, you need to go on this tour! Stephen & Mandy, Belfast, Monday 15th July

We did the ‘Discover Berlin’ walking tour on July 9th 2019 and the Sachsenhausen memorial walking tour on July 13th 2019 - and we loved both of the tours! We learned a lot and it was never boring! Our guides Martin and Sarah were great and knew lots of interesting stories about places and buildings we would have just walked straight by if we were on our own - and they spoke an easily understable English!
Very nice visit of Berlin-Mitte. 14€ for a 4 hours visit of Berlin. The guide (Campbell) shared his great historical knowledge of Berlin with us which made the tour very interesting and dynamic
Lynsey was a terrific guide and really explained a lot of great history and detail about the rich past of Berlin. We learned a ton, saw a ton, and had a great time. Would definitely do this again!

I made my first visit to Berlin over a weekend at the end of June and decided on this tour as probably the ideal way of taking in the major historical and cultural sites in the city centre. I was not disappointed as this walking tour far exceeded my expectations. Our guide, Nathan, was not just very well informed about the city's areas, buildings and sites, both famous and infamous, but wove them all together into a rich tapestry chronicling Berlin's history from its medieval origins to recent times. His passion for the city, its people and its chequered history shone through and, for me, greatly enhanced the whole tour experience. A very memorable four hours! This tour can't come too highly recommended.
Fantastic tour, knowledgeable and friendly tour leader. Picked up far more information than I ever would have done walking around independently.

This guy (Scott) was a blast. Berlin has some heavy topics to cover and he delivered them with finesse and sensitivity.

The start of the tour was more up beat, jokes thrown in, sarcasm to boot. As we headed into the darkness of the 20th century Scott's background in art became an incredibly useful tool while he encouraged us to experience the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe solo if we had come in groups or pairs, to explain how Käthe Kollwitz's art was so focused on the human body, either solo or in groups, and what that represented.
He spoke of the advancement of Germany in the years between the two World Wars, the huge leaps that were made for homosexuality, the safehouse created for all LGBTQI+ people in Berlin.

He carried images with him of important historical moments, letting us sink into the exact moment he was reciting.

Despite all this he kept his history unbiased and was never telling us what to think, he supplied both sides of the coin.

And to top it all off, he was eager to answer any questions I had and was quite personable as we chatted between stops.
Hilarious, fun, somber and creative - Scott delivered the best walking tour I've ever been on. The feelings he evoked have stayed with me for days.

Excellent tour, definitely recommend. Jake was a great guide who provided a highly engaging narrative of how the sites we visited were connected across 800 years of history about Berlin. He addressed difficult topics about German history with sensitivity and respect, and showed how different eras in Berlin’s history contribute to the culture of modern-day Berlin. Highly recommend a tour with this company. Hopefully, you’ll be lucky like us and get Jake as your guide.

Hi this tour is well worth the money. Rob Willis our guide was excellent and handled the sensitivities of some of the history very well. It proved the right way for us to see all the main highlights, understand the context: we covered a lot in a relative short time but never felt rushed. Liked that we started by a Starbucks to get coffee and something to eat before setting off. Very many thanks

This was a fantastic tour, very interesting and insightful. The tour covers central Berlin but will take you to the main tourist attractions including the wall. Our tour guide Rob Willis was excellent, friendly and knowledgable. A brilliant way to start your trip to Berlin.

We had an outstanding experience with the tour! My teenage daughter and I both learned a ton about Berlin, and got to see many things we otherwise wouldn’t have known about. This tour was one of the highlights of our trip!

Sam W was the guide of our group of 50. I had wrongly assumed from reading previous reviews that the group size would be 15-20 people at most. I feel the tour company should have either stopped accepting walk up customers or had a second guide for as large of a group we had. That being said, Sam W handled our group wonderfully, even in the scattered sudden downpours. Sam W was very personable and knew his history. We did enjoy the tour and we feel it was money well spent.

We did this tour last June with my wife and we enjoyed it immensely. We took the tour in English. Our guide was a British historian and he was great (his name we forgot, which is a pity because the guy was really good). We walked around the city, heard interesting stories about each landmark we visited and got a great panoramic narrative of the city's convoluted, passionate history.

We appreciated the tour doubly, first as a great introduction to the city that allowed us to roam later with a good sense of perspective. We also loved the tour because it provided us an interesting view of history that helped us also reflect on what is going on in current times.

The people guiding these tours are really passionate about the city and that enthusiasm is contagious. Gotta love Berlin!
Excellent walking tour and couldn’t fault our guide Beth. Very enthusiastic and knowledgeable and really put across well the complex history of the city
Sam W was an excellent host for this tour. Very knowledgable and gave great information. Highly recommend this walking tour.

Jake was awesome!!! The tour was the perfect amount of time to see the main sights in Berlin and actually know the intricate history behind each sight. Jake also told us individuals’ stories from German history, making the tour more personal and the learning more fun! Could not recommend this walking tour more.

We did a three hour walking tour "Best of Berlin" that began at HACKESCHER MARKT with 6 children ages 5 years to 17 years and 5 adults. Martin our guide who was a long time resident of Berlin was very knowledgeable presenting many interesting facts and personal comments about the various sites that we visited. Highly recommended!

Our guide Kathryn, was friendly and very interesting to listen to. I am a person interested in history and human behavior on a deeper level and I always love when the guide has a wider and more in depth knowledge about history, social sciences and liberal arts. That way the guide can answer interesting follow-up questions from the group, which our guide Kathryn did with passion and expertise. (I have come to appreciate guides who like Kathryn has a university background in these subjects and also has experience from teaching).

There was also time while walking to talk to the guide personally and ask various questions.
In our group we had all ages, and we enjoyed all 4 hours of the tour. Though it was raining part of the tour our spirits remained high and we were deeply engrossed in the city's history coming alive before our eyes. Even our adolescent children found the tour exciting and interesting, which I imagine is due to our guide's passion and communication skills.

I would recommend this tour for people interested in history and who likes to reflect on how and why things happen in history. This tour has left me with many reflections on how history shapes our future, human behavior and our individual and collective responsibility as human beings.

Our tour didn't end back from were we started, but our guide was helpful to show us directions.
Joined a group led by Sam W. Was outstanding. Incredible depth of detail presented professionally. I had never done a walking tour before but I see them now as a fixture to my trips.

The tour was well structured and the tour guide (John from Israel) was excellent, we really got a rich history of the city of Berlin.

Very good value for money

On a hot day, bring water!

This is a great way to see the highlights of some of the major sights and historical locations in Berlin. It took about 4 hours and our guide did a great job. This gave us an overview so we could go back the next day to areas we wanted to explore further.

The walk started close to one of Berlin's major transport hubs and at a convieniant mid morning time. The group size was around 15 persons. The guide, Lynsey, was very knowledgeable, considerate to our welfare (very hot day) and easy to understand with the opportunity to ask questions. We were shown many German landmarks including all the ones we wanted to visit beforehand and many others that wee all very interesting. A lot of the history as you can imagine was relating to the 2nd world war and recent history including the fall of the Wall. Must do for any visit to Berlin especially with Lynsey as your guide.

Highly recommended walking tour.

We considered the free tours but were very glad we decided on this very reasonably priced walking tour. Our guide was Martin who was excellent. His commentary was great and the fact that he was a native East Berliner made it all the more authentic and personal.

We started off our visit to Berlin with this tour which was the perfect introduction to the city. Thanks

A fantastic way to spend your morning/arvo/any time. An incredibly dense, yet wonderfully fun exploration of Berlins detailed history.
Ask for Beth to take you, she'll take care of you. Incredibly witty, fun and full of information, she had everyone in my group engaged and interested (not always possible after a night out in Berlin). Not shy about sharing her own personal philosophys, she'll not only tell you about what you're seeing, but make you think as well.
11/10- A must do.
This was an excellent walking tour. We went at a good pace but Martin our guide provided a wealth of information along the way. His insights and depth of knowledge made this a truly memorable tour.

Our guide Sebastien was passionate, informed and a master in delivering the history of Berlin as we covered the late 18th century to modern day Berlin and all chapters in between. An absolute must-do if you’re visiting this great city !!

We chose the 9 o’clock tour our on our first day in Berlin and it was the right choice. The centre was not yet crowded with other tourists and when the tour was over, we still had almost an entire day to go. After the tour, it was also a lot easier to navigate in the Mitte district. Sam W. was an excellent guide and the tour was very informative. Definitely would recommend, this tour is almost a must-do in Berlin!

We had a great time with our guide (Sam W). An informative tour that covers many of the places we were hoping to see. Sam was enthusiastic and made sure that everyone heard and had a great tour. Thanks!
Sarah was fantastic with right balance of friendliness, information including history and humour. Well worth doing and very much enhanced my trip to Berlin.
Martin was an incredible tour guide! Very knowledgeable, funny and engaging. This tour is a great introduction to the city of Berlin!

Informative, interesting, and a good price. Ken was both very knowledgeable and engaging, completed with a dash of humour.

Well worth the price and I'd absolutely recommend the tour to anybody going to Berlin.

This is an excellent tour that I would highly recommend. Our guide Jake was very informative and gave you time to absorb the history of this fabulous city from the wonder of the Berlin Wall, Brandenburg Gate and Museum Island to the poignant Memorial to the Murdered Jews. I’m so glad I came on this tour to find out things I would never have learnt walking around by myself. Many thanks Jake 👍🏻
Kyle was helpful, friendly and informative. Great tour, would highly recommend! Thanks for the day out!

Wonderful tour of Berlin with Kathryn, a Brit who earned her masters in European history at Humboldt. Don't let her background scare you though! For over 3 hours, she pointed out the highlights of the city center (Museum Island, Dom, Checkpoint Charlie, Berlin Wall, Hitler's Bunker, Memorial to the Murdered Jews, plus some others) in a witty and engaging way. She made recommendations of places to explore on our own later and even helped me find a grocery store. This was the first thing that I did when I got to Berlin, and it helped me so much with knowing what to visit the next five days and how to navigate town.
An amazing half day tour guided by the coolest lad I've come across. Thanks a lot. Highly recommended!

Scott was a fantastic tour guide - he had us all enthralled with anecdotes that brought to life the traumas and fluctuations of this fascinating city, as well as a clear historical overview that helped us piece it together into a whole. A perfect introduction to Berlin.
Had a great experience on our tour, very glad we did it. Tour guide Sam W was excellent and was very knowledgable about everything we saw

I highly recommend this tour with Rob from Manchester. It was the perfect way to begin our four days in Berlin. Rob shared his incredible knowledge of Berlin’s history. He also gave us recommendations of what to do next.

Highly recommended. This was our second time on the walking tour, having visited Berlin for the first time last year. This time with the kids, we again found it to the best way to get to learn the routes to and between all the places worth visiting later, as well as a ton of background information on the history and significance of each site. A special thanks to our guide this time, Johnathan, for entertaining us on the tour and his personal references and insight really brought the history of the city to life. A suggestion I would make to the Original Berlin Walks tour company would be to invest in a large sign for the starting point. We arrived extra early as last year we found it difficult to find the meeting point and seemed to stumble upon the group by accident. This year we spent a worried 15 minutes walking around Hackescher Markt until we found the girl with the small advertising board.
Sam W was a very informative tour guide and this half day walking tour is well worth the money. I would recommend it to anyone who wants a deeper understanding about the history of Berlin.

Just after flying from Paris to Berlin, we put off our stuff into the Hostel and immediatly go for a tour with Daniel ! Just want to say thank you for your time, passion, sens of details and such knowledge about the City. 100% recommend

This walking tour was super intriguing and informative and covered lots of important places in the city. Daniel, our tour guide was super friendly and fun and taught us all the super interesting history about Berlin. Definitely would recommend!!
Daniel was a great tour guide, learnt lots of things that I would not have otherwise. Everything was short and sweet but to the point. Definitely would recommend. Daniel also takes nice photos of you

I am not a fan of walking tours like my partner is... however i was so zoned in on what Nathan was saying that we must have walked miles without even knowing. By the time we finished we were all the way from our starting point and we then had the challenge of finding our way back to the hotel. Nathan is passionate about history and has incredible knowledge of all history... this is one of the best tours i have ever done and talk about value for money.

Massive thanks to Sam W. We had such a blast- it was extremely informative, engaging, well organised and gave so many fascinating insights. We both thought it was the best tour we've ever had! Both of us studied history in school but this tour presented so much good content in a very easy way. If you're going to Berlin, DO THIS!! Thanks again Sam W. Dave& Rachel from N. Ireland.

I was fortunate enough to get Nathan as my tour guide for this activity; it felt as if I was exploring the city with a history professor. I learned so much about the city and all it's been through, but never was it too much information or boring at all. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone looking to learn about the ups and downs of Berlin history, and I would suggest trying to get Nathan as a guide if possible.

I am not one to write reviews, however I was immensely impressed by Kevin’s knowledge of Berlin and his thought probing and authentic delivery explaining each site we visited; all of which were reflective, rich in history and meaningful on many levels. Kevin’s tour encouraged critical thought and was an unforgettable journey through the mixed history of Berlin. If you’re looking for a tour that goes the extra mile and isn’t simply a point and look excursion, this is the one for you!

We only had 2 days in Berlin so this walk was a good way to maximize our time. Sam W. was very knowledgeable about the history of the city and the sights we saw. It was very hot....we were glad we took water even though one break was provided. Note that there is a LOT of standing which was harder than the walking, and there were very few places to sit down. Directions were clear and we had no trouble finding the meeting point.

Our guide Sam W. was terrific and we experienced the main sites within the 4 hours. I would recommend booking a slot to visit the dome on the parliament building for the following day around 14:00. On the second day we followed the walking tour route again spending more time at some locations. We then visited the dome (free, but you must pre-book and take is).

My mum and I did this tour in 30°C+ heat and it was BRILLIANT! I'd highly recommend doing this at the start of your trip to Berlin. It's a great way to get to know the city and discover museums to visit. Sam W was a fantastic guide - so knowledgeable, friendly and considerate of the needs of the whole group (namely finding as much shade as possible throughout the tour!). He even managed to keep us all engaged amidst a loud global warming demo and gig! And a bonus is I covered 10k+ steps but genuinely didn't feel like I had as I was so engrossed in Sam's narrative and the frequent stops to look at various things. 5* 😊🇩🇪

Cannot recommend this guided tour enough Our guide, Nathan, was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic in his delivery We learned so much history and saw so much that we would otherwise have missed The tour is a whistle stop tour but it gives you the opportunity to decide what places to revisit at your leisure Definitely value for money

It’s Canada day in Berlin... and in finishing up our travels with American and Canadian friends our fearless Canadian leader booked this walking tour of Berlin - we were not disappointed. Indeed it was the best tour we took in the last 3 weeks!
The reason: Nathan... he was knowledgeable, witty, insightful and a great ambassador for the city. His comments and suggestions were most helpful. He’s a credit to the company he works with. That all tour guides were like him.

My family and I recently took this tour and had a fantastic time. We had covered much of this ground on our own two days previously, but doing it with a knowledgeable and entertaining guide really enhanced the experience. Our guide, Steve, was charming and gregarious (without being over-the-top), and really brought the history of the city to life. Even my 17-year-old daughter, who isn't really into history, commented on how much she enjoyed it. I'd recommend it to anyone visiting the city for the first time.

Fantastic. Our tour guide Nathan (a history graduate) gave us an incredible morning. Some tours can cause you to glaze over with too many facts and dates - not this one. I have never heard history explained in such a clear and interesting way - covering the founding of Prussia and then Germany, through the 2 world wars and the Cold War to reunification, as we walked through all the historic sites of Berlin. He handled all the history with sensitivity as well as clarity and gave a very balanced account. If you want to understand the history of Berlin as well as its layout, this is definitely the tour to take.

Really amazing value, excellent pace, interesting talking points and quality content. Our tour guide Nathan was incredibly knowledgable and genuinely gave us the best tour we could have hoped for. He was very patient with questions and clearly has a passionate interest for Berlin and its history. Certainly the best walking tour we’ve yet been on, can’t speak highly enough of this chap and the tour altogether. Would highly recommend!

Fabulous. Covered lots of ground. We saw so much of Berlin. All the major sites. Ended at Brandenburg gate. We loved our guide, Robert McCracken. He was so informative and super nice. We would definitely recommend.
A truly excellent tour - Campbell was absolutely phenomenal. A perfect mixture of interesting history and humour! He was a treasure trove of interesting facts and a delight to spend the day with.

I like to take walking or bike tours when visiting a new area to get a quick overview of a place from the experts. Sam Z’s tour of Berlin was like taking the best four-hour college class in the place where history happened. The structure of the tour as we literally walked through chronological history of Berlin was infused with humor, edge-of-your-seat stories, and a depth of knowledge that only a guide with a master’s in history could achieve. I wish Sam Z could be around to narrate the rest of my travels throughout Europe. Thank you again!

We had a wonderful morning walk with our tour guide Campbell, we actually had a tour yesterday to Sachsenhousen with Campbell and decided to take this tour today knowing he was going to be the guide. My husband and I were both really impressed with how knowledgeable Campbell was, he was able to answer any question. We would highly recommend this tour for it’s a great way to see the city and learn about all the hidden details you may miss if you were just doing the streets by yourself. Thanks again Campbell! :D

We enjoyed both the pace and the coverage of this engaging tour. Our guide was both knowledgeable and informative. We packed quite a lot into the half-day, and noted things to see in more detail after.

We were highly recommended to do this walking tour and I now understand why. Our tour guide, Scott, was very passionate, well educated and he ensured this tour was a very enjoyable experience for all. Scott was also very mindful of the heat and kept us in the shade where possible.

We met up in central Berlin with our guide Dave Y who was extremely knowledgeable and passionate as he provided a relaxing walking tour around Berlin's most historical sights. He took the time to explain in fine detail the city's history in the location where things happened. Dave Y also used historical photos to give you a real feel of what it was like all those years ago, engaged and answered questions and really made an effort to look after everyone on the tour. We stopped at a lovely cafe as a group and got to mingle with others on the tour and had a nice lunch too. I'm sure all the tour guides are lovely but having Dave Y felt like a bonus. Highly recommended! Thanks again Dave Y

Did this on our first day in Berlin to gather information about what we should do the rest of the week. Seb B was fantastic and really made the whole experience that bit more enjoyable. He was funny and the information he was able to tell us during the walk was astounding.. I have no idea how he remembers it all!!
He willingly answered any questions we had an gave us recommendations on what museums to visit during our time here. Would highly recommend this tour and if you get Seb B, you're in luck!!!

First time visitors to Berlin we were looking for a very informed and engaging half day tour. We were extremely happy with the experience. Thanks Jake for making it so enjoyable and informative. Highly recommend to anybody looking for a good overview of the the city and its history.

Our first day in Berlin and we wanted to get an overview of the city and to help get our bearings for the days ahead. The meeting point was easy to find and our guide for this tour was Lyndsay. She was an excellent guide explaining the background to all of the places of interest.
She also answered any questions we had and have us plenty of photo opportunities. She spent time at the end of the tour answering questions and giving us tips for our stay in the coming days. Thank you for such a great introduction to Berlin.

This tour was very informative and fun. Our tour guide, was upbeat and full of interesting facts. This tour is very compact as many locations are visited. Highly recommend this tour if you have additional days in Berlin to go back to the various location to visit more throughly.
What a fabulous way to see the main attractions of Berlin . A fabulous tour. So much of the history was explained. Very worthwhile!

This tour may have been the best $12 I've ever spent (love the senior discount). Nathan, our guide, was amazing. I learned more about German culture and history in 4 hours than I did in 18 years of formal education. He was patient, approachable, responsive, funny and more. You can't go wrong if you book this tour.
Awesome tour. Scott was our tourguide and he was approachable and informative. I highly recommend this!

We booked this tour last minute as it was sunny and walking is a nice way to see the city. Ken was our tour guide and he was v informative and he had good banter. He covered the areas we wanted to know about. It was just the right pace and we learnt loads. Thanks 😊😊 #we🧡Ken
Saw major points of interest and learned history we did not know. Great starting point to a trip to Berlin

I only had three days in Berlin and wanted to make the most of it. I thought that if I did a walking tour to begin with, it would be a great way to see all the main sites and also know what I wanted to go back and visit. Our tour guide Matti was amazing. He took us to all the sites, explained all about them, his English was amazing, and I truly enjoyed the tour!! Thank you.

My husband and I really enjoyed our 4.5 hour walking tour led by our very energetic and knowledgeable tour guide, Jake. Not only was the tour a great intro to the city and all the main sites, but Jake was passionate and shared many interesting stories! Definitely a great value and perfect way to start out time in Berlin!

We decided to take a tour before exploring the city on our own which was a great decision. Jake,our very knowledgeable tour guide, gave us extensive and interesting information about the locations we visited.The tour lasted a little over than the 4 hours but we didn’t mind. I would definitely recommend taking this tour first to familiarize yourself with the landmarks and receive interesting facts straight from a tour guide that is passionate about the city.

This was a really really great tour, very informative. Tobi was a fantastic guide and it was very interesting to hear the perspective from someone who lived in East Berlin at the time. Highly recommend!

If your time in Berlin is limited, take this walking tour. In 4 hours you will see most of the major sights and get a real understanding of just how Berlin was formed and changed over such tumultuous times. Scott, our guide, was a walking encyclopaedia and shared his knowledge in a fun and interesting way.

We will do more walking tours on our next next trip to Berlin

I absolutely loved this tour. We learned so much about the city, the history, and what that history meant for Berlin today. It was fascinating. Normally tours point out the sites and give some backstory but our guide, Sam Z, provided such an interesting and thoughtful perspective at each point. His deep knowledge and true passion for Berlin history showed. We left having a new-found appreciation for and understanding of an incredibly complex city. This is a must-do for any trip to Berlin. Even if there for just one day I would recommend it.

What an excellent way to learn a summary of the history of Berlin in a short half day. This was well worth our time, and Sam Z put his masters in History to good use - explaining with true interest the main historical events and showing great optimism for the future of Berlin in light of its checkered past. Highly recommended to do this tour!! Well done Sam Z!! From Canada

Sam W. is an eloquent, knowledgeable and fun tour guide! We enjoyed his tour of key Berlin sites on our first day in the city. He cared that we found shady spots on our surprisingly sunny and warm day. He kept the group of various ages and interests engaged.

Myself and my eight-year-old daughter booked to go on this trip in the afternoon..met the tour guide Beth together with 30 other people. Beth has a great deal of knowledge regarding Berlin and we found her very professional as well as being very friendly too. My daughter normally gets very bored easily...she enjoyed the walk which is at a good pace..the tour took approximately 4 hours inc a 20 minute break at check point Charlie...we all learned a lot.

What I told myself was at least some forced exercise after a week of meetings turned into a captivating opportunity to uncover Berlin with brilliant storytelling. Sam Z (request him if you can) put his masters in History to work as he guided 23 of us from all over through Berlin’s most historic places. I appreciated his optimism for a city with a checkered past and his sensitivity without impressing opinions. I learned a great deal, things I’d never easily uncover. He respectfully gathered us to share our experience walking thorough the Memorial of the Murdered Jews of Europe which allowed us to learn from each other as well. Well worth the time, thank you Sam Z!

Sam W was an expert at pointing out the subtleties and complexities of German history as it applied to Berlin and its buildings and memorials. Especially the 20th century was complex with different regimes using them for different (and conflicting) propaganda purposes. Sam W is pleasant and has a clear voice and thorough knowledge. The tour was one of the highlights of our trip, orienting us in the city and setting us up for the rest of the week.
Fabulous walking tour with great guide Ken. Explained lots of history and we saw most of the main sights. Thoroughly recommend
Ken was our guide and he was great, an Irishman with a degree in history who has lived in Berlin for over 6 years. Myself and my wife had a great time and learned a lot from the tour.

Guide was Sam W(I think). Very personable, very knowledgeable, very helpful. Overall a great tour and a great way to spend half a day. I wish I had done this the first day so I could have had more of a framework for viewing the city! Highly recommended!

Jesse was our tour guide, and he was terrific. Very informative and well worth the cost. It's a hike, so be prepared for that.
