Only quibble is that it ran a bit long time wise, though Jesse was cool about calling that out and making people feel ok about leaving the tour if they needed to. Overall, highly recommend.

Great tour, covers most of the city spots that you want to see. Ken the tour guide knew so much history and knowledge about the city which was amazing especially when we all had questions to ask. The tour took us about four hours and we had a break in the middle. Thought the price was spot on for what you got as well, definitely worth doing.

My first time to Berlin and I wanted to get a overview of the city. Great experience. Well worth the 14 euros. Unbelievable history lesson. Our guide Sam Z was fantastic. He brought us to all the historic sites and really gave us a historic perspective of the city. Highly recommend this tour.

Our guide Jerad was fantastic, the tour was very educative and produced some discussion at the stops, which i found very interesting how a group of strangers interact while they learn this city's history. Very pleased, definitely worth it!!
We had the company of Heidi as our tour guide. 3 1/2 hours flew by and not only did we learn a lot regarding the areas we visited, she also gave us some great pointers for the rest of our stay.
Thanks Ken for a fantastic tour around Berlin. Not only was it very informative but was delivered with humour and an Irish accent ... what more could you ask for?

We did the tour with Scott as our guide. He was excellent! We were in a big group but he managed it all well. We covered a lot of ground in 3 hours and 45 minutes. We had one break around the middle of the day. We started at 10:30am. Very good tour.

What a great tour! Dave was amazing! So informative and helpful and with so many suggestions after the tour ended. Thank you so much, Dave! I would definitely recommend it to everyone visiting this fun, gritty city with so much history.
Greetings from a Polish-Canadian girl!

We did this four hour walking tour with our guide Georgia. The tour was excellent value and covered most of the central Berlin historical sights. Georgia was a brilliant guide who was very knowledgeable and able to put over that knowledge in an entertaining and enthusiastic manner. The four hours zipped along and I would highly recommend this tour as an introduction to Berlin to enable you to orientate yourself and decide what you wish to visit in more detail.

My friend and I did this walking tour with Izzy who was highly knowledgeable, friendly and fun. She clearly has a real interest and passion for Berlin and its history. We particularly enjoyed the opportunities for reflection and discussion with many of the monuments we saw. It was a brilliant opportunity to get to know Berlin better and changed the way we both view the city. Thank you, Izzy, you are great!
Very enjoyable and informative tour with Laura. Covered all the highlights and set stage for further exploration of Berlin.

I couldn’t recommend this highly enough. My friend and I were in Berlin for 2 days so this was an excellent overview of all the main sights. It would also be a fantastic start if you are visiting for longer as it would help you out with deciding where you’d like to spend more time. Our tour guide was Rick who I believe was sadly leaving as he was fantastic! So informative in just the right quantity.

Sarah was our guide and had a very well rounded knowledge of the history of Berlin. Any questions asked were answered thoughtfully during and after the tour.
The walking pace was brisk, but all ages in our group from young to elderly retired couples managed with no problems. Frequent stops with a coffee and restroom break midway. Throughly recommend this tour.
We had our tour led by Scott and it was very interesting, engaging and easy to follow. Couldn't recommend more!
Scott was an excellent tour guide. We enjoyed our tour which lasted close to 4 hours. So wear comfy shoes :)

Gregor led us on a fascinating and illuminating tour. He challenged us to participate by thinking about the historic background and meaning of many of the key monuments before discussing them in greater depth. I thoroughly recommend the tour and Gregor was right up there with the very best of guides we have ever had.

Ysanne was really brilliant making the tour a highlight of our weekend. She is an historian with a wealth of knowledge and deep understanding of Berlin’s past and how it is being dealt with. Couldn’t have anything better!
Did this tour on 6th may and absolutely recommend it. This tour covers literally everything you would want to see or learn about in Berlin.

I had been to Berlin twice before, but my travel partner had not. Even having been here, the discover Berlin tour was not boring or redundant. Our guide knew so much and shared some great stories and insights to the city. The focus is primarily former east Berlin - Hackischer Markt to Checkpoint Charlie, with stops at major buildings, sites, and memorials. The walk gives you a chance to learn about the Mitte area, and decide where to go back on your leisure, since the walk does not include entry to any museums. I also appreciate the thoughtfulness of our guide at the memorials - he did not tell us what to think, but did ask us to think about the intent and meaning. It is a difficult balance when dealing with so many people - and he did it beautifully! I highly recommend this tour; go your first day in Berlin so you get an idea as to where else to visit.
Thank you so much for a wonderful morning walk through this amazing city. The tour gives such a great overview of the history and culture of Berlin and we couldn't be happier. Highly recommended!!

I would like to highly recommend taking this walking tour with an amazing tour operator Original Berlin Walks and even more amazing tourist guide Sam W. I was visiting Berlin only for a weekend I think the tour was just perfect for me and exactly what I have needed - I saw, heard and learned a lot about Belin's history and visited the main touristic points only in 4 hours; 14 euros for operating costs were more that worth and especially I am grateful to had such a wonderful touristic guide Sam W. who was making the Berlin history simple, realistic and supported by the photos how did the things look like in the past, giving us some additional explanation, tips for further visiting and at the end I also gain some additional discount for the trip to the Sachsenhausen concentration camp in next day that I would also highly recommend to do that with the Original Berlin Walks (thank you Georgia to be my tour guide). I couldn't be more happy and satisfied in this weekend trip in Berlin. Thank you very much. Bojana O. (Austria)

If you want to see the history of this amazing city in a few hours, this is the tour for you. The sights themselves are great but our guide, Jake, bought it to life with his knowledge of the city and his evident love for it. At times fun, at times moving, it's a great way to see the history that Berlin has to offer.

Our guide ‘Izzy’ was amazing! She was a wealth of knowledge and managed to balance the weight of Berlin’s history with the respect it deserves, but also making it fun. Her 10 min breakdown of 800 years of Berlin was brilliant. If you’re looking for an insight into this amazing town, whether you have some knowledge or none at all, this tour will leave you with a much better understanding of Berlin.

Amy (guide) was absolutely incredible! She is so knowledgeable and genuinely interested and excited by what she does. The Discover Berlin tour was 10/10, I definitely recommend it! I got to learn about and experience so much of Berlin in just a few hours. I wouldn’t hesitate to book another tour with this company or with Amy. Such a great experience!!

RYAN Was an excellent guide full of info not heard before, four hours went very quickly which is testament to RYAN (his mum will be proud). Also recommend a place to get traditional German beer and food, checked it out, best sausage and mash ever.

Four hour walking walking tour (with numerous stops) hitting all the high points starting at Museum Island west to the Brandenburg Gate. Good insight into WWII and Cold War era Berlin. Our German guide was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. The tour group was medium-sized (about twenty of us), all adults. No flags or audio devices or other obvious tour-toys; we just gathered around her and she gave us the info with the help of an I-Pad and maps. I recommend this tour as an initial get-to-know Berlin quickly tool. You will want to come back to some of the places on your own and spend more time.

Sam W. was an excellent guide, knowledgable, interesting, and concise. We learned a lot while we saw a lot. He's English, which gives him some distance from German history, which helps in many ways. But he has definitely done his homework, and knows the nuances. Independent of the guide, it was a well laid out tour, and a good first Berlin activity.

We’ve done dozens of walking tours around the world and have enjoyed them all, this one was the exception. Our guide spoke as if we were beneath him and most of his “facts” were really just his opinion stated as a fact.
Best tour ever done. Ysanne was very informative and enthusiastic. Must do when visiting Berlin.....

Led by Scott, (a graduate of our Alma mater, Glasgow School of Art) we enjoyed his effective mix of historical information, thoughtful narrative and subtle Glasgow humour.
A well paced tour with time for reflection and enquiry. I particularly liked how Scott left you to draw your own conclusions or make your own observations about a very complex, controversial city. The tour was over all too soon and certainly whetted my appetite for a return visit. Thanks Scott!

Greg was amazing, he gave the most enthusiastic, insightful and relaxed walking tour. His knowledge on Berlin was incredible, myself and my partner learned a lot while in his company.

As we were only in Berlin for a short amount of time, we were worried we wouldn't see everything we wanted to - but thanks to his tour, we managed to see everything that was on our list (and more) in just one day!

I have already recommended this tour to everyone I know - a must if you're heading to Berlin.

Nathan was a brilliant guide. He had clearly studied German history in detail and was an enthusiast on the history of the area. We visited many of the main sites and they were brought to life with conviction and humour. Thanks for a great tour.
They do have the best guides and the best tours. I did 4 tours with original berlin walks and they were all phenomenal

Seven, our French tour guide was really friendly, knowledgeable and very informative.
It give us a really good start to our mini break to Berlin. It was a very relaxing and enjoyable tour and we visited some amazing places. We stopped for a coffee break and a rest half way through which was well deserved. Highly recommend this tour to everyone going to Berlin for the first time.

We did the half day tour of berlin. It was the best thing we did in Berlin hands down. The content of the tour and the locations we were taken to were superb. Our guide,Sam BV, provided a really good historical background to all that we saw. He kept things really interesting over the four hours. By the end of the tour we had a real appreciation for what the city and it's people have gone through over the last 300 years. I would recommend doing this tour early during your stay. It will open your eyes up to everything else you see during the rest of your visit.
Very informative and interesting. You get an amazing "picture" of city and culture in a short time. Great choice for short term visitors.

A decent walk. Not as good as concentration camp tour but definitely did learn a lot about the city. I just feel 2.5 hours is a bit shorter than advertised. Id have loved to be given the opportunity to walk about some sites like checkpoint Charlie , memorial to the Jews etc. It mentions entry is provided to a few places, I felt this aspect is quite misleading. Good tour but a few minutes at each location would have been nice

We recently visited Berlin and chose to do this walking tour as a way to get to know the city. Kai, our guide, was absolutely excellent! He was incredibly knowledgeable and managed to provide an amazing overview of Germany’s history over the last 150 years. He took us to a lot of different monuments and explained their history in a informative and engaging way. I highly recommend this tour for anyone visiting Berlin!

This nifty little tour covers the main sites of Berlin in just a couple of hours. Rob Willis (tall, undeniably handsome, with a sharp, dry wit) was our guide for this tour. While you could easily see all these sites by yourself it cannot be understated how important it is to have someone such as Rob alongside you providing a valuable and unique insight into the city's intriguing, tumultuous and, at times, rather amusing history. Furthermore, his sincere admiration for the citizens of Berlin as a liberal, free-thinking and democratic people in spite of this tumultuous past was evident, invoking a passion not often expressed on these sorts of tours. Well worth the modest ticket fee.

Johnny was our guide and he was excellent bringing the history alive and engaging different nationalities who were on the tour. A fast paced tour that takes in all the major sites whilst bringing alive the history of Berlin. Takes c. 4 hours with a stop for coffee and cake. The tour was excellent value - I recommend you do this early in your visit to get a feel for the best places to visit in more depth.

Sarah was a great tour guide and she managed to teach us many things about the city and it's history! Great chance to learn some recent history and see the main landmarks of Berlin just in 4 hours! Totally recommended!!
I discovered Berlin with Campbell, who is a fountain of knowledge. From the Prussians, to WWII, to modern day Berlin, he knows it all, and funny as hell to boot!

I was worried about doing the 4 hour Discover Berlin tour due to a bad knee but Rosie, who takes bookings, was incredibly kind and reassuring. So glad I did it! Fantastic introduction to the city from which to go on to explore further. Tobi our guide was amazing, so engaging, funny, knowledgable and passionate. I found it so interesting hearing about his early life behind the iron curtain, really brought the fascinating history of the city to life. He was also very mindful of my knee! Such a lovely guy. Berlin went way beyond my expectations and this tour is the perfect way to experience it. Thank you!
My 4 friends and I did a private mixed Third Reich / Cold War tour. Fascinating, and enjoyable. Ask for Kyle.

Just to share the positive impression with our first walking tour in Berlin (Original w.t) with Tobi as our guide. I could recommend this tour for all those who come to Berlin for first time and do not have much time to explore on their own. Our guide Tobi was very friendly, well prepared and helpful for us - group of around 20 p.. Tobi - many thanks and hope other groups would tip you well as you deserve great appreciation!

We all really enjoyed this tour. Our small group was aged 15 to 70 . The total group size was about 25 or so. Xavier was our tour guide and was very entertaining and knowledgeable. Totally worth the money. We stopped about 3/4 into the tour at a place for coffee and dessert. So good since it was a bit chilly outside. Would highly recommend this tour. Jus the right amount of walking and hit many of the highlights in Berlin.

Ysanne was a great guide and very knowledgeable. The your was a great way to see many of the major points in Berlin and learn a lot about the history. It was just what I needed for my only free afternoon while I was in Berlin. The weather was perfect, which made it quite enjoyable!

This is a must do to ground your understanding of Berlin. Ryan was a great guide. Full of knowledge but adjusted the content of information to keep us all interested. The pace was excellent and we learned so much. Helpful tips as well. I highly recommend.

Our tour guided by Georgia was just brilliant. It was incredibly informative and genuinely engaging. She led with just the right level of informality and wry Scottish humour, while sharing some fascinating yet sobering facts about the city- it's architecture and history and politics. She clearly really knew her stuff. To cover all the key spots and get learnt up in such depth all in one morning for only £15 is unbelievable value for money. Thank you!
Good tour hosted by Rob very informative and his enthusiasm and knowledge made the tour all the more interesting. Would highly recommend.

Our tour guide Kathryn helped make this tour enjoyable, fun as well as being extremely informative.
So many important sites were taken in and Kathryn provided excellent descriptions coupled with her own personal stories to make this tour memorable.

Highly recommended.

This tour was an excellent way to start our trip to Berlin. Nathan,our tour guide, gave a fascinating, informative and extremely interesting insight into the history,sights and culture of Berlin. Major historical periods from the Holy Roman Empire to more recent times became understandable. We would thoroughly recommend the tour.

My friend and I only had a weekend to see the city but we saw MUCH more than we would've seen without a tour. Xavier was very informative, fun, and happy to answer any/all questions. We learned so much about the history of the city and where it is today. I cannot recommend it enough!

Went with Jared on Thursday for our walking tour of Berlin. It was very interesting but he talked non-stop about things that were of interest to him and not relevant to our group. Our first stop was at-a graffiti wall where he literally talked for 40 minutes. No one was interested and we almost left at that point but stayed with it. All our stops were random and lengthy & when we did get to something interesting he rushed us through. We finally got to the Wall , Checkpoint Charlie and the victims memorial & Brandenburg gate and he maybe spent 5 minutes at each place. we didn’t even cross the street to see the section of the Wall. Very disappointing. I’m sure the other guides are different as we had Sam today at Sachenhausen camp and he was great. Guides need to keep it relevant to the groups and not waste our time discussing their views instead the the actual history, architecture etc.

How many times do you go on these tours and regret afterwards that you didn’t instead walk around with a book guide? Not so with this tour, and all thanks to Kai (Janssen, I believe). Armed to the teeth with historical and background knowledge, Kai rolled up Berlin in what seemed a very short 4 hours (everyone would have been happy to listen for another 4 I reckon). His impassioned (hi)story-telling was spell-binding. Be prepared for Wilhelmstrasse, standing in a spot which is almost like a locational summary of Dark Berlin. From a vast open space, you will see a long stretch of the Wall. Beneath that, the brickwork of the basement of the GestaPo HQ where prisoners were held and tortured. The empty space you stand in was the former location of both the SS HQ and the People’s Court, run by Death Judge Roland Freisler who condemned thousands of resistance fighters here in show trials. You will be standing in a spot where the death of 60 Million people was orchestrated- but I’ll stop here cause if you’re lucky you’ll have Kai to tell you the story.

We attended the tour on Tuesday 12 March and our tour guide was Sam W. He had a hard task with 37 people from different countries but he made the 4 hours such a pleasure. We had time for a coffee stop and plenty of time to ask questions. Sam was always seeking to find out if all were happy and had questions. The tour was educational and very enjoyable due to Sam's knowledge, passion and humour. We have discovered that Berlin is a complicated, intriguing city and Sam's clear and respectful manner made this the best way of discovering the city and some of it's history. We were so impressed that we book a further tour later in the week.

We really enjoyed our walking tour with our lovely tour guide Ysanne. She was very passionate about all that Berlin has to offer and made the history and politics of Germany understandable and interesting. We were amazed how much was covered in the 4 hours and felt by the end of the tour that we had a really good understanding of the city and could easily identify which bits we wanted to go back and find out more about. Many thanks and I would highly recommend this tour and our guide Ysanne.

Our tour guide, Jared, was absolutely amazing. At every site that we went to, he gave really good insight and facts. As well, his humour made everything really entertaining. Would recommend going on this tour if you want to graze the surface level of all of Berlin's attractions/monuments. You don't spend too much time at each destination (because there's no much to see!!!), so you definitely will need to backtrack on your own and spend more time at sites that you would like to see in detail.

This was an inexpensive tour to get the lay of the land on your first day in Berlin. Dave was great and very knowledgeable. I would have picked a better spot for the break but I understand why he picked it. I would do it again when I come back to Berlin.

This was one of the best walking tours I have ever been on. Scott was engaging, extremely passionate and personable. He created a relaxed environment and was encouraging of us asking questions, which he answered perfectly. The tour was very detailed and informative whilst also combining perhaps lesser known aspects of Berlin's history including Germany's colonial activities in Namibia. Scott is knowledgable but also ensures this knowledge is accessible, through his approachable and dynamic demeanour. He has set a high standard and I would encourage anyone to participate in Scott's tours. I am very impressed.

I've done many walking tours around the world, but Ysanne has really raised the bar! Ysanne's detailed knowledge of the city and it's history really brought Berlin to life for me, and surpassed all of my expectations of the tour. Can't recommend this highly enough, the perfect way not only to see the city but also learn about it's multilayered history.

A massive thank you to Lynsey, she did a fantastic job despite the rain. Her knowledge of the city made our weekend stay in the city really fantastic. I recommend this guided tour at the beginning of your stay in Berlin, so you can use the great personal advice that your guide will help you with.
Had an amazing morning learning so much about the history of Berlin - even though it was in torrential rain! A big thank you to Lynsey, who was an amazing tour guide who definitely knew her stuff!

We have been on Walking Tours in many cities and have been lucky as the guides have always been very informative and Heidi was certainly among the best. Her stories, knowledge and overall presentation kept us enthralled throughout. We generally do one of these tours early in the trip as there is always so much information you don't get in reading about a place and hidden gems you may miss out on. This tour covers many of the top attractions but gives a lot of the history behind them. I would recommend this to anyone going to Berlin

We recently enjoyed a trip to Berlin - mum and 16 year old son.
This tour was led by Ryan who was knowledgeable, interesting, and enthusiastic. We felt we learnt some of the rich, often turbulent history of this fantastic city. We heard anecdotes of triumphs over adversity and harrowing accounts of the realities of occupation.
I was so glad to have booked this activity and would highly recommend - particularly if this is your first time in Berlin. Having the background knowledge at the start of your visit helps you get a feel for the city. And if you are lucky you might get Ryan as your tour guide!

Xavier was our interesting and informative guide. Despite the sometimes unpleasant weather (not his fault) the 4 or so hours passed quickly, with a history of the development of Germany from it's earliest beginnings until today. Along the way we visited many of the key sites, and explanations were given, sometimes with a humorous touch, often with much food for thought. I certainly learned a lot in a short time, and it whetted my appetite to revisit some of the places for a further look. Thank you, Xavier.

This four hour tour covers all the key sites. There were about twenty of us in the group. Nathan our guide displayed a comprehensive knowledge and was happy to take questions. There were still twenty of us left at the end of the tour despite the fact that we covered a fair distance and it was a very cold day. A testament to the interest that Nathan had generated. I would definitely recommend this tour.

I have only one day in Berlin and I chose walking tour, our guide was awesome. Thank you so much Scott, you explained how Berlin was establish with incredible fascinating stories. We spent exactly 4 hours and even a second wasn’t boring. Next time when I’ll come to Berlin I’d like to try another walking tours.

The tour started from an easy to find location by the U-Bahn station. The guide was easy to find and the meet and greet was friendly.
We covered several key sites of interest at a pace that allowed some conversations and questions.
Our guide, Sam W, was knowledgeable and gave us a factual tour with his own personal touches and info on top. Sam gave serval tips for other places to visit as we went round.
A great way top see the key sites and to get ideas for some more extensive exploration... highly recommended!!

Our guide was Darren, a young Irish man working towards his Doctorate in History. He gave an excellent summary of the forces which shaped Berlin and made it the extraordinary city it is today. The tour was nicely paced, and the 3 hours flew by. Absolutely worth the price of the tickets
Jared was a fantastic guide, he can make anything interesting. we went on other tours and he was by far the best

We arrived in Berlin at around 11.30am and had this tour booked for 2pm to help us get our bearings and see the places we might want to revisit in the city.
I have to say that this tour was very well conducted and covered a lot of sites. Mariette our tour guide was very knowledgeable and the 3.5 hour tour just flew by. It was a nice sized party of around 18 people.
The pace was fairly relaxed stopping off every now and then to be told a story or piece of history.
I would highly recommend this tour in particular for anyone who is new to Berlin. It’s informative and very well organised.

This was a great, informative tour of a historical city. We learnt so much about the history of East and West Berlin. Our tour guide, Nathan, was very knowledgable and it was apparent that he had a vast understanding of German history.

Despite it being a ridiculously cold day, we stayed with the tour for the full four hour because it was soo interesting.
I would definitely recommend this tour :).

I would recommend this trip for those you are visiting the city for the first time ( as we were) and are looking to get to grips with the city. This was far better than I was expecting. Our guide Dave (only my grandmother calls me David!) took our party of about 15 -20 on a well-planned 4 hour tour of the city. He was knowledgeable and was really able to communicate his passion for the city and its history, which covered first settlers in the 13 century to the present day. Places we did not have time to see were indicated for later visits by Dave so he helped formulate much of our time in the city, which was brilliant. We learned lots as a result of this tour and recommend this tour highly as one of the best we have done in a whole range of cities. This tour is most suitable for fit adults and older children due to the amount of walking involved.

Thank you to Dave for a friendly, informed and very interesting tour of Berlin. Set up now for getting the most out of our holiday. Great knowledge of history and city. Thanks . Would definitely recommend

My wife and I did this tour on 15/2.
Everyone doing it met outside Starbucks by the sbahn as it says on the website, meeting up was easy.
The group was split into manageable numbers (24 I think) & our guide was Ryan
He was very knowledgeable and informative of all the stops we did on the tour, which took about 4 hours. The group was small enough for everyone to hear his talks at each stop.
We saw all the main sights as it says on the website & had opportunity to take enough photos of each.
Stopped for lunch half way through ( by which time we were at checkpoint Charlie) & grabbed something from a nearby cafe ( a pastry from Kramps, which we liked) before doing the second half of the tour.
We finished about 2.30 at the Brandenburg gate, which is handy if your planning on going into the Reichstag ( we did this separate from the tour- you don't go in here while on the tour. If you're planning to do the Reichstag book in advance and take your passport - as it says on its website- security is strict)
Back to the tour - we'd recommend it and glad we did it. Brilliant, thanks Ryan.

Ps although we did it in February- weather was glorious for the time of year, sunny, about 12 degrees.

Our Guide Sam W was very knowledgeable, gave great insight & we saw most of everything we needed to in Berlin I'm the 4 hours. The time few & we were able to decide where we wanted to visit in more detail because of what he had informed us. Highly recommended.

It was an excellent tour. As we weaved our way through the area the tour guide gave us an amazing history of Berlin and Germany...pictures included. Truly worth the money and will provide a great overview of the key areas of Berlin.
Our tour was amazing, very informative, covered so much, highlight of our trip! Our guide Sarah was faultless, friendly, helpful, highly recommended!

This tour is a perfect way to see much of the center of Berlin and many of its top sights, as well as to hear about the city's history. Sam W is a great tour guide. The tour was a highlight of our trip to Berlin and is highly recommended.

I highly recommend this walking tour and especially Linsey who was an awesome guide. It is worth it as it gives you a chance to see some of the major Berlin’s attractions and learn a little bit of history also.

I think this is the best way to see the sights and learn about all the history. Laura was an excellent guide and we thoroughly enjoyed the tour. I would have walked past many of the buildings without knowing the historical significance if it weren't for the tour. I highly recommend it. Thank you Laura!

We were escorted by Georgia on our tour . We were all greeted and escorted on an amazing 4 hour tour of Berlin , Georgia was knowledgable,thoughtful and attentive to all the group willing to answer Any questions throughout the tour. she was so interesting we enjoyed the whole experience and Learnt so many interesting facts. This was our 2nd day of a 4day stay and we used her tips to go back to several points to visit over the next few days. Well worth the money and highly recommend for any one visiting Berlin .

Had a amazing afternoon with Kai as our guide, he was interesting, engaging and so knowledgeable! It as obvious he enjoyed taking about the history of Berlin. Definitely a must for visitors to Berlin.

To say this was a fascinating tour would be an understatement, our guide Wouter, who is Dutch, was excellent & so passionate about the history behind the sites he took us to. We had a list of places we wanted to see on our very short trip to Berlin & this tour covered the majority of them but with the added benefit of Wouters extensive knowledge. even when it was so cold i couldn't feel my face anymore I was so glad we chose this walking tour. We done about 3.5 hours which was plenty in the cold & with a small group. Would highly recommend taking this tour.
We would thoroughly recommend this tour. Our guide was a welsh lady called Beth who was absolutely fantastic - really knowledgeable and her insight and passion for the subjects was really enjoyable.

This walking tour of Berlin with KYLE was AWESOME. I did the tour on NYE day, and even with the large crowds and fireworks going off everywhere, i was able to learn about Berlins history and feel as though I knew the city quite well myself at the end. Kyle was both informative and friendly, and made the group feel as though we were just her family viting from Chicago taking in the sites.She even recommended a few places to grab a beer along the way : ). I highly recommend this for anyone wanting to get the most out of their trip to Berlin!!

We had Nathan leading us around Berlin's historic city center. He was extremely knowledgeable on all aspects of Berlin's long history. He delivered such an engaging and informative talk. 5/5 highly recommend!!

We really enjoyed the tour with Wouter (?) a Dutchman who was extremely knowledgeable about Berlin.His encyclopaedic knowledge suited me down to the ground but perhaps it could go over people’s heads.Berlin is a lovely city benefiting from extensive rebuilding but with a recognition of its dark,recent history.Wouter’s knowledge and expertise put this all in context and gave newbies insight and understanding of the new Berlin.

Went on tour with my wife on a damp cold Berlin day but thanks to our tour guide Walter (From Holland) we had really enjoyable and interesting tour..full of great information and places we would have missed without his expertise...absolutely recommended for anyone visiting Berlin.

Our guide Darren was first-class. He was extremely knowledgable, obviously loved his subject - the history of Berlin - and is a born teacher able to communicate Berlin's complicated past in simple, digestible terms. He was not shy of giving his own personal opinion which always makes history more interesting! The best part of the experience for me was understanding for the first time some of the deeper underlying causes of the Holocaust and also how and why Berlin had come to be built and rebuilt time and again at different times of history depending on who was ruler. How the Holocaust could happen was a question we returned to again and again and one thing which I think Darren could have recommended was a visit to the Berlin Story Bunker at Schoneberger Str which I discovered at the very end of my trip almost by accident. It brilliantly complimented his excellent tour, filling in many of the gaps about Hitler's personality and what happened in Berlin during the Second World War.

Darren was our guide. He was a fountain of knowledge of the history of the union of the German speaking nations to form Germany and the politics of the 20th century that shaped the unified Germany of today. We learned so much from this tour. Thoroughly recommend it.

We had a tour with Beth as the tour guide. She covered a lot of places and described the detailed history associated with those places. I particularly liked the way she described the events specially the fluency and choice of words. She made some parts interactive. It was just amazing. I wanted the tour to continue even after 4 hrs.

This was honestly a highlight of my few days in Berlin. Wautu was easy to listen to, very interesting, insightful and funny. I learnt so much in just a few hours about Berlin and its history. I would highly recommend!!

I cannot stress enough how amazing this walk was, particularly for a first time visitor to Berlin. Georgia’s humour, enthusiasm and depth of knowledge was highly impressive and the tour itself proved to be the perfect introduction to Berlin as both a historical and modern (as well as highly walkable city). Would highly recommend to any and all visitors.

We did the walking tour with Jess, who was incredibly knowledgeable and a very engaging speaker. We were in a large tour group - lots of people asked questions, and Jess was able to answer them all fully. The tour was fantastic and I’d highly recommend it to all visitors to Berlin.

We (a family of five - three teenage boys) took the tour with Georgia (who is full of history and enthusiasm) on our first morning in Berlin. It has to be the best way to learn about Berlin’s history and sites. Do it early in your trip: its an excellent introduction that helps frame where you spend your time in the hours and day(s) following the tour and Georgia has so many top tips for bars and restaurants. 4 hours (with a halfway stop) whizzes by. Our 12 year old didn’t complain once. Georgia is excellent and made Berlin come alive. We only wish we had time to take Georgia’s tour to the former concentration camp. Next time. Thank you.

Recently took the 4-hour walking tour with Jess as our guide. He is a student of Humboldt University and was really great. I can confidently say this was one of the best guided tours I have taken and a great way to start your visit to the city. He covered a huge amount of detail while explaining it all in the context of Berlin and Germany's history as a whole. His answers to questions (which there weren't many from our group since he did such a good job) where very concise. I highly recommend the tour and if you can have him as your guide definitely do it!

I was lucky enough to discover Original Berlin Walks and our wonderful guide Jesse. What a terrific experience, 4 hours of engaging, enlightening and wonderfully communicated information about the history of Berlin and so much more. The time flew by as Jesse expertly guided us through parts of the city and humanised and explained the history in a really engaging manner. It was the best ever tour guide experience I ever been lucky enough to experience. The tour was excellent value for money, the quality of the guides ability & knowledge was top class -
Treat yourself folks - not to be missed - emeir - irish visitor - Dec 2018

Would highly recommend starting your visit to Berlin with this walking tour as it really does give you a great lay out of the city centre but more importantly it really helped me figure out which places I wanted to make special visits to see specifically. Berlin can be an overwhelming place with so many museums and things to see and do that this really helped me focus my attention on the things I really wanted to make sure I saw instead of trying to see everything and potentially missing out on something I would have really enjoyed.

Sarah was our tour guide and she was a legend. She was very easy to understand, articulate, and was extremely knowledgeable about all of our stops but more importantly when we had questions she had great answers and tons of useful information (ie. business hours during the holidays / public holidays etc).

Sarah gave us an excellent half day tour of Berlin. Recommend doing this on first day in Berlin. Good background history, clear and concise and helpful. It was the best of the three orginal tours we did in Berlin. Also did hitler and concentration camp. Helped us set the stage for the remaining time in Berlin

We saw two groups for the English version and one stopped at 21 which seemed a reasonable number. Our group had all the remaining people (in the English group) and numbered close to 50. This was absolutely too big a group and there should have been at least one more guide.

Rachel, our guide was very good whenever we could hear her, which was around 50 % of the time.

I think she did a great job but the tour company charged around 700 Euros (a rough guess) for this group and really shortchanged all of us by not putting in enough guides.They continued to sell tickets at the starting point till the last moment and did not seem to have a concept of limiting capacity for a group or a guide.

Other than that, Rachel had very good historical and contextual information for all the major stops and was patient in answering questions. She had a good academic background in German history and had a balanced view for a number of important issues and we wish her the best.

From new Zealand. I would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone who wants a very good summary of the past 700years. A great eye opener to what Germany is really about. If you are lucky enough you may even get Gregor as your guide. He is born and bred Berlin and very passionate and knowledgeable about the German history. Many thanks
Our guide was Xavior, he was enthusiastic, passionate about his subject and very knowledgable. He was happy to answer questions and very engaging with the group.

We signed up for the walking tour to get to know the basic landmarks in Mitte. Our tour guide Sarah (Australian but easy to understand ;-) made us feel at ease and showered us with history, interesting little facts and trip tips. I was surprised how much she knew and how entertaining the trip was. If you are a bit inspired by European history then The four hours passes in a jiffy and you will learn a lot.

Thank you Sarah!
Heidi was fantastic! This is a great tour of Berlin, and Heidi did an amazing job. I highly recommend this tour or any tour Heidi is leading!

Marriette did a wonderful job taking us through the historically significant and cultural areas of Berlin. She was kind and engaging, and provided a great overview and understanding of Berlin's history. I highly recommend this tour for your first or second day in Berlin to gain a foundation of the city. 5 stars!

We were pleasantly surprised with how informative and interesting this tour was! Even in the cold weather, Heidi kept us interested and engaged - she was really wonderful!! I would highly recommend this tour!!
A fantastic tour with a fantastic guide, Tobi. A great introduction to Berlin, enabling us to get an overview of Berlin that we would not have been able to do on our own. Highly recommended

Nathan was very knowledgeable about the history leading up to modern day Germany. Very informative and hit all the points we wanted to see. Checkpoint Charlie, Berlin Wall, Brandenburg gate, etc. We even made some historic stops that we had not anticipated such as the place where Hitler's old bunker used to be. So happy we chose to do this walking tour instead of trying to find these places on our own as we would not have had the lesson in history we were able to get. Definitely recommend this tour company.

This was a fantastic tour! Our tour guide Beth was extremely knowledgeable and had a great sense of humour! She handled the group extremely well even when a group member made an uncalled for comment. The tour started with Beth giving us a very comprehensive overview of the history of Germany, this laid a good foundation for the rest of the tour. Her approach as a guide was brilliant, she encouraged us to explore the memorials and then discussed how they made us feel afterwards. I would definitely recommend it! Wished we had done it at the start of our break rather than at the end.

Thoroughly enjoyed our half day tour with Gregor who gave a fantastic insight into many of Berlin's must see landmarks, his knowledge of his city is impressive, cannot recommend this tour highly enough.

We had a great 4 hours walking around Berlin with our very knowledgable tour guide Nathan. It was a great way to see the historical highlights of the city and be educated in the history of the facinating city of Berlin. Great value for money and would highly recommend it!

Discover Berlin-walking tour was the best choice I have made while I have visited Berlin. I took the english tour at 2pm.The Guide, Tobi made my day.
He speaks a very good english, he has a fantastic way to make you live a small part of the history and a great sense of humor.I strongly recommend.

really loved this tour.

Our guide Darren gave us a fascinating tour of over 4 hours which brought the history of this fascinating city alive.

Many thanks Darren for a fantastic and informative tour.

Beth was our tour guide, a very interesting and knowledgeable young lady.
With an extensive knowledge of the history of Berlin she not only introduced us to various sights but also debated historical facts and interests.
She is passionate about her subject/job. Worth every penny and although really cold and a long time on your feet (4 hours walking) its a must. Thank you so much beth.

Tour guide was Rob Willis he showed great depth of knowledge and expertise on all the areas covered on the tour. Rob made it so interesting and the passion for what he does shone through. Fabulous experience was our first time in Birlin but we will definitely be back and joining the tours again.

Our guide was Heidi who was extremely knowledgeable and was able to answer all questions. The tour goes to many of the major sites around berlin. The only downside is that with so much to see it was limited how much time was available at each stop. Also the freezing weather made it difficult to stay warm whenever we stopped. Otherwise it is an excellent way to see a wide variety of sites around berlin.

My friend and I did the Discover Berlin Tour with Darren as our guide and he was fantastic!! His knowledge of the city and its history made the tour so special for us and both of us even commented to each other afterwards that if we had a history teacher like Darren we would have aced that subject at school.
Great tour!

We had signed up for a organized tour of Germany, but went a few days early to combat jet lag. One thing on our pre-tour days was going on a walking tour of Berlin. We always love taking walking tours and this one didn’t disappoint. Our guide, Ysanne, had a masters degree in history and it was apparent in her depth of knowledge. We saw so much of the City and even though we visited some of the same sites the next day with our organized tour, this one was so much more informative. We are so glad that we took this tour and will take more if we are back in Berlin.

Very informative tour showing the history of Berlin. Ryan’s knowledge of the city was excellent. He was happy to answer any questions we had and made sure everyone was happy and following along throughout. Many buildings and sights you would walk past if you were exploring alone so definitely worth the small price tag!

We took a tour yesterday evening and it was fantastic. Despite the cold, we covered so many important sites. Our guide, Gregor, was extremely knowledgeable and thought provoking. He didn’t merely introduce sites, but had a group discussion on many matters which would be seemingly difficult topics to discuss. It was very affordable and worth every cent!

We were very glad that we booked this tour. Sarah the tour guide was amazingly knowledgeable, passionate about her tour and incredibly articulate. A place like Berlin needs a tour guide like Sarah, since Berlin is a city of facts and emotions. She was outstanding when she mixed the historical facts and emotive language. We loved the length and breadth of the tour .Thank you!

This is a wonderful tour that gives you background, history, and perspective on Berlin. Nathan was absolutely incredible and he displayed deep knowledge and passion that I’ve rarely seen in a guide before. Highly recommended!
Good tour -- great overview of the history of Berlin. Nathan was a great tour guide. I enjoyed every bit of the tour even though it was cold and windy!!

We enjoyed our walk through Berlin with TOBI today. We visited all the planned sites and he made it incredibly special and unique in all its details. Coming from Guatemala this distance, his deep knowledge of history and the sites made our experience memorable and ready to return and visit more sights. Great going Tobi.
Had a fantastic tour with Gregor. Extremely articulate and well-informed. I’d visited die Mitte before but Gregor filled in many details I knew nothing about.
Well worth booking a walking tour which proved to be informative and interesting. There are various tours you can book, either pay upfront or free tours which you give a donation.

We decided to book a walking tour on our first morning in Berlin as we felt it would be the best way to get to know the city. Our two girls aged 12 and 16 weren't impressed by this as they thought it would be boring. It turned out to be the highlight of their and our trip. Dave's knowledge of the city and it history were amazing - he was creative in the way that he explained how Berlin had changed over the years and answered everyone's questions thoughtfully, using historical evidence for his answers. Great sense of humour used in a tactful and sensitive way. We are all engaged and felt that we learnt more from Dave than we would have done on our own. The added bonus were Dave's top tips on things to do and places to eat in the city.

We had the pleasure of participating in the Discover Berlin Half-Day Walking tour with Carlos as our guide and it was excellent. He did a particularly wonderful job walking you through Berlin's deep history and keeping a common thread through it out making it easy to follow. We did it on our first morning in Berlin and it did an excellent job of orienting us to Berlin and we definitely had a much easier time navigating around the city over the ensuing days thanks to the tour. I'd highly recommend the tour and also strongly recommend Carlos as a tour guide. He was excellent.

This was an excellent introduction to Berlin, as throughout the tour we covered many of the major sights in Mitte, from Museum Insel to the Brandenburg Gate and Checkpoint Charlie, with lots of stops in between. Our guide, Nathan, was incredibly knowledgeable and managed to give us a condensed history of the city in just a few hours (from backwater village, to political centre and warzone, to modern capital).
I would recommend taking this tour at the beginning of your trip, as we discovered lots of places we wanted to go back and see. Nathan also made some really good recommendations! All in all, well worth the money.

Joined the walking tour (3.5-4hrs) only on the last day of my trip. Ben has been a fantastic guide, sharing with us the history and a lot of details about Berlin. Will definitely be back to Berlin to see more of the parts that I had missed out on in the future.

I visited Berlin for the first time last Thursday and I wanted an educational tour that covered a lot of ground and I was not disappointed... Steve's sense of humor and voice acting made the tour quite entertaining.

We had Izzy as our tour guide and she was excellent! She provided fascinating details about the city and its history. You can tell how passionate she was about Berlin while she talked. Definitely would recommend to anyone visiting Berlin!

Our guide Jess was fantastic. He was a wealth of knowledge and could answer questions about European history even if it didn't pertain specifically to Germany. He is an American, but he has lived in Berlin for several years and is finishing up his masters in history from Humboldt University in Berlin. I was lucky enough to have him again as a local guide on my Rick Steves tour the next week.

Our guide Matti provided an excellent introduction to Berlin, complete with fascinating historical insights and pointing out things that you wouldn't notice otherwise (e.g. plaques on the pavement to remember Jewish people who were displaced from their homes). Covered the Nazis and Cold War and great way to familiarise yourself with the city and orientate yourself. Highly recommended!
Our guide was very knowledgeable and we learned so much on this tour. The tour covered a great variety of sites. Highly recommend!

This was a great way to get a feel for the city and see the main sights of Berlin with a knowledgeable and friendly tour guide. Our guide, Ryan, knew everything about the history of the city and how it fit in with the history of Germany and Europe overall. Started off with a historical overview and then learned about the different periods of Berlin/German history in the context of each spot we visited. Ryan was great and gave us recommendations based on our interests that we would never have discovered otherwise (I was interested in the U/S-Bahn system so he recomended the Ghost Stations exhibit at Nordbahnhof and the Tranenplast exhibit at Friedrichstrasse - both were great).

Very good walking tour best way to see the sights of Berlin. Our tour guide Rob was very good and his knowledge of Berlin was excellent he also gave us information about other sightseeing places to visit

We wished we would've taken this tour earlier on in our stay. The guide was incredibly knowledgeable and interesting. We loved the pace, the history, and the places we visited. Highly recommend to people visiting Berlin.

This was money well spent ... and at just Euros 14 ... a bargain as well. The walk lasted for half a day and our guide, Xavier, was exceptional. He was was funny, entertaining and enthusiastic. It was so obvious that he has a passion to talk about the history of Berlin, the war and to show tourists the main sites with enough tantalising information to entice us to return at our later leisure and spend more time at the ones that interested us the most. Xavier was also happy to give us suggestions of good places to eat as well as other tours.
Which we followed up by going on the three hour FREE tour of the quirky, arty and alternative side of Berlin the following day. Our guide for that was Dora ... who was also exceptional in her knowledge of graffitti and street art. What a delight!
Try them when you're next in Berlin. You won't be disappointed ... just make sure you're wearing comfy footwear!
Thank you Xavier and Dora! xx

This half day tour was terrific, everything we hoped it would cover. Much more than just the Nazi history of the city but back to the original settlement, the initial royal family and Prussian empire.
Our guide, Rick, was a history major and had been in Germany for 10 years his knowledge was encyclopedic.
Rick started the tour with an overview of the history starting from the 13th century to modern day which really set the scene for the rest of the tour and as we moved through the city he revisited these highlights and went into greater detail, very professional.
Rick was also easy to talk to and ask questions, gave recommendation for good restaurants and allowed the group a coffee and toilet break at the mid way point.
This was possibly the most professional and entertaining walking tour we have been on, great job.

We were so lucky to have Tobi as our guide. Our small group got to ask him all the questions we needed to but there weren't that many because Tobi covered it all. Both the history of where he took us but also come more modern context. The walking was at an easy pace and we covered a lot of territory. While we didn't get to stay anywhere for a longer period, the tour is a good overview to get your bearings and plan where you'd like to return to.

Ryan, our tour guide, was very knowledgeable about Berlin (he's lived in the city for the past 10 years), and he showed us every monument and site I wanted to see during my first time in Berlin. He also gave us tips for restaurants and other spots in the city we should try. This tour - especially for the price - is totally worth it.

Xavier, our guide, was excellent. Knowledgeable, enthusiastic and friendly. Open to all questions. Made everyone feel comfortable. The tour is all you could ask for in four hours. We touched on most key sights in historic Berlin. This is a great way to start a visit to Berlin.

My brother and I signed up for this tour as we were only in Berlin one full day and wanted to hit as many spots as we could while still understanding the meaning behind each one. Beth was our tour guide and she was phenomenal! So educated on all stops along the tour. She made it interesting even though it was a ton of information to take in. Would definitely recommend.
A truly fantastic experience. We had Ken as our guide and with his knowledge (and humor) we were entertained and educated about the history of Berlin throughout the entire walk. Highly recommended

Our guide was Rachel and she was extremely knowledgeable about Berlin and it’s history throughout the ages. The tour was very interesting and lasted 3 1/2-4 hrs with a break before the last hour. Very pleased we did this tour, learnt a lot and made me want to know more. Thank you Rachel.

Ulli had a good depth of knowledge, of Berlin and other places, so could answer all our questions. She was able to engage with all of us and hold our interest for over 3 hours. It was a bonus that she and her family are from east Berlin, so she was able to illustrate history with accounts of personal experiences.
We loved every minute of our walk with Gregor. We learned so much and it was such great value for money.

Great way to learn history of Berlin and visit its most renown sights at the same time.
I really enjoyed the tour, or guide was very knowledgeable and answered all our questions.
Highly recommended👍

Nathan our guide was engaging and extremely knowledgeable, imparting a chronological history of Berlin in an informative yet informal manner that ensured we understood and retained the key highlights. Greatly appreciated and would recommend this tour, which provides a great experience, and great value.
Thank you Nathan.
We enjoyed an excellent tour of Berlin with Kathryn. She was extremely knowledgable and enjoyable to chat to and we definitely learned a lot. Thanks again for a fun morning!

We had an excellent guide and a great tour, which made our walking tour a huge plus. We were given a good overview of Berlin, both East and West. The weather couldn’t have been nicer, so walking was the perfect opportunity for the day. Many places of interest was pointed out, and we returned to a few that we wanted to visit in more detail.
This was one of the highlights of my time in Berlin. Our guide, Rick, really knew his stuff and engaged well with the group. The tour is astonishingly good value. I can’t recommend it enough.

Maria, our friendly guide gave us a really interesting, knowledgeable and informative tour of Berlin. Having lived through the 'Berlin Wall' days we learned SO MUCH about the city's history as well as all the changes that have and are taking place. We thoroughly recommend this tour.

Xavier made us love Berlin even more! Not our first time here but we learnt a lot about Berlin troublesome history. A good combination of history and modern everyday life. We visited some places that we wouldn't have found on our own! Recommended

We took the 9am tour which is less crowded and walked with a group of about 14 total. Kevin gave us an extremely informative introduction to Berlin, mostly in the more interesting former East Berlin - Museum Island, Bebelplatz, Gendarmerie Square, Checkpoint Charlie, Holocaust memorial and ending up at the Brandenburg gate. By the end of the tour, we had orientated ourselves to explore on our own and also came to understand not only 20th century history better than ever before but also a pretty clear understanding of the previous thousand years. Quite a feat in 4 hours.

Whilst we would usually opt for a smaller group tour, the guide was excellent imparting his knowledge without an audio system. Although we had already covered some of the areas ourselves Ryan provided so much information in an interesting way we would highly recommend the tour company and guide

Went on 2 walking tours of Berlin. Firstly with John who did the famous walk. It was terrific and he really covered the whole history of Berlin even with his awful jokes
I also went on the third reich tour with Barnaby who was also brilliant and covered everything in depth with great compassion
All in all i would suggest the Insiders walking tours are a must do for anyone visiting Berlin

We spent four hours with Lynsey (and about 25 other people) getting the low-down on the Mitte part of Berlin. Lynsey was exceptional about explaining the history navigating the group through Mitte/Berlin - two thumbs up! While 27 people makes for a largish group, we had no issues hearing her lively explanation the area. I'd recommend this tour as one of the first activities to orient yourself to Berlin.

This tour was excellent. Our guide was Sam and he explained things really well and in enough detail. I felt we covered lots in a short time which is exactly what we wanted to do as we were only in Berlin for 3 days. I would highly recommend this tour and Sam our guide.

I had been to Berlin many years ago during the cold war and never returned until my partner had booked us a trip to Berlin.

We picked the 14:00 tour schedule and meet in Hackescher Markt. Our guide was Xavier - a Frenchman at that who spoke very good English ;)

He was an excellent tour guide. Funny, Whitty, Helpful, full of knowledge and very approachable. When asked numerous questions regarding Berlin by the group he would know the answer. The tour is somewhat lengthy, but plenty of stops and a quick bite to eat allows you to recharge the batteries so to speak.

For the price of this tour it is a fantastic price and very well recommended.

Tour covered everything I expected and more. Rob is amazing, you can tell he is very well prepares by the way his in-detail explanations.

Totalitario recommending to family and friends.

I took the Discover Berlin and Hitler´s Germany tour with the Original Berlin Walks. This is one of the best activities I´ve done in Berlin. It was very informative, I learned a lot in these tours -- actually, I started liking the city more after the tour. Our guide in both tours, Rick, exceeded our expectations -- he is really interested in Berlin, he knows a lot about Germany and the historical events that took place in the city. It was really really helpful! I would recommend this tour for anyone visiting the city!

We had an amazing few hours with Georgia, very knowledgeable about Berlin and its history. very approachable and wonderful manor.

Couldn't have wished for a better tour guide and would highly recommend this as an introduction to berlin.

Gareth, Pete, Claire (Hull, UK)

Interesting and informative tour from Kyle who pitched it at the correct level. Took in all the must see landmarks and provided useful background information. Tour lasted about 3.5 hours - started at Hackersmarket and finished at the Brandenburg gate

Xavier was extremely helpful and extremely knowledgeable during this tour. I highly recommend this trip to anyone who is looking for someone who understands local history and enjoys sharing his knowledge.

Ideal way to spend our first day in Berlin. Rachel was excellent, very knowledgeable and professional.
We recommend this tour to any Berlin newbies like us.

The four hour tour with Kai was a good balance between walking and talking! Our teenaged daughter said she found it more interesting than any history class she had ever taken. There is a mid tour break for coffee and pastry. A great way to see a lot of historical Berlin on foot, especially if your time is limited.

I was on a very short trip to Berlin so didn't expect to see that much of the city but this tour was amazing! I saw pretty much all the major cultural and historical landmarks in a mere 4 hours. Our tour guide Jonny was excellent and I really enjoyed the tour!

My wife and I went on a small group tour two weeks ago upon our visit to Berlin. Our guide, Matt, was basically a walking encyclopedia of Berlin and German history. Not only did we get to see many parts of the city that we wouldn't have otherwise, but we gained an appreciation and knowledge of the turbulent past of Berlin.

I would strongly suggest that tourists go on this tour during your first or second day in Berlin, since it gives some context and historical insight into the city.

If you want to learn more about Berlin, this is the tour to go on. As comprehensive as it is, the time goes fast because there is so much to see.

With limited time that I had, I am glad that I was able to join this tour .
Rachel is the name of our tour guide. I have to say that I did not find her super friendly but it's ok . She was competent and professional. I guess i did not find her " warm".
But I would still do this tour again.

Had a brilliant walking tour with guide Rob Shaw today. This was an informative and good humoured tour with Rob. He spoke about German History from Frederick the Great through to the Berlin Wall. This.walk is a great introduction to Berlin especially if you have never been here before. Highly recommend.
Went with a group of people who had never been overseas before, and had a great time. Our guide was Xavier and he was awesome.

Our guide, Matt, was very knowledgeable and the tour covered so many aspects of Berlin. Matt pointed out places which would be good to visit later and also provide excellent tips and advice on Berlin in general. The tour was very detailed. Thanks very much. Highly recommended

This is our first visit to Berlin, and this tour was a wonderful introduction to the historical and political context, country and region. Our guide Gregor was very articulate and knowledgable about dates, names and cultural events. He put current day into historical perspective, beginning withe the Prussians, then onto WWI, the rise of the Third Reich, WWII, division of Berlin and ending with the current situation.. He encouraged this rather large and diverse group to think and analyze many of the "facts". He presented multiple views through his engaging humor and wit. In the end, it was a year long history lesson in just four hours. Highly recommended.

This is a great introduction to the sights in Berlin. If you are lucky Linsey will be your guide. She was very knowledgeable about the places we visited, kept a good pace but not too fast, found the shade when possible, had a brief break in the middle, and gave out plenty of good information about the main sights and how to get into the various museums and other places she took us too. Very much worth the price. Best intro tour of a city I have ever had. The guide map that was given out is very handy too.

Our tour guide Alice the Scottish princess was amazing. Had so much insight into everything and though it was the middle of the day and really hot it was incredible. I would highly recommend this tour for anyone traveling to Berlin. Things to be cautious of you will be on foot the whole time so wear comfortable shoes & clothes bring some snacks and water if doing this in the summer.

On arrival in Berlin, we did try to find the Brandenburg Gate - but to no avail. However, we had pre-booked a walking tour through Tripadvisor for 2pm on the first day. Meeting was easy, leader was a lovely person with thorough knowledge of the main tourist points, and she understood that the weather was HOT! Glad I had comfortable footwear, because we were out from 2pm to 6pm! It was amazing! She knew the shortcuts, the shady corners for explaining things, and could answer every question! Also knew a good place for a rest, drink and toilet break. Really got a feel for the history of Berlin, far more than the bit between 1939 and 1945. The next day, we revisited some of the sites to have a closer look - were delighted that we found them all again. Would definitely recommend this tour - just be ready to do a fair bit of walking. Much more detail than a bus or boat tour.

We went on this 4-hour tour on the first morning we had in Berlin. It was the perfect way to get to grips with the historic centre of the city and to orientate ourselves for the rest of the trip. It covered almost all the major sights we had in mind, which meant we didn't have to worry about seeing everything for the rest of the holiday. Our tour guide was Rick, who was clearly very knowledgeable, gave a great description of the history behind each part of the city and showed a fantastic sense of humour along the way. It was a very hot day and he made sure we were in shade if we stopped to talk about something and had a break where people could get something to eat/drink nearby. He was also more than happy to give recommendations regarding restaurants and museums etc. at the end of the tour. I highly recommend this walking tour.

We did this tour on our first morning in Berlin and it was a great way to learn a bit about this fascinating city and see some of the key sites. Our tour guide, Rob from Manchester, was entertaining and informative - it was obvious that he had genuine interest in and knowledge about the city and its history. Highly recommended!

Our walking tour was most definitely the highlight of our mini-break in Berlin. Our guide Gregor led the tour at a perfect pace, and the information he delivered was both fascinating and thought-provoking. If you are visiting Berlin I would highly recommend doing this tour early on in your stay as it provides a fantastic insight to both the history and geography of the city that will allow you to enjoy (and plan!) the rest of your trip even more.

Our guide, Kevin was obviously an expert in the history and politics of Berlin. This meant he really drew out the light and shade of this beautiful, complicated and compelling city. At four hours, the tour is quite long especially in the heat of summer but this also means it’s real value for money. Kevin made sure we stopped in the shade and had a break whenever we needed to re-water too. I have had walking tours in other cities and this was by far the best in terms of quality of the guide and the itinerary chosen. I can’t recommend this too highly. Thank you Kevin

Excellent few hours spent in the company of Jamie our tour guide. Can’t believe how knowledgeable one person can be, and he made each stop interesting, answered all questions asked if him by the others in the tour plus made the whole tour an amazing experience. Highly recommended.

My girlfriend from Hamburg and myself (USA) decided to do this walking tour to get to know more about the city. It definitely did not disappoint. Our guide Kevin was very knowledgeable about the area, and the tour was very interactive. Kevin had a history background and had studied and lived in Berlin for over 9 years and it showed. His passion and fascination with the controversial nature of the city was apparent and well received. I would highly recommend it to people who want to walk and see and learn more about this city's rich history.

A friend and I did this tour on Saturday with Rick as our tour guide. I cannot praise him highly enough - his knowledge of Berlin was extensive and was conveyed in an interesting and clear way. There were a lot of facts but he managed to retain our interest throughout. We learnt a lot. The walking speed was brisk but not overly so and there were plenty of stops. As a guide to others considering booking, my friend and I are 68 and 71 respectively and had no difficulty at all with this half day tour.

It was our first day in the city and we decided to take the walking tour to get round the major sites and get a good idea of the layout of the city, this tour did exactly that and more.

Our guide Jess was able to give great information about all of the sites while also providing images to help give more insight and perspective. He was very well informed and encouraged the group to ask questions giving a more unique experience.

I would strongly recommend this tour.

Took about 4 hours, with a 25 minute break in the middle. Walking was done on the faster side of a leisurely pace.

We just had the most enjoyable and historically rich 4 hrs walking tour of Berlin with our guide Xavier.
My teenagers kids (and nephew) and myself were so pleased (but most of the time sad) to learn so much about the past as well as the present of Berlin.
We appreciated all the historical references.
We will definitely recommend Xavier.
Coumba, Nandi, Ilan from Luxembourg and Malick from Paris

We took this walking tour with Gregor as guide. He was very informative, had excellent knowledge and a great presentation style. He invited a two way exchange and answered everyone's questions. He was able to provide a real Berliner,s insight into the history of the city and the conflicts and issues over the past 70+ years.
The tour covered most of the sights and was a great way of orientation oneself to the city. Highly recommended.

Just completed the half day tour with our guide Xavier. Xavier was extremely engaging and discussed with great fluidility and knowledge the history of the city, both the high’s and the low’s. We would thoroughly recommend anyone to take the tour.

This is first time I have joined a walking tour visiting an European city. We joined July 11 1400 Discover Berlin. Knowing very little about Germany and Berlin decided to take the walking tour. The tour was really great. Xavier gave a whirlwind history of Berlin during the walk. He made Berlin come alive with the walk and talk. My son Jonathan(12 yrs) also enjoyed the tour immensely. The conversations with the guide and other travelers from various countries made the afternoon very memorable.

I took the afternoon half day tour with Marriette, and she was fantastic. She has been guiding for more than a decade and clearly knew her history of the city...but not only that, she was able to logically and clearly explain it as we went from point to point. She did a wonderful job with providing the overall historical story, and partnered that with with fun facts and a sense of humor that really made the trip interesting at every point. I would definitely recommend this to anyone arriving to the city to get a preliminary overview of key areas....you get so much more out of it than if you were to just walk around from point to point on your own. Thank you!

Did this tour on a short visit in Berlin late June. Our guide was Darren and he was so knowledgeable and gave us so much information as we walked to the major sites in former East Berlin up to the Berlin Wall. He went over and above what I would expect from a tour guide and I would highly recommend this tour and guide Darren. Thank you.

We took this tour more with idea to get our bearings in Berlin, but Jess was an incredible guide. His knowledge of not just berlin history, but how it tied into the rest of the world at the time was awesome. He made it easy to follow and gave great background for some very heavy material, not making it overly sad, even though obvious inherent tendency to that given nature of events. Incredible tour!

My son and I did the tour on our third and final morning in Berlin. Although we had seen many of the sites over the previous three days, our guide Rachel brought them to life. Rachel gave an excellent overview of German history and used maps and photographs to support her commentary and explanations. She spoke clearly and ensured that everyone could hear what she was saying. The tour moved at a good pace and we stopped halfway at a nice cafe for refreshments and to use the facilities. Rachel was detailed and authentic and full of interesting facts and information and my son and I both came away knowing a lot about this wonderful city and its often turbulent history. At the end of the tour Rachel was willing to offer suggestions and ideas as to what else to see and do. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting the city for the first time or someone who would like to know more about its history.

I’d say that the tour is a must do for a first timer in Berlin who are interested in German history. We are fortunate to have Rob Shaw as our guide. Rob is himself very interested in German history and told a lot of interesting background facts and stories about Germany in WW II and Cold War. The tour also gives worthwhile ideas on where to visit in the coming couple days. We won’t be wasting time to do too tourist spots. Highly recommended.
Can’t recommend enough. Our guide Nathan was excellent and gives you a real understanding of Berlin.

We did this spontaneously as we saw the guides standing in the street by the Zoo Station, and we were not expecting it to be so informative and exciting. Julian, our guide, was super interesting and knew lots of facts about pretty much everything to do with Berlin. We had a few people ask very specific questions in the group and he handled them very well. Top marks, highly recommend!

Ryan was our Tour guide, and he was fab, talked and showed us the history of Berlin. He was great, very friendly, looked out for us all and answered all the questions we asked. The walk was really interesting, with a break in between, it didn't even feel like 3.5 hours!

Kai was our guide. I really can't recommend this tour enough, we had only half a day in Berlin so really wanted to ensure we saw the highlights. Kai was incredibly knowledgeable, with an excellent sense of humour. He took us to all of the places we would have chosen to visit, but his expert knowledge meant that we could fit everything in and the information he gave us about each location was so much more than we could ever have hoped to learn had we attempted to do the tour ourselves. The tour is excellent value for money. If we'd had more time in Berlin we would have gone back to some of the areas we visited and definitely plan to go back!

We were lucky to have Xavier as our guide on our Discover Berlin tour. A Frenchman telling us all about Berlin in English? Yes, and the most knowledgeable guide. A cheerful leader. The tour itself covers the main sites in the city that most tourists would want to see and Xavier gave us the background to understand their significance. Be sure to wear your walking shoes as it covers a lot of ground. Value for the money for sure.
Rob Shaw was a wonderful guide, passionate about Berlin and full of fascinating information. Didn't waste a minute and felt we got more than our money's worth. Highly recommend this tour.

This was our first day in Berlin and despite some basic research we wanted a much clearer overview of the city’s considerable history.
Our guide was Rob Shaw, and he took us on a deeply detailed chronological tour of the history of Berlin. Put very simply, what Rob does not know about Berlin and it’s deep history is simply not worth knowing!
The tour was fantastic - at times amusing, at other times emotional and occasionally eerie- exactly what all the tourists attending the tour wanted. The quality of Robs delivery is excellent whilst he maintains an openness about his research and work which allows all tourists the chance to ask questions and learn so much more.
Highly highly recommend the tour and in particular Rob Shaw the tour guide.

Paul & Rachel

We learnt so much on our 4 hour walking tour, we are still talking about it. Our guide, Jess was originally from L.A but now studying in Berlin. What he did not know, was not worth knowing about. If you want a potted guide to Berlin from centuries ago to the present day, go on this tour. It was informative, thoughtful, humorous and so enjoyable.

It was a delightful experience, with Xavier our tour guide bringing alive every place of significance with his vivid commentary. He managed to talk us through german history in the most fun way possible, connecting buildings and places to culture and symbology and what makes Berlin the truly wonderful city it is. Highly recommended!

I’m a big fan of walking tours, they’re a great way to get orientated to a city and learn its history. This walking tour definitely helped. Our guide Mike was friendly, made an effort to get to know everyone and was very informative.
