I was lucky that this particular time slot only had about 10 people which meant we could chat/ask more questions. I’m pretty sure he also spent longer than he needed to on the tour which I appreciated!

The tour covered a lot of important sites in Berlin and Mike, while not a native had lots of great stories which made it all the more interesting - things I may not have pieced together from reading a website/guide books. Given that it covered quite an extensive area you may not have a lot of time at each place to wonder around and take photos, but I went back the next day to some of the places I liked the most to spend more time. One thing I would have liked (from my previous experience in Amsterdam), is having a local guide as there’s a whole new dimension from having grown up in the city. However, I must say Mike did a fantastic job and the inner history buff in me was very satisfied!

Thanks to our tour guide, Rick! I counted 7 times I got the chills from living in the moment of his informative, clear and detailed history (Mainly from Hitler's bunker to the Holocaust Memorial.) Reminding us the day-to-day process, he is knowledgeable and very attentive. We had a great group last week, it was bright & sunny, great start for an overview of the great city of Berlin. --Stay hydrated folks, remind yourself it's summer & walking shoes will be needed for a good 4 hours! Thanks again Rick, that was pretty fun.

We really enjoyed this half-day walking tour with Kai! He was incredibly knowledgeable about all of the rich history Berlin has to offer on this tour. Although 4 hours sounds like a long time for a tour, it really does fly by and could easily be twice as long to see everything. Kai gave us a great overview of all of the important sites, answered any/all questions and made recommendations for the rest of our time in the city as well. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to learn more about this great city!

A walking tour of a new city is always the first thing we do. This one is EXCELLENT. start point is easy to find right opposite S Bahn station. Nathan our guide was very knowledgeable and the 4 hour walk was packed with sights and information. A must do as far as we are concerned and i would heartily recommend this one.

We did the half day walking tour and thought it was great and really good value for money. Nathan our tour guide was great (we decided not to hold the fact that he was American against him!) he was very knowledgable and obviously new the city very well. It was great to have a guide who spoke English as a mother tongue as it can be difficult straining to understand European English. The tour is put together as a walkthrough of German history through its landmarks. If you want to see all of Berlin’s modern sites and architecture this isn’t the tour for you. The 4 hours went by very quickly and was broken up by frequent stops to listen to Nathan’s explanations so even though it was a very hot sunny day it wasn’t that strenuous. It brought back many memories from studying ww1/2 at school and was a great re fresher on the period. We went to all the key landmarks plus a few hidden gems we wouldn’t otherwise have visited or noticed. Nathan pointed out things that were worth visiting as well as those that weren’t and was really friendly and at ease with everyone. There was 20 in the group and we both really enjoyed it and would definitely recommend.

Xavier was a very well-informed guide. He was clear, had a broad base of knowledge, had a good sense of humor, and yet provided the appropriate seriousness this city requires, given its complicated history.

We had (Aussie) Dave as our guide, he was engaging, informative and a really nice guy. We thoroughly enjoyed the tour and only wish we'd been able to do it earlier in our stay!

The tour moves at a reasonable pace, Dave's recommendations for local places to go to is really useful and the history element is comprehensive all round.

Thoroughly recommended!

Just been on a walking tour with our guide Kyle and what a tour full of local knowledge, excellent historical facts about Berlin, me and wife who isn't one for history really enjoyed it and learning about the modern history of Berlin. If one wants to know the historical landmarks of Berlin & about Berlin itself it's a must.

Ken is very informative. Ken is very personable. Ken is Irish and Ken is very funny. But beware, elderly people, Ken walks fast. Would I recommend this half-day walking tour? I sure would! It was a blast!

Among all the travel experiences that I've had across the world, this one was the icing on the cake. Guide was Jess, a history major from Berkeley who was doing his post grad at that time in Berlin. Beyond words I should say. You feel like taken through Germany from Bismarck's time to the fall of Berlin wall.

If I ever visit Berlin again, this is something that I won't miss.

I enjoyed every second of the tour. The guide was entertaining and very passionate, with lot's of details and background information. I was only 2 days in Berlin so I unfortunately could not visit the other tours, but I definitely would now! Amazing day in Berlin with a nice and interesting group. Thanks for the great time!

Rachel, our guide, was really excellent. The group was about 15-18 people but she literally corralled us close to hear her presentation at the 15 or so stops we made. She took us from before there was a Germany to present day. The route was about 3.5 miles, flat and easy to negotiate but did cover a lot of important ground. She is quite the historian and the level of detail she supplied made us want to delve deeper At almost each of the stops, but particularly the period 1930 through the war and then to present day. Really fascinating. I’d use these guys Again. Moving visit to the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe. Thoughtful discussion.

This was a superb 4 hour walk that took place on Monday 30 April 2018, which ended up taking 5 hours to complete! This was due to the excellent tour that XAVIER gave us. He was so enthusiastic about the various locations we visited and was full of interesting information. He kept our attention riveted throughout the walk, and we were sorry that the walk ended, even after 5 hours, as we could have gone on listening to XAVIER for much longer!! We will certainly be booking another tour with you the next time we are in Berlin. David and Hazel
We had a great tour from Ken the Legend! He told us the story of Berlin with lots humor. We learned a lot!

This is a brilliant thing to do on your first day in Berlin. Our guide Jim was fantastic - hugely passionate and knowledgable about Berlin past and present, and his chat was pretty funny too! It covers loads of ground - literally - so wear a good pair of trainers as it’s 4 hour walk with a short break in the middle. Well worth the time and money and set us up for a great weekend in Berlin.

We thoroughly enjoyed our walking tour with Xavier. He has a wealth of knowledge and presented it with interest and passion. What makes his guiding unique is that he shares anecdotes and personal experiences that enhance the visitor's experience and challenges us to delve a little deeper, reflect on history in terms of the present.

He interacts well with tour guests and ensures that everyone is able to keep up and not get lost. His sense of humour, his willingness to answer questions and provide additional suggestions and assistance beyond the scope of the tour are a testament to his enthusiasm for his work.

This will be remembered as a highlight of our time in Berlin.

We were a family group of 9 of all ages and interests and each one of us was captivated for the full 4 hours by Kevin's passionate delivery of lots of fascinating information about Berlin.

Although we covered a lot of ground, the walking was split up in to manageable sections with points of interest at each stop. Main highlights were the Brandenburg gate, Reichstag, Jewish Memorial, Berlin Cathedral and the Berlin Wall.

Our walk was from 10.30am to 2.30pm. The meeting point was in an area full of cafes so we found it was well worth getting there a wee bit early (no last minute panics on the tube) in order to have a coffee before we set off. We had a quick stop for lunch too.

This tour really opened our eyes to some of the history both pre-war and post-war and it also helped us to decide which areas to go back to over the next few days.

Well worth it!

We often do guided tours of cities as a good way of getting an overview, this tour 'Discovering Berlin' was much more informative & detailed than you usually get. Our guide Nathan was knowledgeable about the history & the sights & empathetic to the cities past events. Don't visit Berlin without doing this tour - you'll miss a lot.
Kevin ran a very well presented tour. He was very knowledgeable and easily understood within a large group. I would high recommend this for people traveling to berlin

A very informative, well organised tour. The tour guide gave a well researched, well balanced account of the historical context and explained each of the sites in a way that could be easily comprehended by everyone. There was plenty of time to ask questions and to reflect at some of the more sombre sites, so it never felt rushed, but it did include a very comprehensive tour. Definitely recommended - do this on your first day and then return to the places you want to visit in more depth

We spent 4 hours in the company of the incredibly knowledgeable Kevin, albeit in the freezing sleet! The tour is an absolute must, we learned so much about beautiful Berlin, Kevin really brought the city to life for us. the pace was just right, the information was just enough, never long-winded or dull. We thoroughly enjoyed it.

If you go to Berlin you must start your journey with this amazing walking tour, so you learn about Berlin's History and see the main points of the City. My guide was Pip, a british wonderful young lady who was amazing guiding us through Berlin and explaining to the detail everything we saw!

An excellent way to discover Berlin. Our guide Ken, was obviously knowledgeable and brought the right mix of humour and fact to the tour. The walk was at a reasonable pace and covered many of the main sites. Highly recommended.
This was a great way to explore the city on foot and learn a ton while doing it! Our guide was fun, enthusiastic and super knowledgable. We really enjoyed this tour and would recommend it to anyone!

Laura, our guide was very well informed and told us in an enthusiastic and passionate way about Berlin. For me as a german (tous in german were not available at this time, so i took an english tour) it was very interesting to see her point of view about Berlin.
I WOULD DEFINITELY RECOMMEND THIS TOUR.

We had a couple of days in Berlin and wanted to get in as much as possible. It was bitter cold but our awesome guide Ken got us through it! It was a great introduction to the city and Ken was extremely knowledgeable and super approachable. I'm not sure I could have lasted the tour without Ken. He was funny, easy going and full of information. Thank you Ken for showing us such an amazing city. I will be back.....just not in March!

Despite the bitter cold, the half day tour was totally enjoyable with the wonderful Barnaby as our guide. Thorough, informative and with lots of humor - Barnaby clearly knows his history and loves his adopted city. A great overview, wish I had done the tour at the beginning of my stay here.

I did this tour with my wife on Monday 12th March 2018. The weather was, sadly, awful. However the tour guide (Xavier) was so enthusiastic and interesting that this hardly seemed to matter. The tour lasted for 5 hours but it was so enjoyable that it seemed much shorter. All the stuff I really wanted to see was included and Xavier gave a first class account of the history of the city as we went. Highly recommended !

We did the half day walking tour in Berlin even though it was raining it was a great day. The trip turned into 5 hours of walking with Xavier our group leader who made it interesting and fun with his little stories and antidotes along the way. Would highly recommend it’s a great way to see a city.

Nathan was fabulous! Best way to see the city in half a morning. Absolutely loved it! He had so much knowledge, knew how to deliver the info, ensured we had the best views and really made coming to Berlin for a quick 48 hour getaway worth while!

This is a must do for the Berlin visitor. Its easy to get to the start point on the train or tram. Its a full value 4 hour trip cram jammed with information. About 70 people turned up and we were split into three groups so just enough people to be able to hear all the commentary. Our guide was Kyle who gave us a great outing. She moved us along in a lively manner and was excellent with the updates and background to the attractions we saw. Her commentary was very balanced, nothing was glossed over and she encouraged us to look at all sides of the issues we came across. We had time in the middle for a toilet break and refreshments and the group was disciplined to stick together and there were no delays. I note most folks who take the trouble to write a review compliment their guides highly which indicates the tour company have it spot on. If you do nothing else in Berlin do this.

We had a great day out and learned a lot about Berlin’s past. Our tour guide Kevin was incredibly knowledgeable about the history of Berlin and conveyed this in a way we could all understand, he was also a lovely guy and very funny! Even though the weather was absolutely freezing I think we were all a bit sad when the tour ended.
Very informative tour and very amusing. I highly recommend this tour. Covered all the sites I wanted to see. Brilliant!

This was my first walking tour ever and I couldn’t have had a better guide, Dave from Australia, for this! His knowledge on the history of Berlin was impressive and his way of explaining things was very clear and entertaining. The stops are absolute must see in Berlin and you get to see many of them on this tour. Highly recommend it!

Nathan our guide gives an excellent presentation of Berlin, Although from the US, he has extensive historical knowledge of the city, and is passionate about his subject. He gives a gives a particularly poignant talk at the Memorial to the Murdered Jews..plenty to reflect on. Would highly recommend.

We had a great tour with Gregor! We loved how our tour included lots of context and information that made the sites come alive. We also loved that Gregor asked thought-provoking questions and gave us the opportunity to think, process, and internalize. It was a fantastic experience!

We have had a wonderful working tour today, and KAI is our Guide who has a wealth of knowledge, good experience and full of passion. This is really a good Start of our visiting in Berlin.
Thanks a lot, KAI!

An excellent walk informative and extremely interesting. Nathan our guide was superb, humerous and full of knowledge. He was friendly and extremely approachable and the four of us would recommend Nathan and the walk to friends back home in West Yorkshire, England.
Thank you Nathan for our wonderful experience and for making our break in Berlun great!

Nathan, our guide, was excellent in every respect. Clearly spoken, friendly and most informative. A good teacher, he paced the walk and talk superbly and used his humour to good effect. He kept our full attention throughout and gave a very skillful summary and explanation of complex political issues as well as explaining the relevance and importance of the sights we visited. A most enjoyable introduction to Berlin.

On a cold and snowy day in Berlin, we were greeted with Xavier. He was knowledgeable, answered any question and brought a lot of humour to our tour. Couldn't recommend this tour enough, gives you so much knowledge and history of Berlin. Would recommend doing this tour at the start of your stay as it shows you where everything is on your trip and the history behind it. You can then pick and chose which you'd like to go back to at a later date, Couldn't recommend enough and if you're lucky enough to get Xavier you'll have a blast.

We went on this very well organised trip with Nathan as the guide.It was really informative and put into context the varied history of Berlin.Nathan was able to point out the remarkable events this City had undergone and shared some personal experiences which made the walk more poignant about how war can effect generations
Good walk thoroughly recommended

I can definitely see why this tour is number 1 on TripAdvisor! Xavier was an amazing guide, everything you'd want; really interesting, great stories, very knowledgeable, sensitive on difficult subjects and very funny on others, loves questions and willing to give lots of advice on the best places to go in Berlin. The tour goes to the essential must see places and the timing at each is perfect. It's the best overview of the city for those with not a lot of time and Xavier gives lots of suggestions of where to spend more time if you have it. Dress very warmly if you're going in February but the weather won't detract from how good the experience will be.

Doing a walking tour of Berlin in February is probably not ideal. However our tour guide Xavier took the chill right out of the air by telling us the back story on each place of interest. His depth of knowledge and genuine passion for the history of Berlin was informative, engaging and entertaining. Great guide, great tour, great value

Feel obliged to write a review after a wonderful half day tour courtesy of Xavier. Enthusiastic, informative and engaging his passion shone through. I have friends visiting in a fortnight and have already recommended this tour 10/10.

Hi just returned from Berlin and did this walking trip on Sunday 4 February 2018 @ 10:30am. It was cold and dry and our guide was Xavier - Brilliant !! Very informative and he knew his stuff inside out. He was funny and serious when he needed to be as some of the sights/places were from bad times in Berlin. Would highly recommend and in fact would say Don’t visit Berlin without doing this it was so good total value for money. The coffee stop was great as well. Thank you Xavier.

I would highly recommend this walking tour, well organised, it covered all the relevant areas and sights, Wouter was an excellent guide, very enthusiastic and knew all there was to know. The hot drink and cake stop was very welcome half way into the tour as it was so cold!

Just got back from a very informative guide Xavier very knowledgeable . It was very cold an we stopped for coffee and cake before continuing on an absolutely wonderful unforgettable tour Xavier made it a great experience.
Half day walking tour was great! Interesting and informative! Xavier was a great tour guide - animated and enthusiastic. Would recommend!

I can't recall the name of our tour guide, but he was from Manchester, UK. He was wonderful. The tour provided a great overview of the city and its history. The tour guide also gave us a good feel for Berliners and how they view life, politics, and their own history. It was one of the best walking tours we've been on. Would definitely recommend!

AMAZING TOUR. Easy to find the meeting point. Learnt so much, saw loads. Never felt rushed. Well planned and my guild was amazing not only was she knowledgeable she was funny and a nice lady! i would highly recommend this tour. I new very little about Berlin when i came to the city and i left knowing so much!!! My guild was kyle she was awesome!!!

If you have never been to Berlin we hadn't this walk is a must Jonathan our guide was very knowledgeable took his time there was no moving on from any particular site before he had given an in depth background there was time to ask questions and Jonathan always had the dates facts and figures to hand. It was informal in depth thought provoking and even though it was four hours of walking (nice break at Checkpoint Charlie) the end at the Brandenburg Gate in darkness a must. Would use this company and Jonathan again.

It think it would be very difficult for a guide to hold the attention of a walking tour group in January, but Wouter was able to do this with aplomb. The 4 hours went by really fast with him. He told compelling stories that grabbed your attention and made you forget the bitter cold.

We were guided by Jonathan who made the tour around the important sites around Berlin very interesting. Not all the information was a comfortable story, but was delivered sensitively and approximately. He gave great insight into what it was like to live at different times in both sides of Berlin. Would highly recommend this tour

This walking tour was the right length, pace and exactly what we were looking for on our first day in Berlin. We learned a tremendous amount about the history of Germany, Berlin and the events leading up to and following WW II. It was a great tour--we could have gone longer!!

Ysanna's enthusiasm for this tour was infectious; she made this a fantastic experience. Ysanna held a captive audience throughout and definitely covered everything (and more) that I wanted to know about German history. While it was a fairly long tour and walk, it was well worth it!

I took the Discover Berlin Half-Day Walking Tour to learn more about the history and land marks of Berlin - it was one of the best tours I have ever taken. I walked away feeling I received an amazing crash history course of this resilient city thanks to our guide Robert M. Rob was very passionate about the city of Berlin and all the history. He had a way of connecting with the group through his stories, was very engaged, and always made sure to answer any questions. I appreciate and feel like I know Berlin so much more since Rob M's tour and would highly recommend this tour to anyway who loves history.

Great tour. Heidi knew everything about the sights and history of the city. I really appreciated her insight. Loved to see and learn about Berlin which I knew very little about beforehand. Great tour!!

For her birthday, my fiance and I visited Berlin for a couple of days, and decided that we wanted to use the limited time we had in the city as efficiently as possible, so we booked onto this walking tour of the city. Our guide, Jess, offered a very detailed history of the city, as well as allowing for interaction with the other people on the tour over their thoughts and opinions on certain aspects of the city (such as their own interpretations of the Jewish memorial and what it depicts).
The tour overran slightly, but this made it better value, and was largely due to Jess being so knowledgeable on areas as well as open to questions and discussions.

Nathan was an excellent guide during this 4-hour tour of Berlin. His thorough knowledge of Berlin's history from the Holy Roman Empire through the Cold War held our interest throughout the tour. At different points, he allowed time to reflect and take photos. We had planned to visit some of the sites ourselves, but this tour covered those and more. This tour is a must for anyone visiting Berlin. Thank you!

Our tour guide was an excellent! She was very knowledgeable about Berlin, explaining sensitive events in a factual way and allowing our group to feel comfortable with their thoughts. She was a history major in college so it was no surprise that she is in the right role as a tour guide. I would take this tour over again. It was a fantastic way to soak up Berlin. Do not pass it up!

I highly recommend this tour. Our guide, Dave was very knowledgable about everything Berlin especially the history. It was amazing to learn details and information I just would not have known if left to my own devices.

This was a very good way to spend half a day. The guide was witty and well-informed and his English was very good. We started at Alexanderplatz and ended at Brandenburg Gate. Book burning, Berlin Wall, Hitler's bunker, Checkpoint Charlie, Holocaust Memorial and much more. Good pace. Our tour did last from 10-30 to 16:00 and was billed as 3.5 hours - you can regard that as a bit long or even better value depending on how you are feeling. We regarded it as good value.

This is an excellent tour, make sure you are wearing good walking shoes! From the outset our guide Martin was clear and very informative explaining the route, sites to visit and stops. I cannot recommend Martin too highly, he has a very unique personal knowledge & experience of the city that made his narrative really live for us. He also has quite a wicked sense of humour that we loved. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and really appreciated visiting some areas that we hadn't seen before.

Scott provided a fascinating journey through Berlin's troubled history, exploring ideas and themes as much as the actual events and personalities that had shaped the city. He did so with passion and humour, making this is a thoroughly enjoyable and informative experience. Highly recommended.

Dave out tour guide had the right balance between historical information, humour and general information.

The four hour tour was very good, excellent value for money and paced just right.

Highly recommended.

Best tour I have been on, taken by an enthusiatic and knowledgeable guide Ysanne. Covered key themes in the history of Berlin and a lot of interesting information on everything we looked at. I've taken a lot of once-over-lightly tours. This was different and much appreciated.

Great tour with our guide Georgia. She was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the city and its history. She conveyed it in a lively and enjoyable manner. We can only recommend it as a very good introduction to Berlin.

Our tour guide, Georgia was so good that we asked to be in her group the following day when we toured the concentration camp. Her enthusiasm showed her love for the city. With a master's degree in German literature, history and fine arts, Georgia was genuinely interested in passing on her knowledge to us. Additionally, she was open to answering our questions about restaurants and Berlin's public transportation system and she made sure we knew how to return to our neighborhood after the tour.

Attended this half day tour. Had the pleasure of having Scott as a guide. He made an effort to introduce himself and get to know the group. His ability to recount historical fact and answer questions from the group was phenomenal.
The tour itself is excellent and I would recommend it to anyone visiting Berlin. It provides a great introduction to the city and its many great historical landmarks. I thoroughly enjoyed this tour and would recommend Scott as a guide.
Wonderful tour. Very personable and very informative. She tried to introduce herself to all 30 of us and speak with each person individually

What an experience for us. We were really blown away by how knowledgeable Dave was and even took the time to speak to each of us individually while we were on the tour to get to know us better. We could not have asked for a better tour guide than Dave and I hope anyone that plans a visit to Berlin does book this tour. It is a must and you get to know so much of the history behind all of those building we walked past. Thanks so much Dave and I hope you continue with this passion of yours as you are exceptional and one of a kind.

So, I have so much to say about this trip. First of all, I sadly only had two days in Berlin and thought this was a great way to get a basic intro. I did not get a basic intro, I got a full course! After the tour was completed, I had heard ALL periods of German and Berliner history and I felt completely satisfied.

A bit about our guide, Wouter. English is a great language, but there are not strong enough words of praise for the guide he was. I am young, but my father isn't, and we were so incredibly impressed by his knowledge and how in-depth and factual his information was that we booked a SECOND trip with him the following day to Potsdam. Never in my life have I encountered such a talented and incredible guide. He gave me such a deep appreciation of Berlin and after our two tours, I left feeling I had made the most of my time.

If I come back to Berlin again, I would take this tour with Wouter again just because it was so interesting and informative.
We took the 9am tour with Ysanne, who was an entertaining and passionate tour guide. She gave an excellent overview of the history of Berlin, and really brought the sights to life!

Jake, our tour guide, brought the past alive and connected the various events in Berlin history to each other in a seamless way; from the origins of the city up through the fall of the wall. He also personalized the city by connecting his own life as a musician and artist, to the artistic outlets offered by Berlin. We saw all the major sites and it made us want to return to explore them more deeply. Thanks Jake, for a great tour of Berlin.
Had a great tour guide who shared so much knowledge, and truly uncovered everything you need to know about Berlin!

My husband, my 17 year old son and myself took this fantastic tour. Nathan, our guide, was superbly knowledge and gave a history account that was perfectly contextualised, informative and relevant to today's political climate. I could not recommend this tour highly enough, it has definitely enhanced our holiday experience. Thank you😊
I enjoyed this tour and it provided a great overview to the history and culture of Berlin by a very passionate and engaging guide.

This was a great tour and very well done! Scott did a great job in making it fun and interesting and offered a lot of insight. It was a great way to see a lot of Berlin's "highlights" so you know what you may want to revisit later. I learned a lot on this tour, very well done.

Martin was our excellent guide today for this wonderful tour. He is a native of the Berlin area. His mastery of facts about German history, Berlin history, the Cold War (which his parents lived through in East Germany), and the aftermath of the fall of the Berlin Wall was simply amazing. He made us feel as if we were there when historic events happened. His descriptions were mesmerizing...detailed, humorous when appropriate, and unforgettable. What a fantastic way to learn all about the highlights of a complex city. As an added bonus, the tour is a great way to work exercise into your vacation. If you are lucky, Martin will be your guide.

FANTASTIC! The best tour I have ever been on. Ysanne is a born guide, full of facts, information, useful tips, thought provoking discussions. 4 full hours was not enough. We could have listened to Ysanne talk about Berlin all day. A MUST do tour for all. Well done original Berlin Walls and thank you Ysanne we are coming back 👍👍

What an awesome way to discover and explore Berlin! We booked this only the night before and the price you cannot beat. The tour ended up being closer to 4 hours versus the 3:30 advertised but I am not saying that was a bad thing AT ALL! Kyle was our guide and man did she know all of the history behind the sites. We visited a lot of the main sites like the Brandenburg Gate, Checkpoint Charlie, The Berlin Wall, Holocaust Memorial, and MANY more! Sure you have to put on your walking shoes but Kyle gave us plenty of chances to rest and even a break in the middle of the tour right by Checkpoint Charlie...which allowed us to really be tourists and get some great pictures there! Actually every location we visited on this tour we were given time to explore and take pictures! Overall this was a great tour full of a lot of knowledge that you can’t get with just exploring yourself or one of those hop on hop off bus tours. Next time we visit we will definitely look to book another tour with Original Berlin Walks!

We did the morning tour with a group of 23 English speakers led by Sam Z a dynamic Scot with a masters in history. Sam unpicked and clearly mapped out the complicated past of this historic city whilst managing to remain neutral with respect to the powerful political powers and varying viewpoints of this cities rulers and power bases. The Age of Enlightenment, with its emphasis on music, philosophy and the arts followed by war and subsequent financial impacts. The rise of fascism and the events of World War Two, leading to the division of the city and the eventual fall of the wall were all clearly laid out for us to understand. Questions were encouraged and never dismissed, Sam Z’s humour helped with some of the grimmer aspects of the cities history without demeaning the human impact of tyranny and persecution. Despite the all too frequent reminders of a divided city with a painful past Berlin has a a real sense of a modern buzzing city. Go there!!

Brilliant walking tour by Sam W - interesting and fun. Happy to answer any questions and had a detailed in depth knowledge. He clearly loved Berlin and the history of the beautiful city!!

Thank you Sam W you made our trip

Jon and Vanessa

Would highly recommend this tour. Our guide Wouter was extremely knowledgable about the history of this fascinating city. Wouter gave the back story to the sights but also made us think about what we had seen and prompted some discussion about what we thought.

The tour with Original Berlin Walk was awesome. It hit so many of the key landmarks of Berlin and gave a great overview of the city in a compact four hour tour. Our guide, Sarah, was extremely knowledgable about the city and its history and did a great job pointing out all of the landmarks of Berlin and introducing us to the city as a whole. I would highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants to see the main attractions of the city and learn about Berlin's history!
What a great way to see some of the main sites of interest in Berlin. Nathan made it a most enjoyable walk with wonderful knowledge.

The tour was incredibly well organised and our guide (Martin) provided a lot of information and entertainment not only about the sights that we visited, but also the city in general and really seemed to enjoy what he was doing. The tour will not only show you the main attractions of Berlin, but will also provide detailed historical information about them and what makes them so special.

Ysanne was an amazing guide!!! My entire group agreed that she jogged our thirst for learning about the history of Germany. She made the information very easy to understand, and the entire 4-hour tour was extremely engaging. I would highly recommend this as a first to-do in Berlin, since it provides great foundational background for a lot of the other information you'll read about in museums.
Guide was very knowledgeable however the tour was far too long - 4 hours and 45 minutes in total including a brief 20 minute coffee stop. Lost the will to live after around 3 hours.
Our Discover Berlin walking tour was informative, enjoyable and a great introduction to the city. Gregor is a very good guide indeed. Highly recommended.
I would highly recommend this Tour to anyone visting Berlin for the first time. Jess was incredibly knowledegable, passionate, and engaging. It was the highlight of our visit to this great City.
Sam Z was our guide He was excellent! Very knowledgeable! If time for only one activity this is a must!

This walking tour met all my expectations and more. Wouter was very knowledgeable and articulate. This is so much better than just "sightseeing" - all the historical context and anecdotes truly brought Berlin to life. I especially liked the artistic take Wouter had on certain buildings and memorials - challenging us to not just observe, but interpret. Beyond understanding Berlin, it made me appreciate contemporary art more. 100% would recommend!

if you want to learn about Berlin - facts, stories, numbers and atmosphere, this is the tour!
Kai was our tour guide, he is an intelligent guide, knowledgeable, accurate and his loud and clear voice made our tour.

Great walking tour with Kyle. She's very knowledgeable and personable. Great value - we saw and learnt lot. Ideal way for us to get to know the city and its history in just a few hours. All enjoyed it including teenagers aged 13 and 17.

Ken was our tour guide from Original Berlin Walks, and he made the tour engaging, entertaining and informative. We covered major historical sites in Berlin, and Ken has his own style of narration by showing us the historical pictures associated to the sites we visited. He had great knowledge on the history of Germany along with great sense of humor, and made us feel the worth of the 4 hr tour. I definitely recommend this tour esp. with guide like Ken who brings in lot of knowledge and information onto the tour. Thanks much Ken..!
The tour was awesome! Scott was a great tour guide and I really enjoyed how interactive he was with the group!
Excellent start to our holiday. Dave was very knowledgeable and engaged the group well. Also, the map with recommendations he provided was a great touch. Would definitely recomend.

Ken was our tour guide, he was funny and engaging. The tour itself hit most of the major sites and have us a good idea of what we wanted to explore in greater depth afterwards. I can't recommend it enough.
We had an excellent tour of Berlin led by Lynsey. It was brilliant - really fun and informative, and we learned a lot.

An interesting and informative walking tour, which lasted approximately 4 hours. Our guide, Jake, had a huge depth of knowledge and was able to answer every question that was thrown at him. An excellent way to get to know Berlin.

The great experience was because of our very energetic guide "Isanne". Izzy provided the group with sooooo much information it was almost mind blowing. She really knows her stuff!
Only one slight negative was that we were not actually taken through the main part (middle) of the Brandenburg Gates, rather, Izzy took up through a side gate but after the tour I went back and walked through the Gate (arch) from one side to the other and back again - after all that is part the reason why I went to Berlin.

Aside form that great job Izzy!!
A fun and efficient way to see (almost) all the major sites in Berlin! Our guide Ken was a lot of fun

I highly recommend going on a walking tour of Berlin as one of the first things you do when coming to the city. It will help give you context and will orient you to places you'd like to explore further. We went with Original Berlin Walks and our guide was excellent. Dave Y coincidentally happened to be from the same city where we are from, which was instant synchronicity. His background in German Literature lent depth to the tour, and he handled the difficult aspects of German history with sensitivity and thoughtfulness.

Five friends and I did a walking tour of Berlin last weekend. Our tour guide's name was Kyle. Kyle told us that we could ask her any question we liked. The question I asked was how did it feel to do a job you loved? From the moment the tour started it was obvious that our tour was going to be excellent. This was my third trip to Berlin and I wish that I had done this tour before now. The tour takes about 4 hours, I really enjoyed the crash course in Germany History at the start of the tour. It brought me back to my high school days and learning about Bismark. This tour is a must do in Berlin. You see many important historical landmarks and our tour guide explained events and brought history to life. The six of us definitely enjoyed it. Thank you Kyle.

Our guide was Ysanne and she was brilliant, very very knowledgeable and she certainly gave you cause for thought about the monuments,statues and buildings that we saw, not only that but also about the history of the city.

Our guide Gerard was fantastic. His passion for history and politics and academia shone through - and our 4 hour tour lasted closer to 5 - although it felt much shorter as we were so engrossed.
Great value at €14 each - simple online purchase with TripAdviser.

Would recommend to all.

We booked this tour for our first day so we could get our bearings and see the main sights. We were not disappointed. Our guide Kathryn was fantastic, very knowledgeable and told us loads of interesting facts and information about the history of Berlin and Germany.
My kids are aged 13 and 11, and although it was a long tour ( almost 4 hours ) they loved it too.
She answered all the questions with ease, would highly recommend this tour!!!
Rick, our American tour guide was friendly, knowledgeable and was very informative overall. Would highly recommend him again and this tour. A bit of walking but no hills or difficult terrain.
This was an excellent walking tour, and particular thanks to our guide, Georgia who was both informative and entertaining. I take a lot of walking tours and this is one of the best I have been on
Great experience. Scott was very informative and knowledgeable. He encouraged group participation and kept at a good pace.

Great walking tour with a funny guide called Ken. Well organised, thoughtful, interesting and informative!Great way to see the main sites and get an overview of the city and the history. We were then able to go back the next day and visit certain places in more detail.

This walking tour was amazing. It included almost all historically significant monuments and spots in Berlin in such a short period of time. Our tour guide was very informative and gave good historical background for all the spots that we visited. I would highly recommend this trip.

It’s not difficult to have a guide who’s well informed. But it is to find one who is passionate about what they do and say. We had Georgia who I think was born to do this. We had an amazing 4 hours through German history, explained in the most interesting and wittiest way. Even my 16 year old loved it, which is quite unlikely.
The one thing i regret was not having booked this walk at the beginning of my visit, there were so many tips that I would have taken into consideration. Definitely considering visiting again
Thanks Georgia

We had very good, informative 4 hour tour with Lynsey our guide. She was very professional and super knowledgeable about the history of East Berlin and the wall.
She was able to answer all our questions and I am very glad I went. I would love to do another Berlin Walk in the future.
A clear must in Berlin! A little bit of everything and with a lot of insight, knowledge and humour. Our guide, Robert M was brilliant! So worth the money and time! Not to be missed.

Nathan provides a fantastic insight with his depth of knowledge and personal insight.
Thoroughly recommended.
Glad we did this tour, it was a great experience. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and entertained the whole group with lots of interesting information.
Sam W did a great job of explaining the history in an energetic and articulate manner and kept everyone moving along.

If you ever had only time for one tour on Berlin's past, go for this one. Ryan was our guide and he was the best! He has degree in modern history and this shows. For a Scot who fell in love with a German city (Berlin), he sure knows this stuff.

I would definitely check out his other tours under the Original Berlin Walks banner!
Gregor was brilliant & so knowledgable. Loved it. Enjoyed the way it was delivered in time zones - very clear & interesting.

Very insightful tour by Scott from Glasgow . His depth of knowledge of history about all the points of interest we visited was amazing . This is brilliant value and a must do at the start of any visit to Berlin.

What a brilliant way to find out about Berlin. No matter if you’ve visited Berlin before or if this is you’re first time, this trip can help you get orientated. Scott our guide had a great knowledge and was happy to answer questions on any of the stops of the tour. He obviously has a passion for the city and it shows in his presentation of facts. I would definitely recommend a walking tour, and I would say do it on your first day, so you can get to know the area.

We spent 4 hours walking around Berlin with Scott as our guide. His knowledge and ability to convey the nuanced history of Berlin was nothing short of incredible. I could not recommend this tour higher. I learned so much about Berlin during our trip. Scott was hands down the best tour guide we have ever had.

Lyndsey was our tour guide. I can't imagine how anyone could have done a better job. It was a cold drizzly day and she had a great energy. The tour was really comprehensive, insightful, and personal without being overwhelming. Great mix of history, architecture, contemporary culture, and travel tips. We did this our first day in Berlin and it was a great introduction to the city.

Came to Berlin on a 4 day trip and knew a walking tour was a must to get as much info on Berlins interesting history as possible. Our tour guide was Scott. He was very informative, friendly and engaging. What I liked most was that he really encouraged you engage with the monuments and buildings he took you to see. Highly recommend anyone do this tour as long as you're able to walk/stand for 3.5 hours.

My husband and I went on a 4 day trip to Berlin, returning late on the fourth night. We had a marvellous time but started off so well with a walking tour of Berlin which was supposed to be two and a half hours but became almost 4!. We didn't mind at all as our guide Rick was fantastic. He was from Philadelphia but had lived and studied in Berlin for some years. He was so knowledgeable about the city and its history and we thoroughly enjoyed the stops at the River Spree, Museum Island and the University. There was a half Marathon on the same day but Rick had us confidently running across their path, when able to, in pairs! It was fun watching our group doing this and no-one seemed to mind! We went to Check- point Charlie and had a 25 min break there which allowed for a coffee. We carried on to see the Holocaust Memorial, last remaining 3rd Reich building, Hitler's bunker (now a car park) and eventually ended our tour at the Brandenburg Gate, just as the last Marathon runners were going through! A hot day, 21C but all made so interesting by Rick who we would like to praise for his fast,yet fascinating talk.

Ben was our tour guide. The tour was fantastic. Lots of information but delivered so not to overload us with dates etc.
Woud highly recommend.

My wife and I went to Berlin for our honeymoon and this was the first activity we wanted to do, as we wanted to get our bearings of the city.

Gregor was our guide and we were lucky to be in a smaller group of about 20. We saw many of the downtown Berlin city highlights including Museum Island, Brandenburg Gate and The Memorial for the Murdered Jews of Europe.

We learned a lot of things that we wouldn’t have learned as a tourist.

Gregor was very knowledgable and very friendly and gave us plenty of chances to ask questions about the tour and also about the outer city.

Our guide "Issy" was one of the best I've experienced: incredible ability to condense 800 years of Germany into an interesting, understandable narration. Fun, good humored personality made her an idea tour guide. Couldn't have asked for a better intro to Berlin.

Just back from Berlin (April 2019). The walking tour is fantastic, I highly recommend it. Got across so many major places in the city, skillfully guided and narrated. the quality of guide-tour made it, Ysanne - anyone lucky enough to visit with her is in for a treat, so informative, she should have her own History TV channel.

After 2 days of indulging in Berlins clubbing scene we decided to see some of the sites. We booked this walking tour and it had a great day being guided around some of Berlin’s sites by the excellent Carlos, who really brought the difficult history of Berlin to life with his humour and honesty. His extensive knowledge was amazing and entertaining.
This tout was very nice amusing the tour guy Robe Willis was very helpful and has a sense of humer, he had showed us lots of places in east Berlin explaining the history over every site.

We really enjoyed our walking tour of Berlin and our guide Nathan was excellent , it definitely covered everything from the Roman empire , 1st and 2nd world wars and the rise of the Nazis. Highly recommend these tours as we then on the following day went on another walking tour which concentrated on East Berlin and cold war with Tobi which certainly filled in the gaps on the DDR. Berlin is a Beautiful city with lots of history and this was a fantastic way to see it.

Amazing tour with the most engaging and knowledgable tour guide Beth.
She brought the whole history of Berlin to life, and gave an insightful commentary for over 4 hours.
Definitely recommend :)

We did this tour with Rob Willis on our first day on Berlin. He brought the city alive with his enthusiasm and knowledge and gave us a throughly enjoyable introduction to the history of the city. There was ample time to enjoy each point of interest and plenty of time for questions which were answered in an informative way.
We would definitely recommend taking this tour and if you are lucky enough to book with this guide you will not be disappointed.

This walking tour was very interesting and good value for money. Our tour guide Ken was fun, knowledgable and approachable. This is probably worth doing at the beginning of your stay in Berlin. As there’s so much to see it will give you a good idea of where you’d like to go back and explore further.

Took this tour 2 days ago with James as our guide who was very informative and fun.
His knowledge was excellent and it was a great way to spend time finding out about this city without traipsing around on your own
On arrival at meeting point, there seemed to be hundreds of people but we were split up into groups of 25 and taken off for introductions to be made and route to be taken
Ample stops made - would recommend to anyone

The half-day walking tour in Berlin is a must see and do! Our Aussie tour guide Dave was great! He was energetic informative an had great tips for others sites to see while in Berlin. Two big thumbs up for the tour content and Dave.

10mins crash course on hundred of years of Berlin history.
Several Frederics
Several museums
30 years war
2 sides of Germany
2 sides of Berlin
2711 memorial slabs
2 bottles of beer
1 dictator
4hours walk
No problem for our tour guide Beth who knows everything there is to know about German history and politics.
The tour is highly informative and always interesting. Definitely worth every step made during the day.
Our guide Izzie was so incredibly knowledgeable on Berlin’s history and delivered with such enthusiasm - a great history lesson and one of the best city tours I have ever done.
Such an interesting and fun walk to major sights with Rob, who held our attention in the rain and cold with his passionate and knowledgeable love of Berlin.

Our tour was amazing! We learned so much from our tour guide Georgia, she really cares about Berlin or what she calls the best city in europe. She showed us all of the usual touristy spots but with a great amount of historical context which make it clear why these stops are not just tourist attractions but places of great historical impact. Georgia’s guidance even went beyond the tour to include a custom made map of great places to eat, drink and other great destinations to visit while we were in the city! My brother and I can not recommend this tour enough.

Our tour guide Gregor was fantastic, knowledgeable, interactive and funny, he answered all questions anyone had.
Would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin

Very interesting tour. Saw all the worth while places, our guide -Cambell- was very knowledgeable. It's a great way of seeing the sights and the 4 hours - with half hour coffee break - flew by.
Good value and well worth it

This was our first walking tour and was absolutely terrific. Xavier was our guide and was very knowledgeable and friendly. We did the tour on our first day in Berlin and it set us up for the rest of our break.Highly recommended.

Lynsey was our guide for a walking tour of (mostly formerly-East) Berlin. She was very knowledgeable, polite, and helpful. She provided a great introduction to Berlin! My wife and I were very pleased with the tour, and Lynsey was prepared to carry on in spite of a periodic, cold, rain.

Our guide was Dave, and he was exceptionally professional … funny, knowledgeable and extremely helpful - he even gave us a link for all his great café, bar, museum and restaurant recommendations … which we then followed for the next few days and wouldn't have found them otherwise.

The tour started on time, was easy to find (Starbucks Hackeseker Markt) and went at the right pace to allow enough time at each stop point, but not to drag on (4 hours went very quickly). We could hear him clearly at each spot, his background expertise was fascinating and he kept us well informed throughout the tour on what was next, what was around us and how it all came together with Berlin's history. We went on the tour pretty much straight from the airport after dumping our bags, and it was a great way to get started. Highly recommended

Very good tour - we had a super informative guide called Kevin who is clearly well versed. A little bit too well versed in that a few assumptions are made into what people know to start off with. A lot of history and philosophy and less about the key landmarks of which there are many. Having said that, I got a lot out of it and could see what it was that I felt necessary to visit again. Most of the sites are quickly worked through in order to get to it all. Lots of walking. Stopped at a nice affordable university cafe for a break that didn’t break the bank - thank you.

This tour exceeded expectations thanks to our tour guide thanks to Gregor. Not only did he give us a great tour experience but he also went into vast amounts of detail when he explained the history of the sights we saw. He was very clued up on the history and even gave us much to think about with the critical analysis of interpreting the meaning behind the memorials and other monuments. Learnt way more than expected on this trip thanks to him would definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to see Berlin and learn about its history.

The tour guide, Sam W., had a deep knowledge of the subject, and his great sense of humour made this walking tour a very enjoyable experience indeed. Sam is a great communicator, and his delivery style was clear and elegant: it was a huge pleasure to have a PhD-qualified academic to lead this walking tour.

Kathryn was very informative, knowledgeable, clear and precise. Kathryn was able to be heard clearly above the noise of any traffic without having to shout, and she kept everyone walking at a reasonable pace for the whole group of 20. Kathryn was comfortable in answering any questions and having studied German history she was correct in all her facts. The places she recommended to visit were well worthwhile.
Kathryn enhanced our weekend

We really enjoyed our walking tour of Berlin with Sarah on Saturday. She delivered the story of Berlin in a clear and meaningful way. She was very knowledgleable on the history and current situation in Berlin. Good value for money

Enjoyed our overview of the city of Berlin with our tour guide Gregor. He was engaging and knowledgeable. He gave a German perspective and a philosophical perspective to have different unbiased views regarding the history of Berlin.

On 9th March we did a 4 hour walking tour of Berlin. Not only entertaining but more important was the insight our guide Scott gave us on the well thought out Original Berlin Walk introducing the city to us.
Normally do the bus tours but the personal touch that Dave brought to the tour was excellent. Knowledgeable, concise and sometimes humorous, this walk gave us a great insight into Berlin's history.

It was very cold and raining but four hours flew by with Jared, our wonderful tour guide.
A fabulous mix of history, covering various ages, information about German life, architecture, war and the Germans people.
Highly recommended tour. Thank you!

We really enjoyed the Discover Berlin Walking Tour the guide (Darren) was excellent very knowledgeable and had a balanced view of the History of Berlin. We experienced most of the must see places in the City. Would definitely recommend this tour.

Our tour guide Jared was super friendly and informative. Since my time in Berlin was very short and limited I wanted a tour that would provide me with as much history and information on Berlin as possible. This tour not only achieved this goal for me but it also provided the information in a very interesting way. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin!

We booked this walking tour on recommendation and were not disappointed. Our guide Scott was extremely knowleagable and interesting. This was an excellent way to start our visit to Berlin and to get a feel for its complicated history, so much more than just the Nazis. So worth the money and cannot recommend highly enough.

Our tour guide Isanne (Izzy) was excellent and over the 3 and a half hours gave us a great deal of interesting information and facts about the city and it's history.
We are so pleased that we did this tour at the beginning of our stay as it really helped us get our bearings and have a better understanding of the city.
Great value, highly recommended.

Dave was an amazing tour guide. Tour was informative yet entertaining. Had an amazing time. If you are new to Berlin this tour gives you a great deal of knowledge about the city. Dave also helped us with other things that we can try during our time here. Totally worth the time and money.

Decided to do the tour on our 1st afternoon as it would allow us to plan what to do for the rest of our break. A special thanks to Kyle who led us through a fantastic walk of the city explaining everything as we went. A great history lesson. Her enthusiasm and love of Berlin was evident. The 4 hours flew in (30 mins to ourselves for a coffee break) and with a good pace to the walk you felt at the end you had seen so much. A must do for eveyone to get the true inside to the city and learn it's history.

It was a great help in letting us know what to go back and visit again.

We joined Ryan’s walking tour our 2nd day in Berlin and, in spite of the rain, wind and cold it was an excellent introduction to the city and its remarkable history. Ryan really knows his stuff and is a very passionate and skilled tour guide. He was professional without being too polished and answered everyone’s questions with ease and enthusiasm. Highly recommended!
Scott was great as a guide. He was very knowledgeable, polite, and considerate. He had a great sense of humor as well. We had a great time!

Make sure you have your walking shoes on..our guide was Dave from Australia..and he really knew German history..if you aren't interested in knowing the history of the sights...I'd still recommend it, since you visit the important sights and have plenty of time to take pictures of the area..
Great way to learn the history of Berlin rather than just walking around looking at the amazing buildings. Sam W was a great tour guide, happy to answer lots of questions. Highly recommend this tour.

Went on the tour hosted by Sam W, which was excellent. Sam’s knowledge of Berlin and it’s history really came across and I will be recommending this tour to friends! The tour was the ideal length of time and distance to walk.

Our Sam W made this tour really interesting and he brought a great amount of personal experience to it. It really helped to set up the rest of our stay in Berlin and gave us some good ideas of where to go and what to explore in more detail. Well worth it.

Despite it being a freezing, wet morning Lynsey made our tour extremely interesting and we woud highly recommend it to anyone wanting to see bits of east Berlin you wouldn’t necessarily notice - good value for money.

Ryan our Scottish tour guide was so helpful, polite and informative with an obvious passion for what he does. I took my 11 year old son and whilst he tuned out for some bits there were some great stories and historical facts that kept him interested even though it rained for all of our tour! Thank you.

This was my first tour I ever been on and I've to say it went beyond my expectations. Ysanne was a great tour guide who impressed the group with her knowledge and presentation of Berlin. I've really enjoyed the tour and have learnt a lot about the city. If you want to immerse yourself in German history and culture then this is the perfect choice.

Nathan was terrific - felt like we saw all the major highlights, along with many many little things that I would never see or know on my own. Good sense of humor, great pace, and lots of context on how the history unfolded in this incredibly history-rich city. Thanks Nathan!

Ken was a fantastic guide . Informative, knowledgeable and even told jokes .
He was enthusiastic and answered all of our questions. Made some great recommendations too .
Beth is the Best Guide ever! We didn’t want the tour to end! Very knowledgeable, engaging and loves her job! Thank you Beth!!
I had a wonderful visit with our guide Darren. He explained us a lot of different aspects of this city that I didn't know. It was well explained! Thanks a lot!!!!
Fantastic tour with Kyle on a cold Berlin morning. Fascinating tour with lots of interesting history and local information. Comfortable walking pace and well timed coffee stop.

Our tour guide was Matti, he was brilliant and very knowledgable! He was also funny and added humour to the tour. So much was covered and well worth the money. If you’re in Berlin and tight for time this is a fantastic way of seeing the key sites and gaining an insight into the history of the city. Especially like learning about the wall!

Heidi was a very knowledgeable and friendly guide, and was open to answering any additional questions or to give further explanation if required. The tour lasted about 4½ hours including a 20 min break for lunch and there were numerous stops along the way to hear about landmarks and Berlin's history. I would highly recommend!

The tour was very good, showed us the historical sites and some that we wouldn't have known about without the tour. Our guide Heidi knew the area well and answered all questions. Wrap up warm though as there are alot of stops where the guide explains things to you and in March this meant we got cold quickly! Would definitely recommend and if we came back would do some of the other tours.

We were first time visitors to Berlin and Darren our tour guide was captivating with a historical treasure chest of information. He brought Berlin alive, articulating the horrors of its past in a sensitive and questioning manner. Wrap up warm as Berlin in February is chilly. Fabulous value for money!

Our guide, Ryan, was very personable and presented information in a very interesting and attention - keeping way.
All the sites you’d expect are visited but for us the best part was discovering the history of Berlin you probably don’t know much about.
A must for any 1st time visitor to the city!

This is a GREAT walking tour! Gregor (our guide) is a native Berliner, well versed in his topic and with a sparkling sense of humor. This tour is packed with interesting points that give a more complete view of Germany historically and in modern times. The information about West vs East Germany (now all one) is also important to understand, not only Berlin (divided for so long), but also Germany as a whole. Having a walking tour is to quite literally walk in the footsteps of history. You cannot get this with a bus tour and/or guide book. It is indeed four hours, so wear comfortable shoes!! (I didn't. Ouch!) Bottom line: if your time is limited, and you can only do one thing, do this tour. It is real value for your time/money.

This was a great tour that really hit all the important landmarks in Germany. Marriette was a great guide. She was extremely educated on Germany's history and provided us with a lot of cool fun facts and jokes!

Matti was our tour guide and he was brilliant. Informative, interesting and really knowledgeable about everything Germany! The time flew by we were so engaged.
I am so glad we booked the tour for the first day of our trip so we could get a real feel for the area and then we could go back and visit things that had sparked our interest on the tour.
I was inspired to find out more about the city and the history as not everything could be covered in the 4 hours. I thoroughly recommend the tour and especially Matti our guide.

Nathan was our guide and did a very good job. He was engaging and knowledgable about Berlin's history and handled the issues around the Holocause memorials with dignity and respect. He was very engaging and we learnt a lot

Just back from Berlin and this was undoubtedly the highlight of our visit. Our guide Nathan was very informed and passionate about the history of the city and we all learned so much from being on the tour. A much better way to learn about the city than the rip off bus tours. Could not recommend this highly enough.

If you are considering this tour, but are unsure - go for it. It was, by far, the best money I spent in Berlin. The tour took place in December, on a very cold day. We had two kids with us a 3 year old and an eight year old. Our guide, Nathan, was vastly knowledgeable, engaging and encouraged participation- questions. The manner in which Nathan conducted the tour kept us - and kids - interested throughout the 4 hours tour. And yes, the coffee/snack break was time well too. :)

Darren was our guide, he was excellent. Not everyday you get a current PHD student of German political history giving you the tour! Darren was extremely insightful and thought provoking in his commentary. If only my history teachers in school had been as good. I would very much recommend this tour especially if you are lucky enough to get Darren as your guide!

Our tour guide Kevin was very knowledgeable and friendly. Despite the cold weather he gave us a four hour tour and was always patient enough to answer all our questions. His British English was also easily understandable for me as a non- native speaker.
The tour is great to get an overview over the history of Germany and Berlin in particular. It covers the most popular sights, like Brandenburger Tor, Museumsinsel, Checkpoint Charly, and the Berlin Wall, but we also got a lot of information about small details like the tripping stones or spots like the Hitler Bunker that we otherwise would have missed.
The tour made us curious about Berlin and we made a long list of Museums and spots that we wanted to visit again. Kevin was nice enough to recommend some of his favorite Museums, so the tour really was the perfect starting point for a visit to Berlin

All first time tourists to Berlin should do this tour it is fantastic . We met our brilliant tour guide David at an easy to find location . We were guided around all the main tourist attractions at a good pace with lots to look at with lots of really interesting historical information. It was easy to ask questions and feel relaxed as we were walking around .
Lots of time for photographs and a break for coffee and cake .
Really good we were so happy that we had booked .

We took the tour with the brilliant Jess. He managed to keep everyone on the tour entertained and informed for the whole thing . Quite a feat !!. His level of knowledge was excellent and some of the tips he gave us about other experiences were right on the money . Definitely worth doing but you will cover 3-4 miles so dress accordingly.

We meet for 10.30 on the 2nd day of our trip, Just myself and my husband, there were at least 70 other tourists waiting!, we broke up to 3 groups. our guides name was Ryan, he was Scottish with a nice clear loud voice so we could hear everything. he was very knowledgeable about Germanys/ Berlins history, he made it very interesting and fun,
We seen all the main attractions you wish to see in Berlin, we stopped for a half hour break at check point charle, I would highly recommend booking this tour if you want to see all the main tourist attractions in Berlin

Nathan was our tour guide, he was very informative & knowledgeable. Brilliant amount of info my son is in year 10 and doing GCSE History he really enjoyed it and felt he had learn more as Nathan brought it to life & made it easy to understand along with seeing the buildings etc rather than in just pictures. I would definitely recommend the tour.
I learned a lot, and saw a lot of places of interest I would not have seen otherwise. Plus, there's a lot of stories, a bit of history and recommendations for museums and such.
Was really good the tour and the Guide Walter make the experience wonderful. He know everything about the history of Berlim and make sure we understand all stages during the tour. I really recommend.
Gregor was outstanding. Knowledgeable and witty, he presented all three major eras (Prussia, WW2 and the Cold War) in a cogent and accessible style. Fun, too. Full marks for this one.

It was an absolute pleasure to be shown around a very sunny Berlin by the super knowledgeable and super charming Beth.
We came away from this tour with a far greater understanding of the history surrounding us while in Berlin.
Thanks Beth

This was a great walking tour. The guide Wauhter was really good, one of the best ever we had. Very knowledge, did really interesting presentations, perfect English and was easy to understand. Highly recommended!
This tour was with Beth. She was exceptional in her knowledge and humour. The four hours concerning Berlin history was amazingly enlightening and fun. Would highly recommend! Get Beth if you can.
We had a great time on this tour, and learned so much! Our guide, Greg, was fantastic- funny and so smart in his commentary. It was a perfect way to start our trip to Berlin!

Dave was the perfect tour guide, very passionate about his subject and he made it very interesting to listen to. We learned much more than we would have done so well worth doing the tour as a way of seeing the main attractions. He also gave us good tips to see other things the following day

Dave made us a fantastic and very professional tour of Berlin.
I definitely recommend this experience to everyone

Scott was an amazing tour guide with a lot of passion and knowledge. Both myself and friend have previously done many walking tours but this was by far the most enjoyable and interactive irrespective of the history being discussed. He allowed us to explore our own feelings and emotions whilst expressing his own. A truly remarkable tour guide !!
I would highly recommend this tour to anyone and everyone and believe it’s the best way to discover Berlin.

As 2 families taking a whirlwind trip through Europe over our Christmas break, this walking tour was a highlight for everyone. Our guide was very knowledgeable and passionate about the history and some of it was eye opening. Loved understanding how the different empires all interconnect. Don't hesitate to take this tour and if possible, do it on your first day.

I had Lynsey today as my tour guide and she was very informative and had a lot of knowledge. she always made sure the group was together and kept us moving because of the cold. even though it was freezing she did a great job! thank you Lynsey!
A wonderful tour of Berlin and our guide was very much the German historian.. would highly recommend this tour to anyone
7 of us braved the February cold and we were glad we did. David was engaging and informative. Highly recommended

We took the half day walking tour of Berlin in the afternoon on the day we arrived. Our guide, Jess, was terrific. He is an American who has lived in Berlin for several years and is now a graduate student at Humboldt University. We walked and walked, covering a lot of ground in Berlin, including the Brandenburg Gate, the Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe, Museum Island, and much more. Jess was extremely knowledgeable about German history and the sites we saw. He was very patient with questions from the group, and continued past the four-hour time originally set for the tour so he could cover everything. He also gave us tips on which sites to go back and visit on our remaining days in Berlin -- which museums to visit based on our interests, where to get good views of the city, etc. We learned a lot and it was a great orientation to the city.

We had a wonderful tour with Wouter who made the history and sociology of the city come alive with his interesting insights and engaging demeanor. Other tours may shuffle you around and hit you with facts and figures. Wouter instead told a story of the city. Would highly recommend.

Whenever I visit a new city, I love to spend the first day just walking around to get the feel for the geography, people, food, and culture. Sadly, this I only had a day and a half on my first trip to Berlin, so I needed something a little more organized than my usual ramble. This tour was awesome.

The meeting place was clear and easy to find. Check in was easy. There were about 40 people for the English tour, so we divided into two groups. Wouter led our group and I couldn't have been happier.

Wouter is a very approachable young Dutch man and a great speaker. He has art history background and a career in audio/video journalism. He showed us the sights and, more importantly, explained the historical and contemporary landscape of Berlin. It's a complicated place with a lot of conflicted legacies. I'll be thinking about what I saw and heard for a long time. You don't get that with your standard, "and here on the left is the ..." tour. Wouter also gave some great recommendations for museums and attractions to see later.

The walk itself took the full 4 hours, including a 20-30 minute coffee/snack/bio break about half way through. It was a cold and rainy day, which made it a bit of a slog, but the pace was good and we had periodic opportunities to get out of the rain.

All in all, a fantastic experience!
Engaging, dynamic and knowledgeable, Martin held my large group at rapt attention in a cold winter day in Berlin. He knows all the details but also weaves a larger narrative. Six stars out of five.

We landed at 10am local time and after using public transport to the hotel this was the first thing we did.
It gave us a really great insight into the history of Germany and importantly Berlin. The tour enabled us to get our bearings and know exactly what was around us so we could plan the next couple of days.

Given it was 25 January the weather was as expected....very cold at -4, but we had prepared in terms of clothing and never did this distract us from the amazing history, architecture, views and on occasions the utter despair of the awful past.

Kyle our guide was friendly, passionate, knowledgeable and enthusiastic despite the cold. We took in many sights and she gave great insight into the history and culture of Berlin.

I would recommend this tour to anyone who wishes to gain a fantastic and deeper understanding of their visit to the City of Berlin.

I did the tour today and despite the freezing temperature, it was an amazing walk through the most iconic landmarks in Berlin, guided by Kyle.
She (yes, it is “she” and her name is Kyle! If you want to know the reason she’s got a male name you will have to come on the tour and ask her in person!) was extremely attentive and knowledgeable and did not fail to make us laugh when explaining the history of this fascinating city.
I was not even for a moment disappointed and highly recommended you to do this walk.

We did this tour on 23rd Jan. The tour lasts 4 hours and it was -7°C for the whole tour - very chilly! Despite the cold our tour guide, Kevin, managed to hold our attention throughout. There was a much welcomed coffee stop about half way through where we managed to defrost a little! Kevin showed us round the most famous sites of Berlin as well as some lesser known places (I won't spoil the surprise!). We did this on our 2nd day in the city - we'd already visited some of the place but had walked past so many others without realising the history of each site. Kevin is extremely well informed and made it really interesting. Thanks very much.

With the company of pretty guide Haidi,the tour was excellent and very much satisfactory, before the tour it is advisable to make a tour with the double-decker bus 100 to see the historic places in advance.

We did an excellent tour with a great guide, David . He was pleasant, interesting and very knowledgeable about the early history of Berlin and also about the more recent events in the city. He brought us to monuments marking significant historical events , spoke about the personalities and people involved and was clearly very passionate about passing on his knowledge in an engaging way. Highly recommended tour.He also gave us advice on other places to visit in the city and also helped in recommending easiest way to airport .
Highly Recommended! Our guide Amy had loads of knowledge and was a very entertaining guide throughout the 4 hours (there is a halfway toilet/coffee break which was a lifesaver).

Absolutely fantastic-our guide was so knowledgeable and took time to answer individual questions. I learned a lot from that tour about ww2 which was both eyeopening and interesting. Recommend to anyone going to berlin - must do.

We went on Half Day Tour Berlin with our guide Amy. It was absolutely fantastic, despite of very cold weather-thanks to Amy. She is so knowledgable, professional, she knows a lots of great local stories too. Her guidance throughout Berlin was so interesting, never boring and with a hint of decent humour too. We loved this tour and highly recommend it. Thank you Amy for so many information that one cannot find in guide books,xx

This tour was great! For those who know their history the beginning may seem a little basic, but once that introductory bit is over, which means everyone is up to speed, you'll be taken to lots of fascinating spots, both iconic/well known and more hidden. Our tour guide Carlos was lovely, very good fun, and extremely knowledgeable. We learnt loads of interesting facts and stories about the city, as well as its context within the wider history of German. If looking to improve, I'd have liked to have just five minutes to wander around some of the bigger historical sites, like the Holocaust Memorial and the Brandenburg Gate, to take a moment to soak up the atmosphere and their gravitas. It felt like a bit of a shame to rush through places like. But it was still a great thing to do, and I would thoroughly recommend the tour and Carlos!

If only history had been this interesting at school - I might not have become a maths teacher! Our guide Nathan managed to use our 4 hour walking tour of the historical centre of Berlin to give us a good understanding of the history of the city and country. His knowledge of European Politics, through the Masters Degree that he was studying in Berlin, was most apparent and he was able to both describe the turbulent history with clarity and give thoughtful explanations of the causes of conflicts and the way that they affected different groups of people..
