It only transpired towards the end of the tour that Nathan's grandfather had been an Auschwitz survivor, who's wife and daughter had been murdered at the concentration camp. I think that the addition of this personal connection meant that we gained much greater insight than we would have done from a history book. I cannot recommend him highly enough.

The tour is very good, packed with lots of interesting information and lovely sights of the centre. The guide was very knowledgeable, friendly and responsive.

The guided walk takes you on a history of the city which centres on the division of the city between east and west.

Would advise it for everyone that like to take in the sights while improving their cultural knowledge of German history.
Wouter gave an excellent tour of Berlin. Very knowledgable, funny, everything well planned and on time. It's well worth the price!
Was a cold and windy day but hats off to Sam W for not letting that phase him, very knowledgeable person and well spoken. Over all brilliant tour, me and my girlfriend loved it!!

Darren was an insightful tour guide who having studied the history of Berlin for a Phd gave deep insights into the history of Germany and its capital. An all-round entertaining and knowledgable guide, and it was a privilege to be in his company. Couldn't recommend enough.

This was an exceptional tour. We would highly recommend this tour to anyone interested in learning a lot more about Berlin and the history of the 20th century.

Darren's knowledge was exceptional including the ability to provide varying logic behind how and why history arose as it did. It is clear to see that he has extensive knowledge regarding the history of this time.

His ability to provoke thought and discussion within the group added so much enjoyment and value to the tour.

Thank you for your time today Darren, it is absolutely appreciated and thoroughly enjoyed.

Regards
David & Elizabeth
(Aussie's that love their coffee......)

This tour was an excellent introduction to the different periods of Berlin's history and the way those play out in the architecture. Darren was simply excellent - he gave us so much more depth and nuance than I was expecting from a simple walking tour. He really made us think about what the buildings and places signify and what it means to remember or memorialize something. Highly, highly recommend.

Our guide Jess was awesome. Cool dude with endless knowledge about German history. The 4 hour tour is a beast of a trek (especially when it's snowing and freezing), but it was a really good tour nonetheless. Thanks Jess!
Nathan was our guide and he was captivating and informative! A great history class that explored the darkness and the light that Berlin has endured. 10/10 would recommend.

Sarah as an exceptional guide. Her vast knowledge kept us interested despite the freezing cold conditions. She shared lots of details and her dry sense of humour gave the tour a bit of an edge. Sarah also gave us some good pointers and recommendations of what to do and where to go.

Did the tour today with guide Aron Willis. It was very informative but had lots of chances to ask questions too. This is a great sampling of the must see sights in Berlin, but also sets you up for what you want to know more about or see more of with the rest of your time in Berlin

Went on the Berlin half day walking tour with Nathan as our tour guide. He was brilliant and was extremely informative. He showed us the important sights and knew what he was talking about. Would definitely recommend.

Sarah from 'Original Berlin Walks' was excellent. Her knowledge of the city both past and present is amazing, and she kept us all interested throughout. I would most certainly recommend Sarah and 'Original Berlin Walks'.
Due to the engaging story telling of our guide Wouter, this tour was well worth it! We had fun and learnt a lot, cool!

We did the half day walking tour a couple of weeks ago with Jared. He was so passionate, funny and really engaging. He has such a wealth of knowledge and you can tell he loves sharing it with others. Jared did an amazing job of fitting so much into such a short space of time. Incredible value for money and highly recommended.

This is a full 4 hour tour as advertised with a coffee break at the mid-point. Our tour guide Nathan is American with German/Jewish grandparents. He was HIGHLY knowledgeable and provided the social and political context for the stories about each stop, connecting it in a great way that brings your through 200+ years of German history. There is no better city to do a walking tour like this than Berlin. I highly recommend this tour. Wear comfortable shoes and dress warm as you are outside for the entire 4 hours.

This is a 4 hour walking tour (with a coffee break) learning about Germany's history. Not just in the World Wars but before and after. Our tour guide Grogor Berger was funny, knowledgeable and considerate. I quite enjoyed following him around for the 4 hours and just chatting in between the destinations. I would recommend this tour to all those visiting for the first time especially, or even to those that don't know the background to a lot of historical sites around Berlin. Really no complaints, just know you really will be walking the whole way, even in slight rain. Dress appropriately.

Our guide Nathan was very knowledgeable and gave interesting information on the history of 18th-20th century Germany that I didn't know. He gave funny jokes while talking a big group around lots of sights in cold temperatures, thank you Nathan for that!
I would definitely recommend this tour.

Jess studies history and regaled us with a wonderful history lesson of Berlin and Germany on this 4 hour tour. We covered all the major periods and many sights. Highly highly recommended. It’s kind of cold to be outside right now for hours so bundle up!

Our guide Laura was very informative and gave a great overview of the massive history of Berlin. I recommend this tour for the first day in Berlin as it helps you to decide what you want to see for the rest of the trip. But also it helps you to get familiar with the city it self.

Ysanne did an outstanding job. She has a degree in history and was well-versed in the subject at hand. She is also enthusiastic, entertaining and holds the attention of her audience!! “Izzy” did an outstanding job. I would love to have another tour in Berlin with this tour guide.

We booked the English 2:30pm tour and it was cold but enjoyable and informable. Our guide Ryan answered questions at the ready and half way through we stopped for a hot drink and something to nibble on to get warm. So much information was given that we didn't know and we saw things that were surprising to all of us. I would love to do this again when the weather is nicer and the sun up longer.

Kai was our guide for the tour and he was wonderful absolutely jam packed full of historical knowledge. it was an absolutely freezing day but Kai got us through seeing all the sights and learning plenty about them. I highly recommend

A good walking tour gets you up to speed on a place, a great guide makes you feel you’re the only one in the group. The half day walking tour is THE introduction and Heidi coped with the idiot questions very well. Highly recommended.

Our tour guide Kathryn was very informed and personal, she knew a lot about German history. We walked through the major historical sites and got an in-depth overview of each place. Definitely recommend this tour.

Our experience of this walking tour with our very funny guide Beth and the rest of the group was very exciting despite the chilling weather and annoying rain. Huge appreciation for our guide for being so humorous, making the visit of the Berlin monuments a lot of fun and also making the group involved. We highly recommend her. The idea of the tour, in general, is good, covering a good number of sites. The only negative is walking 4 hours in chilly December is hard, just an excuse for having some good hot wine at the Christmas market during the break. Very good tour!!
Kai was our guide through Berlin. He was extremely informative and just amazing. Greetings from couple from Slovenia :)

Martin was out tour guide and provided us numerous information, historical and up to date regarding sites seen. Walking tour was easily to fallow with one break for snack and coffe in small restaurant.
The weather was horrible, windy cold and rainy, but Martin bravely guided us.
Our guide was very knowledgeable and made the tour very interesting. Walking tour is the best way to see the main points of interest. Highly recommended.

Despite the inclement December weather we have just completed an excellent 4+ hour walking tour of Berlin with Gregor Berger. He is a most enthusiastic, articulate and engaging orator who clearly knows his stuff. The history of Germany and Berlin in particular put everything into context and his depth of knowledge on his subject was outstanding. What I particularly enjoyed was his spin of the architecture and art around the city and political philosophy. I highly recommend this tour as an overview of Berlin that is entertaining and very good value for money.
We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with guide Nathan. He was very knowledgeable and gave us a brilliant insight in to the history of this great city.

Highly recommended to all who visit Berlin, Marriette our tour guide had us hooked with all her enthusiasm and humour. Marriette answered all questions eloquently with such knowledge of the History of beautiful Berlin.I loved all three and half hours of it which flew past.

We had a great time finding out about Berlin and its history. Our guide Marriette did a fantastic job informing, amusing and looking after us all afternoon. Her detail and personalisation of the history made for a very special visit. I would recommend to all.

Wault was a wonderful tour guide. Knowledgeable and amusing. I would recommend doing this walk on your first or second day of a long weekend as you can then go back and enjoy the areas that really interest you.
Wrap up warm and wear comfy shoes!

I had a great time exploring and learning about Berlin’s history, architecture, art and life in the city. Rob Shaw is a fantasatic tour guide - super friendly, knowledgeable and entertaining. I would highly recommend this experience.

Our tour guide, Kathryn, was fantastic! Very informative, great way to learn about the city and its history. You cover a great deal of distance so do come prepared to be on your feet for 4hrs. Overall was absolutely excellent and would definitely recommend!

Ysanne (Izzy) was our guide for this very informative tour- her knowledge and passion for this city and its complex history, was evident from the start. Our tour was a good mix of young and old, but she made sure that everyone was there to hear everything. We learned so much about the history of this city over the last 800 years and the post-war reconstruction. Ysanne communicated everything so passionately and clearly, as well as helped us reflect on the significance and purpose of the design of several memorials.
Jess the guide was very informative with significant knowledge. A fantastic way to be introduced to important landmarks and history. Highly recommend
Our guide, Sarah, was very knowledgeable and did an amazing job! The tour was extremely interesting. I apparently knew very little about Germany's history.. Definitely recommend this tour!

I couldn't recommend this more highly. Our guide Marrette was exceptionally knowledgable, accommodating and sparky. I love history and she had so much to share with us. It was brilliantly thought through, an enjoyable route and Marette was great at finding out about us individually and making us feel welcome. Without doubt the highlight of my holiday.

Thank you
We have landed in Berlin jest for day soon as left airport we headed to city center by train. And got on tour bus for sight seeing this place so beautiful it reminds me of Paris.

Took this tour on Saturday morning. Rachel was our guide and she was really knowledgeable. You had to make sure you were standing at the front because it wasn’t always easy to hear her and we would have like a couple of minutes more to take photos at some of the places we stopped but we do understand that she has a time line to stick to.
Took this tour on Sunday, very interesting and informative. Ken was our guide, he had a great knowledge of the city plus a great sense of humour

On Saturday, our guide Rachel was very knowledgeable about Berlin and was very friendly throughout.

My only criticism would be that in some of the louder areas of the tour it was a little difficult to hear her unless you were close to the front of the group.

Our guide was Tobi who offered excellent knowledge throughout as well as a friendly and relaxed atmosphere. He kept the day flowing smoothly and went brilliantly.
Really can't recommend this enough, if was our first day in Berlin and it covers all of the major sights we had planned to see as well as offering a lot of information on everything that you might miss without a guide.
Thank you Tobi for a brilliant tour.
Excellent tour. Rachel was extremely knowledgeable about Berlin and it's history. One of the best things I did in Berlin!

Brilliant insight into the history of this amazing city. Unfortunately the temperature was freezing, literally, and therefore with lots of stops outside very difficult to keep warming while standing, listening to a very informative guide.
This was well worth the effort. Dave our guide was both interesting and very enigmatic! We had not realise how much there was to see in Berlin.

Kai Arne Janssen is a phenomenal guide. I cannot sing his praises enough. My sister and I spent the summer going on walking tours throughout Europe and he was by far the most efficient, dedicated, friendly, and intelligent tour guide we had. We went in with limited knowledge of German history, particularly German history prior to WW2. He started the tour with a ridiculously comprehensive, easy to follow, 15 minute recap of German history that set up and gave context to the layers of history he would present over the next four hours. He is a true historian that prioritizes truth over sensation. Kai made us learn, feel, and reflect on our own lives and role the individual plays in shaping human history.

He kept everyone on our tour engaged. The endless questions that were thrown at him were met with intelligent and thoughtful responses. We could have spent another 4 hours listening to him. He went out of his way to accommodate a handicap participant and was extremely kind and generous. If you have the opportunity to have Kai as your guide, don’t miss out!

The tour guide was super knowledgeable and gave a really good tour and spoke about very interesting points and gave information you would not get in a normal city tour. My one complaint is that we didn't stop long enough to get some photos but also hear what he had to say. For example, at the site of the Berlin Wall he was speaking the whole time and was really interesting but then we hurried off and didn't get to take any photos there. That aside it was a really good tour and I would highly recommend it.

Had an excellent day yesterday on the walking tour of the city. Ryan was really knowledgeable of the history of Berlin and had some interesting stories. It was great to see the main highlights of the city in one go and the architecture of Berlin is stunning. Thank you Ryan for being such a great guide!

We had the Walking Tour of Berlin on Saturday and were guided round the city for four hours by the very knowledgeable Laura. Her introduction into the history of Germany was amazing and her overall knowledge was great. Lots of interesting stories and she kept the group involved and so well informed. I learnt more from Laura in 4 hours than I did in years at school history lessons!!! If you do one thing in Berlin do the walking tour, Is off on time and was just brilliant. Many thanks

In a nutshell, thank-you Toni for a wonderful 4 hour informative and humorous tour of Berlin,
Absolutely worth every penny, superb tour and great value for the money!

Thank-you!

I went on the walking tour of East Berlin with Kathryn as our guide. For an “immigrant” it was amazing to listen to her talk so passionately about the city and it’s history with such in-depth knowledge

This half day walking tour was the highlight of my friend and I's 5 day trip to Berlin. We took the tour on 9/11 which is a special day in Berlin, Kai our guide was fantastic,very friendly and extremely informative. Great value for money.

Ysanne was our guide for this tour and was excellent - her knowledge and passion for this, her adopted city, was evident from the outset. Her group of 27 for our tour was of mixed ages, but she always made sure that the slowest were there to hear everything. We learned so much about the history of this city over the last 800 years and the post-war reconstruction. Ysanne brought everything to life for us all.

I would like to share that the Tour Guide "Mr. Tobi" for "Discover Berlin" , executed on 10.11.2018, was exceptionally informative. The way he was explaining us regarding historical facts of Berlin, Politics, Buildings were extremely fantastic with sprinkling of light jokes. It was really a fun and memorable experience of my life. Commendable efforts of "Original Berlin Walks" to have such experienced Guides like "Mr. Tobi".
M.B Shaikh, Pakistan

We did this walk on our first day in Berlin and it was an excellent introduction to the city. In fact, it probably topped everything else on our very interesting 3 days. Gregor was knowledgeable, informative, thought provoking and very generous in giving us an extra 3/4 of an hour to expand our experience even further. A fascinating experience.

Ken was an amazing guide - he was genuinely informative and had a great sense of humour - making the time pass very quickly. It lasted for 3.5 hours, covering a few areas that we had already been, but giving us a fresh insight into these. I have a much greater understanding of the city now - thanks for a great day!

I was in town for a day and wanted to see as much as possible. After checking out the huge number of tours available, I settled on Discover Berlin by Original Berlin Walks. Our group was lucky enough to get Ysanne as our guide. Ysanne is amazing; her knowledge, humour and passion made this one of the best tours I've ever done. We covered a lot of ground and a lot of history making this a brilliant way to spend a day in Berlin.

This was probably the best walking tour of a city I have ever been on. Our guide Nathan was an excellent facilitator. His knowledge of and passion for German history was so engaging. His delivery of the information he had to share with us was top class. I cannot recommend this tour highly enough.
It was a thought-provoking and very informative tour. Laura is a great guide and I personally liked that she wasn't afraid to include her own views and opinion.

A great guided walk. Since all the historical/tourist landmarks in berlin are rather spread out, this is a great way to see the sights, though note that it doesn't include the east side gallery. My guide Tobi was super friendly and knowledgable!

Our 4-hour walking tour with Laura last week was really well organized, and very informative. Laura explained things very well, made us all think harder about the history of Berlin, and even offer opinions and concerns about the current state of the area, and the world in general. It was great! Thank you Laura. From Elpida, New Jersey

Beth was our tour guide on October 27th 2018, she was excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed the tour, historical, with a very interesting social perspective. We discovered all the key sites with lots of suggestions for further exploration. I would recommend this tour to any friend visiting Berlin
Monica ...visiting from Ireland

We had a good time, the tour covered all the most important sights, our guide Dave was awesome and shared the history of Berlin with us, also recommended other places to visit that werent covered by the tour. Took about 4 hours, had a 20 minute break inbetween. Definately recommend this tour if you want to see the most important sights and know about the history.

Dave was interesting, knowledgeable, nice and clear. The tour was extremely informative. We definitely recommend ! The only problem we encountered was finding the meeting place; perhaps a better description of the meeting place would be helpful.

Just finished the tour with Georgia (our fellow Scot!) who was the most exceptional tour guide. Her knowledge was very impressive but it was her witty and cheerful manner which made the four hours fly by. This is an absolute must for anyone visiting Berlin for the first time - but also for return visitors keen to learn more about the history of this unique and wonderful city. — with Lynn Houston.

Our guide Seb B was incredible. He explained and helped us explore every area that we visited while including humorous anecdotes throughout.
Seb B gave us a comprehensive history of the formation of Germany, the world wars, the aftermath and the present day. To take a line from Oliver Goldsmith’s poem “The Village Schoolmaster” it was amazing to imagine “That one small head could carry all he knew” !!
This walk really gives one an invitation to return as it creates an appetite to further explore other areas of Berlin and Germany. Many thanks Sebastian B.

It was a very interesting walk in Berlin. In this tour you can see several of the main touristic and historical destinations on the city center. The guide Greg was good and funny, but spoke to quickly and it was hard to follow up his thoughts sometimes. He should take a bit slower on words, names and dates, especially in the beginning.

An amazing way to get an in-depth understanding of Berlin’s significant sights and their history. Kevin was extremely knowledgeable and helpful at answering questions and keeping everyone on track. He should have been my history teacher at school - Highly recommended!

Our tour guide Sam W. was outstanding. He entertained us for the entire 4,5 hours with the right mixture of information, facts and humour. The tour covers the most highlights in Berlin Mitte and gives you an idea of which things you might want to explore further. Great value for money, I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin.

We went on this tour yesterday after a friend recommended it to us. Took around 3.5-4 hours with a little break in the middle. Saw loads of places in that time and learnt lots. The tour ends up at the topography of terror museum which is free and also worth going in. Our tour guide was called Dave and was very knowledgeable. Would really recommend this tour as it is a great way to see the city if you are only here for a short time :)

Our guide, Gregor Berger, was outstanding. He took us to so many memorable locations. The best part of his presentation was that he challenged us at each step of the way. Rather than just telling us what a certain memorial was - we'd first view it, then he'd get the groups reaction, then he would tell his perspective. Very thought provoking and I will remember these places because he called upon us to think about what we were seeing. Loved this guide - Greg!

Kevin kept us on pace to discover the highlights of Berlin in 4.5 hours. Excellent historical view of a city with a very different history than most European Capitals. We booked this for our first day and it was an excellent priori the city geography and history. Be prepared for lots of walking at a fast clip with a 29 minute break for a snack and the facilities. Bring a bottle of water and comfortable shoes and be prepared for a fabulous experience!

From the first introduction, Wouter (“wow ter”) laid the ground work and provided an excellent history lesson which really helped set up what we can expect to see. He really helped us process what happened to Berlin over the years from Nazi Germany to the Berlin Wall. It was an amazing history lesson. Wouter would ask provocative questions about how we felt about sites that he showed which we found to be impactful and thought provoking. Wouter is super smart. Very good at framing information for all people. We saw everything you need to see in 4 hours. Then you can go back to the sites if you want to dive deeper. His commentary was informative, funny, provocative. It couldn’t have gone better! I hope you get Wouter for your tour!!!

No better way to start your visit to Berlin. Great way to see the main areas of central Berlin and perhaps shortlist some more in-depth visits. Gregor B was brilliant a guide, sharing personal stories and opinions with wit and grace, engaging with a wide range of views.

Great Tour with young history graduate and journalist Matti. He was born in East Berlin the year before the Wall came down - so plenty of fascinating family anecdotes about life in in the East. Matti had a fabulous knowledge of pre-20th century history that he combined brilliantly with the past century of two world wars and the cold war. He really bought the history of Berlin to life, and set us up perfectly for next final two days of our stay. Highly recommended.

We joined this tour based on exceptional reviews, and it did not disappoint.

Initially, given our interest in World War II history; we were concerned that this tour would be more of an "all-round" tour of Berlin, however; we were pleasantly surprised at the amount of related content.

We were taken around Berlin by Nathan, an American—don't hold that against him; he has lived in Berlin for three years with accreditations in all things German—and were engaged right throughout. Even if you're not a history buff; the content is compelling and delivered in a succinct fashion. Nathan was all too accommodating with any questions, too.

The tour covers the history of Berlin—and Germany as a whole—as well as detailing events leading up to and during the world wars and the 20th-century separation. Importantly, the content is delivered in an objective fashion, without bias.

We'd recommend this tour for anyone. You'll definitely walk away with more knowledge than when you arrived.

Many thanks, Nathan. This was thoroughly enjoyable.
Our guide Ryan knew everything you could possibly ever want to know!! Very informative and a very enjoyable way to see Berlin.

Our guide, Matti, ensured that this tour was the best we have ever taken, not just for the sheer number of sights we toured, but also for the amount and quality of information he provided.

At each site, we were treated to an entertaining and concise history which neatly provided a context for what we were about to see. Often we were shown photographs of the sights post or pre-war to further inform. He was able to answer any and all questions; completely approachable.

Can not recommend this tour enough - thank you Matti!

Our guide Kevin was fantastic and so passionate on our tour. It is a fantastic way to see Berlin, especially if you do not have long to explore the city. I cannot recommend this company enough as you learn so much history about the city.

I highly recommend this tour for anyone coming to Berlin for the first time or for anyone who isn't too familiar with the history of the city. It was a wonderful 4+ hours. I learned so much on this tour, thanks in most part to Tobi's enthusiasm for the topic. An East Berliner himself, he related a lot of the history to his experiences, sharing some of his insights and knowledge. This is so important when walking around a city you don't know, or surrounded by history you're not aware of. He brought much of the city to life. He was candid and educated us about some of the more negative aspects of the tour, such as the "fundraisers" who are found all over the city looking to "raise money", essentially for themselves. I was here for a conference and had a couple of days to spare. The tour itself was filled with interesting facts and stories. It was better than a classroom session on the history of Berlin. At the conclusion of the tour, I asked Tobi what I could buy that wasn't overtly touristy but was something from Berlin, and he introduced me to Ampelmann. What a treat! I would never have known about this delightful piece of Berlin history, so thank you Tobi for all you did to make our tour as top class as it was.

I will be recommending this tour to anyone who comes to Berlin - whether the first time, or the 10th time. I have also been on many tours throughout the years, and this ranks as one of the bests. Our tour guide, Nathan, was fantastic. We half joked that he was able to basically summarize a semester's worth of world history in 15 minutes. It was great how he was able to discuss the history, then show us the sights. Our tour group was a manageable 25 people and we covered a lot of ground. It was also nice to meet other people from around the world.
Our guide Jess was no less than perfect He knows history of Berlin, appreciate art and architecture and has great sense of humor. 5 hours flied quickly!
Just finished a tour with Ryan. Cannot speak highly enough about his knowledge and handling of tour!!

I was slightly alarmed to see the large size of the walking group at the outset, but our guide Nathan managed to keep everyone together and it was never a problem to hear him. He gave a really comprehensive, fascinating and passionate account of the history of Germany and Berlin - clearly his degree in European history was put to good use. I really recommend this tour to appreciate Berlin and used his recommendations to visit the Checkpoint Charlie exhibition and other memorials subsequently. Thanks very much Nathan. By the way, wear comfortable shoes & bring water - the tour lasts 4 hours although there is a coffee stop along the way.

We did the 4 hour tour this week with Georgia who was an amazing tour guide. We got to see a lot of sites around the city within our time and she had tonnes of interesting facts about each place and was really good at keeping everyone engaged and everyone really enjoyed it too. I used to have a negative view of walking tours but after doing one with Georgia it completely changed my mind and I love them now! I particularly enjoyed her story at the end about the fall of the Berlin Wall, and how she had made a map with recommendations on things to do in the city. Had we had more time in Berlin we definitely would have joined one of Georgias many other tours. It was a great way to see Berlin and to get to know its history. Definitely would recommend.

Took this tour on the 28th of September and I completely forget the name of our guide (so sorry!!) but he was Irish and really funny! He had a great knowledge of Berlin’s history and could answer any questions asked. Also, there were lots of road closures which stopped us visiting some key sites but he made the most of it and showed us some things off the beaten track which was really cool! Highly recommend :)

We met the group for a 4 hr tour with guide Beth we visited all the relevent sites in and around the Wall.
Beth was very warm and friendly with an amazing knowledge of Berlin and German history and obviously enjoys sharing them .

Thanks for a great day ..

This was a walking tour and not for those not physically fit. It covered a lot of territory in a short period of time and hit the major sites of Berlin. Lynsey gave an excellent overview and with a lot of history. Not a lot of time was spent at any site so if you want a more in depth view I suggest you go back to any of intetest at another time.

This tour covers a lot of ground and content but the way the information was presented was interesting and thought-provoking as well as entertaining. The tour guide, Izzy, is bright, personable and extremely knowledgeable, and brought the history of Berlin to life. Myself and 3 friends took the tour on Saturday 6th October and would all highly recommend it. Many thanks to Izzy and Berlin Walking Tours for a great experience.

My husband I took this tour on the first day we were in Berlin. Our guide Lindsey was amazing. she was well versed in the history and geography of the area and gave us a very informative and thorough tour. I would recommend this for anyone visiting Berlin.

Izzy was fantastic! My Husband and I took this tour the 6th of October & our weather and guide couldn’t have been better! Izzy is incredibly knowledgeable and extremely well spoken. She was both funny and relatable. She offered insightful ways to consider the different memorials we visited that were thought provoking, but not overly opinionated or political. We loved the way the tour was organized and the way Izzy narrated our four-hour history lesson on central Berlin. We highly recommend her and the Berlin Walks touring company. We will be taking another one.

This was a very informative tour and excellent value. The guide, Kyle was an excellent communicator, very clear, slick and with good humour. Covered lots of ground in both distance and history. Really worthwhile doing. Recommended.

This is a must do! Georgia was amazing! It was a pretty crowded tour but the guide did a great job making sure everyone could hear and nobody would be left behind. This tour gives you all the highlights of the city. You see all the important places and learn about their history. It’s an almost 4 hours tour so bring comfortable shoes!

Our guide, Pip, has a masters in history from the UK and managed to retain and share with us 800 years of German history in a few hours. We tried to keep up with her but between Bismarck, the Prussian empire, World War I, World War II -and here she shared with us that Nazis were her specialty- the information she provided us was both extensive and fascinating. Overall, we felt like we just had a flash seminar on Germany’s history and enjoyed every minute of the tour. Highly recommended.

Our tour guide Dave was great! He was impressively knowledgeable about the history, politics and cultural stages not only of this city but since the creation of the country. This was not our first tour of the city and he was able to answer questions without a doubt that the other guides could not. The four hours past by without us noticing it. He gave us good breaks. He was clear in his speech. He was entertaining and very polite. Politically correct and mindful of the group safety. We definitely recommend Dave and this company for your tours!
Beth was fantastic tour guide!! She was a wealth of information. The tour was very informative and fun! Well worth the 4 hour walk.

Gregor led us on a walking tour of Berlin that gave us a great start to our adventure in Berlin. He clearly is very knowledgable in terms of history and helped us all understand the complex history of Berlin. Thank you!

Such a fantastic tour!! Superb! I travelled alone to Berlin and joined the 9am Original Walking Tour together with a small group of people. It was an amazing experience and I didn`t even noticed the 4-5hr walking around the city! The tourguide, which I unfortunately forgot the name, was very informative and outstanding. Plus, he speaks fluent English. I recommend this tour for everyone who wants to visit Berlin!
We just finished our tour today. It was a fantastic experience with Heida. The tour is informative and fun. Definitely recommend it!

There are many tours in Berlin. I recommend this one. It was informative, fun, and well-paced. We were lucky to have Lynsey, whose knowledge of German and Berlin history was impressive. She had many anecdotal stories and quotes to make much of the history come alive and she was able to answer all questions comprehensively. You can tell she has a passion for city. Great way to experience the key sites of Berlin in a morning and learn a great deal. Lynsey also shared recommendations for museums where we should spend additional time, movies related to events mentioned in the tour (13 Minutes and Downfall), and best neighborhoods for restaurants. I took her advice on several museums, including a visit to the Stasi Museum. This is a very affordable tour at 14 Euro. Well worth the price. Forego some of the more expensive tour options, ask for Lynsey, and tip well.

What a fantastic way to see and learn about this great city. Our guide Rob Willis was so knowledgeable and passionate about Berlin, skilfully conveying this love to our group. This was our first day in the city and the tips that he gave us for travelling, eating and more was really appreciated. We enjoyed it so much that we booked onto the East Berlin walk the following day. Would thoroughly recommend and the walk isn't strenuous.

Just finished the Discover Berlin afternoon walk with Nathan. This was a sensational experience. it's informative, never boring, nor tiring. You would think that 4 hours (including a 20 minute café/bathroom break would be too much or tiring but it's not. Nathan had a terrific sense of the history of the country, concentrating mostly on the events of the 20th Century. Whether you are a history buff or someone who spent more time studying their own country's history, I guarantee you will be enlightened by this experience.

A very well run company. They anticipated a larger than normal group and arranged for a second leader to ensure people had a good opportunity to hear their guide. Our guide today was Kevin. He spoke wonderfully about his 'adopted city', drawing upon his experience as a historian and his educational background. He provided a balanced and incredibly knowledgeable look into Berlin's rich history without pushing his own perspective. This is a tour for those who are looking for more than 'shiny' highlights and is a great orientation from which to further explore the city. Well worth the ticket.

Even a little bit of rain did not spoil a great tour. It was incredible walking around to much recent history plus the inside and accurate comments of our tour guide Darren. Thanks so much. For sure I will do it again next time.

Arriving in Berlin I decided to book onto a tour as an introduction to the city, to see all of the cities most significant landmarks.

Our guide Ken was incredibly knowledgable and really bought Berlin to life, with a fascinating insight into the events from a somewhat turbulent past. His captivating style and sense of humour really made the tour.

Highly educational and highly recommended!

Rob was excellent, very engaging and knowledgable on his subject. If we had more time in Berlin we would have joined him on other tours
Thank you Rob

A great way to learn about the history of Berlin! An amazing end to my trip, it made me so much more eager to learn about the history of the war and the split between east and west Berlin! Tour guide was awesome and listened to all the enquiries and curiosities we had and was quick to answer! Made me want to return to Berlin and learn more as you learn so many facts i didn't have a clue about! 100% recommend this.

I would have paid x4 the price I did for this. And I'm generally broke...

It wasn't just a walk with a guy who knew his stuff. Wouter Bernhardt delivered a lecture, a performance, and even a pleasant walking companion. High energy throughout. Some of his talks felt like a piece of narrated theatre. I'll be coming again next year and doing more guided walks. He's reminded me that a city comes alive when history is physically explored through space, engagement and discussion. Thoroughly satisfied.

perfect way of getting to know the layout of this city as well as the history and how events unfolded in the 20th century. a long but easy walk with a charming guide. Our knowledgeable, patient and very well informed guide Sam W took us to all the best known sites in the city centres. the tour was very crowded but Sam W was able to be heard by all.
highly recommend this tour to anyone

I highly recommend this tour if you want a well-researched and precise. Our guide, Sam W., was excellent with a good sense of humor. 4 hours passed by quite fast. It was a lovely experience for my two sisters and I. We even booked a second tour to the concentration camp for next day after this tour. And Sam also gave us shopping info :).
Wonderful tour by Rachel on Tuesday. So informative and she pointed out interesting spots to go back when we had our own free time. Wear walking shoes!

We truly enjoyed our tour with Lynsey. Very knowledgeable about the history of the area. She taught us a great deal about this amazing city. She gave us recommendations which we followed up on later in our stay. Recommend the tour highly and Lynsey glowingly.

Our guide was Lynsey.
This was an excellent introduction to Berlin - it's main sites and it's history over 800 years.Lynsey had a detailed knowledge which she imparted to us in an interesting and often humorous way.Four hours of history and sites covering 4/5 miles can be a long time but it passed over so quickly. Lynsey was always open to questions on anything about Berlin, obviously loves the City and really enjoys her job.
Thank you Lynsey.

I highly recommend this tour if you’ve never been to Berlin before. It gave us an excellent insight into the history and sites of this city. Our guide, Kevin, was very well informed and entertaining in his presentation of a city and subject he obviously has a passion for.

We were pleased to discover that booking was not essential and so we just turned up at the meeting point. We had confidence, having read the reviews, that this was a well organised and professional outfit. Our guide Lynsey confirmed this by providing a very well researched and engaging tour of the main sights of central Berlin. Some of the content was disturbing and thought-provoking, but we were aware of this before hand. We thought that these issues were sensitively handled by Lynsey and were balanced by more light-hearted elements such as the balcony where Michael Jackson dangled his baby son. The holocaust memorial was particularly upsetting and we were sorry that we did not have enough time to return and form our own interpretation of its design. This was a very informative and polished depiction of a fascinating city and its complex history. Thank you
Very informative , Our guide Laura was very knowledgeable and answered any questions we had , lots to see , our 4-5 hours went by quickly and walking bit was very easier .Highly recommend.

Excellent tour with Georgia, she gave just enough history and information that I found it interesting rather than overwhelming. Length of the tour was perfect. Time to take in the sights was just right. Recommendation for a restaurant for dinner that evening was spot on. Had a great time in Berlin and want to go back to explore more.

I highly recommend the Discover Berlin Half-Day Walking Tour as a great insight of the history of Berlin and a good way of getting your bearings of the city to explore further on your own.

The tour was made very interesting by our guide Lynsey who was very knowledgeable, informative and had a lovely personality.

Thank you Lynsey for a great tour!

All in all, a lovely tour. Kyle, our guide, was a native English speaker and very informed about the history and culture of Germany. Her ability to take both an inside and an outside perspective on German culture was refreshing and started many a rich conversation in our small group.

It was relatively easy to find the starting point, considering the complex roads of Berlin, and it was very easy to get there by subway. You may want to bring a bottle of water and sunglasses on a bright day. The pace is very reasonable. Kyle did a great job warning us about possible pickpocketing risks along the way, which came in handy because we actually ran into some of the forewarned folks! This is the only part of Berlin where I thought it'd be nice to have a travel wallet around my waist as a fallback option.

Our guide, Sebastian, was perfectly in tune with our keen interest in learning just enough history to appreciate the architecture and placement of the major buildings in central Berlin, to resonate with story of Frederic Wilhelm (the Great) and the other monarchs, and to find and absorb enough information about the empire, the democracy, the 3rd Reich, the Soviet era, and the modern age. It was just a taste, but a rather good introduction to the city. Most importantly it provides an excellent opportunity to see what has changed in recent years for tourists who wonder about the changes since the Wall came down.
Had a great walking tour of Berlin. The tour guide was very friendly, knowledgeable, and informative of the history, and architecture of the city. Would recommend this tour to everyone.

I'd definitely recommend the tour as a first introduction to the area. It helps you get your barrings and you see a lot of good stuff from the outside (taking mental notes of what you want to go back to later). Ken our tour guide was great and gave us personal recommendations. My only (minor) negative for 4 stars instead of 5 is that the group was HUGE with about 40 people. At this size, you might as well do one of the free "pay tip only" tours. Personally, I wish I had paid a bit more and done a "small group" tour...but still 40 people is still unacceptable for even the low price.
Gregor did an amazing job on this walking tour. Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. Provided multiple perspectives and made you think about the history.

Enjoyed the tour so much as I could visit many main historical Landmarks in Berlin. Our humorous and knowledgeable guide Gregor, who studies art history, did a great job! He gave so much information and history and questions etc. all were very interesting. For sure I could visit the places referring to some travel guides, but then I would likely only take a few photos and miss a lot of important historical information, which I cannot understand how/why Berlin and Germany are like nowadays.

The tour covered many spots (you can refer to the tour introduction) and we had a coffee break in between. The route was good and interesting.
Definitely the tour is great value for money. Highly recommend this tour.

My sister and I had the pleasure of doing this tour on our first day in Berlin and found it incredibly valuable and of great value-per-euro as well (14 euro for tour + I gave 4 euro tip). The tour lasted approx 3.5 hours and provided us with a strong foundation on the city's history, orientation on various suburbs, and visits to all key "top 10" Berlin sites as well. Our guide Dave was extremely knowledgeable, welcomed questions and made everyone feel welcomed and well-cared for. Highly recommended, especially if Dave is your guide!

This tour totally exceeded my expectation. It was very well planned, and the landmarks we covered tell a great story of the rich history Berlin has to offer. Like many other people visited Berlin, I’ve known bits and pieces of the city’s past, and this tour was able to filled in the big gaps for me. Our guide Sam B.V. did a wonderful job. He knows his stuff by heart, is very energetic, and has a great sense of humor. I’d say this tour is a must-do for anyone who wishes to know more about Berlin.

The only thing that could use some improvements is since the route is along very busy streets, it is not always easy to hear our guide over the crowd or passing traffic. It would be even better if there is a way to enhance the audio in the future.

Highly recommend this walking tour it was far more beneficial than sitting on the tour busses. Excellent tour guide he gave deep history on each stop. The guide was brilliant he was entertaining and gave very detailed information at each stop. A much better way of seeing the city and learning of its history.

For this tour I recommend comfortable walking shoes it is a lot of walking and sunscreen.
My tour guide was Rachel and she was very knowledgeable, great at answering my many questions and managing the group. Rachel was awesome!

This was a brilliant thing to do - our guide Lindsey was so knowledgeable, giving enough detail in an engaging and humours way. We went a good pace and learnt so much. Thank you we enjoyed it so much and can recommend it without any hesitation.
This was a very good overview of many of the important sites in Berlin - the guide did a great job and we had a very good time.

My friends and I absolutely loved the best of Berlin tour. Our guide Nathan was very informative and gave an excellent history of Berlin from medieval times to modern day with all the best sights explained. Would highly recommend to anyone who wants a great overview of Berlin in a few hours.

With a professor of history as our guide we were in excellent hands. This was an English speaking tour but we were the only English couple in the party, others were Australian, American, Canadian. Our guide put across the history of Berlin like a best selling novel, armed with his portfolio of historic pictures. We were enthralled and it got even better when we reached the Holocaust Memorial blocks when Kevin asked how we all felt. Most people in our group were forthcoming with their emotions, it was a memorable moment. If you want a tour of Berlin this is the one, but make sure Kevin is your guide.

A fascinating introduction to Berlin, with a well- informed and entertaining guide, Ken. He introduced us to many of the main sights in the centre of the city, giving us plenty of background information. It helped us decide where we would like to visit in more detail later in the our stay. I would definitely recommend this to visitors to Berlin.
However, there was no sign of the map and city guide promised in the advert and in the booking information, so don't rely on being given one.
Thought this tour was very good. Very informative, interesting and gave us lots of info about historical Berlin guide was Elisha, well done

This is the best way to start a trip to Berlin. You get a nice overview of the many sites and museums. You can then decide which ones are worth a deeper dive. The guide provides a lot of additional information for a follow up visit if you ask (how best to get tickets on short notice, the best bang for the buck, etc.). I found the tourist map a bit difficult to follow. I don't know if I would have been able to navigate seeing all the sites on my own.

This was a 4 hour walking tour of the highlights of Historical Berlin. We saw many famous landmarks and had the history explained in such an interesting way. Our tour guide, Sam, was friendly and extremely knowledgeable: I learned so much and recommend this very highly.

We spent almost five hours during our first day in Berlin, and it was really worth. I recommend you our guide, Jeff, a nice guy that gave us every detail about the history of the places and the mood of Berlin across time. Very very recommended!

We were guided by Rachel and the tour was everything we could have wanted. She offered lots of interesting details and a reals sense for the historical past of Berlin and the larger region around it. We highly recommend this tour and, in particular Rachel as a guide.

On our first full day in Berlin, we did the half day walking tour, with Rob Shaw as the guide. We couldn't have made a better choice. The tour covers most of the highlights of Berlin's attractions and history. This was a great way to orient ourselves to the layout of the city. Best of all was our guide, Rob Shaw. He has an incredible in-depth knowledge of Berlin's history and the people. His style is highly interactive and engaging. At any of the sites he can talk at length about the history and the events "behind the scenes". You can't get that in most tour books!

We enjoyed this tour so much that when we learned he was doing the Sachsenhausen tour the next day, we changed our plans for the rest of the trip just to go with him again. Thank you Rob...Best tours ever!!

We really enjoyed this tour because :
1) We learnt so much about Berlin History in a very short time.
2) After the tour it was really easy to orientate ourselves for the rest of our stay.

The tour was a very enjoyable introduction to all things about Berlin. Our guide Gregor was knowledgeable entertaining and so passionate about what he does that we went overtime by an hour ( paid for 4 hours got 5 ! ). The tour has a very well designed walking route with shade and breaks and the information was given in such a way that it was easy to visualize the chronological timeline and importance of historical events in Berlin. Thank you Gregor and thank you Berlin!

Kai is a wonderful guide. Superb historic knowledge which he conveys with passion answering questions with fascinating detail. He tackles all of German modern history with honesty in a forthright warts and all approach. The tour is a great way to start a trip to Berlin. Kai’s opening history mini-lecture was brilliant putting the rest of the trip in context. Strongly recommend this tour.

We took this tour today as we were only in Berlin for one day, and this tour did not leave us feeling like we have missed out on anything, Sarah our tour guide was full of information, and facts, and also giving us tips on the best places to go after the tour had finished. I didn’t know what to expect from this tour but it certainly changed my opinion of doing tours like this again, it’s a must do tour for Berlin

An excellent tour of Berlin's highlights. Our guide Tobias (“Tobi”) was top notch: knowledgable, friendly, fun. His upbringing in East Germany adds unique insight. Tobi took his time explaining, answering our questions yet we still saw everything on our wishlist. There were four of us on a private walking tour. We highly recommend him. Thank you, Tobi! Also, Lars did a great job arranging our tour. Thank you, Lars!

I was a little wary when I saw our group was going to be over 30 people, but our guide Beth was fantastic (I believe she has a degree in German history), we stopped off in a park and she gave us a whirlwind 20 minute talk on the 800 or so year history of Berlin. Stunning. We then went and saw all the sites you'd expect from a tour of this nature and were allowed to take photos without issue.

A brief stop at halfway point for refreshments on a warm day was appreciated and then the information overload continued (in a good way). I could feel myself getting smarter just standing near Beth.

If you have any interest in Berlin, and you obviously have as you are reading this then this tour is ridiculous value for me for what you see and get.

Booked this on a friends recommendation and very pleased at we did. My 15 year old son found this just as interesting as I did. Apart from the sights and historical info, we both found that our guide Gregor did an excellent job of explaining some of the monuments and street artwork, and as neither of us are normally very interested in those that is particularly impressive. All round a very enjoyable and interesting tour.
Lynsey was an awesome tour guide. She had a great deal of information and was very personable. We learned so much!

This tour was terrific. We had a very knowledgeable guide - Jess. He did a wonderful job explaining the significance of the sites that we saw and had a very accessible approach in doing so. He was a wealth of historical and political information. It was an excellent way to get an understanding of the many important sites in Berlin in a fairly quick fashion. Jess also made several great recommendations for further touring for those that had time.Highly recommended.
Thank you Kyle for a very informative tour, we’re so glad we had the chance to learn in depth about the history of Berlin !

We did our tour with the lovely Kyle. She was such a friendly, informative guide, we found her very approachable. Our group of 20 left our meeting point right on time, and headed off on a 4 hour walking tour around beautiful Berlin. The entire walk is on flat ground so most people would manage this tour. Kyle gave us all a very thorough German history lesson. Her extensive knowledge was impressive. We visited many landmarks. Kyle was also very helpful with our forward travel arrangements and wished us all safe travels. Highly recommend.
My business provides guided tours and I was on a trip to test out what was on offer in Berlin. Glad to see so many very good tours to choose from, very encouraging.
Half day walking tour which lasts about 4 hours and is undertaken at an easy pace across Berlin (which is a flat city) - great way to hear and see the history of the city. Kathryn was a great guide!

Our tour guide was Kathryn, who was so lovely and incredibly knowledgeable of the history and geography of Berlin. The tour itself was so informative and covered all areas of interest, including the main landmarks/historical sites in Berlin. Great value for money, we would definitely recommend.

We had Jonathan as our guide and he was amazing! He has so much knowledge of the City and the history. There was alot to see and we covered alot of ground. I would highly recommend booking this tour - you wont be disappointed.

We went on a half day walking tour of Berlin. Our guide was Kevin. He was the most interesting and passionate guide with much knowledge of the history of Berlin. We found the walking tour to be the best way to get your bearings and discover where you want to explore. Very exciting city with Germans very friendly and willing to help you with the language barrier. I would highly recommend Original Berlin Walks and would definitely recommend Kevin as your guide.

Our guide, Kathryn, was very informed on the history of Berlin and answered all questions put to her. She was friendly, chatty and helpful; all you could want in a tour guide! Would definitely recommend everyone to do this tour at the start of their stay.

Hey I took this tour with the girlfriend and was thoroughly entertained. We had Kathryn who spoke very clearly and expressed a clear passion for the city.

She was almost savant-like in reeling off names and dates. Very good tour. Highly recommend and the time flew by. Thanks

Our tour guide, Lynsey, was terrific for this walk. She shepherded her large group of 23 persons around the best sights in die Mitte of Berlin. She gave great descriptions of lots of history, but not too much, just the right amount. She was polite, gave plenty of time for questions, and was very helpful throughout the tour with lots of information of additional things to see and do. I highly recommend this company and Lynsey in particular.

The walking tour, as a whole, was enjoyable and not physically demanding- as Berlin is mostly flat. The tour guide contributed with great depth and breath of the city’s history from WWI, WWII, and the Cold War and how such events relate to the present. The guide also encouraged the perfect amount of questions and invited conversation. This experience was interactive and immersive, which is why it merits 5 stars. I would definitely recommend it as a first tour of Berlin.

My tour guide was Lynsey who provided an excellent tour of Berlin's most important touristy and untouristy hotspots. I had a fabulous time and was able to easily navigate my way around the city after the tour (which shows that I was paying attention!). The guide was lovely and the organisation shown by the company was superb, I therefore cannot recommend this company and this guide enough!

Not only was this walking tour very affordable but the quality of our guide was way beyond our expectations. We learned so much about the part of Berlin we were in/ Our guide used the architecture of the building as a reference point into the heart and and soul of Berlin and the history of last century. Very engaging tour.
Brett gave us a great insite into Berlin and it’s history. Learnt a lot about its past. It was a great adventures. Loved it

Went on this tour and our guide was Kevin who was exceptional in his knowledge and passion for the city of Berlin . He covered the major history points of the Berlin he was passionate and had excellent knowledge of his subject. He was always mindful of the group it was a very hot day so always looked for the shade when stopping to explain his points of history . The tour itself cover s lots of the major sites of Berlin. We did this on our first day here so gave us a good feel of the city and were to re visit in more depth. I would certainly recommend this tour if you ever visit Berlin.

We booked the four-hour tour around Berlin and visited the most popular sites downtown with our guide, Georgia. I had to talk my husband into signing up for such a long tour, but we were both very interested and the tour flowed along nicely. It was the perfect length for us. Georgia was an excellent guide and very helpful with our questions (recommendations on restaurants and museums as well).

We went a half day trip in Berlin with Jess from USA. He is a fantastic knowledgeable and inspirational guide! Although I am hearing impaired, I had no problem hearing what he said, he spoke very clearly with a nice voice.

I went on a walking tour with Kai Arne Janssen. He is an amazing tour guide. The tour lasted just under 4.5 hours. He knows the history of everything here, even the statues we passed. There wasn’t one question the group asked that he didn’t have a detailed answer for. It was hot and sunny but he made an effort to walk in the shade, stop and talk in shaded areas, which was very much appreciated by all. Great tour!

This is a great way to start your trip. You get an excellent overview of the city by a true professional. The length and scope of the tour is perfect, so I would highly recommend it. Rachel was my guide, and she obviously has a real passion for history. She kept us moving along at a good pace, and she had extremely good commentary throughout the tour.

Hi! My family and I took this half day walk last Friday morning at 10:30am and Darren was our guide. Darren was very informative, witty and extremely good at explaining things on the walk which made one think a bit deeper about all that has happenend historically in Berlin. I really loved it. It was informative and inspiring to learn more about Berlin.

It was a walk from 10:30 - 15:00 which was perfect for us as I had booked a visit to the Bundestab at 1545. We started our walk at Hackescher Markt station and ended by Checkpoint Charlie. We covered a lot of places and got really good, concise historical info. I had an 11 year old with me...and even though she got bored she walked along with us and hopefully when she learns about history a bit later in school she will remember this walk! :)

I had Rachel as our lovely tour guide around Berlin! She was fantastic, super friendly and informative with history facts as we walked around the city to some of Berlin’s most popular sights/landmarks, putting them in context. The tour wasn’t rushed and at a great pace to take everything in as well as get those desired happy snaps!
Definitely recommend the tour to get an idea of Berlin and main attractions if you are staying a short time (like myself) & shows you where things are if you have time to go back & spend longer somewhere if needed.

Booked a waking tour with Original Berlin Walks. Good price, reasonably sized group. Our guide Lynsey was knowledgeable, approachable, happy to answer questions. The tour was about 4 hours, pretty easy as Berlin is completely flat. We saw all the major sites and received a very nice overview along with suggestions for how to learn more or gain more in depth knowledge. Would recommend the tour and guide.

Our family thoroughly enjoyed our walking tour with Brett... We were kept enthralled, Brett gave us time to stroll along, even our son kept up with us and stayed interested..... Halfway, we stopped at a cafe for a short rest... Thank you Brett, we definitely recommend you and Berlin Walking Tour.

Chose your most comfortable walking shoes because the tour involves a great deal of standing interspersed with bursts of slow-mo walking on unrelenting urban surfaces.

Guide - Jess - who quite literally as a student of Germany’s medieval history lives and breathes Berlin. Encyclopaedic knowledge delivered in a pattern that varies from day-to-day depending on the narrative he’s creating.

Kyle was an amazing tour guide who had endless interesting information and stories based on German history! This tour is an excellent way for beginners to get around the area and learn more about its history! Would highly recommend to anyone!

The tour covered the most important historical and cultural landmarks in short time, which gave beginner good ideas where to do next if more time is available. For visitors with short time, the tour led you to the most important landmarks. Our guide Kathryn is very knowledgeable and I learned a lot from this tour.
Our tour guide Rick brought the arc of Berlin's history to life with much energy and insight. Would highly recommend this tour to anyone interested in learning more about the city's history.

Our guide Alice had a great knowledge and enthusiasm for the history of both Germany and Berlin. This is a great way to see the important parts of the city together with things you may miss in a guide book. We felt we had a much greater appreciation of the city and it’s history after this walk. The 4 hours passed very quickly in spite of the exceptional high temperatures. Don’t forget to take a drink with you.
Thank you to Alice.

My spouse and I scheduled this tour as one of our first things to do in Berlin. We had the absolute pleasure of having Beth as our tour guide - wow did we luck out! Beth is very passionate about the history of Berlin and we learned so much - but the best part is that she's so engaging. We could have spent the entire day listening to her (and wish we would have had that chance). Truly - this was a great start to our week in Berlin and strongly encourage you to book this tour if you are looking for some fascinating history of Berlin.

Our guide, Rachel, was fabulous. Informed and interesting to listen to, I learned a lot during this tour. Rachel gave interesting information at each stop and although we were a large group, I never had to struggle to hear her. The sites we visited were brilliantly explained and I now want to explore more after learning so much and being given lots of ideas and suggestions about further things to see and do. Wonderful way to spend time in Berlin.

Our guide Nathan was passionate about the history of Berlin and his style was engaging. He addressed questions from the group with ease and when presenting the details ensured he made eye contact with everyone on the tour irrespective of their age. He articulated dates and events and shared a personal account of his history. We all walked away from the tour with a greater understanding of the history of Berlin and the 11 and 12 year old with us were highly complimentary of the guide and the tour itself as were we.

Our son recommended we visit Berlin, so we came. This tour was our introduction, and our guide Rick gave us an extremely insightful trip through the city centre.and its past 500 years. Resident in the city for the past 10 years, his knowledge of german history was impeccable and he was able to present a perspective of a foreign visitor who had grown to love the place, warts and all. We really appreciated his frankness and willingness to offer alternative interpretations of the fascinating landmarks, as well as the events and cultural context that lead to their existence. This really helped us plan the rest of our stay in Berlin. Thanx Rick!

Heidi was our fabulous tour guide. She was very pleasant and knowledgable. We enjoyed the tour. It was useful to do on our first day to get a flavour of the city and plan the things we wanted to explore in more detail. The tour lasted 3.5-4 hours with a short coffee stop on the way, which was most welcome. Good for my 16 year old but for young children it would have been too long.

Alicia was our guide, she was brilliant - very funny, engaging and taught us a lot about old Berlin, and an insight on how modern day Berlin is really like. We both wished that the tour went on for longer!

Our family of 7 had a great time with Wouter learning about Berlin, its history, and all the important sites around town. Highly recommended as an introduction to the city especially if you are limited on time. Thanks a bunch.

Blessed to have Jess as tour guide, his knowledge of the history accompanied with photos , made tge tour exceptioal. The time flew he doesnt mind lots of questions and was happy to go overtime to ensure we missed out on anything.

Alice was our guide and she was excellent! She was very well versed in her history and was able to provide background information about the city as well as the places that we visited. Definitely would recommend the tour and Alice.

Along with friends we had a very interesting walking tour with Barnaby as our guide. He was excellent. Very informative and also able to include some light entertainment. The four hours passed so quickly. Would have no hesitation of recommending this tour.

Kai was our guide and he was brilliant! Really knowledgable, clearly passionate about the city with an engaging delivery style and good sense of humour. The tour was fascinating (the stop for cake also welcome!) and has definitely inspired me to return to Berlin to explore more of the city. Wear your comfy shoes as your feet will be aching by the end, there's just so much to see! :)

Jess was the guide for the tour I went on, and in half a day I gained an appreciation for Berlin that I might not have attained otherwise. I had spent two days walking around the city before this tour, but I didn't know what I was looking at. Jess provided context and knowledge that made me want to stay in Berlin longer.

My guide was Nathan. He gave an excellent tour and really knew his German history and World War history. In just three hours, I felt like I learned a lot about how Germany came to be a country and the rise and fall of Nazi Germany. He took us around to all of the typical historical highlights that one would want to see on their first time visit to Berlin. I highly recommend this tour and especially Nathan as a tour guide!

Brian Bell was a great tour guide. Throughout our tour you could feel his passion and love for the people and city of Berlin. His historical knowledge and storytelling was fantastic. It was entertaining and respectful of a city with so much history.

My husband, two teen daughters and myself were completely engaged with Gregor’s education on Berlin’s history. With his encouragement to think, question and be engaged with arts and politics, we felt a strong sense of community in our diverse group. Gregor Bergen was open to all questions and responded to delicate topics with openness and acceptance. We were tired at the end of the walk and had no idea how to get back to our hotel, but soon figured that out as well.

My family consisting of my husband and our three kids, ages 23, 18 and 11 took this tour and it was fantastic. Our tour guide was Dave from Australia. He was very knowledgeable and friendly. He was very considerate of the guests and always looked for rest areas where we could sit along the tour. It took the entire 4 hours but it was so interesting that you don't mind the walk. Really, it is the best way to get to know the city. As you go along, you can develop a list of places you will revisit when you have more time. This tour is one of the first things to do when you arrive in Berlin.

Dave was an excellent story teller and even our 11 year old was interested the entire time.

We booked this tour to get a preview of the city on our first day in Berlin. Nathan was our guide, he was very informative, kept the tour interesting, and made it a wonderful experience. Great way to see the city and leaves you knowing exactly where to go next if you are staying longer than one day! Highly recommend.

I booked this tour based on the reviews. The tour did not disappoint. Rob from Manchester was an excellent guide who provided the insight into Berlin and its people together with the events that mapped the history of Berlin. The tour was relaxed, informative and fun and I would thoroughly recommend this to anyone who can walk for 4 hours.

Did the tour today, my first day in Berlin, with Rob from Manchester. The pace and amount of information was perfect and Rob was the perfect guide. His enthusiasm for the city is infectious and he did a great job managing a large (31 people) group. I admit to being worried when I saw how many people were on the tour, but Rob was easy to hear and follow and he really brought the history and spirit of Berlin to life. Excellent orientation!

We joined an original Berlin walking tour with our guide being Rob Willis..... he was excellent and in 4 hours you got a proper tour of all the many interesting tourist sites Berlin has to offer.

Robs delivery showed a real passion for Berlin which was impressive for a non native and his knowledge and humour made it a great half day tour.

I would recommend without hesitation.

Dave Bristol.

What value for money!!!
Nathan our tour guide was fantastic. His knowledge of the history of Berlin was amazing. The pace of the tour was great and I certainly felt that I saw the main areas of interest. Definitely recommend this walking tour!!! Thanks guys!!!

As the title reads, very in depth also. Good to have a basic knowledge on some of Germany’s history to do with the war but there is lots to learn. Excellent tour guide Rick who went into plenty of detail along the tour and answering questions, has a great grasp and interest in the history of Berlin which goes a long way. Excellent tour for the money, a great way to learn about the history of Berlin involving the war and everything that came with it.

My wife and I enjoyed this tour so much. Rick was very knowledgeable about the sites in Berlin and ready and able to answer the group's questions. It was a hot day and Rick was very patient and understanding of the need for shade. The tour was filled with so much information and the time spent at the Holocaust Memorial was so powerful. Rick, thanks for a wonderful afternoon. Tom & Pat D.

Our guide was Jonathan. He was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about the tour and the historic sites we visited. Although the group was fairly large, Jonathan did a good job keeping the group together and answering everyone’s questions. The half day walking tour is a great way to see the main historic sites in a short amount of time.

Our guide Rick was amazing, his presentation supported by his knowledge was 1st class. It was a very hot dat in Berlin 32 deg and a 4 hour walking tour is not for the faint hearted but it did not deter us

We did the Berlin half day walking tour and our guide Jonathan was extremely informative. His presentation of the city which is immersed in history in a nut shell put a clear picture in front of us. We did this on our first day in Berlin so we got a head start of how to move ahead from there.

Wow! This tour was so awesome. We started our tour with Lynsey, and there were about 20 people in the group. Lynsey was very nice, and she covered hundreds of years of German history in about four hours, which was so cool. We went to all the main attractions, starting with the museum island. She was so mindful and respectful. She made sure that nobody from the group was left behind. She answered everyone's questions and made recommendations regarding museums, cool bars and restaurants, and other attractions not to be missed.

If you are in Berlin, then you should definitely do this trip. It is half and day, and you will get so much information that you otherwise would not uncover.

You will not be disappointed.

Thank You, Lynsey!!!

We started our tour at 10:30am and it lasted about 4 hours with a 30 minute break in the middle. Our tour guide was Oh-Ken from Ireland and he was excellent! We have no doubts that we would not have enjoyed our tour as much with a different guide. Ken's accent was also awesome and added to the tour (The Turd (Third) Reich, LOL). We stopped in the shade everywhere possible to stay cool. It was a slightly fast walking pace but we are in standard American shape 😊 and it was all mostly flat so not difficult at all to keep up. Ken waited for everybody in the group yo catch up before he talked and even counted everybody before moving on so he still had everybody.

Definitely book this tour as a first or last activity of your visit. If you get Ken as your guide you will enjoy it even more than usual.

Wouter knew pretty much everything about Berlin and taught us about the history in a really entertaining way. The tour hit all the big Berlin sites and took care of pretty much everything that I wanted to see in Berlin for sure. I highly recommend it!
Such a great tour, well paced, really informative. Our tour guide was Marriette who made it feel very individual.

We only had two days in Berlin and this 4 hour tour gave us a little bit of lots of things and helped us decide what to do with the rest of our time. Lynsey our guide was excellent, she knew the city and its history and explained everything really clearly. She was also happy to help people by providing advice at the end about how to get to/get tickets for other things they wanted to do. She managed the group - who walked at very different speeds. The pace was spot on as far as not being rushed but also not wasting time.

Whenever we visit a new city we always try to book a walking tour learn about the place we are staying in and maybe pick up some local info. Our tour guide was Brett who was both charming and well informed. He took us through the history of Berlin and pointed out the various landmarks and their stories. It was a longish tour - 4 hours but the time just flew by. On Brett's recommendation we later visited the Topography of Terror Museum which was sobering and thought provoking. An excellent tour and at just £12.50 superb value too.

Darren was an excellent guide ! Lots of history but with the occasional tidbit that you would never know otherwise. He took his time , waited for us all to gather before he started speaking ! He gave us a great introduction to Berlin on lots of levels ! We would highly recommend this great tour !!!
We had Kyle. She did Awesome! Very knowledgeable. I learned more History in this 4 hour tour than I did 4 years in high school. Highly recommend.

This was a 4 hour walking tour which my wife and I thoroughly enjoyed.The guide was totally engaging with an obvious love for his subject.His depth of knowledge was immense and he answered every question posed by the groupI. Iwould highlyrecommend the tour to all.Francis and Carmel,Ireland.

I usually do my own, but this time as a part of history tour i decided to join a daily tour. Nathan was my guide and he led 30+ people very smoothly. It was a little hot on the day of my tour, but after a day I figured it was such a worthwhile tour. Nathan was a very informative and humorous and caring guide. I am now back in the states from the trip, and felt obligated to write a review on this tour because it was truly the best tour I've done throughout this year's trip. I would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to learn more about history of Berlin. Thank you, Nathan!
