Lynsey was great at communicating the most impacting aspects of Berlin history and was knowledgeable to answer all our follow up questions. This is a great tour for good coverage of significant events in the history of the city. Highly recommend.

This is the first time I’ve taken a group tour — usually do everything on my own — and it was fabulous. The guide Tobi was born in East Germany and shared stories from his childhood that really made all the sights come to life. He was very knowledgeable about Berlin’s history but also really entertaining and nice (i.e. called “Check Point Charlie” “Cash-point Charlie” and boy was he right!). He also provided valuable safety information. There are tons of gypsies around with clipboards ad/or dressed in costumes who pick your pocket. We watched others get approached and steered clear. This is a wonderful tour — you see all the major sites and have enough time to take pictures and/or figure out where you want to visit on your own. A LOT of walking so not for folks who are not really fit. I think I logged 5 miles when we finished.

Ken "The Legend" was our guide for the afternoon and what a guide he was! What he didn't know about Berlin wasn't worth knowing, he provided so much information about the various monuments, buildings, places and more! I guess we covered about 4 miles and it left my wife and I with a knowledge of Berlin we never expected in one afternoon. If you want an introduction to this wonderful city, this is the tour for you and getting Ken will be a bonus! (But he finds it difficult to pronounce his "h" 's as he's Irish!!)

This was an English spoken tour with a really nice guy, he briefed us on a timeline of Germany´s history that was quite useful as we walked and he explained us a lot of history in a very interesting way.
We walked quite a bit but was very well dosified so we did not feel it, also we took some more time because we needed it.
I really recommend this tour

Kai was a brilliant guide giving really good insight introducing you to both people and places throughout recent German history!

Great mix of war / Nazi information with a lot of other pieces about the Prussian origins and everything up to the fall of the wall.

Worth doing!
Brilliant tour and really interesting, definitely a highlight of our trip to Berlin. We had Ken as our guide who was awesome, very knowledgeable with a great sense of humour.

We were so pleased we booked this tour the first morning we visited Berlin Darren our tour guide was so knowledgeable and informative. The tour was set at a very comfortable pace with a 20 min break after a couple of hours. I would very much recommend this half day tour as it made the remainder of the holiday so much easier to navigate the city.

We really enjoyed the Discover Berlin half-day tour. A special shout out to our tour guide Phillipa (Pip), who was very knowledgeable & ready to take questions, clarify them patiently. The 800 year old history of Berlin is well covered in this 4 hour walk.Highly recommend this for tourists who love their history. Additionally this 4 hour walk is just about adequate to keep young children engaged. Comparatively a 6 hour walk may be a bit taxing & boring for accompanying children (personal view)
Very interesting and informative tour. Enjoyed the sense of humour of your guide. Highly recommended!

The Discover Berlin walking tour was quite interesting thanks to our guide Matti. He is knowledgeable and helpful. Not only he provided a wealth of historical background about the city, but he also shared the experience his family had living in East Berlin.
A great way to get oriented to Berlin’s main attractions. Tour guide Rick was terrific and provided an excellent historical overview.

Spent a great afternoon with our tour guide Lynsey, she was very friendly and informative. She walked us around Berlin and it was great hearing all about Berlin and learning about the various sites we visited. She encouraged everyone to ask questions and offered help and advice to everyone if they need to know anything to help them during their stay in Berlin. It is a great way to see the sights but more importantly to learn about them , the walk lasts about 3.5 hours but you do get a comfort break during that time. I would definitely recommend it.

Without doubt the best guided tour I've taken in any city; so much more than a been there, seen it, done it tour - thanks to Jess's knowledge, enthusiasm and obvious passion for relating the history of the city. An outstanding experience.

Kyle was exceptional, kindly and very well prepared, she does her job with passion and the four-hour tour is an excellent starting point for getting around Berlin and having the bases then to go deep in details what you like, raccomanded!

We only had one day in Berlin en route to Poland and wished to get an introduction to Berlin. This tour more than met our need with guide Kathryn exceeding expectation with interesting information. She has a European history background and is clearly passionate about Berlin. The four hours was perfect with a break after about 3 hours, highly recommend Hotel Aldon adjacent to Brandenburg Tor for the bathroom stop.

We took Rick Steves' recommendation from his guide book on Berlin, and took this English language walking tour with Ryan. Ryan is a Berliner by choice, and he was knowledgeable, entertaining, enthusiastic, agreeable, attentive, and passionate about his adopted city. We thoroughly enjoyed our time with him, and highly recommend it as a way to get a handle on everything Berlin has to offer. 5 out of 5, for sure.

Jim and Rhonda Musgrave, Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada

I thoroughly enjoyed this tour. There was so much substance. The tour guide (I had Maria) was entertaining and very knowledgable. She really brought history to life and gave a wonderful condensed "greatest hits." Highly recommend.

Rachel, as our tour guide, provided clear and concise history lessons as we walked through the major sites in Berlin. This was simply the best guided tour that I have experienced. She was not just well informed and intelligent but poignant and friendly. She made sure everyone was enjoying the tour. We had quite a large group but it felt like a private tour with her easy going nature and depth of knowledge. You might want to take notes about places to go visit in depth. She gave lots of tips about seeing Berlin and was willing to answer other questions related to visiting the city.

Rachel our tour guide made the four hour trip fly by. She’s really knowledgeable and shares her wealth of knowledge in an informal, relaxed and humorous style. Rachel’s passion for Berlin is infectious. At no point did it feel as though she was just going through the motions.

The tour takes in all the major sites you would want to have covered and gives you a good base to go further and explore in more detail at your leisure.

Jessie met us at the meeting place which was clearly marked nad we set off for a great 4hrs tour of Berlin Jessie knows his history very well and I feel we got a good and informative walk around the sights.
Jessie made sure we all had a great afternoon and could find our way home at the end of the tour

We had Rachel from L.A who gave a great tour. Very informative and knowledgeable speaker who gave a very personal tour, even though there was about 20 people! 3.5-4 hours long but the half hour break in between got us through it.

My son & I thoroughly enjoyed the informative tour brought to life by Jess. He is obviously passionate about Berlin's history, links everything together and certainly gave excellent value for money. Many thanks

We did the afternoon tour with the kids. It was really great. Our guide (Jonathan) was very good. He really knows the city very well and gave us a lot of great tips for the rest of our stay. He is also very good at getting the people involved during the walk. We saw most of the top attractions and found out the history around them. Bonus was the hidden history. Absolutely recommended.

Laura, our guide, seemed pretty knowledgeable of the sites we visited. The information parted was somewhat more detailed than what you can get from the Rick Steves Germany tour book. So, if you’re short of cash, just checkout that book from the library and us it for your walking tour. We walked a lot, but the terrain is very flat. FYI, with the exception of one site, the tour does not take you into any building. However, many of the sites visited are outdoor experiences.

So glad we booked this highly rated walking tour for our first afternoon in Berlin. Our guide, Nathan, was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic, leading us through the history of Berlin from its beginning as a river port through numerous wars and political upheavals to the present day. It really helped us get our bearings for the rest of our visit. 4 hours passed remarkably quickly, although the short coffee break was also welcome!

Wasn't looking forward to a 4-hour walking tour (my partner booked it) but I'm so glad we did it. I absolutely loved it - it was definitely the highlight of our trip to Berlin. Wouter, our guide was incredibly knowledgeable & friendly, was clearly passionate about the city, it's place in history and the way the city has tried to reconcile its past. We were really glad we were in his group.

Our tour guide was Dave - he was great. Clearly very passionate and knowledgeable about Berlin’s history. We only intended to do 2 hours as we felt 4 hours would be excessive but it was far too interesting and fun to leave early. First class tour, highly recommended. Thanks Dave! 🧔🏻

My friend and I are from Texas in the US and it was our first time in Berlin. Our tour guide Lynsey was amazing! She was so incredibly knowledgeable about German history and all the different sites we visited that we got to learn so much in just 3.5 hours. She was very welcoming and inclusive of everyone in the group and always available to answer questions. Highly recommend this tour!

Myself and my wife did this your at the weekend and it was excellent, our tour guide Nathan was knowledgeable and didn't bombard us with information but we still came away learning loads. We saw all the main historical sites in the city centres and at the price we paid was worth every cent and I couldn't recommend it any higher. We did it on our first day and it helped us get used to the city and gave us some ideas where to go in the following days.

My partner and I did the 3.5 hour discover Berlin walk at the weekend. It was amazing. Our guide Nathan was superb. The tour gave us an excellent grounding in the history of the city and was so informative and delivered in a clear enthusiastic way that it really was the highlight of the trip.

This tour was amazing value for money! Could not believe how much we got out of it for the price charged. Our guide, Jess was incredible. Literally he was like google on all things History - there wasn't much he didn't know about this place. His passion for his job came through and made the whole thing really enjoyable, always going the extra mile for out group . Our tour even ran for an extra hour because he went so in depth and above and beyond for us- which I really appreciated. 100% recommend!
We did a guided walk around Berlin. We did see the main sites but would have liked more facts and less of a comparison of fascism with communism. Our guide was Kevin,

For two people who have never been to Berlin, Justin's tour covered a vast amount of history of both Germany, and the city of Berlin. The walking pace was moderate with stops at important historical sites where he would give background and information about the site. There was a larger 20 minute break about halfway through which was welcomed.
For the price, the amount of history, historical sites, and tips we received on this epic walk about, it is one of the best tour values we've ever had. Can't recommend them enough!

Truly enjoyed this informative tour that is perfect if you don't have much time in Berlin, or just want to get an overview before you go deeper. Our guide Nathan was knowledgeable and adept at clearly explaining the history in an easy-to-listen to manner. Highly recommend! Great value for money!

Brilliant way to begin your first day in Berlin, very knowledgeable, friendly and interesting guide (Ryan) gave a brief and very interesting history of the city and went on to take us to key areas to illustrate.
Got some great advice on what to do next and how to get there and found some wonderful places that we would either never have seen or knew the significance of if Ryan hadn't pointed them out.
All in all a "must do" in Berlin. Brilliant and Thank you to put fantastic guide.

John from Cork (Ireland) showed us important highlights, memorials and historical darklights in the centre of Berlin. His comments were very appropriate, enriched with a certain kind of humour, which made the tour unforgettable. Four hours walking and smelling Berlin history - you shoudn't miss it.

Very informative, our tour guide Barnaby was excellent, very informative and enthusiastic, would recommend this tour to those who wanted a quick overview of the history of this beautiful city. Thank you

We did this tour today. It was rly nice and informative. Ken was rly good tour guy-he told us a lot of german history during this 4 hours tour. And he made this tour very interesting...we recomed this as a must on the first day in Berlin.
Great tour . Have clear explanation in each subject and also history . We were moving with enjoy Berlin environment. Will reccomend to the other

We took this tour on our first day in Berlin and were very pleased. A great way to get a feel for the city and learn some contextual information. Our tour guide Kyle was very knowledgeable and gave us tips on what to visit after the tour was complete. Would definitely recommend to other travelers!!

A few outstanding hours exploring awesome Berlin with this comprehensive, informative and fun tour. This tour simply gives you the best of Berlin while giving you an overview of its history and all its main sights as well as a taste of the local culture, jamming 800 years of history in just a few hours!

The tour was great (even if it was 1 degrees celsius and snowing for most of it). Kevin the guide was charismatic, and had a vast amount of knowledge on the history of Berlin. You see a lot of the main sites and it would also help someone get their bearings around this fabulous city.

We were fortunate enough to have Nathan as our guide during this half-day tour. He covered Berlin’s establishment to today with highlights from the Holy Roman and Prussian Empires, German kingdom, world wars, Shoah, Cold War, and we covered most of the major sights. I highly recommend this tour for first time Berlin visitors.

Really interesting tour- walking around Berlin, finding out the history and events that took place.
Was a lot of walking so definitely need sensible shoes, the tour guide was amazing and knew how to keep us all interested.

I went to Berlin last Fall and took this walking tour. My guide, Daniel, was phenomenal. He knew so much about the history and was truly passionate about what he was talking about. I could not have asked for a better tour or guide. Great use of time to see this wonderful city!

Our guide was Dave. He has an extraordinary knowledge of Berlin's history and an ability to bring it alive in interesting and fun ways. He gave us a list of recommended further visits and places eat and drink which will keep us going for several more trips to Berlin. Thoroughly recommended.

I always do walking tours when I travel and this was probably the best one I've ever done. Our guide Gregor was entertaining and informative, and we particularly appreciated how he presented the history of Berlin with different perspectives. This was 100 percent worth the money and gave great context to the sights we were passing. Only complaint is very small but the coffee break in the middle felt too long. The cafe was not big enough for our whole tour group, plus other tour groups, to fit inside and it was a cold day and some people had to wait outside. All in all though a great experience and we wished we had more time in the city to do another one of their walking tours.

Definitely recommend this tour on first few days for a visit, to get recommendations and ideas for a following days. Tour guide Wouter was funny and very knowledgeable, so we went to Sachsenhausen Concentration Camp tour as well.

Our tour guide Georgia was amazing! She is very passionate and knowledgeable about the city and is super fun to be around! The half day tour gave us a wonderful introduction of the city for our 5 day stay.

Even it was very cold, the 4,5 hours trip thru Berlin City Center with KAI in german was very informative and good. I learned a lot and KAI was able to give answers to very different querstions. Absolutely to be recommended.

Our guide was Laura, and she was clearly well informed and passionate about Berlin. Despite the cold weather, she maintained her enthusiasm and kept the walk enjoyable and interesting. The walk lasted four hours with a 20 - 25 minute coffee/toilet break. Probably ideal timing. We would highly recommend this tour.

Me and my husband went on this tour in Jan, and it was amazing! Darren our tour guide was knowledgeable and passionate about the history of the City and this was definitely the highlight of our trip!

If there is one thing you do whilst in Berlin and I would recommend this!

Darren - thanks for bringing our trip to life!

Me and my friend, both tour guides from Sarajevo, choosed paid tour of Berlin. It was cold day but Jess made it special. He mentiones that he is planning to visit Balkans soon, Serbia and Bosnia, and few days later, here he is.

I am glad to welcome him and his mother.

Whoever is visiting Berlin and want to learn history, JESS is guide for u.

Always ask for him..

Jess's tours of Berlin!

Went on a great walking tour of Berlin on Sunday! Nathan, our guide from Chicago, was very knowledgable and entertained us through four hours and hundreds of years of German and Prussian history. Great pace and he added a personal touch as well. At the end he gave us all a lot of tips on what to do next. If you're new to Berlin, I highly recommend you go on this tour, and make sure to go with Nathan!

We’ve taken a lot of walking tours over the years, and these tours are some of the best. Guides are excellent,tours are interesting and fun. They take you places that are off the beaten path as well as the standard sites. We’ve taken almost all of the tours in Berlin and Paris.

Wonderful experience walking amongst the history of Berlin. Our tour guide Charlotte was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the city she calls home which made for an extremely interesting tour. Would definitely recommend this tour!!

This tour was so interesting and informative. There is so much history to Berlin that a tour is a must. Jess was extremely knowledgeable and obviously passionate about the place. So despite the rain and cold, it was an amazing afternoon.

The Original Walks tour was absolutely brilliant. Covered all the places we wanted to see and a lot of those we didn’t even know we wanted to see! Excellently thought out with plenty of interesting stops and our guide Ryan was a wealth of information. All done with great humour and a really friendly, welcoming atmosphere. There were lots of recommendations of dos and donts and it was no trouble after the tour for Ryan to stop and chat and answer questions about bars/restaurants/shops/museums etc. He really went out of his way to make sure everybody had a fun morning. First class tour!!!

Our guide - Jess - led us through a great overview of the sites in Berlin's centre. He showed us at least two that we wouldn't have discovered on our own. He was extremely knowledgeable - every question was answered fully. He wasn't afraid to share his opinions, which helped give us perspective. And his opinions were nuanced and balanced. Recommended! (Just realize it is a long afternoon - four hours or so - there's a lot to cover!)

Nathan took us through the history of Germany from the begining. He was extremely informative and the tour lastwd almost 4 hours. He was happy to anwser all questions. Would highly recommend. Cost 14 euro.

A Fantastic and enjoyable way to start our 5 days in Berlin having read so much about the City from the 30's, I guess being born in 1946 the story about the ending of the war and some of the landmarks we have grown up with made our trip.
A young lady named Kyle was our guide and very well presented and guided us well

This was my first time back in Berlin in nearly ten years and my partner’s first ever visit. Ryan was able to give a good overview of a lot of history with some thoughtful comments and context. He answered questions with enthusiasm and great insight.

If you’re going to do this tour be sure to wear comfortable shoes! We were tardy to meet our group who left at 10:30 and wrapped up at around 3:00. You’ll mostly be walking and standing, Ryan did have us pause for a break part-way through for refreshments.

I completely recommend the service, it was thorough and enjoyable even on what began as a rather cold day

Our guide, Nathan, gave us a great tour around so many of the key sights in Berlin. Full of useful facts and information, all delivered in an engaging and entertaining way. I'd absolutely recommend this tour and Nathan and will definitely be looking to find time for some of their other tours when I'm next in Berlin.

Our guide Jonathan was excellent. Very informative and friendly. We were in Berlin for a long weekend so time was tight but this was the best activity we did in that short time. We learnt so much of the history, the culture and the hidden things you would just never see or realise were there by yourself.

I would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin.

Great tour, very informative and interesting both about local history and the main sights of the city. Ken was a great guide, good craic and super friendly and accommodating! Would highly recommend to get your bearings and for a nice day activity. Cheers Ken!

We had a great tour with Georgia! Georgia was really engaging and funny which meant learning about the history of Berlin was really interesting, making sure I would remember all the facts. You could tell that Georgia really empathised with the history of Berlin and that it meant something to her. Brilliant tour. Would definitely recommend.

I thoroughly enjoyed my walking tour and learnt a huge amount about the city. I really appreciated that it was explained in chronological order - a very clever way of structuring the tour. Our guide had a great charismatic personality and added a lot of personal stories into the tour which was great. Thank you for an awesome experience.
Kyle was the perfect guide. Really interesting and enjoyable, much better than juggling maps and guidebooks and trying to ‘do it yourself’!

Laura was an amazing tour guide despite only living in Berlin for less than a year. She was very knowledgable and interesting. I would highly recommend this 4 hour tour. I leant so much from this tour and it was a very emotional day. Only thing I would recommend after you do this is go back and checkout checkpoint Charlie again and then visit the wall with the graffiti on it.

Kyle was incredibly knowledgeable on Berlin's history and the gave broader context of world at war. The length and speed of the tour was perfect. Importantly Kyle was able to explain in terms that suited everyone in the group. One thing to note is that there are many more expensive tours but I doubt they gave anymore this was great value for money. Thanks for a fantastic tour Christine and Andy x

A really excellent start to our short stay in Berlin. We had Wouter as our guide. He was very knowledgeable and kept our interest with all kinds of information and stories that you wouldn't otherwise know. The pace was good, not too fast or slow. The introduction helped us decide what we wanted to know more about and where to go next.

Generally the guides have lived in Berlin for several years and many have degree level or higher historical knowledge. They are genuinely proud of the city and very happy to share that excitement for Berlin with guests.

Take a tour!

Thoroughly recommendable tour to take in the main sites in the correct order, and then know which ones to go back to. Our tour guide Ken was funny and knowledgeable and gave really clear and easy to understand explanations and was able to answer any questions we had. Very enjoyable.

Wonderful tour given by Kevin! So knowledgeable and explained everything so thoughtfully. Made his vast bank of Berlin history knowledge so accessible to us all. Thank you very much for making a cold February morning feel so warm. So interesting and a great way to explore this beautiful city!
This was a wonderful way to start a visit to Berlin. Our tour guide gave us great tips for places to explore on our own in more depth. Highly recommended!

This tour was an excellent experience. In the couple of hours we spent walking, we saw a good chunk of the city and learned a tonne about Berlin’s history. It is highly recommended for any visitor to Berlin!

The format of the tour was well thought out, as it managed to follow a chronological history of Berlin. The length was perfect, with a good break at the halfway point.

Our tour guide, Nathan, was very knowledgeable and entertaining. His anecdotes really brought the tour to life. He even had the scoop on the hours & rates of all the museums & tours we passed. From start to finish, he drained nothing but 3 pointers; when we asked why he took so many 3s, he responded, “Cuz you can’t shoot 4s.”

Our only regret is that we took this tour at the end of our trip to Berlin. This tour would be a PERFECT way to start a trip to Berlin as it highlights many places & museums worth visiting.

I attended this walking tour about a week ago whilst travelling on a top deck tour. This walking tour took place on a Sunday morning at 9am so you could imagine everyone would have been..not their best. However, Charlotte's lively energy and passion for the German history was very engaging and interactive and has everyone intrigued and participating. It was a cold day but she also took us to a great hot chocolate and pastry place which was lovely. I learnt so much that I never knew and saw some amazing buildings. There is so much history and I would highly recommend having a tour guide as insightful as she is to take you around Berlin! 5 starts for Charlotte! Kind regards, The Aussies

This trip was excellent from start to finish, tour guide Carlos was a very funny and intelligent. His knowledge is 2nd to none and he made this trip very worthwhile! You gain very important information about buildings and areas that you wouldn't by walking the streets yourselves. Highly recommend you take this tour

We went along this morning with Ryan who was an excellent guide. Not only knowledgeable about the basic history but could expand and answer any questions put to him.
Would definitely recommend to any family and friends.

Our guide was Jonathan. Despite the cold and rainy weather, we had a great and very informative tour with Jonathan. He was very relaxed and showed us around with pleasure. He was willing to answer any questions we had. Even though we were there only for 2 days, we are glad that we have taken this tour. With our excellent guide who was well up on Berlin, we were well informed about interesting places
We recommend it to anyone who would like to know Berlin in a short period of time.

We can highly recommend this informative and fascinating tour. Our guide, Jess has studied European history at Berkeley, California and is now studying at the Humboldt university so he certainly knows his subject. Jess is an excellent communicator and the whole tour was delivered in an accessible way with the use of visual aids and some humour. We had a few days in Berlin so doing this tour on the first day helped us to decide how to spend the rest of our stay. Jess was very helpful in recommending museums and places to visit and we were very grateful as they were all excellent.

Really informative walk that gave an over view of the city from its beginnings to present day. We walked all the main sites and Kevin our guide was fabulous. The right amount of social, political and economic history to keep us interested. Brilliantly done Kevin.
Visited 26th Jan 2018

Was a very nice guide and some things you would not notice otherwise or maybe not understand unless you are very familiar with the history, like the rooms containing empty rafts of books. If you have a few days you should take this tour.

We had a very good time with our guide Kai who told us everything and more about Berlin.
Very good way to start visting this city, without this you’ll probably miss many things.

Thank you, Kai!

It is a great way to start a visit to Berlin.

We had a great guide (Kai) that showed us the main things to see and gave a very good historical background to the city's history

I’ve just returned from a lovely weekend in Berlin made all the better for this tour! Our guide Kyle was fantastic, she was very knowledgable, friendly and helpful. The tour was really interesting and great for taking in a lot of the sights and learning the history. I would highly recommend this to anyone visiting Berlin!
As I was only in Berlin for a short time I found this walk very interesting and very helpful for when I visit again and have more time to explore. The guide was Johnathan, excellent!

Took the tour on first day there and got orientated and felt releaved to have seen a lot. I recommend taking this tour as our guide was good and the pace was right. A good way to know Berlin and enjoy it!

It was quite our choice to take part in Berlin Half Day Walking Tour. We were taken around all major sites : Checkpoint, Holocaust Memorial, The Brandenburg Gate. When we walked through the Holocaust Memorial it was something quite special as standing on the bunker. It is a lack of mercy if not mention about our guide (Sebastian). He made the tour memorable. He was such a informative, funny, passionate and articulate guide. Thanks Sebastian.
All in all - An excellent tour.
I would highly recommend this. A great insight into Berlin and it’s history. While being interesting and informative Kai was an excellent guide who was very engaging.

-Meet-up point was easy to find
-The tour stared on time
-Tour guide was excellent and very knowledgeable (can’t remember his name, however)
-overall great and would recommend
-dress warm if going in winter. Can get really cold

If you are on the fence about tours, give this one a shot. Very inexpensive and you will get so much more out of it compared to just walking around yourself. The tour guides will explain where your at and what you are seeing in detail. You won’t regret it.

We had Kai as our tour guide and he was a wealth of knowledge! We gained insight into some of the most interesting aspects of Berlin’s history and had answers to all of our questions. A brutally honest look into Berlin. We thoroughly enjoyed our tour, thank you Kai!

This tour should be an absolute must on your to do list when you’re out in Berlin. We took a 2pm tour with absolutely brilliant Gregor and quite honestly it was the highlight of our trip. From the vibe I got, all the tour guides are great, but if you’re lucky enough to get Gregor, then you’re in for a treat. It’s a good long walk so be prepared, and when we arrived it was utterly freezing but he was so animated and knowledgeable, with the right edge of humour, that it didn’t matter. You are taken around all the major sites and given an overview of the history of the monuments and landmarks and I was blown away. It was quite dark when we did the trip so the walk through the Holocaust Memorial was something quite special as was standing on the bunker. Our group was quite large but Gregor was incredibly attentive and answered everyone’s questions and collectively I know that everyone enjoyed it immensely and felt as though they a great overview of the city and history. A wonderful experience all around, definitely do this.

We took the Discover Berlin Walking Tour. It was the first time exploring the city, and it was excellent to get to know the main attractions in Berlin. Our guide Wouter was excellent. He knew a lot about the city history and we could learn a lot from the places we were seeing, which is way better than to just look at them by going alone. We had done some walking tours in other german cities, but this one was the best! Thank you Wouter!!
Darren was a fantastic tour guide. Very informative and thoughtful. Highly recommended if you want some knowledgeable insights into the city’s history.

Thanks Ken for a really informative and knowledgeable tour. Loved the way we just flitted between East and West culture, seeing all the best bits of this great city. A fabulous way to get a feel for the place and thanks for the recommendation of Father Carpenter. Superb.

This was our first time in Berlin and our first day exploring the city. This walking tour was excellent as it took in all the key sites of Berlin and enabled us to get an understanding of the geography, history and culture of the city. This tour is fantastic value for money.

Dave our tour guide from Australia was outstanding - he was so knowledgeable, approachable and thoughtfully answered all questions. His facts were not forced or rushed rather he gave in-depth and honest commentary. He really made this tour memorable with his personal touch. Thanks so much!

If this is your first, second or third time in Berlin we would be highly recommend doing this tour.

An excellent start to Berlin! Wouter was both personable and well informed and managed to convey the history of Berlin in an enthralling way - just the right amount of detail for everyone to absorb and set the scene and tone of each location. His Art history was invaluable in drawing out various monuments. Finishing on a positive note so we were not left mired in the War and post war period reflects his positive view of Berlin and its ability to rebuild from its past in its unified present. Would sign up for more walk with him any time.

Our guide, Pip, was really fantastic! She struck the right balance of information and humor to keep us going all four hours and at the end even stuck around to help everyone figure out their next destination. She did an especially great job using information she'd gathered while in Berlin to supplement multiple perspectives at every stop on our tour!
I did a walking tour with Ken on 30.12.17. He was very informative, passionate & easy to follow. It knew his history about the city & was happy to answer any questions

Greg was our guide, and he was fantastic. His degree in Art History shone through in the way he explained buildings, monuments etc. He was funny and explained things in a down-to-earth way. Would highly recommend going on his tour.

Some tours can be quite dull (this building is from x date, x meters high, x number of bricks etc)..... Not this one!
4 hours of funny, well researched fascinating info was given by our guide Matti. He had perfect English and a great knowledge and sense of humour.
I would recommend this to anyone to do on the first day in the city.

The teenagers were less than enamoured with the prospect of a 4 hour historical walking tour whereas I approached it with Beevor like enthusiasm.

I am pleased to report that Wouter got the tour pitch perfect beginning with a tour de force opening 10 minute treatise on the history of the city - no mean achievement.

We then did numerous stops through the museum district and the Government district hitting all the key spots. It was our first full day so the tour was an excellent scene setter in terms of what could be considered done and what is worth a second visit. The only place that seemed particularly busy was the Jewish memorial.

Wouter is extremely knowledgeable, passionate and articulate - a first rate guide.

All in all - an excellent tour.

Only nit - for our lunch break, we were pulled a few streets away to a so-so lunch place that is clearly favoured when our lot was craving a Starbucks. You can only have so much culture.

Thanks Wouter - will listen out for the podcasts.

Excellent guided tour.Very informative input from history student starting with very early (around 14th century)political historical background of "Germany"Input delivered in an accessible and sometimes humerous way with the use of low tech but effectivel visual aids.walking not onerous as plenty of stops including a toilet.coffeè/ break.Tour took all of 4 hours and for us could have been extended for another 4 without our interest flagging.and despite the freezing weather. Thanks Jess
Sandra and Gary
Comprehensive, informative, and we'll worth it. Wouter was a great guide and taught us much in a friendly and knowledgeable way.

on December the 27th we had a great your in east Berlin by Mattie! His English was impeccable and he added some humour as well as a personal touch to the tour along the historical monuments by adding some personal history. He really knew the ins and outs as he studied history. 4 hours was a bit too long since it was really cold but other than that; highly recommended!
Absolutely recommend this tour. 4hrs of history and exposure into the tale of Berlin. Stopping at all the key locations whilst maintaining a relaxed pace. Tour guide Wouter was brilliant.

I forget the tour guides name but he was a German man who's English was unreal. His knowledge of Berlin and it's history left me gobsmacked. He was so helpful and was happy to answer any questions. For someone who doesn't usually do these type of things, I had a fantastic time and would recommend this to anyone. If I ever visit Berlin again I would definitely do it another time.

Did a four hour walking tour with a well deserved coffee break in the middle. Was shown all the major sights - checkpoint Charlie, Museum Island, Holocaust Memorial, the Brandenburg Gate etc. Our tour guide was so informative and enthusiastic, learnt lots about the city. Definitely the best introduction to Berlin.

We recently did this tour with Jess. He was extremely informative and very pleasant as a guide. He controlled a large group of people very well. This was our introduction to Berlin and we learnt a lot from the tour that we could then go back and look at

Did my first ever walking tour and. I was very happy with it.........Rob Mc was the guide and every part of the tour was with a smile.....and also with some much knowledge. Made my trip to Berlin enjoyable

Based on reviews on TripAdvisor, we decided to try the Berlin half day walking tour. We haven't done walking tours before but found this one to be excellent value for money.

Our guide was Jesse who did a fantastic job to manage such a large group which must have been well over 40 people. He is a historical and has a passion for sharing about the city.

We met at Hackescher Markt s-Bahn which was easy to find and saw many sights including churches, Brandenburg Gate, Jewish Memorial, and Checkpoint Charlie. Fortunately the weather was good and sunny despite being cold (we did the 1030 tour). There was a break for a quick lunch in the middle which was appreciated.

Worth doing as we learnt a lot more that if we tried to do it ourselves, and got some good exercise as well!

Had a fantastic 4hr tour of the sights on a bitterly cold but beautiful sunny day. Our guide Jonny was a fountain of knowledge, good crack, funny and friendly to all of us in tour group. We managed to see all the historic and important areas of Berlin and finished of at gendarmenmarkt, went our seperate ways and enjoyed a welcome gluhwein and look around Christmas market. Our best day there.
Best 4 hours of our trip to Berlin. A passionate and erudite guide who made the city come alive and I'm sure infected us all with a desire to go back and study history. Thank you, Jesse!

Had a fantastic guided tour this morning with Jesse. It's clear that this guy knows his Berlin history old and recent and is passionate about the city. We loved the way he presented his tour ranging from humurous to sombre topics and the four hours flew by with us fully immersed. Not to be missed.

My husband and I booked online for this walking tour after reading the positive reviews . We had not been to Berlin before and wanted a good understanding of the landmarks and the history. This tour was perfect for us. Our tour guide Jonny is English and has lived in Berlin and conducted tours for 7 years ! His knowledge was thorough and he gave us lots of details that made the tour fun and memorable . The time went by quickly and the pace was appropriate . We had a large group of around 25 and Jonny made time to walk and talk to each person individually ( if they wanted) in between the standard stop points so everyone felt comfortable and informed . Thoroughly Recommdnded !

The guide for my tour was Laura. She did a great job, presenting herself openly, creating a very comfortable setting for the tour from the outset. She did a lovely job - despite the freezing cold and wet weather as well! I loved every moment of the tour, thank you very much! :)
Just back from a very informative and interesting walking tour. Our Guide Kevin really knew his stuff; I learnt a lot. The price for a 4 hour tour is very good value.

Our tour guide was Ysanne. Amazing knowledge and passion, giving you a different spin on things, making you think deep thoughts about the history of the city. The tour takes you to all the highlights, and the guide will give you all the interesting facts you wouldn't get if you visit each site on your own. Note that if you want to take pictures, you will have to be quick. Also note that if you take the afternoon tour in autumn or winter, it will be dark before you finish. But for some of the later attractions, that can add even more meaning to them. Worth every cent!
caroline was our guide and she certainly knew her stuff. very knowledgable on all aspects of Berlin never felt rushed was a great way to spend a morning in the great city.

My husband and I took this tour on our first morning in Berlin. It was a great way to start our trip. We passed most of the big sights, got orientated and learnt loads of the history from Jonathan who was really knowledge and engaging.

Definitely do this, even if like me you have been to Berlin before.

Went in October and accompanied by an Australian national tour guide named Dave who was extremely passionate and knowledgeable. He was a typical Australian with a relaxed and approachable manner.

Well worth a visit and a great way to spend 4 hours for not a lot of monies.

I was a bit nervous at first when Nathan introduced himself as being a native of Chicago and only living in Berlin a year. But very quickly his thirst for history came through ( he is a Masters History student) and over the subsequent 4 hours we got a fantastic insight into Berlin, its history and some off the beaten track sights to see. I plan to repeat it (hopefully with Nathan again) when I return to Berlin with my darling wife next time round. One observation : tour party was very large ( might have been 30 or so) but that did NOT impact the tour - all got a chance to hear him and all questions were answered.

We attended this tour on Saturday morning, not expecting too much as the price was significantly less than other tours we had looked at. What we received was a superb 4+ hours of engaging commentary on all of the key sites in the history of Berlin. Nathan our guide proved to be knowledgeable, funny but most importantly kept everyones attention and interest for the whole 4 hours. We originally wanted to do one of the 'war tours' but actually this one, that takes you from the origins of Berlin, through Prussia, WWII and the Cold War to modern day Berlin is perfect. Not so detailed as to bore people either. Went from the museum island, along past a number of palaces to the Brandenburg gate, to the Jewish memorial, checkpoint charlie and part of the wall itself, the site of Hitlers Bunker... amongst other features. Does include a short stop for coffee/ lunch.
Our party was very large (45) so it is testament to Nathan that a) he managed to keep everyone together and b) was engaging enough to prevent anyone from sloping off.
Highly recommend this - simply excellent and enriching. Such a great price too.

Our tour guide Will was amazing. Very informative explanations, very knowledgeable guy.
Tou took time when a drizzle was on and off, but we did not notice the precipitation. We were totally occupied by Will's stories.
We would highly recommend this tour and especially with Will

Our guide was Caroline, she had extensive knowledge of Berlin and German history and she had an extremely engaging way of sharing it.
The history of Germany an Berlin is at best difficult and often makes very uncomfortable telling but it contains many important lessons for us, Caroline led us through this dark and tempestuous wood with honesty and good humour, opening our eyes to the events that shaped a nation and the world and yes we at times had to think about what we were being told and consider how we felt about it. This was a great thing to do as to pass by some of these sights of a great city with out this background would be to miss the importance of the place.
So thank you Caroline.

We had our tour on Sunday 26th November with Kevin. There were a lot more of us than planned as some people had changed to the morning walk and some had missed their original walk. Kevin stated there would be usually someone around to help him, but he did a fantastic job on his own, even though we were a fairly big group.

Luckily for us the starting point was just around the corner from our hotel (Hotel Zoe) and started with some background history of Berlin and Germany in general. As we moved around the city we heard about the Nazi's, and the splitting of Berlin. The information was relevant and interesting, and Kevin had a brilliant sense of humour which made the tour even better.

We finished up by a Christmas Market (the most popular in Berlin) and I was actually sad it had ended!

I would definitely recommend this tour, as even though I'm sure many of us think we know a bit about Berlin, there is so much to learn and it was a great way of really seeing the city.

Would really like to thank Will, a future professor no doubt, for his humour, patience and great depth of knowledge of this beautiful city. Will has the kind of care for people and attention to detail that visitors to any city really appreciate. Highly recommend this walking tour - you could easily stroll past sites without realising their importance in history.

Peter, Alanna Stell and Sebie from Australia

Easy booking in advance on line, but some people turned up without and were made just as welcome. A good scale walking map was included which we used throughout our stay. Ryan our Scottish guide has chosen to live in Berlin and his enthusiasm and knowledge of German and Berlin history was huge so that he could answer and enlarge on any question anyone asked. We learned so much we then revisited the key sites he showed us to explore them further, and some museums inside, as the tour is a wonderful orientation for central Berlin.
The half way coffee stop at Checkpoint Charlie was much needed on a cold morning, as all the tour is outside.

We would highly recommend this walking tour as a very enjoyable way to find out about the history of Berlin whilst visiting the key sights. The time flew by and you don't realise how far you are walking (est. 5km) as it is at a relaxed pace whilst chatting and stopping for photos etc. Jonathan is very knowledgeable and managed to relay all the facts in an engaging, interesting and respectful way and he put everyone at ease with his friendly manner. Very good value for money.

I did the morning tour on Oct. 16. My tour guide was Lynsey. She was absolutely incredible -- the whole group thought so. She really brought the history of Berlin to life. She was enthusiastic, funny, and had great storytelling skills. Although I had walked around the city for a couple days by myself to get my bearings, it was the tour that really taught me the significance of everything I saw. For example, I had walked right by the square where the Nazis held their book burning without even realizing it. I had also missed the underground monument. This tour also allowed me to connect with other solo travellers, whom I hung out with afterwards. Luckily we had beautiful weather, which was just an added bonus. I am so glad I did this tour and had Lynsey as my tour guide!!

We decided to book this tour as it was our group's first time to Berlin and we all highly enjoyed it!

Our tour guide was Heidi, who we all liked very much! You can tell she is very passionate about the history of Berlin. She had a picture book to refer to as she was talking about different people/places which was helpful. We saw iconic buildings/locations such as the Berlin wall, Hitler's bunker, the Jewish memorial, the Brandenburg Gate (just to name a few), and learned more than expected of each.

We all felt that we went away knowing a lot more about the history of Berlin, and can't thank Heidi enough!

My first trip to Berlin is coming to a close, a great trip, definitely set off by starting with a walking tour, and with this tour company you get much more than a walk around! Over 4 hours with Will flew by, packed with his incredibly vast knowledge and brilliant teaching skills, (helped by his major in history!) we covered the complex history of this troubled (more than troubled at times) city and country, and related it all to the major sites of the place. We never felt under pressure to walk too far or too fast, of course come prepared in good shoes, and this time of year rug up! There was plenty of times to ask questions. And having spent the past couple of days with 2 of the better guide books, I know that Will took us to places and told us background information that the books just don’t have! Thanks Will!

Despite it being a freezing November morning, we had a great time being guided through 800 years of Berlin history by Will, a lighthearted and intelligent history PhD student from the US. He spoke clearly and with passion, keeping us engaged. Definitely worthwhile, especially if you're not as well versed in Germanic/Prussian etc. (I was decently, my partner was not). Just make sure to wear warm clothes depending on the season as you will be outside for awhile!

An excellent walk around a Berlin City Centre led by Wouter who was very interesting. He is very knowledgable, giving us an overview of the history of Berlin and how events in the past impacted to give us the present day Berlin. Oh, if only all history lessons were so interesting. Thank you Wouter, a thoroughly enjoyable 4 hours.

The overall experience with Original Berlin Walks was great. Booking online is easy and they offer a wide array of tours for you to choose. The meeting point is very close to Alexander Platz, and, therefore, really easy to get to. Our guide for the day was Merren, and she was absolutely amazing, full of energy, witty and very knowledgeable.

We booked in advance which was very easy and the meeting point is central and easy to find. Some people turned up on the day without booking in advance which seemed easy enough too.
Our tour guide was Beth and WOW she was literally amazing, best guide I've ever had on a tour anywhere. She is incredibly knowledgeable about Berlin and its history and in addition to this engaging and friendly. We had a large group of 45 or more, but she still managed to engage with everyone individually throughout the 4 hours.
The tour covers a huge amount in a short space of time which is great, we did the tour on the first day and then went back to some of the places we covered for a more in depth look around.
Have already been recommending Berlin and this tour to friends and family since I got home. Next time I am back in Berlin I will definitely give one of their other tours ago.

Best guidance ever into a city. Irishman Ken gave us so much info, full of humor!
My feet are exhausted, my heart is warm!
Will do,another tour next year with this group!

Jonathan, our tour guide, was soooo amazing! He knows A LOT about Berlin's history and he created such a great atmosphere with his sense of humor, conversation, and sharing a bit about himself. I truly recommend this tour since it shows you quite a few monuments/museums and the tour guides are excellent at recommending what to do/where to go next. It is perfect for a lone traveler, families, couples, etc.
Excellent tour. Beth was extremely knowledgable, entertaining and engaged well with the members in the tour. Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Berlin.

Very knowledgeable guide, in depth information about the city history and the monuments. It's mostly an 'outside' tour, no entrance to any of the monuments, but good to have an idea of what you'd like to visit afterwards. We walked about 5-6 km.
The guide had a degree in history, was native american English (might be a bit difficult if you are not proficient in English).
Highly recommend.

We went on this tour on our first morning in Berlin. Our tour guide Lynsey was excellent - very knowledgeable and engaging and happy to provide advice and tips. We learnt a huge amount from our tour which helped us to plan the rest of our stay.

We took the half day Berlin walk tour with Beth and she was brilliant. She was very insightful, had loads of knowledge about the city of Berlin and also each site we stopped at. I couldn't recommend this highly enough as it is the best way to see and learn about Berlin. Beth is more then happy to answer any questions you have (and can also recommend the best places of Berlin for a few drinks :) )

Our tour guide Tobi gave a really guide infulunce on a prespective of Berlin as an east and west and was really engageing and gave tips on how to spend the rest of our time in Berlin e.g. Do this, dont waste your money on this. Would definatley recommend this if you have half a day in Berlin.
Thank you Tobi our time in Berlin wouldnt be as enjoyble without going on this tour.
Izzy did an excellent job orienting a friend and I to Berlin. She has a engaging speaking style and was able to cover a lot of history and interesting facts in 4 hours.

带团的是个来自英国的男人，一整组人只有几个亚洲人，就是我本身，一个巴基斯坦女人和一个来自印度可是居住在苏黎世的印度一家三口，其他的都是来自美国、欧洲和澳洲的老外。

这个步行团从10点开始，大家搭火车一直走，导游的冷笑话让我冒汗，他问为什么在俄罗斯的超市全部东西都售完了？？ 因为everythingMoscow (must go) 🐧🐧🐧🐧🐧🐧 🙈 他说德国人很喜欢算，所以每棵树都有号码，天真的我还以为是真的，后来我问了问朋友，他说导游坑你们啦。。 🤦‍♀️🤦‍♀️ “我们德国人才没那么无聊” 途中他也随地拿起树枝说了第二次世界大战和东西柏林分裂， 最让我惊奇的是我后来参观的hitler's bunker 现在竟然成了carpark，平静的出奇。。 一代枭雄（不晓得这么称呼是否恰当）， 就在他的地堡（现在的停车场）自杀，而且在宣布战败之前，希特勒还举办婚礼，整个感觉很诡异。。 。 所以我没有拍carpark哈哈哈！ 导游也有带我们去最famous 的 charlie's checkpoint , 他说那是disney land 😂, 在那个checkpoint有两个兵士（演员，导游说他们是stripper😳) , tour guide 说都是假的，连checkpoint 的board也有语法错误哈哈哈哈哈！ 害我也不好意思拍，站着在我隔壁的巴基斯坦女人一直问我， isn't this an attraction point, why the tour guide never ask us to stop and take pic 哈哈哈哈哈！ 我心里os:假的假的, 为什么要拍。😳😳

后来我看到了柏林围墙（其中一部分），就是一个被篱笆围起来的墙，很讽刺， 因为以前这墙是为了防止东柏林的人去西柏林， 现在它却被礼拜围起来防止被别人破坏。。 我不敢靠近，我无法想象多少家庭、亲人、情侣被这道墙狠狠的隔离着，又有多少人命丧此墙。 这个walking tour有着 很多历史伤痕的visit，像是是holocaust memorial, 我穿梭那些concrete slabs 时真的很压迫。。 这是纪念第二次世界大战犹太人被杀的纪念碑。。

最后一站是在Brandenburger Tor ，这时候的我已经饿扁了，我根本没有留意导游在说什么故事哈哈！ 就随便拍照打卡赶着去找朋友吃道地的德国餐了。

当天我竟然不可思议的走了12KM， 远远超过自己在马来西亚1礼拜的步行量哈哈哈。

Jonathan was my guide. The tour was planned to help you see and learn about Berlin throughout Prussian beginnings through the Nazi era and the wars. All the sights have been made extremely interesting as Jonathan provided very good context so you'll be often prompted to put yourselves in the shoes of a Berliner living in a specific era, so you experience the particular site. I found his narrative moving and thought provoking. He was also very helpful, ready to provide tips on the particular site or the area. We were even shown where Angela Merkel lived and I was really surprised to know. I won't say it here because it'll be a spoiler. My favourite memorial is the one next to the Humboldt University. I needed something to show me the city quickly in half a day. This was perfect. If I had another day in Berlin, I'd love to sign up for the Nazi walking tour too.

Our guide Seb did indeed help us discover Berlin. We were only visiting for two days so the walk was an excellent introduction to the city and enabled us to see far more than we would have done on our own. Seb is clearly very knowledgable and has the enviable skill of being able to share some of his knowledge without overwhelming his audience. Thank you for 4 hours which we felt was very well spent.

This walking tour was excellent! I usually don't say that about tours and I don't give tours rave reviews. However, this tour was different. The weather did not behave for a walking tour. It was cold, raining, so spending 4 hours walking around a city didn't sound thrilling to me, but since my friend and I only had a limited stay in Berlin, we went. It was a great way to see the city and learn the history. Jess, our tour guide, was amazing! His knowledge of history made the tour. He didn't bore us with facts or make it seem like he had memorized a script, but told us the history in a way that made us interested in learning more about the city.

Our tour guide, Ryan from Dundee, was fantastic. He told us huge amounts of information without making it ever seem like it was too much, he linked things together very well indeed, and he had answers to almost any question. Worth every penny.

As a former tour guide myself I know a thing or two about it, but he was a master of the art.

He also gave us fantastic advice for a local foo market to visit which was one of the highlights of our trip - above and beyond the call of duty.

~3.5 hour walking tour of Berlin. Very informative & very entertaining, and took in loads of the sights. I got a lot from this tour - even though I've been to Berlin several times and in fact lived there for a while and know a fair amount of German history.
Our guide was Ken, Irish guy, who was great.

This tour is great for those who like to walk. We saw a lot but and had a stop halfway to buy a snack and drink and use the washroom. Kevin has an unbelievable amount of knowledge of Berlin. I would suggest you do this tour near the start of your stay in Berlin as you then can go and visit the museums and attractions that your tour guide will suggest. Highly recommend this tour! Mark
I went to Berlin three weeks ago and bought the ticket here. It was really good, especially for people want to experience the local history. I highly recommend this product.
Will was really awesome! He told us many interesting and funny stories. He definitely knows how to make a half-day walking tour super-intriguing and inspirational. Definitely recommend it!
